title: Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining
summary: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.
summary_zh: 类人全身操控技术已取得显著进展，使得策略能够协调移动、姿态、双臂交互及灵巧手部动作。与此同时，以自我为中心的视角的人类视频提供了跨物体与场景的多样化日常交互范例，无需机器人操作即可实现可扩展的监督信号。然而，现有来自这些视频的监督信号对全身运动及手-物交互协调的覆盖有限，而通过类人遥操作获取此类监督信号成本高昂且难以规模化。为此，我们探索人类经验如何支持类人移动操控的可扩展学习。为支撑该研究，我们引入了HumanVerse-500数据集，这是一个包含500小时多样化人类全身移动操控行为的数据集，采集自开放世界环境，使用轻量化可穿戴系统同步记录自我中心视频与身体及手部运动。基于该数据集，我们开发了$λ_0$——一个全身类人视觉-语言-动作策略，通过三阶段训练实现：首先从多样化自我中心数据集中学习交互，随后利用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后将策略适配至下游任务及机器人本体。在各阶段中，$λ_0$学习一个共享表示空间以支持人类经验迁移，同时领域特定接口处理人类与机器人状态及动作之间的差异。我们在SIMPLE及4项真实世界移动操控任务上评估了$λ_0$，取得了最先进性能，并进一步分析了其扩展行为、泛化能力及各训练阶段的贡献，以理解人类数据如何支撑下游全身类人控制。我们将公开代码、模型及数据以支持后续研究。
tldr: This paper introduces HumanVerse-500, a large egocentric human loco-manipulation dataset, and Lambda_0, a whole-body humanoid VLA model pretrained on this data to achieve state-of-the-art performance in simulated and real-world loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HumanVerse-500大规模第一人称人体全身操控数据集，并基于此预训练了全身人形VLA模型Lambda_0，在仿真和真实世界的全身操控任务上取得了领先性能。

title: EWAM: Emergent Depth-Wise Specialization in a Unified Embodied Model -- From Semantic Understanding through Visual Foresight to Action
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies emphasize semantic understanding, whereas world-action models (WAMs) learn predictive representations of environment dynamics. Systems that expose a policy to both sources often still concentrate action computation on a single expert. We present EWAM, an action-centric unified embodied model whose asymmetric joint attention lets action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action information at every layer while the perceptual experts retain their distinct roles. Without layer-wise supervision, EWAM develops an emergent depth-wise specialization: action queries attend mainly to vision-language features in shallow layers, to predicted future frames in intermediate layers, and to action tokens themselves in deep layers. This handoff replicates across tasks and is stable across denoising steps. Checkpoint tracking and causal interventions show that it is learned and that action generation depends on it. EWAM is pretrained in two separate regimes, one on cross-embodiment robot trajectories and one on human egocentric video. In simulation and real-robot experiments, it surpasses existing VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines. Human egocentric data improve both cross-embodiment transfer and real-robot robustness, and subtask-phase supervision improves long-horizon completion. Together, these results suggest that unified embodied learning can induce an ordered internal progression from semantic understanding, through visual foresight, to action formation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略强调语义理解，而世界-动作模型（WAM）则学习环境动态的预测性表征。将策略同时暴露于这两种来源的系统中，往往仍将动作计算集中于单一专家模型上。我们提出EWAM，一种以动作为中心的统一具身模型，其非对称联合注意力机制使得动作令牌在每一层都能读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来和动作信息，而感知专家则保持其各自的不同角色。在无需逐层监督的情况下，EWAM展现出涌现的深度方向专门化：动作查询在浅层主要关注视觉-语言特征，在中间层关注预测的未来帧，在深层关注动作令牌本身。这种交接模式在不同任务间复现，并在去噪步骤中保持稳定。检查点追踪和因果干预表明，这种专门化是学习得到的，且动作生成依赖于它。EWAM在两个独立机制下进行预训练，一个基于跨具身机器人轨迹，另一个基于人类第一人称视频。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，它超越了现有的VLA、WAM及混合基线方法。人类第一人称数据同时提升了跨具身迁移和真实机器人鲁棒性，而子任务阶段监督则改善了长时程任务的完成度。综合来看，这些结果表明，统一具身学习能够诱导从语义理解、经视觉前瞻、到动作形成的有序内部演进过程。
tldr: EWAM is an action-centric unified embodied model that integrates semantic, visual, predictive, and action information via asymmetric joint attention, developing emergent depth-wise specialization from understanding to foresight to action, and surpassing VLA/WAM baselines in simulation and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: EWAM是一种以行动为中心的统一具身模型，通过不对称联合注意力整合语义、视觉、预测和行动信息，形成从理解到预见再到行动的涌现深度专化，并在仿真和真实机器人任务中超越VLA/WAM基线。

title: SplineWAM: Adaptive Action Horizons for World Action Models via B-Spline Representations
summary: World action models (WAMs) are large embodied policies that jointly predict future video and the actions to execute, emitting a fixed-length action chunk per inference call. Such a policy allocates its computational budget uniformly in time, unable to execute for longer over free-space motion or to spend more inference on contact-rich manipulation, which limits the throughput a WAM can reach when served in the cloud. We present SplineWAM, which adaptively compresses the action trajectory into a fixed-size window of cubic B-spline parameters, fitting the knot times to the characteristics of the motion. One parameter budget then decodes into chunks of varying temporal resolution and duration, and both the executed span and the interval until the next policy call follow from the prediction itself. Aligning the video supervision to the fitted knot times of the demonstration rather than to a uniform grid concentrates the supervised frames where the action trajectory is complex. For asynchronous deployment we introduce Jacobian-Pullback Real-Time Chunking (JP-RTC), which imposes chunk continuity on the decoded raw actions the robot executes rather than on the spline parameters, and corrects the parameters through the decoder so that the executed prefix agrees with the actions already committed. On LIBERO-Plus and RoboCasa, SplineWAM improves success rate over an action chunking WAM by $8.2$ and $4.4$ points while cutting policy calls per episode by 22% and 26%. On three bimanual real-robot tasks under asynchronous execution, it leads or matches the baseline while decoding 1.2 to 1.6 times as much executed motion per call.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）是大型具身策略，能够联合预测未来视频与待执行动作，每次推理调用输出固定长度的动作块。此类策略在时间上均匀分配计算预算，既无法在自由空间运动中执行更长时间，也无法在接触密集的操作任务上投入更多推理，这限制了WAM在云端服务时所能达到的吞吐量。我们提出SplineWAM，该方法将动作轨迹自适应压缩为固定大小的三次B样条参数窗口，并将节点时间拟合至运动特征。由此，一个参数预算可解码为具有不同时间分辨率和时长的动作块，且执行跨度及下次策略调用的时间间隔均由预测本身决定。将视频监督与演示数据的拟合节点时间对齐，而非均匀网格，可将监督帧集中于动作轨迹复杂的区域。针对异步部署，我们引入雅可比拉回实时分块（JP-RTC）方法，该方法对机器人实际执行的解码原始动作施加块连续性约束，而非对样条参数施加约束，并通过解码器校正参数，使已执行的前缀动作与已承诺的动作保持一致。在LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa上，SplineWAM相较于动作分块WAM将成功率分别提升了8.2和4.4个百分点，同时每回合策略调用次数减少了22%和26%。在三个双臂真实机器人异步执行任务中，该方法在每次调用解码的执行动作量上高出基线1.2至1.6倍，同时保持领先或与基线持平的表现。
tldr: SplineWAM introduces an adaptive action-chunking mechanism for world action models using B-spline parameterization, allowing variable temporal resolution and duration that improves success rates and reduces policy calls on LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa, and bimanual real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: SplineWAM 通过 B 样条参数化实现世界动作模型的自适应动作分块，使得时间分辨率和时长可变，在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa 和双臂真实机器人任务上提高了成功率并减少了策略调用次数。

title: Magic-W0: A Structured World-Action Foundation Model for Physical Intelligence
summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned environment dynamics, yet existing approaches largely rely on future observation reconstruction or generic latent prediction and lack structured, control-oriented world representations tightly coupled with action generation. We introduce Magic-W0, a world-action foundation model that jointly models structured physical state evolution and continuous actions. Magic-W0 represents interaction as a Structured World Transition consisting of Current State, Transition, and Future State. Current State combines vision-language context with Current 3D Geometry; Transition is represented by 3D Motion capturing action-induced three-dimensional changes; and Future State is represented by Future Semantics describing task-relevant outcomes. To couple prediction and control, we propose a layer-aligned world-action interaction architecture in which evolving action hypotheses condition world-transition prediction, while predicted world representations continuously inform action generation. Magic-W0 is pre-trained on large-scale egocentric human manipulation, UMI, real-robot, and simulation data, with latent supervision for geometry, 3D motion, and future semantics from pre-trained visual models. Inference-time interventions show that structured world representations respond systematically to changes in candidate actions and that action-related information propagates through shared 3D representations into future semantic predictions. On RoboDojo-Sim, Magic-W0 achieves an average Score of 27.10, the highest among the compared WAMs. Across multiple real-robot tasks, it also demonstrates strong downstream performance after fine-tuning with limited downstream data, supporting generalization and rapid adaptation.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过动作条件化的环境动力学增强机器人策略，然而现有方法大多依赖未来观测重建或通用潜在状态预测，缺乏与动作生成紧密耦合的结构化、面向控制的世界表征。我们提出Magic-W0，一种联合建模结构化物理状态演化与连续动作的世界-动作基础模型。Magic-W0将交互表示为结构化世界转移，包括当前状态、转移和未来状态三个组成部分。当前状态结合了视觉-语言上下文与当前三维几何信息；转移以三维运动表示，捕捉动作引发的三维变化；未来状态以未来语义表示，描述与任务相关的结果。为耦合预测与控制，我们提出层对齐的世界-动作交互架构，其中演化的动作假设条件化世界转移预测，而预测的世界表征持续反馈至动作生成。Magic-W0在大规模自我中心人类操作、UMI、真实机器人和仿真数据上进行预训练，并利用预训练视觉模型提供几何、三维运动和未来语义的潜在监督。推理时干预实验表明，结构化世界表征对候选动作的变化产生系统性响应，且动作相关信息通过共享的三维表征传播至未来语义预测。在RoboDojo-Sim上，Magic-W0取得27.10的平均得分，在所有对比的WAMs中最高。在多项真实机器人任务中，Magic-W0在有限下游数据微调后展现出强大的下游性能，支持泛化与快速适应。
tldr: Magic-W0 is a world-action foundation model that jointly models structured physical state evolution and continuous actions via a layer-aligned architecture, pretrained on diverse embodied data and demonstrating strong performance on RoboDojo-Sim and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: Magic-W0 是一个世界动作基础模型，通过层对齐架构联合建模结构化物理状态演化与连续动作，在多种具身数据上预训练，并在 RoboDojo-Sim 和真实机器人任务上表现出色。

title: Discrete Forcing: Infusing Discrete Guidance into Continuous Denoising for Few-Step Action Experts
summary: Efficient action generation in vision-language-action (VLA) models requires capturing both coarse action structure and fine-grained details. Discrete action tokens provide compact structural representations but sacrifice precision, while continuous action tokens offer high precision but often require multiple denoising steps. We introduce Discrete Forcing, a flow-matching framework that combines these representations through an explicit coarse-to-fine generation process. It first predicts discrete action tokens to establish a coarse action structure, then uses them to guide continuous action refinement. The discrete and continuous components share a common diffusion transformer backbone with specialized branches, maintaining a parameter count comparable to a conventional single-branch model while requiring only one forward pass per branch. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster inference over a parameter-matched continuous action expert, with consistent performance gains as model capacity increases. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improvements on high-precision and dynamic manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 高效生成视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作，需要同时捕捉动作的粗略结构与细粒度细节。离散动作标记提供紧凑的结构表示，但牺牲了精度；而连续动作标记则提供高精度，但往往需要多次去噪步骤。我们提出离散强制（Discrete Forcing）——一种流匹配框架，通过显式的从粗到细生成过程将这两种表示相结合。该框架首先预测离散动作标记以建立粗略的动作结构，随后利用这些标记引导连续动作的精细化。离散与连续组件共享一个具有专用分支的扩散Transformer主干，其参数数量与传统的单分支模型相当，且每个分支仅需一次前向传播。在多个基准上的广泛评估表明，与参数匹配的连续动作专家模型相比，该框架在性能和推理速度上均有提升，并且随着模型容量的增加，性能增益保持一致。真实世界实验进一步展示了其在高精度和动态操作任务上的改进效果。
tldr: Discrete Forcing introduces a flow-matching framework for VLA models that predicts discrete action tokens to guide continuous denoising, achieving faster inference and improved performance in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Discrete Forcing 提出了一种用于 VLA 模型的流匹配框架，通过预测离散动作标记来引导连续去噪过程，在操作任务中实现了更快的推理速度和更好的性能。

title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, yet using it to train humanoid robots presents two challenges: (1) an embodiment gap, as human hands differ structurally from robot end-effectors and low-cost egocentric recordings lack the torso kinematics required by conventional retargeting; and (2) heterogeneous data quality, including noisy hand-pose tracking and weakly aligned text annotations. We introduce IronMind, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that uses egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot data to pretrain policies for humanoid dexterous manipulation. To bridge the embodiment gap, IronMind bypasses explicit body-retargeting by using a camera-space action representation, the native reference space of egocentric video, and semantically aligning robot and human action dimensions. Across total pretraining budgets from 250 to 10,000 hours, validation loss decreases approximately log-linearly with data scale. Larger pretraining budgets also improve out-of-distribution real-robot manipulation after post-training: across six challenging tasks with unseen objects, affordances, and reasoning prompts, the 10,000-hour model achieves a 55.0% success rate, compared with at most 11.7% for every pretraining budget up to 5,000 hours and 5.0% without pretraining. At the same pretraining budget, the camera-space action representation also outperforms the torso-frame baseline. Together, these findings support pretraining with a camera-space action representation on large-scale human egocentric data as a scalable foundation for humanoid robot manipulation.
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类视频为灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据来源，然而利用这些数据训练人形机器人面临两大挑战：（1）具身差异——人类手部与机器人末端执行器在结构上存在差异，且低成本的第一视角记录缺乏传统重定向所需的躯干运动学信息；（2）异构数据质量——包括含噪的手部姿态跟踪和弱对齐的文本注释。我们提出了IronMind，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用以自我为中心的人类视频及异构机器人数据进行预训练，为人形灵巧操作策略提供基础。为弥合具身差异，IronMind绕过了显式的身体重定向，采用相机空间动作表示——即第一视角视频的固有参考空间，并在语义上对齐机器人与人类的动作维度。在250小时至10,000小时的总预训练预算范围内，验证损失随数据规模近似对数线性下降。更大的预训练预算还能提升后训练阶段在分布外真实机器人操作中的表现：在涉及未见物体、功能可供性与推理提示的六项挑战性任务中，10,000小时模型取得了55.0%的成功率，而预训练预算在5,000小时及以下时成功率至多为11.7%，未经过预训练时仅为5.0%。在相同的预训练预算下，相机空间动作表示也优于躯干坐标系基准。综合这些研究发现，以大尺度人类第一视角数据上基于相机空间动作表示的预训练为范式，可为人形机器人操作提供可扩展的基础。
tldr: IronMind is a vision-language-action model that pretrains humanoid dexterous manipulation policies on large-scale egocentric human video using a camera-space action representation, bypassing embodiment retargeting and achieving significant gains in real-robot manipulation after post-training.
tldr_zh: IronMind 是一种视觉-语言-动作模型，利用以自我为中心的人类视频和相机空间动作表示，预训练人形机器人灵巧操作策略，绕过具身重定向，并在后训练后显著提升真实机器人操作成功率。

title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
summary: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.
summary_zh: 移动操作需要先精确导航至适合操作的位姿，再执行可靠的对象交互。这两个阶段在动作空间和视觉需求上存在差异，给统一策略学习带来了挑战。此外，收集带有明确操作就绪位姿标注的多样化真实世界导航数据仍成本高昂且难以扩展。我们提出了UniWAM，一种统一的多流世界-动作模型，分别为导航和操作设置独立的动作编码器与输出头，并共享同一骨干网络。该设计支持在独立采样的导航和操作数据上进行联合表示学习。UniWAM支持任一数据流的独立推理，也支持两流的批量并行推理。我们进一步引入了操作锚定位姿监督，用于确定导航停止位置及操作朝向。我们构建了一条自动化流程，从大规模三维场景中生成MAP-Data，共计超过150万个片段和7,500小时数据。MAP-Data提供逐帧目标物体边界框及图像平面上的MAP坐标作为辅助导航监督。结合用于操作的投影末端执行器轨迹，这些预测目标为从自我中心观测中进行动作学习提供了特定流图像平面监督。借助大规模MAP-Data，UniWAM在我们的MAP-Bench上相比最强外部基线在位置误差上降低了30.1%，在朝向误差上降低了44.0%。在24项真实机器人任务中，UniWAM在MAP导航和移动操作任务上取得了领先结果，操作性能也具备竞争力。我们已发布代码、数据和基准测试。
tldr: UniWAM introduces a unified mixed-stream world-action model for mobile manipulation, with separate encoders for navigation and manipulation and a scalable pipeline generating 1.5 million episodes of manipulation anchor pose supervision data, demonstrating significant improvements in real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: UniWAM 提出了一种用于移动操作任务的统一混合流世界动作模型，通过分离导航与操作编码器，并利用自动化流程生成150万带操作锚点姿态监督数据，显著提升了真机任务表现。

title: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
summary: We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.
summary_zh: 我们提出了ASENA，一个具身智能体系统，将通用编程智能体与机器人感知、计算、受控执行及持久经验相连接。智能体可以在保持模型权重固定的前提下，编写并执行程序、检查记录结果、修复失败，并复用笔记与可执行技能。我们还进一步引入了ASENA-VLN，一个4B单目导航策略，作为该可编程系统中的可选工具。ASENA-VLN利用共享的视觉-语言解码器，预测扩展路线与短时行为中的机体坐标系轨迹，该解码器基于路线指令、视觉问答以及一个由几何推导的原子导航任务组成的新数据集进行训练。作为独立策略，ASENA-VLN在R2R上实现了68.7%的成功率，在RxR上达到70.2%，均达到当前最优水平。当与编程智能体集成时，学习到的导航能力在两个智能体基准上将ASENA的成功率提升了11个百分点，同时减少了执行时间。通过持久工作区的演化和模拟器反馈，在重复的100任务子集上迭代十次，进一步将R2R上的成功率从72%提升至98%，RxR上从65%提升至89%。在具身视觉问答任务中，ASENA以更少的交互步骤取得了当前最优的准确率。最后，在Unitree G1上的真实世界演示将搜索、视觉检测、空间推理与合成手势结合，且无需预建地图，展示了在线编程如何将机器人行为扩展到路线跟随与预定义技能之外。
tldr: ASENA introduces a self-evolving embodied agent system that connects coding agents to robot sensing and execution, with a 4B monocular VLN policy achieving state-of-the-art success on R2R and RxR and large improvements through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback.
tldr_zh: ASENA提出了一个自进化的具身智能体系统，将编程智能体与机器人感知和执行连接起来，其4B单目VLN策略在R2R和RxR上取得了SOTA成功率，并通过持续工作区进化和模拟器反馈大幅提升性能。

title: Blackout vs. Freeze: Analyzing Physical Failure Modes of VLAs under Camera Faults
summary: Unreliable visual inputs can harm task performance and cause potential physical safety risks for vision-language-action (VLA) models. We analyze how $π0.5$ and GR00T models act under input faults such as image blackouts and freezing. We find that blackout and freezing produce distinct physical failure modes even when task-success rates are similarly low: freezing causes more extreme joint behavior, whereas blackout after gripper closure can cause more object drops, most markedly without proprioception. Selective intervention studies reveal that proprioception (current robot state) partly compensates for the removed robot depictions and reduces non-target contact. However, it cannot sufficiently restore task success when wrist-view object information is removed, even when aided by the remaining scene view. We then evaluate two mitigation approaches: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings. Both improve task success in selected conditions, but can increase unintended contact or disturbance to surrounding objects. Real-robot trials further show that successful execution under camera faults can still involve unintended physical interactions. These findings motivate designing VLA policies that use the robot and object information still available under camera faults to limit hazardous motion.
summary_zh: 不可靠的视觉输入会损害视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的任务性能，并可能带来潜在的身体安全风险。我们分析了 $π0.5$ 和 GR00T 模型在图像黑屏和冻结等输入故障下的行为表现。研究发现，即使任务成功率同样较低，黑屏和冻结也会产生不同的物理失效模式：冻结会导致更极端的关节行为，而夹爪闭合后的黑屏则可能导致更多物体掉落，尤其是在缺乏本体感觉的情况下尤为明显。选择性干预研究表明，本体感觉（当前机器人状态）在一定程度上补偿了机器人图像被移除所带来的信息缺失，并减少了非目标接触。然而，当腕部视角的物体信息被移除时，即使有剩余场景视角的辅助，本体感觉也无法充分恢复任务成功率。随后，我们评估了两种缓解方法：摄像头黑屏训练和无训练式的故障视觉嵌入替换。两种方法在特定条件下均能提高任务成功率，但可能增加意外接触或对周围物体的干扰。真实机器人实验进一步表明，在摄像头故障下成功执行任务仍可能涉及意外的物理交互。这些发现提示，在设计 VLA 策略时应利用摄像头故障下仍然可用的机器人和物体信息，以限制危险运动。
tldr: This paper analyzes how vision-language-action (VLA) models fail physically under camera faults like blackouts and freezing, identifying distinct failure modes and evaluating mitigation strategies that can increase unintended interactions.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在摄像头故障（如黑屏和冻结）下的物理失效模式，识别了不同的失效模式，并评估了可能增加意外交互的缓解策略。

title: SteerQuant: Steering Quantization Error with Action-Guided Scaling in World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future world states and actions through iterative denoising, using shared weights to process heterogeneous semantic streams of video, proprioceptive, and action tokens. Quantization reduces inference cost, but comparable numerical errors in different streams can have markedly different effects on final actions, making numerical accuracy alone insufficient for reliable control. We introduce SteerQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework for WAMs that steers errors toward computations with less influence on final actions. It maps how each stream's quantization errors affect final actions and uses this map to guide shared channel scaling. Activation scaling is further calibrated for each stream and denoising step to accommodate changes in activation ranges and action impact. This adapts quantization to different stream requirements without duplicating weights or increasing bit-widths for selected streams. To reduce the extra kernel launches and memory traffic introduced by scaling, we develop Rudder, a 4-bit inference engine for WAMs that fuses scaling and output compensation into low-bit kernels. Under W4A8 and W4A4, SteerQuant maintains mean LIBERO success within 0.8 percentage points of full precision, while delivering up to $2.23\times$ denoising speedup over BF16 across three WAMs with reduced peak GPU memory usage. On a real dual-arm robot, W4A8 deployment achieves a $1.35\times$ end-to-end inference speedup while maintaining average task success relative to BF16.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过迭代去噪联合生成未来世界状态和动作，使用共享权重处理视频、本体感觉和动作标记等异构语义流。量化降低了推理成本，但不同流中数值上相当的误差可能对最终动作产生显著不同的影响，这使得仅凭数值精度不足以实现可靠控制。我们提出SteerQuant，一种面向WAMs的4比特量化框架，将误差引导至对最终动作影响较小的计算中。该框架绘制了各流量化误差对最终动作的影响图谱，并利用该图谱指导共享通道缩放。激活缩放进一步针对每个流和去噪步骤进行校准，以适应激活范围及动作影响的变化。这使得量化能够适应不同流的需求，而无需复制权重或增加选定流的位宽。为减少缩放引入的额外内核启动和内存流量，我们开发了Rudder，一种面向WAMs的4比特推理引擎，将缩放和输出补偿融合到低比特内核中。在W4A8和W4A4设置下，SteerQuant使平均LIBERO成功率保持在全精度的0.8个百分点以内，同时在三个WAMs上相较于BF16实现了高达$2.23\times$的去噪加速，并降低了峰值GPU内存占用。在实际双机械臂机器人上，W4A8部署实现了$1.35\times$的端到端推理加速，同时相对于BF16保持了平均任务成功率。
tldr: SteerQuant introduces a 4-bit quantization framework for world-action models that steers quantization errors away from action-critical computations, achieving near-full-precision LIBERO success with significant inference speedups on real robots.
tldr_zh: SteerQuant 提出了一种针对世界动作模型的 4 位量化框架，将量化误差引导至对最终动作影响较小的计算，在真实机器人上实现了接近全精度的 LIBERO 成功率并显著加速推理。

title: Looking Back to Move Forward: Temporal Verification for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative policies have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, combining expressive generative action modeling with scalable imitation learning from large demonstration corpora. However, heterogeneous demonstrations can induce suboptimal action chunks whose errors compound over time, eventually driving the robot into out-of-distribution states from which recovery is difficult. Action verification offers a test-time scaling strategy for mitigating this failure mode by sampling multiple candidate actions and using a verifier to select one for execution. Existing approaches, however, remain temporally myopic and costly to train, evaluating candidates from the current observation alone without accounting for trajectory continuity and often relying on large verifiers and additional expert demonstrations. In this paper, we introduce Temporal Verification (TeV), an efficient temporally aware action verification framework for flow-matching VLAs. TeV first learns a temporal token that summarizes recent observation--action history, enabling candidate chunks to be evaluated as continuations of the execution trajectory rather than as isolated predictions. Conditioned on this token, TeV constructs positive--negative pairs without additional expert demonstrations or preference annotations and trains an energy-based verifier contrastively to assign lower energy to higher-quality, trajectory-consistent action chunks. Beyond post-hoc ranking, TeV further uses the learned energy landscape to guide intermediate flow samples toward lower-energy regions, improving candidates before final selection. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that TeV provides reliably ranks action candidates, improves task success rates, and produces smoother execution trajectories.
summary_zh: 生成式策略已成为机器人学习的一种有前景的范式，它将表达性生成动作建模与从大规模示范语料库中进行的可扩展模仿学习相结合。然而，异构示范可能导致次优动作片段，其误差随时间累积，最终将机器人推入难以恢复的分布外状态。动作验证提供了一种测试时扩展策略，通过采样多个候选动作并利用验证器选择一个执行，以缓解此类失效模式。然而，现有方法在时间上仍较为短视且训练成本高昂，仅从当前观测评估候选动作，未考虑轨迹连续性，且通常依赖大型验证器和额外专家示范。本文提出时间验证（Temporal Verification, TeV），一种面向流匹配视觉语言动作模型的高效时间感知动作验证框架。TeV首先学习一种时间令牌，用于概括最近的观测-动作历史，从而使候选片段能够作为执行轨迹的延续而非孤立预测进行评估。以该令牌为条件，TeV构建正负样本对，无需额外专家示范或偏好标注，并以对比方式训练基于能量的验证器，为更高质量、轨迹一致的动作片段分配更低能量。在事后排序之外，TeV进一步利用学习到的能量地形引导中间流样本向低能量区域移动，在最终选择前改进候选动作。在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验表明，TeV能够可靠地对动作候选进行排序，提升任务成功率，并生成更平滑的执行轨迹。
tldr: This paper proposes Temporal Verification (TeV), a temporally aware action verification framework for flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which learns a temporal token to evaluate candidate action chunks as trajectory continuations and uses contrastively trained energy-based verifier to rank and refine actions, improving task success and trajectory smoothness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出时序验证（TeV）框架，针对流匹配VLA模型，通过时序token总结历史动作，对比学习能量验证器对候选动作片段进行连续性评估与优化，显著提升任务成功率与轨迹平滑性。

title: DrivingBench: Can Vision-Language Models Drive a Toyota Corolla?
summary: Frontier models excel at many digital benchmarks, yet their ability to drive a real car, an everyday human skill, remains largely untested. We present DrivingBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car. Through three tools, the models see camera frames from a Toyota Corolla and directly command its steering and velocity around a parking lot cone course at low speeds. The car may continue moving while the model thinks and new commands replace the currently running one, so inference latency is part of the task, testing the models' abilities to observe, act, monitor, recover, and complete a long-horizon objective under such constraints. We benchmark GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Grok 4.6 in vendor-native harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) with up to three attempts each in one conversation; Astra is the only model to finish the course, on its second attempt, with no other attempt passing 50% of the course. Two of the four models improved materially across attempts with retained context. We also detail the design principles behind our action interface, and show how the tool output format and the framing of the task combined to determine whether models would drive at all or refuse. We release our harness, prompts, course map, and traces with video and telemetry for reproducibility.
summary_zh: 前沿模型在众多数字基准测试中表现出色，但其驾驶真实汽车的能力——一项日常人类技能——在很大程度上仍未得到检验。我们提出DrivingBench，据我们所知，这是首个要求通用视觉语言模型驾驶真实汽车的基准测试。通过三种工具，模型可获取丰田卡罗拉车载摄像头的画面，并直接控制其转向和速度，在低速情况下绕行停车场锥桶赛道。模型在思考期间车辆可继续行驶，新指令会替换当前正在执行的指令，因此推理延迟本身即为任务的一部分，考验模型在观察、行动、监控、恢复以及完成长期目标等方面的能力，且需在如此约束条件下进行。我们在供应商原生的工具链（Codex、Claude Code、Cursor）中对GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-5.6 Sol和Grok 4.6进行了基准测试，每个模型在同一对话中最多尝试三次；Astra是唯一完成赛道的模型，且在第二次尝试中成功，其他所有尝试均未通过赛道的50%。四个模型中有两个在保留上下文的情况下，随尝试次数增加取得了实质性进步。我们还详细阐述了我们动作接口背后的设计原则，并展示了工具输出格式与任务框架如何共同决定模型是会真正驾驶，还是会拒绝执行。我们公开了工具链、提示词、赛道地图以及带有视频和遥测数据的轨迹记录，以供复现。
tldr: DrivingBench is a benchmark that tests general-purpose vision-language models on real driving in a Toyota Corolla on a parking lot cone course, finding that only GPT-6 Astra can complete the course, highlighting the gap between digital and real-world driving abilities.
tldr_zh: DrivingBench是一个基准测试，用于测试通用视觉语言模型在丰田卡罗拉上于停车场锥桶赛道进行真实驾驶的能力，结果显示只有GPT-6 Astra能完成赛道，凸显了数字与真实世界驾驶能力之间的差距。

title: BIND: Binding 3D Robot Actions to 2D Image Features
summary: We introduce BIND, a new action representation for visuomotor robot policies that binds 3D robot actions to their corresponding 2D image features, yielding strong data efficiency gains and robustness to out-of-distribution object positions and camera viewpoints. The action heads of current robot policies are typically formulated as an MLP regression from a single global feature vector produced by a pre-trained vision encoder. This global formulation requires the policy network to discover, from demonstrations alone, the relationship between target robot actions and the image features they project onto. The consequence is that although modern image features are semantically descriptive, spatially robust, and even multiview-consistent, the policies built on them are brittle to subtle changes in camera viewpoint and object placement--and surprisingly data-inefficient. BIND closes this gap by supplying the action-feature relationship through camera geometry rather than learning: it discretizes a volume of candidate end effector positions, attaches each candidate to the pre-trained features at its projection in each camera view, and selects actions by scoring each candidate's position and image-bound feature combination. On a real robot, we study data efficiency and out-of-distribution robustness to unseen object positions and camera viewpoints, as well as general long-horizon task execution and dexterity. We find BIND to be highly data-efficient and robust: it achieves near-perfect success on tasks with as few as 5 demonstrations, and degrades gracefully under steep camera-viewpoint shifts and held-out object positions where coordinate-regression baselines completely fail.
summary_zh: 我们提出了BIND，一种用于视觉运动机器人策略的新型动作表示方法，将3D机器人动作与其对应的2D图像特征绑定，从而在数据效率和对外分布物体位置及相机视角的鲁棒性方面取得显著提升。当前机器人策略的动作头通常构建为从预训练视觉编码器生成的单一全局特征向量进行MLP回归。这种全局公式要求策略网络仅从示范中自行发现目标机器人动作与其所投影的图像特征之间的关系。其结果是，尽管现代图像特征在语义上具有描述性、空间上具有鲁棒性，甚至具备多视角一致性，但基于这些特征构建的策略在相机视角和物体位置的细微变化下表现脆弱——且数据效率出人意料地低下。BIND通过相机几何而非学习来提供动作-特征关系，弥合了这一差距：它将候选末端执行器位置的体积离散化，将每个候选点附着在其在每个相机视图中的投影处的预训练特征上，并通过评分每个候选点的位置和图像绑定特征组合来选择动作。在真实机器人上，我们研究了数据效率、对未见物体位置和相机视角的外分布鲁棒性，以及一般的长时程任务执行和灵巧性。我们发现BIND具有高度的数据效率和鲁棒性：它在仅5次示范的任务上即可实现近乎完美的成功率，并且在陡峭的相机视角偏移和保留的物体位置下优雅地退化，而坐标回归基线在这些情况下完全失败。
tldr: BIND introduces a new action representation that binds 3D robot actions to 2D image features via camera geometry, improving data efficiency and robustness to viewpoint and object position changes in real robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: BIND提出了一种新的动作表示，通过相机几何将3D机器人动作与2D图像特征绑定，在真实机器人操作中提高了数据效率和对于视点与物体位置变化的鲁棒性。

title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
summary: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.
summary_zh: 三维装配任务要求将对于零部件及其相互关系的理解转化为精确的空间排布。预训练的通用智能体能否在没有额外装配专项微调的情况下，通过视觉交互完成物体装配？为探究这一问题，我们提出了AssemblyWorld——一个交互式三维环境，智能体在其中检视渲染视图、操作所提供的刚性零件，并在可用时依据图像或装配手册获得引导。智能体通过二维视图感知零件几何形状，而非直接获取网格顶点或面片信息，其最终的装配结果则通过几何方式进行评估。基于该环境，我们构建了AssemblyWorldBench，包含跨越家具、工业装配和断裂复原三大类别的80个物体上的100项装配任务。对八种智能体系统的评估揭示了其能力上的显著差异。表现最强的系统达到80.9%的零件准确率，但完整装配成功率仅为59.4%。所评估的开源系统在执行可靠性和装配精度两方面均大幅落后于其更强大的闭源同类系统。对视觉参考、交互轨迹及失败案例的分析展示了智能体如何修正装配过程，同时仍残留定位误差。AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配智能体的能力，以及刻画近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距，提供了一个统一的评测平台。
tldr: AssemblyWorld introduces an interactive 3D assembly benchmark and environment where agents assemble objects from 2D views using pretrained general-purpose vision-language models without assembly-specific fine-tuning, evaluating 8 closed- and open-source agent systems and revealing a significant performance gap.
tldr_zh: AssemblyWorld 提出了一个交互式 3D 装配基准和环境，要求智能体仅通过 2D 视图操作零件，在不进行专门微调的情况下完成装配任务，并评估了 8 个闭源和开源智能体系统，揭示了显著的性能差距。

title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
summary: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类数据为机器人学习提供了可扩展的经验来源，但在人机对齐、行为覆盖范围及可用监督信息方面存在显著差异。已有研究显示，增加人类数据量可带来有利的性能提升，但究竟哪些数据属性驱动了下游机器人的性能增益，以及如何在训练流程中有效利用此类数据，仍不明确。我们在统一的世界-动作模型框架下，对不同对齐程度和监督信息下的自我中心人类数据进行了系统性研究。在固定模型主干的情况下，我们分别考察了人机对齐、数据时长与任务多样性、动作监督及数据使用策略各自的影响。研究发现：对齐的人类示范显著提升了分布外泛化能力，并降低了对目标任务机器人数据的需求；数据时长与任务多样性对下游能力的影响各不相同；仅含视频的监督即便没有动作标签依然有效，为后续的视频-动作联合训练奠定了坚实基础。我们通过在真实机器人和RoboDojo平台上的闭环策略评估验证了上述发现。Ego4WAM表明，不应仅将数据时长视为唯一的扩展维度，对齐程度、任务多样性、可用监督信息及使用策略共同决定了自我中心人类数据对机器人学习的价值。
tldr: This paper systematically studies how different properties of egocentric human data—such as human-robot alignment, duration, task diversity, and action supervision—affect robot learning within a unified world-action model framework, finding that aligned demonstrations improve generalization and reduce robot data needs.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究了第一人称人类数据的不同属性（如人机对齐、时长、任务多样性和动作监督）如何在统一的世界-动作模型框架下影响机器人学习，发现对齐的示范能改善泛化并减少机器人数据需求。

title: DynaHarness: A Dynamic Physical Harness for Self-Evolving Robot Agents
summary: Pretrained robot policies provide useful action priors, but long-horizon manipulation still requires coordination between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Semantic reasoning operates at a coarser timescale than physical interaction, while episode-level failures provide limited guidance on which system component should be revised. We propose DynaHarness, a dynamic physical harness that couples semantic reasoning with physical governance through a shared execution contract and turns failure evidence into validated capability revisions. To be more specific, the slow brain proposes capabilities and symbolic arguments, while the fast brain grounds and monitors commands, refuses unresolved actions, substitutes capabilities, and requests replans when needed. The physical execution contract bounds each accepted command and records execution evidence across analytic skills, recovery skills, and the frozen VLA. Failure attribution localizes faults in these records and directs targeted revisions of reusable capabilities or execution mechanisms. Paired regression checks govern admission or rejection, closing the self-evolution loop. On LIBERO-Pro, DynaHarness achieves 75.2% on 800 newly sampled initial states, compared with 17.5% for the frozen policy. With the same capability library, full dynamic execution reaches 74.0% versus 63.9% under nominal one-step replanning. This demonstrates the value of DynaHarness as a dynamic physical harness that governs how existing capabilities are grounded, monitored, and coordinated during execution. Our project page is at https://denghaoyuan123.github.io/Dynaharness_page/.
summary_zh: 预训练机器人策略提供了有用的动作先验，但长时程操作仍需在语义推理与物理执行之间进行协调。语义推理的时间尺度粗于物理交互，而回合级失败对应当修订哪个系统组件所提供的指导有限。我们提出DynaHarness，一种动态物理管控框架，通过共享执行契约将语义推理与物理治理耦合，并将失败证据转化为经过验证的能力修订。具体而言，慢速大脑提出能力与符号参数，而快速大脑负责落地与监控指令、拒绝未解析动作、替换能力，并在必要时请求重新规划。物理执行契约为每个被接受的指令设定边界，并在分析技能、恢复技能及冻结的VLA中记录执行证据。失败归因在这些记录中定位故障，并指导对可复用能力或执行机制的定向修订。成对回归检查掌控能力的接纳或拒绝，从而闭合自进化回路。在LIBERO-Pro上，DynaHarness在800个新采样的初始状态下达到75.2%的成功率，而冻结策略仅为17.5%。使用相同能力库，完整动态执行达到74.0%，优于名义单步重规划的63.9%。这表明DynaHarness作为动态物理管控框架的价值，能够治理既有能力在执行过程中的落地、监控与协调。我们的项目页面位于https://denghaoyuan123.github.io/Dynaharness_page/。
tldr: DynaHarness introduces a dynamic physical harness that couples semantic reasoning with physical governance via a shared execution contract, enabling self-evolving robot policies through failure attribution and capability revision. It improves long-horizon manipulation success rates on LIBERO-Pro from 17.5% to 75.2%.
tldr_zh: DynaHarness 提出了一种动态物理约束机制，通过共享执行契约将语义推理与物理控制耦合，并利用失败归因和能力修订实现机器人策略的自我进化。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，长时程操作成功率从 17.5% 提升至 75.2%。

title: STARS: From Spatiotemporal Dynamics to Social Representations in Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Robot navigation in dynamic, human-centered environments requires socially-compliant decisions grounded in robust scene understanding. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising capabilities such as object recognition, common-sense reasoning, and contextual understanding, capabilities that align with the nuanced requirements of social robot navigation. However, it remains unclear whether VLMs can accurately understand complex social navigation scenes (e.g., inferring the spatial-temporal relations among agents and human intentions), which is essential for safe and socially compliant robot navigation. While some recent works have explored the use of VLMs in social robot navigation, no existing work systematically evaluates their ability to meet these necessary conditions. In this paper, we introduce the Social Navigation Scene Understanding Benchmark (SocialNav-SUB), a Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs for scene understanding in real-world social robot navigation scenarios. SocialNav-SUB provides a unified framework for evaluating VLMs against human and rule-based baselines across VQA tasks requiring spatial, spatiotemporal, and social reasoning in social robot navigation. Through experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that while the best-performing VLM achieves an encouraging probability of agreeing with human answers, it still underperforms simpler rule-based approach and human consensus baselines, indicating critical gaps in social scene understanding of current VLMs. Our benchmark sets the stage for further research on foundation models for social robot navigation, offering a framework to explore how VLMs can be tailored to meet real-world social robot navigation needs. An overview of this paper along with the code and data can be found at https://larg.github.io/stars.
summary_zh: 在动态、以人为中心的环境中，机器人导航需要基于稳健的场景理解做出符合社会规范的决定。近年来的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）展现出令人期待的能力，如物体识别、常识推理和情境理解，这些能力与社会机器人导航的精细需求相契合。然而，目前尚不明确VLMs能否准确理解复杂的社会导航场景（例如，推断智能体之间的时空关系及人类意图），而这对于安全且符合社会规范的机器人导航至关重要。尽管一些近期工作探索了VLMs在社会机器人导航中的应用，但尚无现有工作系统性地评估其满足这些必要条件的能力。在本文中，我们引入了社会导航场景理解基准（SocialNav-SUB），这是一个视觉问答（VQA）数据集和基准，旨在评估VLMs在真实世界社会机器人导航场景中的场景理解能力。SocialNav-SUB提供了一个统一框架，用于在需要空间推理、时空推理和社会推理的VQA任务中，将VLMs与人类基线和基于规则的基线进行对比评估。通过使用最先进的VLMs进行实验，我们发现尽管表现最佳的VLM在与人类答案一致性上达到了令人鼓舞的概率，但仍不如更简单的基于规则的方法和人类共识基线，这表明当前VLMs在社会场景理解方面存在关键差距。我们的基准为基于基础模型的社会机器人导航进一步研究奠定了基础，提供了一个探索如何定制VLMs以满足真实世界社会机器人导航需求的框架。本文的概览、代码和数据可在 https://larg.github.io/stars 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces SocialNav-SUB, a VQA benchmark for evaluating VLMs on spatial, spatiotemporal, and social reasoning in social robot navigation, showing that current VLMs underperform rule-based baselines and human consensus.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SocialNav-SUB，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在社交机器人导航中空间、时空和社交推理能力的VQA基准，结果表明当前VLM的性能不及基于规则的基线和人类共识。

title: Social-WM: Safety-Aware Latent World Models for Robot Social Navigation
summary: Safe social navigation requires a robot to anticipate not only the future consequences of its actions, but also whether a nominal action can actually be executed under surrounding physical and social constraints. We present Social-WM, an efficient latent world-model planning framework trained from egocentric RGB video sequences. Our key observation is that social-navigation experience contains a systematic discrepancy between the nominal action and the realizable action: a nominal forward action may be fully executed in free space, but needs to be constrained when heading towards a pedestrian or obstacle. Social-WM learns these safety-relevant consequences directly through action-conditioned future prediction, where the target is the actual observed future following each command. We further introduce a realizable inverse-dynamics objective that associates observed latent transitions with the action actually realized rather than the nominal one. At deployment, candidate actions are imagined through the latent world model, and the inverse dynamics model estimates their realizability; nominal--realizable discrepancy then provides a safety signal before execution. The learned dynamics and realizability model remain goal-independent and support both position- and image-goal navigation. On Social-HM3D, Social-WM achieves 63.77% success while reducing human collisions to 21.67%, and maintains strong performance under zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D, without explicit pedestrian tracking, privileged human state, or online reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 安全的社会导航要求机器人不仅要预判自身行为的未来后果，还要判断在周围物理与社会约束下，名义动作是否真的能够被执行。我们提出Social-WM，一种高效潜空间世界模型规划框架，仅依赖以自我为中心的RGB视频序列进行训练。我们的关键观察在于，社会导航经验中，名义动作与实际可实现动作之间存在系统性偏差：在自由空间中，名义前行动作可以完全执行，但当朝向行人或障碍物时，该动作则需要受到约束。Social-WM通过动作条件下的未来预测直接学习这些与安全相关的后果，其中预测目标为每条指令下达后实际观测到的未来状态。我们进一步引入一种可实现逆动力学目标，将观测到的潜状态转移与实际实现的动作而非名义动作相关联。在部署阶段，候选动作通过潜世界模型进行想象推演，逆动力学模型则评估其可实现性；名义动作与可实现动作之间的差异在执行前提供安全信号。所学习到的动力学与可实现性模型保持目标无关性，支持位置目标与图像目标两种导航方式。在Social-HM3D上，Social-WM实现了63.77%的成功率，同时将人际碰撞率降至21.67%，并在零样本迁移至Social-MP3D时保持强劲性能，全程无需显式行人追踪、特权人体状态或在线强化学习。
tldr: Social-WM introduces a safety-aware latent world model that learns action realizability through inverse dynamics, enabling safe robot social navigation with reduced collisions and strong zero-shot transfer.
tldr_zh: Social-WM 提出了一种安全感知的潜在世界模型，通过逆动力学学习动作可实现性，实现安全社交导航，降低碰撞率并具有强零样本迁移能力。

title: PrefPI: Preference-Guided Steering into Out-of-Distribution Behaviors
summary: We present PrefPI (Preference-Guided Policy Iteration), an iterative framework for steering pretrained generative robot policies using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories. Unlike prior preference-learning methods that primarily sharpen modes already represented by the policy, we study steering beyond the initial effective support, where desired behaviors are rarely or never observed under the initial policy. Our key idea is to formulate preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling: preferred trajectories define a conditional distribution, whose density ratio with the broader behavior prior provides an implicit preference signal amplified by classifier-free guidance (CFG). Repeating this preference-conditioned modeling and guidance step yields a form of preference-guided policy iteration, turning incremental improvements toward previously inaccessible behaviors. Across diffusion policies and the PI0.5 flow- matching VLA in simulation and the real world, PrefPI produces substantial behavioral shifts with limited feedback. In particular, PrefPI increases object transport height from 10.7 cm to 19.8 cm on real hardware with only 150 preference-labeled trajectories.
summary_zh: 我们提出PrefPI（偏好引导的策略迭代），一种仅利用对自生成轨迹的相对偏好来引导预训练生成式机器人策略的迭代框架。与以往主要锐化策略中已有模式的偏好学习方法不同，我们研究在初始有效支持范围之外的引导，即所期望的行为在初始策略下很少或从未被观察到。我们的核心思想是将偏好学习形式化为偏好条件生成建模：偏好轨迹定义了一个条件分布，其与更广泛行为先验之间的密度比为分类器自由引导（CFG）提供了隐式偏好信号。重复这一偏好条件建模和引导步骤，形成了一种偏好引导的策略迭代，逐步向先前无法触及的行为改进。在扩散策略和PI0.5流匹配VLA的仿真及真实世界实验中，PrefPI在有限反馈下产生了显著的行为转变。特别是，PrefPI仅用150条带偏好的轨迹，就在真实硬件上将物体搬运高度从10.7厘米提升至19.8厘米。
tldr: PrefPI is an iterative framework that steers pretrained generative robot policies toward out-of-distribution behaviors using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories, leveraging preference-conditioned generative modeling and classifier-free guidance. It demonstrates substantial behavioral shifts in simulation and on real hardware with limited feedback, e.g., increasing object transport height on a real robot.
tldr_zh: PrefPI 是一个迭代框架，仅利用自生成轨迹上的相对偏好来引导预训练生成式机器人策略走向分布外行为，通过偏好条件生成建模和分类器无关引导实现。它在仿真和真实硬件上用有限的反馈实现了显著的行为转变，例如在真实机器人上将物体运输高度提高。

title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
summary: Video generation models (VGMs) offer strong spatiotemporal priors for embodied observation--action modeling. However, joint-space action vectors lack explicit image-space structure and vary in dimensionality and semantics across embodiments, making it challenging to directly leverage the rich spatiotemporal priors of VGMs. End-effector visualizations provide an alternative but do not specify the full articulated configuration needed for robot execution. We present Dream4ACT, a world model built for joint video-action modeling across embodiments. To unify action representations across embodiments, we introduce a shared visual action interface, called action views, which render target joint configurations from four prescribed virtual cameras using URDF-based forward kinematics. This shared visual representation preserves embodiment-specific articulated geometry while allowing observation and action sequences to share a video autoencoder and diffusion transformer. Through masked flow-matching, our model supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint observation--action generation within a single jointly trained model by varying which future sequences are corrupted. To recover executable action sequences from predicted action views, we propose a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery mechanism, without a learned embodiment-specific decoder. Dream4ACT achieves an average success rate of 88.98\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and an overall score of 65.66 on TriWorldBench, supporting effective closed-loop manipulation and competitive action-conditioned multiview prediction through the visual action interface.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型（VGMs）为具身观察-动作建模提供了强大的时空先验。然而，关节空间中的动作向量缺乏显式的图像空间结构，并且在不同具身之间维度和语义各异，这使得直接利用VGMs丰富的时空先验变得困难。末端执行器可视化提供了一种替代方案，但无法指定机器人执行所需的完整关节配置。我们提出Dream4ACT，一个跨具身的关节视频-动作联合建模世界模型。为统一不同具身间的动作表示，我们引入了一种共享的视觉动作接口，称为动作视图（action views），该接口利用基于URDF的正向运动学，从四个预设虚拟相机渲染目标关节配置。这种共享的视觉表示保留了具身特有的关节几何结构，同时使观测序列和动作序列能够共享一个视频自编码器和扩散变换器。通过掩码流匹配，我们的模型通过改变被损坏的未来序列，在单一联合训练模型中同时支持正向动力学、逆向动力学以及观测-动作联合生成。为了从预测的动作视图中恢复可执行的动作序列，我们提出了一种无需训练的、URDF约束的多视图恢复机制，无需学习特定于具身的解码器。Dream4ACT在RoboTwin 2.0上实现了88.98%的平均成功率，在TriWorldBench上取得了65.66的综合得分，通过视觉动作接口支持有效的闭环操作和具有竞争力的动作条件多视图预测。
tldr: Dream4ACT introduces a shared visual action interface (action views) that renders joint configurations via URDF-based forward kinematics from multiple virtual cameras, enabling a single video-action world model to handle multi-embodiment forward/inverse dynamics and joint observation-action generation. It achieves high success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 and TriWorldBench for closed-loop manipulation.
tldr_zh: Dream4ACT 提出了一种共享的视觉动作接口（动作视图），通过基于 URDF 的正向运动学从多个虚拟相机渲染关节配置，使单一视频-动作世界模型能够处理多 embodiment 的正向/逆向动力学以及联合观测-动作生成。在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 TriWorldBench 上实现了高成功率的闭环操作。

title: Game-Guided Skill Discovery through Self-Play for Playable Agent Control
summary: We present Game-Guided Skill Discovery (GGSD), a framework that uses self-play in games to discover motor skills that are directly playable by humans. Playable skills provide a compact abstraction for controlling embodied agents through a small set of learned behaviors rather than low-level actions. To be effective, these skills should be semantically distinct, interpretable, and expressive; properties that existing unsupervised skill-discovery methods often fail to achieve simultaneously. GGSD achieves these desiderata by grounding skill discovery in competitive gameplay. A hierarchical agent competes against its past selves, with a high-level policy selecting from a small discrete skill set and a skill-conditioned low-level policy learning the corresponding behaviors. After training, a human can replace the high-level policy and directly control the agent through the same discrete skills. Despite the small number of high-level actions, skill transitions give rise to emergent combo behaviors, expanding expressivity beyond individual primitives. Across Ant, Franka-arm, and Unitree G1 environments, we show that GGSD produces human-playable skills that humans can compose to solve unseen tasks, such as Maze and CubePush, without additional training. An interactive demo is available at https://ggsd-demo.github.io.
summary_zh: 我们提出了游戏引导技能发现（GGSD）框架，该框架利用游戏中的自我对弈来发现人类可直接操控的运动技能。可玩技能提供了一种紧凑的抽象，通过少量学习到的行为而非底层动作来控制具身智能体。为了有效，这些技能应具备语义上的区分性、可解释性和表达力；而现有无监督技能发现方法往往无法同时满足这些特性。GGSD通过将技能发现植根于竞争性游戏玩法中来实现这些目标。一个分层智能体与其过去的自身版本进行对抗，其中高层策略从一个小型离散技能集中进行选择，而技能条件化的低层策略则学习相应的行为。训练完成后，人类可以取代高层策略，通过相同的离散技能直接控制智能体。尽管高层动作数量有限，技能之间的转换会引发涌现性的连招行为，从而将表达力扩展至单个原始技能之外。在Ant、Franka机械臂和Unitree G1环境中，我们展示了GGSD能够生成人类可玩的技能，并且人类无需额外训练即可组合这些技能来解决未见过的任务，如Maze和CubePush。交互式演示可访问 https://ggsd-demo.github.io。
tldr: GGSD uses competitive self-play in games to discover a small set of semantically distinct, human-playable motor skills for embodied agents, enabling humans to directly control the agent via discrete skills and compose them to solve unseen tasks.
tldr_zh: GGSD通过在游戏中进行竞争性自对弈，为具身智能体发现一组语义清晰、可解释且可表达的人类可操控技能，使人类能够通过离散技能直接控制智能体，并组合这些技能解决未见过的任务。

title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
summary: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx, a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.
summary_zh: 掌握基于强化学习的机器人操作技能仍然存在样本效率低下的问题。最常见的强化学习算法依赖随机动作采样来发现新策略，导致智能体将大部分训练预算分配给自由空间中的运动，而远离那些产生操作技能的接触状态。现有的基于模型分歧或认知不确定性的内在动机方法虽优于各向同性噪声，但同样可能对功能无关的转变中的不确定性给予奖励，例如自由空间中的杂乱运动。在本研究中，我们提出触觉反馈为探索提供了天然信号，并引入TacEx框架，该框架通过将模型不确定性按感知模态进行分解、并将好奇心导向触觉通道，将触觉融入认知不确定性驱动的探索之中。通过将好奇心锚定于触觉感知，TacEx驱动机器人发现复杂的接触动力学，在探索过程中无需任务奖励或专家示范即可学习操控和抓取物体。通过这种触觉驱动的好奇心所收集的密集交互数据集，支持了无需额外环境交互即可进行的下游拾取与放置策略的离线学习。我们进一步利用触觉驱动的探索对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。尽管VLA模型在初始预训练阶段未使用触觉反馈，但通过TacEx进行后训练后，下游性能显著提升，同时保持了极高的样本效率。
tldr: This paper introduces TacEx, a framework that uses tactile feedback to drive curiosity-based exploration in reinforcement learning, enabling efficient learning of manipulation skills such as pick-and-place and improving downstream vision-language-action (VLA) models without task rewards or demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TacEx框架，利用触觉反馈驱动基于好奇心的探索，在无需任务奖励或专家演示的情况下，高效学习抓取和放置等操作技能，并提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的性能。

title: Multi-Link Safety Filtering for VLA Policies Around Moving Hazards
summary: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid's center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from $65.62\%$ to $27.27\%$ and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from $29.35\%$ to $50.43\%$. Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in $2.2$~ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision--language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each $π_{0.5}$ policy call on the integrated GPU from $343$ to $177.3$~ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在完成操作任务时，可能会撞倒与其无关的物体，因此仅凭任务成功并不能证明该策略在杂乱环境中部署是安全的。我们研究如何在运行时无需重新训练即可使预训练的VLA策略避开此类危险，这需要对机械臂的更多部位（而不仅仅是末端执行器）进行防护，在危险物移动时对其进行跟踪，并与策略共享机载算力。我们的无训练防护罩用五个椭球体覆盖夹爪、腕部和前臂，并通过一个屏障程序对每次指令运动进行过滤，该程序基于重置时从RGB-D感知中拟合的禁入椭球体进行约束。随后，稀疏光流将该椭球体的中心随危险物一同传递，无需重复检测或重新拟合。在六种模拟危险物运动条件下，该防护罩将碰撞率从$65.62\%$降至$27.27\%$，并将安全成功率（即无碰撞完成任务）从$29.35\%$提升至$50.43\%$。消融实验表明，对机械臂链路的防护提供了超越末端执行器屏蔽的保护，而跟踪机制恢复了在危险估计于重置时被冻结所损失的大部分保护。在异构边缘硬件上，五个椭球体的屏障程序在CPU上的99百分位运行时间为$2.2$~ms；同时，压缩视觉-语言前缀并减少流匹配步数，可将集成GPU上每次$π_{0.5}$策略调用的时间从$343$~ms缩短至$177.3$~ms。在物理SO-101机械臂上的四项任务中，受防护的16次试验中有3次机械臂触及危险物，而未受防护的16次试验中有11次触及。项目页面：https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/
tldr: This paper presents a training-free, run-time safety filter for pretrained VLA policies that uses multi-link ellipsoidal barriers and sparse optical flow tracking to keep robot arms from colliding with moving hazards in cluttered environments, significantly reducing collisions in simulation and on a real SO-101 arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种免训练的运行时安全过滤器，通过多连杆椭球屏障和稀疏光流跟踪，使预训练的VLA策略在杂乱环境中避免与移动危险物碰撞，在仿真和真实SO-101机械臂上显著降低碰撞率。

title: When Instructions Retrieve Trajectories: Diagnosing and Mitigating Generalization Failures in VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can exceed 90% success on in-distribution tasks and withstand nuisance changes that preserve the required action, yet fail under counterfactual changes that demand a different action. Aggregate robustness scores can therefore conceal a more specific failure, in which a policy responds to both language and vision yet does not combine them to select the action the task requires. We call this failure instruction-action binding. Instructions cue familiar trajectory families, and visual feedback adjusts their execution. Behavioral analyses of fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.7 policies reveal that failed rollouts often retain the source behavior or switch to another demonstrated task. These switches show that language is not simply ignored. Readouts and interventions connect these choices to task-conditioned internal states. Our analysis of the imitation objective shows how narrow conditional action support can leave grounded and instruction-keyed solutions indistinguishable on the demonstrations. This motivates Equivariant Counterfactual Training (ECT), which acts at two levels. ECT data supply valid demonstrations in which the same instruction requires different actions in distinguishable scenes, while the ECT loss trains each demonstration with its counterpart in the same update. In a controlled LIBERO-PRO comparison, full ECT raises $π_{0.5}$'s mean position-swap success from 36% to 59%. On CALVIN, where counterparts already occur in the original data, the ECT loss improves five-task completion without new demonstrations. On a real UR5e under a fixed demonstration budget, full ECT raises unseen-position success from 8% to 88%.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在分布内任务上可取得超过90%的成功率，并能抵御那些不改变所需动作的干扰变化，但在需要不同动作的反事实变化下则表现失败。因此，聚合鲁棒性得分可能掩盖一种更具体的失败模式，即策略同时响应语言和视觉，却未能将二者结合以选择任务所需的动作。我们将这种失败称为“指令-动作绑定”。指令提示了熟悉的轨迹族，视觉反馈则调整其执行方式。对微调后的$π_{0.5}$和GR00T-N1.7策略进行的行为分析表明，失败的轨迹往往保留源行为，或切换至另一示范任务。这些切换表明语言并未被简单忽略。读出与干预实验将这些选择与任务条件化的内部状态联系起来。我们对模仿目标的分析显示，狭窄的条件动作支持如何使基于场景的解决方案与基于指令的解决方案在示范数据上难以区分。这促使我们提出等变反事实训练（ECT），其在两个层面发挥作用。ECT数据提供了有效的示范，其中相同的指令在可区分的场景中要求不同的动作，而ECT损失则在同一次更新中将每个示范与其对应示范配对训练。在受控的LIBERO-PRO对比中，完整ECT将$π_{0.5}$的平均位置交换成功率从36%提升至59%。在CALVIN中，由于原始数据中已存在对应示范，ECT损失在无需新增示范的情况下提高了五项任务的完成率。在实际UR5e机器人上，在固定示范预算下，完整ECT将未见位置的成功率从8%提升至88%。
tldr: This paper identifies the instruction-action binding failure in VLA models, where policies follow language and vision cues separately rather than combining them, and proposes Equivariant Counterfactual Training (ECT) to mitigate it, improving generalization on LIBERO-PRO, CALVIN, and a real UR5e robot.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了VLA模型中的指令-动作绑定失败问题，即策略分别遵循语言和视觉线索而非组合它们来选择动作，并提出了等变反事实训练（ECT）来缓解该问题，在LIBERO-PRO、CALVIN和真实UR5e机器人上提升了泛化性能。

title: PhasePlan: Ordered Future-Phase Planning for Robot Brain Models
summary: Robot brain models integrate vision, language, and robot state to generate actions for complex manipulation tasks. Most predict fixed-length action chunks that may span multiple task phases. This can obscure phase transitions and favor frequent action patterns, compromising action timing in dynamic environments. We propose \method, an ordered future-phase planning method for robot brain models. From current multimodal observations, it predicts the task phase at each future action position. The resulting planning representations condition the corresponding actions, preserving temporal alignment between task progress and action generation. Training first learns the planner, then freezes it during action-model adaptation to maintain stable phase representations. We instantiate \method on pretrained $π_{0.5}$ and AcrossWAM1.0 robot brain models. Detailed quantitative evaluation uses the $π_{0.5}$ implementation. On conveyor-belt manipulation, \method reduces offline joint-action error by approximately 22.5\% relative to the original $π_{0.5}$ model. It also improves phase-transition modeling and cross-phase action prediction. These results demonstrate the value of ordered future-phase planning for continuous action generation.
summary_zh: 机器人脑模型整合视觉、语言与机器人状态信息，以生成复杂操作任务中的动作序列。现有方法大多预测固定长度的动作片段，这些片段可能跨越多个任务阶段，从而模糊了阶段转换边界，并偏向于频繁出现的动作模式，削弱了在动态环境中的动作时序性。为此，我们提出\method方法，一种面向机器人脑模型的有序未来阶段规划方法。该方法从当前多模态观测中预测每个未来动作位置所处的任务阶段，并将所得规划表征作为对应动作的条件，从而保持任务进度与动作生成之间的时间对齐。训练过程中，首先学习规划器，随后在动作模型适配阶段冻结规划器，以维持稳定的阶段表征。我们在预训练的$π_{0.5}$和AcrossWAM1.0机器人脑模型上实现了\method方法，并基于$π_{0.5}$实现开展了详细的定量评估。在传送带操作任务中，\method相较于原始$π_{0.5}$模型，将离线关节动作误差降低了约22.5%，同时改善了阶段转换建模与跨阶段动作预测性能。上述结果验证了有序未来阶段规划在连续动作生成中的有效性。
tldr: PhasePlan introduces ordered future-phase planning for robot brain models, conditioning actions on predicted task-phase representations to improve phase-transition modeling and cross-phase action prediction during continuous manipulation, reducing joint-action error on conveyor-belt tasks by ~22.5% over the baseline Pi0.5 model.
tldr_zh: PhasePlan提出了一种有序未来阶段规划方法，用于机器人脑模型，通过预测未来动作位置的任务阶段并以此条件化动作生成，改善了连续操作中的阶段转换建模与跨阶段动作预测，在传送带操作任务上将关节动作误差相对降低了约22.5%。

title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体基于指令和观察生成动作。通用多模态智能体为此任务提供了有前景的基础，但选择合理的局部动作并不能确保执行过程始终与预期路线保持一致，尤其是在长时程任务中。此外，累积的交互历史增加了后续决策所需的输入量，导致显著的推理开销。为此，我们提出 \method，一个智能体式VLN框架，包含目标智能体（Goal Agent），为局部动作设定自适应目标；验证智能体（Verify Agent），动态验证目标是否已完成；记忆智能体（Memory Agent），用于多模态上下文压缩；以及视觉运动智能体（Visuomotor Agent），用于执行自适应目标。具体而言，目标智能体基于指令、当前观察和执行历史制定自适应目标。随后，视觉运动智能体执行导航动作以实现每个目标，同时验证智能体使用特定于目标的验证问题，动态评估观察结果是否满足预期的完成条件。经验证的目标完成为记忆智能体标记了一个边界，使其能够压缩相应的多模态交互历史，同时保留后续导航所需的信息。我们在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上评估导航性能，在三种模型骨干上考察框架变体，并研究执行过程中的上下文演变。在真实世界评估中，\method 在八条具有挑战性的路线上（每条路线评估三次）实现了83.3\%的成功率和1.51\,米的导航误差。
tldr: NavHarness introduces an agentic VLN framework with adaptive goal-setting, verification, and memory compression, improving long-horizon navigation performance and efficiency on R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and real-world routes.
tldr_zh: NavHarness提出了一种智能体视觉语言导航框架，通过自适应目标设定、验证和记忆压缩，提升了长程导航的性能和效率。

title: Toward Real-Time VLAs: Stage-Aware Two-Step Flow Denoising and System-Level Evaluation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models face a timing gap between low-rate inference and high-rate robot execution. We characterize this gap through end-to-end latency measurements of model inference and the robot execution chain. Repeated Flow Matching denoising contributes substantially to inference cost, while robot-side delays mainly arise from perception acquisition, communication scheduling, and physical response. Analysis of the velocity field shows relatively stable magnitude and direction in early integration, followed by stronger directional correction near the terminal steps. Based on this stage heterogeneity, we propose two-stage non-uniform denoising, reducing the number of steps from 10 to 2 and model-inference time from 61.557 ms to 21.956 ms. We also develop a distributed real-time VLA framework with independent inference, action-publication, and robot-control rates, modular observation acquisition, and action-provenance logging. Using π0.5 as the baseline, we evaluate six real-time execution methods on a long-horizon physical garment-folding task. Legato performs best overall among training-based methods, while Temporal Smoothing leads among training-free methods; both perform strongly in task success, completion time, action continuity, and acceleration smoothness. Combining two-step denoising with representative execution methods substantially reduces inference cost with a small reduction in task performance. These results motivate joint optimization of model-inference efficiency and robot-system timing.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在低频率推理与高频率机器人执行之间存在时间差。我们通过对模型推理与机器人执行链路的端到端延迟测量来刻画这一差距。重复的流匹配去噪过程显著增加了推理成本，而机器人端的延迟主要来源于感知采集、通信调度和物理响应。对速度场的分析表明，在早期积分阶段，速度场的幅度和方向相对稳定，而在接近末端步时出现较强的方向校正。基于该阶段异质性，我们提出了两阶段非均匀去噪方法，将步数从10步减少至2步，模型推理时间从61.557毫秒降低至21.956毫秒。我们还开发了一种分布式实时VLA框架，具备独立的推理、动作发布和机器人控制频率，模块化的观测采集以及动作来源日志记录。以π0.5为基线，我们在长时程物理衣物折叠任务上评估了六种实时执行方法。在基于训练的方法中，Legato整体表现最佳，而在无需训练的方法中，时间平滑方法表现最优；两者在任务成功率、完成时间、动作连续性和加速度平滑性方面均表现优异。将两步去噪与代表性执行方法相结合，可显著降低推理成本，同时仅带来较小的任务性能损失。这些结果激励了对模型推理效率与机器人系统时序的联合优化。
tldr: This paper characterizes the latency gap in VLA models for real-time robot execution, proposes a two-stage non-uniform flow matching denoising to reduce inference steps from 10 to 2, and introduces a distributed real-time VLA framework with system-level evaluation on physical garment folding, demonstrating substantial inference cost reduction with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: 该论文刻画了VLA模型在实时机器人执行中的延迟差距，提出了两阶段非均匀流匹配去噪方法，将推理步数从10步减少到2步，并开发了分布式实时VLA框架，在物理衣物折叠任务上进行了系统级评估，显著降低了推理成本且性能损失较小。

title: Learning from Runtime Feedback through Failure-Bank Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize broadly across robotic manipulation tasks, but complex environments require balancing task success with unintended contact. Runtime shields can correct individual actions, but they leave the underlying policy unchanged, so repeated disagreements may create a persistent policy-shield mismatch that blocks task progress. To address this challenge, we introduce FailBank, a four-stage self-evolving framework that converts runtime feedback into persistent policy improvement. During collection, a fixed CBF-based safety module serves as an observe-only teacher, producing counterfactual corrections while the policy remains in control. Outcome-aware admission then converts useful proposals into corrective targets and retains successful uncorrected actions as quiet anchors for guarded LoRA updates. We evaluate FailBank on the VLA-Arena benchmark across two difficulty levels and two VLA backbones. Compared with the base policies, FailBank improves the joint success-cost operating point. Across the two backbones, FailBank improves task success rate by 8.5 and 6.9 percentage points, while reducing policy-induced cumulative cost by 35.6\% and 23.8\%, respectively. Compared with runtime shielding, FailBank raises task success rate by 25.4 and 9.5 percentage points, while maintaining comparable policy-induced cumulative cost. These results show that runtime feedback can serve as persistent policy supervision rather than only as a temporary action constraint.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中具有较强的泛化能力，但复杂环境要求在任务成功与意外接触之间取得平衡。运行时屏蔽可以修正单个动作，但无法改变底层策略，因此反复出现的分歧可能导致策略与屏蔽之间持续不匹配，从而阻碍任务进展。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了FailBank，一个四阶段自进化框架，将运行时反馈转化为持续的策略改进。在数据采集阶段，一个固定的基于CBF的安全模块作为仅观察的教师，在策略保持控制的同时产生反事实修正。结果感知的接纳机制将有价值的建议转化为修正目标，并将成功的未修正动作保留为安静锚点，用于受限的LoRA更新。我们在VLA-Arena基准上评估了FailBank，涵盖两个难度级别和两个VLA骨干网络。与基础策略相比，FailBank改善了任务成功-成本联合工作点。在两个骨干网络上，FailBank分别将任务成功率提高了8.5和6.9个百分点，同时将策略引发的累计成本分别降低了35.6\%和23.8\%。与运行时屏蔽相比，FailBank将任务成功率提高了25.4和9.5个百分点，同时保持了相当的策略引发累计成本。这些结果表明，运行时反馈可以充当持续的策略监督，而不仅仅是临时的动作约束。
tldr: FailBank is a four-stage self-evolving framework that converts runtime feedback from a CBF-based safety module into persistent policy improvement for VLA models, improving success rate and reducing policy-induced cost on the VLA-Arena benchmark.
tldr_zh: FailBank 是一个四阶段自进化框架，将基于CBF的安全模块的运行时反馈转化为VLA模型的持久策略改进，在VLA-Arena基准上提高了任务成功率并降低了策略诱导成本。

title: Tool-Policy Co-Design for Powder Weighing in Laboratory Automation
summary: Autonomous powder weighing is one of many bottlenecks in laboratory automation due to the complex, non-linear dynamics of heterogeneous materials. Robot chemists performing this task utilise standard tools shaped for the dexterity of human hands, whose fixed geometry sets the dynamics that the control policy needs to regulate. This work introduces a tool-policy co-design framework that concurrently optimises the morphology of a dispensing tool and its control policy for use by robots in chemistry laboratories, formulated as a bi-level optimisation that minimises dispensing error over a target distribution of powder flowabilities. The outer loop varies tool-design parameters such as tool depth, width and rim spike topology using Bayesian optimisation and hyperband, while an inner loop optimises a control policy for each candidate morphology. We also introduce a geometric similarity metric that warm-starts policy training from cached policies of structurally similar designs, exploring 28% more configurations under the same compute budget. The proposed framework is evaluated on a robotic powder weighing task across seven materials with distinct physical dynamics in a flowability-informed robot-material simulation framework. Experimental results demonstrate that our co-designed tool morphology reduces real-world weighing errors by 45% relative to a standard tool, including on previously unseen materials. These results demonstrate our method can adapt both the control policy and the physical tool to the dynamics of the target material, bringing a new paradigm for material manipulation to the field of laboratory automation.
summary_zh: 摘要：由于异质材料具有复杂的非线性动力学特性，粉末自动称量是实验室自动化中的主要瓶颈之一。执行该任务的机器人化学家使用为人类手部灵活性而设计的标准工具，这些工具的固定几何结构决定了控制策略需要调节的动力学特性。本研究提出了一种工具-策略协同设计框架，可同时优化配药工具的形状及其控制策略，供化学实验室中的机器人使用。该框架被表述为一个双层优化问题，以在目标粉末流动性分布上最小化称量误差。外层循环使用贝叶斯优化和Hyperband算法来调整工具设计参数，如工具深度、宽度和边缘尖刺拓扑结构，而内层循环则为每个候选形态优化控制策略。我们还引入了一种几何相似性度量，可从结构相似设计的缓存策略中预热策略训练，从而在相同计算预算下探索多28%的配置。该框架在具有七种不同物理动力学特性的材料上，于基于流动性的机器人-材料仿真框架中进行了机器人粉末称量任务评估。实验结果表明，与标准工具相比，我们协同设计的工具形态在实际称量中减少了45%的误差，包括对未曾见过材料的情况。这些结果表明，我们的方法能够同时调整控制策略和物理工具以适应目标材料的动力学特性，为实验室自动化领域带来了一种新的材料操作范式。
tldr: This paper introduces a tool-policy co-design framework that optimizes both the morphology of a powder dispensing tool and its control policy for robotic laboratory automation, reducing real-world weighing errors by 45% on seven materials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种工具-策略协同设计框架，同时优化粉末分配工具的形状和控制策略，在七种材料上将真实称重误差降低了45%。

title: Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其适应新任务和新领域的能力仍存在效率不足的问题：现有方法通常依赖参数微调，不仅成本高昂，还可能导致对已学任务的灾难性遗忘。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{Optimus-R}，一种以记忆为中心的VLA框架，将机器人适应性学习形式化为显式的查询-技能记忆调优。Optimus-R包含以下核心组件：(i) \textbf{用于技能提取的内联记忆接口}。该接口将可学习的记忆标记插入VLA前缀流中，使主干网络能够在原生动作条件路径内提取控制相关的查询与技能表示。(ii) \textbf{用于技能学习的查询-技能记忆库}。该模块将技能外部化为查询原型（用于决定\textit{检索什么}）和技能值（用于明确\textit{如何执行}），从而在仅需有限参数更新的情况下实现技能的复用与扩展。(iii) 轻量级的\textbf{桥接-自适应技能更新机制}。该机制通过轻量级适配器和残差记忆更新，将目标领域的查询和技能与现有记忆空间对齐。在内域适应、跨域适应以及持续学习任务上的实验表明，Optimus-R能够实现数据高效的技能学习，同时有效缓解灾难性遗忘问题。
tldr: Optimus-R introduces a memory-centric VLA framework with inline memory tokens and a query-skill memory bank to enable data-efficient robotic skill adaptation and mitigate catastrophic forgetting without parameter tuning.
tldr_zh: Optimus-R 提出了一种以记忆为中心的 VLA 框架，通过内联记忆令牌和查询-技能记忆库，实现无需参数调优的数据高效机器人技能适配，并缓解灾难性遗忘。

title: DiffWAM: A Fast and Efficient Navigation World Action Model
summary: Pretrained video foundation models encode rich semantic and spatiotemporal priors for embodied navigation, yet converting these priors into UAV motion typically requires expensive future-video synthesis and geometric reconstruction. We investigate whether the motion implicit in future visual prediction can instead be recovered directly from the predictive representations of a frozen video model. To this end, we present DiffWAM, a geometry-conditioned navigation world-action model that directly transforms multi-level predictive features into continuous camera trajectories. Its Grid-Motion module preserves spatial-temporal motion associations, while Latent2Pose grounds them with first-frame geometry to recover metrically meaningful 3D motion. Complete video rollouts and geometric reconstruction are required only for offline supervision, eliminating future-video decoding and multi-frame reconstruction during deployment. We further introduce FastDreamer, which overlaps predictive and geometric computation with ongoing flight and performs timestamp-aware asynchronous trajectory handoff for continuous UAV execution. DiffWAM achieves a trajectory RMSE of 0.3492 m and an endpoint success rate of 74.40% on the 1,000-sample DiffWAM-1000 benchmark, while representative real-world experiments demonstrate complex behaviors including constrained traversal, orbiting, S-shaped flight, and multi-stage navigation. An onboard DiffWAM-Flash implementation further reaches 1.08 s model-pipeline latency on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor. These results demonstrate that predictive video representations can be efficiently grounded into continuous 3D motion, providing a direct alternative to generate-then-reconstruct navigation pipelines. Project page: https://zzmmzzm.github.io/diffwam.github.io/.
summary_zh: 预训练视频基础模型为具身导航编码了丰富的语义和时空先验，但将这些先验转化为无人机运动通常需要昂贵的未来视频合成和几何重建。我们探究未来视觉预测中所隐含的运动是否可以直接从冻结视频模型的预测表示中恢复。为此，我们提出DiffWAM，一种几何条件化的导航世界-动作模型，直接将多层级预测特征转化为连续的相机轨迹。其Grid-Motion模块保留时空运动关联，而Latent2Pose模块利用首帧几何将其锚定，以恢复具有度量意义的3D运动。完整的视频展开和几何重建仅用于离线监督，从而在部署阶段消除了未来视频解码和多帧重建的需求。我们进一步引入FastDreamer，将预测与几何计算与飞行过程相重叠，并执行时间戳感知的异步轨迹交接以实现无人机连续执行。DiffWAM在包含1000个样本的DiffWAM-1000基准上实现了0.3492米的轨迹均方根误差和74.40%的端点成功率，而代表性真实世界实验展示了包括受限穿越、环绕飞行、S形飞行和多阶段导航在内的复杂行为。板载DiffWAM-Flash实现在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor上进一步达到了1.08秒的模型流水线延迟。上述结果表明，预测性视频表示可以被高效地锚定为连续的3D运动，为生成-重建式导航流水线提供了一种直接替代方案。项目页面：https://zzmmzzm.github.io/diffwam.github.io/。
tldr: DiffWAM introduces a fast navigation world-action model that directly maps frozen video model predictive features into metric camera trajectories for UAV flight, removing expensive future-video decoding and reconstruction at deployment. It introduces FastDreamer for asynchronous onboard execution and demonstrates real-world flights with a 1.08 s pipeline latency on an embedded GPU.
tldr_zh: DiffWAM提出了一种快速的导航世界动作模型，直接将冻结视频模型的预测特征映射为无人机的度量相机轨迹，在部署时无需昂贵的未来视频解码和重建。它引入了FastDreamer以实现机载异步执行，并在嵌入式GPU上展示了1.08秒的流水线延迟和真实世界飞行。
