title: Experience-Driven Continual Learning of Terrain Traversability for Quadruped Robots
summary: Safe and efficient quadruped navigation over unfamiliar terrain requires predicting terrain-robot interaction before contact: geometry and visual appearance alone cannot reveal how the robot will slip, load its feet, or expend energy. This paper presents a continual learning pipeline that uses locomotion experience to learn these interaction outcomes from pre-contact images and continually updates the predictions as new contacts are observed. Pre-contact descriptors, produced by a DINOv3 backbone model frozen during training, are mapped to five proprioceptive indicators weighted according to measurement reliability: planar foot slip, mean normal ground-reaction force, traction index, cost of transport, and touchdown loading rate. A compact evidential regressor allows us to predict these indicators together with aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty from the visual descriptors. Continual adaptation combines bounded experience replay with a validation gate: candidate models replace the deployed predictor only when they improve performance on recent held-out data while keeping degradation on historical held-out data within a prescribed tolerance. Predictions and epistemic uncertainty are projected into a local multilayer map and combined into a conservative traversability score map whose property weights can be adjusted without retraining. The resulting map is used for downstream navigation tests. The ROS2 implementation supports evaluation on a Unitree Go2 in simulation and on hardware, with models trained separately in each domain. On a sequential hardware stream over three previously unseen terrains, gated replay reduces final anchor negative log-likelihood (NLL) degradation by 23.1% relative to replay without the gate while attaining similar new-terrain adaptation.
summary_zh: 安全且高效的四足机器人在陌生地形上的导航，要求其在接触前预测地形与机器人之间的相互作用：仅凭几何形状和视觉外观无法揭示机器人将如何打滑、如何承载足部负荷或如何消耗能量。本文提出了一种持续学习流水线，利用运动经验从接触前图像中学习这些交互结果，并在观察到新的接触时持续更新预测。由训练期间冻结的DINOv3骨干模型生成的接触前描述符，被映射到五个根据测量可靠性加权的本体感觉指标：平面足部滑移、平均法向地面反作用力、牵引指数、运输成本和触地加载速率。一个紧凑的证据回归器使我们能够从视觉描述符中预测这些指标，同时包含随机不确定性和认知不确定性。持续适应结合了有界经验回放与验证门控：候选模型仅当其在最近保留数据上性能提升，同时将历史保留数据的性能退化控制在规定容差内时，才替换当前部署的预测器。预测结果和认知不确定性被投影到局部多层地图中，并组合成保守的可穿越性得分图，其属性权重无需重新训练即可调整。生成的地图用于下游导航测试。该ROS2实现支持在仿真环境和硬件上对宇树Go2进行评估，模型分别在各域中单独训练。在三个此前未见过的地形上的顺序硬件数据流中，门控回放相较于无门控回放，将最终锚点负对数似然（NLL）退化降低了23.1%，同时达到了相似的新地形适应效果。
tldr: This paper presents a continual learning pipeline for quadruped robots to predict terrain-robot interaction outcomes from pre-contact images, using a frozen DINOv3 backbone and evidential regressors, with gated replay to avoid catastrophic forgetting, integrated into a traversability map for navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个四足机器人持续学习管线，利用冻结的DINOv3骨干和证据回归器，从接触前图像预测地形-机器人交互结果，并通过门控回放避免灾难性遗忘，集成到可穿越性地图中用于导航。

title: ChunkTrust: Adapting Execution Horizons for Robot Policies with Action-Expert Evidence
summary: Robot foundation policies predict action chunks, but how many actions to execute before replanning depends on the current task phase. We introduce ChunkTrust, which treats the execution horizon as a latent variable inferred from action-expert evidence rather than a fixed hyperparameter. Its training-free Action-aware Horizon Selector (AHS) combines intra-chunk spectral stability of generation traces with inter-chunk continuity between executed history and predicted actions. An online Beta posterior with kernel forgetting tracks horizon preferences across replans. A lightweight Query-based Horizon Adapter (QHA) optionally learns a context-conditioned dense prior from complementary evidence, fused with current evidence and episode-local Beta memory while the base policy remains frozen. Across RoboTwin2.0 and RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop, AHS improves overall task-averaged success for each evaluated base-policy configuration, including gains of +6.80 percentage points on $π_{0.5}$ over all 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks and +9.67 percentage points on Qwen3GR00T in RoboCasa. AHS+QHA raises the gain over Base to +9.44 percentage points on the eight-task $π_{0.5}$ evaluation. On four real-world household tasks, AHS improves the equal-task mean normalized process score from 50.4% to 57.5%. Ablations examine the contributions of both evidence terms, temporal memory, and the learned prior. Project page is https://hf618.github.io/ChunkTrust.github.io/
summary_zh: 机器人基础策略预测动作块，但重新规划前应执行多少动作取决于当前任务阶段。我们提出ChunkTrust，将执行视界视为从动作专家证据中推断的潜在变量，而非固定超参数。其免训练的基于动作的视界选择器（AHS）结合了生成轨迹的块内频谱稳定性与已执行历史及预测动作之间的块间连续性。在线Beta后验结合核遗忘机制，在多次重规划中跟踪视界偏好。轻量级的基于查询的视界适配器（QHA）可选择性地从互补证据中学习上下文条件化的密集先验，并与当前证据及情节局部Beta记忆融合，同时保持基础策略冻结。在RoboTwin2.0和RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop上，AHS提升了每个评估的基础策略配置的整体任务平均成功率，包括在全部50个RoboTwin2.0任务上对$\pi_{0.5}$提升+6.80个百分点，以及在RoboCasa中对Qwen3GR00T提升+9.67个百分点。AHS+QHA在八任务$\pi_{0.5}$评估中将相对Base的提升扩大至+9.44个百分点。在四项真实世界家务任务中，AHS将等任务平均归一化过程得分从50.4%提升至57.5%。消融实验检验了两种证据项、时间记忆及学习先验的贡献。项目页面：https://hf618.github.io/ChunkTrust.github.io/
tldr: ChunkTrust adapts the execution horizon of robot foundation policies by treating it as a latent variable inferred from action-expert evidence, combining spectral stability and continuity terms with a Beta posterior and optional learned adapter, improving task success in simulation and real-world household tasks.
tldr_zh: ChunkTrust 将机器人基础策略的执行视界视为从动作专家证据中推断的潜在变量，结合谱稳定性和连续性项及 Beta 后验和可选学习适配器，在仿真和真实家庭任务中提高了任务成功率。

title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
summary_zh: 长视野机器人操作在众多任务组合中复用技能，但通过额外的端到端演示来改进这些组合代价高昂。一个实用的自改进系统必须同时决定下一步教授什么内容以及在何处施加该监督。我们提出了ROBOCOACH，一个基于世界模型的教练框架，利用想象失败来引导演示请求和专家更新。其“路线-想象-诊断-改进”（RIDI）循环在我们共享的动作条件世界模型COACHWORLD中执行可复用的技能专家，并使用进度评判器记录第一个未能完成的子任务。聚合记录会选择需要获取哪些子任务演示以及更新哪些专家适配器。在两个仿真套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象成功率与部署成功率在22对任务-策略组合上呈现相关性（ρ = 0.840）。受控比较表明，在匹配的数据预算和更新计划下，我们的教练方法优于匹配的基线方法。仅需额外150条子任务演示，Franka上的成功率从13.3%提升至75.0%，AgileX上的成功率从40.0%提升至83.8%。经教练训练的专家还能迁移到四个保留组合中，平均成功率达到35.0%，而使用统一获取的演示更新的共享策略基线成功率为0%。这些结果共同表明，世界模型可以充当主动教练，将想象失败转化为针对模块化策略改进的定向监督。项目页面：https://robocoach-ai.github.io/
tldr: ROBOCOACH is a world-model-guided framework that identifies and improves failing subtask skills in long-horizon robot manipulation by using imagined failures to request targeted demonstrations, boosting real-robot success rates with minimal additional data.
tldr_zh: ROBOCOACH 是一个由世界模型引导的框架，通过想象失败来识别并改进长时程机器人操作中的子技能，以极少的额外演示数据显著提升真实机器人的成功率。

title: From Local Whole-Body VLA Behaviors to Scene-Scale Aerial Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable task-conditioned interaction, but extending them to scene-scale aerial manipulation remains challenging due to costly whole-body demonstrations, latency-induced action-state misalignment, and cross-site behavior composition. We present a unified framework for synthetic policy training and scene-scale execution on articulated uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs). A scene-reconfigurable pipeline synthesizes task-conditioned, kinodynamically feasible trajectories and synchronized multiview observations for VLA training without physical-platform demonstrations. Measured-progress-aligned realization (MPAR) aligns asynchronously returned action chunks with measured execution progress and realizes them as continuous, dynamically feasible trajectories. A relational Scene Graph grounds language goals to object instances and feasible interaction regions, while topology-guided transfer connects local behaviors across sites. Local VLA skills achieve 39/60 successes (65.0%) in simulation under oracle target and feasible-handoff conditions. Under 500-ms added latency, with and without a transient command-update stall, MPAR reduces median takeover phase error by 0.212 s over nominal-time alignment. The complete system completes 21/50 simulated multi-site missions (42.0%) and is further validated on a physical articulated UAM.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够实现任务条件下的交互，但将其扩展到场景级空中操纵仍面临诸多挑战，原因包括全身演示成本高昂、延迟导致的动作-状态错位以及跨站点行为组合困难。我们提出了一种统一框架，用于在关节式无人空中操纵器（UAM）上进行合成策略训练和场景级执行。一种场景可重构流水线能够合成满足任务条件且符合运动动力学可行性的轨迹，并生成同步多视角观测数据，用于VLA训练，而无需物理平台演示。基于测量进度对齐的实现（MPAR）方法将异步返回的动作块与实测执行进度对齐，并将其实现为连续、动态可行的轨迹。关系式场景图将语言目标映射到具体对象实例和可行的交互区域，而拓扑引导的迁移则将局部行为跨站点连接起来。在具备理想目标与可行交接条件的情况下，局部VLA技能在仿真中实现了39/60次成功（65.0%）。在额外500毫秒延迟的情况下，无论是否出现瞬时命令更新停滞，MPAR相比标称时间对齐方法，将中位接管相位误差减少了0.212秒。完整系统在仿真中完成了21/50次多站点任务（42.0%），并进一步在实体关节式UAM上得到验证。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for extending vision-language-action (VLA) models to scene-scale aerial manipulation using synthetic trajectories, measured-progress alignment, and relational scene graphs, achieving success in simulation and on a physical platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种将视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型扩展到场景级空中操控的框架，通过合成轨迹、进度对齐和关系场景图，在仿真和物理平台上取得成功。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
summary_zh: 精确接地至关重要。它决定了哪个对象是目标以及该对象所在的位置，即使在杂乱环境中或面对微小物体时也是如此，并且其速度必须足够快以满足闭环控制的需求。然而，视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）从通用视觉-语言和视频生成骨干网络中获取感知能力，这些骨干网络在这些场景下仍然表现不佳。我们引入了GroundingPI，一个4B规模的接地基础模型，它通过共享词汇表中的量化坐标生成点和框。训练过程结合了多模态与空间预训练、监督微调以及基于GRPO的强化学习，利用公开数据集和专用数据引擎提供的监督信号。在涵盖34个接地基准测试、跨越11种感知能力的44个基线模型的对比中，GroundingPI确立了新的最先进水平，平均得分为73.68%，超过了参数量更大的GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。作为下游视觉骨干网络，GroundingPI提升了机器人操作和自动驾驶的性能。在RoboTwin 2.0上，它在所有四种分布外设置中均优于我们所评估的所有主流骨干网络，相对于最强骨干网络最高提升达24.8%。在RoboCasa-GR1上，使用50%演示数据训练的GroundingPI优于使用75%数据训练的基线模型。在nuScenes上作为视觉骨干使用时，GroundingPI实现了平均开环L2误差0.296米。我们系统性地分析了GroundingPI在规模和数据构成方面的预训练效果。随着预训练规模的扩大，下游自动驾驶和机器人操作性能均得到提升。对这11种感知能力的数据配方的分析表明，密集接地对两者均有显著益处，而OCR则展现出作为感知学习催化剂的潜力。这些结果支持将接地作为感知基础，并将专门的感知预训练视为物理智能基础模型的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: GroundingPI introduces a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates, achieving state-of-the-art results across 34 grounding benchmarks and improving downstream robotic manipulation and autonomous driving performance.
tldr_zh: GroundingPI 提出了一种 4B 规模的接地基础模型，将点和框生成为量化坐标，在 34 个接地基准测试中取得最新最优结果，并提升了下游机器人操作和自动驾驶性能。

title: Text-to-3D Policy: Fine-Grained Language-Behavior Alignment for Unseen Specification Generalization
summary: 3D visuomotor policies provide a strong foundation for spatially precise manipulation, yet current text-to-3D policies struggle to follow unseen fine-grained behavioral specifications beyond those covered by demonstrations. We study this challenge as unseen specification generalization, where language specifies behaviorally significant variations, such as target position, displacement, or articulated state, that are absent from policy training. We find that pretrained language representations and conventional global behavior-language alignment capture coarse task semantics but often blur nearby specifications that require distinct behaviors. We introduce T3DP, a Text-to-3D Policy framework for fine-grained language-behavior alignment. Rather than compressing each instruction and demonstration into a single global embedding, T3DP preserves their local structures and establishes bidirectional token-level correspondence between linguistic elements and behavioral segments. This directly grounds subtle linguistic variations in the behavior components they affect, preventing closely related specifications from collapsing in the representation space. The resulting specification-sensitive language representation conditions a point-cloud-based 3D diffusion policy, enabling more precise control over unseen behavioral specifications without modifying the underlying policy architecture. Across Meta-World, ManiSkill, and RoboTwin, T3DP improves average held-out-specification success over global language-behavior alignment by +11.0-14.2 points, with gains on all 15 task families; on real-robot tasks, it further raises average success from 47.5% to 65.0% (+17.5 points). Representation and action-probe analyses show that fine-grained alignment better preserves specification geometry and action-relevant variation, linking local behavior grounding to downstream control.
summary_zh: 三维视觉运动策略为空间精确操作提供了坚实基础，然而当前的文本到三维策略难以遵循演示数据之外的未见细粒度行为规格。我们将这一挑战视为未见规格泛化问题，其中语言指定了行为层面的显著变化，如目标位置、位移或关节状态，而这些变化在策略训练中并未出现。我们发现，预训练语言表示与传统的全局行为-语言对齐能够捕捉粗略的任务语义，但往往会模糊需要不同行为的邻近规格。为此，我们提出了T3DP，一种面向细粒度语言-行为对齐的文本到三维策略框架。T3DP并非将每条指令和演示压缩为单一全局嵌入，而是保留其局部结构，并在语言元素与行为片段之间建立双向的标记级对应关系。这直接将细微的语言变化锚定到其影响的行为组件上，防止紧密相关的规格在表示空间中坍塌融合。由此得到的规格敏感语言表示用于条件化基于点云的三维扩散策略，在不修改底层策略架构的前提下，实现了对未见行为规格的更精确控制。在Meta-World、ManiSkill和RoboTwin上，相较于全局语言-行为对齐，T3DP在平均未见规格成功率上提升了+11.0至+14.2个百分点，并在全部15个任务族上均取得增益；在真实机器人任务中，其进一步将平均成功率从47.5%提升至65.0%（+17.5个百分点）。表示与动作探针分析表明，细粒度对齐能更好地保留规格几何结构及与动作相关的变异性，将局部行为锚定与下游控制联系起来。
tldr: T3DP introduces a fine-grained token-level language-behavior alignment framework for 3D visuomotor policies, improving generalization to unseen behavioral specifications in manipulation tasks across multiple benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: T3DP 提出了一个细粒度的 token 级语言-行为对齐框架，用于 3D 视觉运动策略，在多个基准和真实机器人上提升了对未见行为规格的泛化能力。

title: LIBERO-Agent: Evaluating General-Purpose Agents for Direct Embodied Manipulation
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, use tools, and revise their behavior from feedback, but it remains unclear whether these capabilities transfer from digital environments to embodied manipulation. To investigate this question, we introduce LIBERO-Agent, an agent-native benchmark for evaluating these agents in robot manipulation tasks. Rather than asking agents to submit task-level Python control programs or operate through high-level robot skills, LIBERO-Agent provides an interactive robotic environment where agents can select which observations to inspect, process them with their own tools, and issue native action commands. LIBERO-Agent integrates 200 tasks into a common interaction framework and provides a 30-task primary suite that separates perception, short-horizon execution, and long-horizon composition. Results reveal a pronounced reliability gap: while agents perform well on perception and easy short-horizon tasks, their performance degrades substantially on hard short-horizon and long-horizon tasks. Richer observations improve short-horizon manipulation, while demonstration benefits depend on the agent and format. Among these agents, GPT-6 Astra achieves the strongest overall performance. Further analysis shows its major advantage lies in mechanism interaction, especially when sustained physical contact is needed, while its remaining failures stem from cross-stage interference and geometric errors.
summary_zh: 通用型智能体能够规划、使用工具并根据反馈调整自身行为，但这些能力能否从数字环境迁移到具身操控场景，目前仍不明确。为探究这一问题，我们提出了LIBERO-Agent——一个用于评估这些智能体在机器人操控任务中表现的智能体原生基准。LIBERO-Agent并非要求智能体提交任务级Python控制程序或通过高层机器人技能进行操作，而是提供一个交互式机器人环境，智能体可自主选择查看哪些观测信息、使用自身工具进行处理，并发出原生动作指令。LIBERO-Agent将200项任务整合到统一的交互框架中，并提供包含30项任务的主测试集，分别考察感知、短时程执行和长时程组合能力。结果揭示了显著的可靠性差距：智能体在感知任务和简单短时程任务上表现良好，但在困难短时程和长时程任务上性能明显下降。更丰富的观测信息有助于提升短时程操控表现，而示范数据的效果则取决于智能体类型和数据格式。在这些智能体中，GPT-6 Astra取得了综合最优性能。进一步分析表明，其主要优势体现在机制交互能力上，尤其当任务需要持续物理接触时表现突出，而其剩余失败则主要源于跨阶段干扰和几何误差。
tldr: This paper introduces LIBERO-Agent, a benchmark for evaluating general-purpose agents directly in embodied robot manipulation, revealing a reliability gap where performance degrades on hard short-horizon and long-horizon tasks, and identifying GPT-6 Astra's strengths in physical interaction but weaknesses in geometric errors and cross-stage interference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LIBERO-Agent，一个用于在实体机器人操作中直接评估通用智能体的基准，揭示了在困难短视距和长视距任务中性能下降的可靠性差距，并指出GPT-6 Astra在物理交互上的优势及其在几何错误和跨阶段干扰上的弱点。

title: Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection
summary: A robot that observes people interacting with objects should be able to carry out later requests that refer back to those interactions. Such requests may specify a grasp target by the role it played in a past event rather than by its name or appearance. Moreover, the target may no longer be visible when the robot is asked to act. We present BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system for this event-referential setting. Given the event history and the current scene, the system identifies the requested object or part and localizes it for grasping. If the target is occluded, it combines an event prior recovered from the history with current scene geometry to select camera viewpoints likely to reveal the target. The system uses pretrained models without additional task-specific training. In real-robot experiments with a single wrist-mounted RGB-D camera, it achieves grasp success rates of 76% and 77% for initially visible and occluded targets, respectively, compared with 40% and 55% for the strongest baseline in each condition. On four additional scenes with heavy occlusion, it increases grasp success rates from 75% to 95% while reducing the mean number of views from 3.35 to 2.20, compared with an active-perception baseline given the target's ground-truth 3D bounding box.
summary_zh: 能够观察人与物体互动的机器人，应当能够执行之后提出的、涉及这些互动的请求。此类请求可能通过某个抓取目标在过去事件中所扮演的角色来指定它，而非依靠其名称或外观。此外，当机器人被要求执行任务时，该目标可能已不再可见。我们提出了BeyondSCe，一种适用于这种事件引用场景的零样本机器人抓取系统。给定事件历史记录和当前场景，该系统能够识别所请求的物体或其部件，并定位其位置以供抓取。若目标被遮挡，系统会将从历史记录中恢复的事件先验知识与当前场景几何信息相结合，选择可能揭示目标的相机视角。该系统使用预训练模型，无需额外的任务特定训练。在配备单个腕部RGB-D相机的真实机器人实验中，该系统对初始可见目标和被遮挡目标的抓取成功率分别达到76%和77%，而在每种条件下，最强基线的成功率分别为40%和55%。在四个重度遮挡的附加场景中，与给定目标真实三维边界框的主动感知基线相比，该系统将抓取成功率从75%提升至95%，同时将平均视角数量从3.35次减少至2.20次。
tldr: This paper introduces BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system that uses event history and active view selection to grasp objects referenced by past interactions, even when occluded, achieving high success rates on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BeyondSCe，一种零样本机器人抓取系统，利用事件历史和主动视角选择来抓取由过去交互所指代的对象，即使在遮挡情况下也能实现高成功率。

title: MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. HRC extracts differences between interaction representations at adjacent horizons, encodes them as temporal motion cues, and injects them into action tokens through a gated residual. During training, robot-arm masks rendered from future frames are used to construct KL-based motion-grounding supervision, while inference uses only the current observation. On six MetaWorld tasks, MotionWeave achieves a 75.3% average success rate, an absolute gain of 8.6% over π0 (66.7%), especially on sustained-interaction tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近年来引入了世界模型，以在稀疏动作标签之外提供更丰富的动态监督信号。然而，显式预测未来图像或视频可能包含与控制无关的外观信息，而基于整体未来视觉表征和共享全局动作特征所生成的引导信号，则难以建立动作与局部视觉变化之间逐时间步的对应关系。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MotionWeave，一种以运动为中心的未来动态框架，用于动作分块预测，包含两个模块：动作诱导运动定位器（AIMG）和时序残差合成器（HRC）。具体而言，AIMG以动作和本体感知表征为条件，构建特定于时间视界的查询，从当前视觉标记中定位与每个未来动作时间步相关联的交互区域。HRC提取相邻时间视界之间交互表征的差异，将其编码为时序运动线索，并通过门控残差注入动作标记中。在训练阶段，利用未来帧渲染的机械臂掩码构建基于KL散度的运动定位监督信号，而推理阶段仅使用当前观测。在六个MetaWorld任务上，MotionWeave实现了75.3%的平均成功率，相较于π0（66.7%）取得了8.6%的绝对提升，尤其在持续交互任务上表现突出。我们的代码已公开于 https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave。
tldr: MotionWeave introduces a motion-centered future-dynamics framework for VLA policies, using action-induced motion grounding and horizon residual composition to improve action-chunk prediction, achieving significant gains on MetaWorld.
tldr_zh: MotionWeave 提出了一种以运动为中心的未来动态框架，通过动作引导的运动定位和残差合成，增强视觉-语言-动作策略的动作块预测，在 MetaWorld 任务上显著提升性能。

title: HiWE: Hierarchical World Knowledge Model with Visual Keypoint Enhancement for Zero-Shot 3D Path Planning
summary: Robot demonstration generation requires a system to identify where an interaction should occur, plan a feasible motion, and execute the required contact. HiWE connects these decisions through a point-based interface between visual grounding and language-based planning. PointVLM is instruction-tuned to associate task-relevant objects with image coordinates using a mixture of point annotations, segmentation-derived samples, robot observations, and visual question answering data. Depth measurements lift these predictions into a semantic 3D representation. A language planner, 3DLLM, uses this representation to specify end-effector waypoints and gripper commands, while a hybrid grasping module resolves local grasp poses. The evaluation covers 14 simulated manipulation tasks and four physical-robot tasks, together with ablations of the visual training data, spatial inputs, and grasp selection. Here, zero-shot execution refers to deployment without task-specific demonstration training; the visual model uses existing robot data during fine-tuning. This paper describes the original point-based formulation of the framework; its relationship to the subsequent GeneralVLA extension is detailed in the introduction.
summary_zh: 机器人示范生成需要一个系统来识别交互应发生的位置、规划可行的运动并执行所需的接触。HiWE通过基于点的界面将视觉基础与语言规划连接起来，从而整合这些决策。PointVLM经过指令微调，利用点标注、分割衍生样本、机器人观测及视觉问答数据的混合，将任务相关对象与图像坐标关联起来。深度测量将这些预测提升为语义3D表示。语言规划器3DLLM利用该表示来指定末端执行器路径点和夹爪指令，而混合抓取模块则解决局部抓取姿态。评估涵盖14项模拟操作任务和4项实体机器人任务，并对视觉训练数据、空间输入及抓取选择进行了消融研究。此处，零样本执行指在无需任务特定示范训练的情况下进行部署；视觉模型在微调期间使用现有机器人数据。本文描述了该框架基于点的原始表述；其与后续GeneralVLA扩展的关系详见引言。
tldr: HiWE introduces a zero-shot 3D path planning framework that combines a visual keypoint model (PointVLM) with a language-based planner (3DLLM) and hybrid grasping to generate robot demonstrations from semantic 3D representations, validated on simulated and physical robot tasks.
tldr_zh: HiWE提出了一种零样本3D路径规划框架，结合视觉关键点模型（PointVLM）与基于语言的规划器（3DLLM）及混合抓取模块，从语义3D表示生成机器人演示，并在仿真和物理机器人任务中验证。

title: A Biophysically Detailed C. elegans Circuit as a Task-Agnostic Dynamical Core for Visually Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot policies are usually trained for one task, one body and one visual environment, and generalize poorly beyond these conditions. Whether a nervous system can instead supply the sensorimotor computation through its evolved wiring and biophysics remains unresolved. Here we embed a biophysically detailed Caenorhabditis elegans sensorimotor circuit - 136 multicompartment neurons with realistic morphologies and electrophysiological characteristics - as the dynamical core of a visuomotor policy. Only thin task-specific adapters are trained; the core's synaptic weights stay fixed while its membrane voltages evolve freely. Across different MetaWorld tasks the core matches or exceeds diffusion-policy, action-chunking-transformer and neural-circuit-policy baselines, and degrades less under visual perturbations. Replacing the core with generic network models such as MLP, LSTM, transformer or reservoir networks removes the advantage. Furthermore, on a real robotic arm the core withstands diverse visual perturbations that collapse the baselines. Our results suggest that visual robustness can be inherited from biophysically detailed circuit dynamics rather than learned by task-specific controllers.
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人策略通常针对单一任务、单一本体和单一视觉环境进行训练，因而在这些条件之外难以泛化。神经系统能否通过其进化形成的布线和生物物理特性，直接提供感觉运动计算，这一问题仍未得到解决。在此，我们将一个具有生物物理细节的秀丽隐杆线虫感觉运动回路——包含136个多房室神经元，具有逼真的形态学和电生理特性——嵌入作为视觉运动策略的动态核心。仅训练薄薄的任务专用适配层；核心的突触权重保持固定，而其膜电压自由演化。在多个MetaWorld任务中，该核心达到或超越了扩散策略、动作分块变换器及神经回路策略的基线水平，并且在视觉扰动下退化程度更小。将核心替换为MLP、LSTM、Transformer或储备池网络等通用网络模型后，这一优势消失。此外，在真实机械臂上，该核心能够抵御多种足以使基线方法崩溃的视觉扰动。我们的结果表明，视觉鲁棒性可以从具有生物物理细节的回路动力学中继承而来，而非由任务专用控制器学习获得。
tldr: This paper embeds a biophysically detailed C. elegans sensorimotor circuit as a fixed, task-agnostic dynamical core for visuomotor policies, showing improved robustness to visual perturbations across simulated and real robot manipulation tasks compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文将生物物理细节丰富的秀丽隐杆线虫感觉运动回路作为视觉运动策略的固定、任务无关的动态核心，在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中相比基线展现了对视觉扰动的更强鲁棒性。

title: ReWAM: Reciprocal World Action Models for Interactive Autonomous Driving
summary: In interactive scenarios, an autonomous driving system is required to generate ego actions under the influence of other agents' behaviors. Existing World Action Models (WAMs) typically model other agents as components of the world model rather than as decision-makers that fundamentally shape the action of the ego agent, which impairs their performance in dense interaction scenarios. We introduce Reciprocal World Action Models (ReWAM), a game-theoretic world action modeling framework that captures the reciprocal influence between the ego agent and other agents by representing them as conditional responders whose actions are mutually influenced. We instantiate this framework with a Level-$k$ response hierarchy, where role-specific ego and other action DiTs exchange compact strategy tokens through cross-agent attention while remaining grounded in a shared representation of the future driving world. To learn the response policy of the ego agent from demonstrations, we formulate expert actions as samples from the best response distribution and jointly optimize the entire hierarchy using conditional flow matching. Our framework is evaluated on the NAVSIM dataset and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to baselines. The improvement is particularly significant in interactive scenarios, validating that modeling reciprocal responses provides a more effective foundation for interaction-aware world action generation.
summary_zh: 在交互场景中，自动驾驶系统需要在其他智能体行为的影响下生成自车动作。现有世界动作模型通常将其他智能体建模为世界模型的组成部分，而非从根本上影响自车动作的决策者，这削弱了它们在密集交互场景中的性能。我们提出了互惠世界动作模型（ReWAM），这是一种博弈论式世界动作建模框架，通过将自车与其他智能体表示为条件响应者来捕捉它们之间的相互影响，其中各智能体的动作彼此作用。我们基于Level-$k$响应层级实例化该框架，其中角色特定的自车与其他智能体动作DiTs通过跨智能体注意力交换紧凑策略令牌，同时共同锚定于未来驾驶世界的共享表征。为了从演示中学习自车的响应策略，我们将专家动作建模为最优响应分布的样本，并利用条件流匹配联合优化整个层级结构。我们在NAVSIM数据集上评估了该框架，相较于基线方法取得了最优性能。在交互场景中性能提升尤为显著，验证了对互惠响应进行建模为交互感知的世界动作生成提供了更有效的基础。
tldr: ReWAM introduces a game-theoretic world action modeling framework for autonomous driving, using a Level-k response hierarchy and cross-agent attention to model reciprocal influence between ego and other agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: ReWAM 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的博弈论世界动作建模框架，通过 Level-k 响应层次和跨智能体注意力来建模自我与他人的相互影响，在 NAVSIM 上取得了最先进的结果。

title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
summary: World models offer a promising way to help robots understand how the physical world evolves and plan complex behaviours through imagination. Yet existing studies mainly demonstrate what these models can accomplish, leaving unclear when their predictions remain useful for planning and where they fail. We study this question using action-conditioned predictors built on five frozen self-supervised visual backbones: V-JEPA 2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAEv2, VideoPrism, and DINOv2. We use frozen backbones to test representations intended to transfer across environments. We evaluate these models on diverse Meta-World manipulation tasks and real-robot interactions from BridgeData V2. We find that a world model guides action selection reliably only when the goal lies within, or slightly beyond, the trajectory it imagines during planning. With five-step rollouts, the length the predictor was trained on, the world model ranks actions reliably only for targets five to ten control steps ahead, whereas task goals lie 16 to 53 steps away. Neither an 81-fold larger predictor nor longer-rollout training extends this range; the encoder affects both range and closed-loop success, with V-JEPA 2.1 performing most consistently. More fundamentally, the limit persists under perfect prediction: using the real simulator, success falls from 92% to 41% as the target moves from five to twenty steps ahead of a five-step rollout. Planning therefore requires either longer imagined trajectories or closer subgoals. For distant goals, pure imagination succeeds in 23% of episodes, planning with feedback (MPC) raises success to 30%, imagining as far as the goal to 47%, and nearby expert subgoals to 76%. Used within its plannable range, a world model can also improve a vision-language-action (VLA) policy: choosing among eight actions the VLA proposes raises its success from 65% to 77% across 16 different tasks.
summary_zh: 世界模型为帮助机器人理解物理世界如何演化并通过想象规划复杂行为提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，现有研究主要展示了这些模型能完成什么，而对于其预测在何种条件下对规划仍然有用、在何处失效，仍不清楚。我们利用基于五个冻结的自监督视觉骨干网络构建的动作条件预测器来研究这一问题，这五个骨干网络分别是V-JEPA 2、V-JEPA 2.1、VideoMAEv2、VideoPrism和DINOv2。我们使用冻结的骨干网络来测试旨在跨环境迁移的表征。我们在多种Meta-World操作任务以及BridgeData V2的真实机器人交互上评估了这些模型。我们发现，只有当目标位于世界模型在规划期间所想象轨迹之内或略超出该轨迹时，世界模型才能可靠地引导动作选择。对于五步展开（即预测器训练时的长度），世界模型仅能对五到十个控制步之后的目标可靠地排列动作，而任务目标则位于十六到五十三个步之后。无论是将预测器扩大八十一倍，还是延长展开训练，都无法扩展这一范围；编码器同时影响范围与闭环成功率，其中V-JEPA 2.1表现最为稳定。更为根本地，这一限制在完美预测下依然存在：使用真实模拟器，当目标从五步展开的五步之后移至二十步之后时，成功率从92%降至41%。因此，规划要么需要更长的想象轨迹，要么需要更接近的子目标。对于遥远的目标，纯想象在23%的回合中成功，带反馈的规划（MPC）将成功率提升至30%，想象延伸至目标本身则达到47%，而使用附近的专家子目标则达到76%。在其可规划范围内使用世界模型，还可以改进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略：从VLA提出的八个动作中选择一个，可将16个不同任务的成功率从65%提升至77%。
tldr: This paper investigates the planning limits of latent world models, showing that their action-selection reliability is confined to short horizons relative to task goals, and that this limit persists even with larger models or longer training. It further demonstrates that within this limited range, world models can improve VLA policies by selecting among proposed actions.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了潜在世界模型的规划极限，发现其动作选择可靠性仅限于相对于任务目标的短视界，且这一限制在更大模型或更长训练下依然存在。此外，在该有限范围内，世界模型可通过选择提议动作来提升VLA策略的性能。

title: DSDyn-VLA: A Dual-Stream Dynamic Manipulation Framework with Motion Perception, Future Awareness, and Realtime Correction
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static tasks, they struggle in dynamic environments where objects are in motion (e.g., conveyor belt manipulation). We identify three fundamental limitations hindering current VLAs in these scenarios: the \textbf{perception gap}, where static visual inputs lack temporal motion cues; the \textbf{latency gap}, where inference delays render actions obsolete; and the \textbf{control gap}, caused by the open-loop action chunk execution without real-time adjustment. In this work, we propose \textbf{DSDyn-VLA}, a Slow-Fast \textbf{D}ual-\textbf{S}tream \textbf{Dyn}amic manipulation framework that integrates motion-aware foresighted planning with real-time residual correction. The slow \textbf{Flow-Planner} serves as a macro-planner. By enhancing the VLA with optical flow for temporal perception and a future state awareness mechanism to preemptively offset inference latency, it produces globally consistent, motion-aware action chunks. Complementing this, the fast \textbf{Res-Refiner} employs a lightweight RL policy to inject high-frequency, closed-loop corrections into the planned action chunks based on real-time observations. In addition, we introduce \textbf{DynBench}, a MuJoCo-based benchmark for dynamic object manipulation that comprises nine tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSDyn-VLA reduces the failure rate by over 76\% compared to current SOTA method in high-latency setting on the Kinetix dynamic benchmark, while achieving about 6$\times$ the success rate of PI0.5 in real-world dynamic settings and about 5$\times$ on DynBench. We will open-source all the code and weights.
summary_zh: 虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在静态任务中表现出色，但在物体处于运动状态的动态环境（例如传送带操作）中却面临挑战。我们识别出当前VLA模型在这些场景中存在的三个根本性局限：\textbf{感知差距}，即静态视觉输入缺乏时间维度的运动线索；\textbf{延迟差距}，即推理延迟导致动作失效；以及\textbf{控制差距}，即开环动作块执行缺乏实时调整。在本工作中，我们提出\textbf{DSDyn-VLA}，一种慢-快\textbf{双}流\textbf{动}态操作框架，将运动感知的前瞻规划与实时残差校正相结合。慢流\textbf{Flow-Planner}作为宏观规划器，通过为VLA增强光流时间感知和未来状态感知机制以预先补偿推理延迟，生成全局一致且运动感知的动作块。与此互补，快流\textbf{Res-Refiner}采用轻量级强化学习策略，基于实时观测向规划的动作块注入高频闭环校正。此外，我们引入\textbf{DynBench}，一个基于MuJoCo的动态物体操作基准，包含九个任务。大量实验表明，在Kinetix动态基准的高延迟设置下，DSDyn-VLA相较当前最先进方法将失败率降低了超过76\%，同时在真实世界动态场景中取得了约为PI0.5六倍的成功率，在DynBench上约为五倍。我们将开源所有代码和权重。
tldr: DSDyn-VLA is a dual-stream framework for dynamic manipulation that combines a slow flow-aware VLA planner with a fast RL-based residual corrector to overcome perception, latency, and control gaps in moving-object tasks, achieving large success-rate gains over prior VLAs in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: DSDyn-VLA 是一种面向动态操作的双流框架，将慢速的光流感知 VLA 规划器与快速的基于强化学习的残差校正器相结合，以克服移动物体场景中的感知、延迟和控制差距，在仿真和真实世界设置中相比先前 VLA 取得了显著的成功率提升。

title: LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation
summary: High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations. Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation. Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines. Demos and code are available at: https://zhaozijie2022.github.io/LocoWM
summary_zh: 高精度运动结合了运动指令跟踪与任务相关物理状态的精确调控，使机器人能够在运动过程中与其周围环境可靠交互。端到端联合优化可能导致精度目标优化不足，而反应式残差控制仅在偏差变得可观测后才调整动作。我们提出了\textbf{LocoWM}，一种用于高精度运动的世界模型引导的预主动残差自适应框架。基础策略提供指令跟随运动，而动作条件世界模型根据本体感觉历史及所提出的基础动作预测未来物理状态序列。残差适配器以该预测序列为条件生成加性动作修正，以补偿预期偏差。两阶段训练首先学习运动与动作条件动力学，随后冻结这两个模块并训练适配器，从而将运动习得与精度自适应相分离。实验涵盖地形整平、加速度补偿和推力恢复，结果表明相较于端到端及反应式残差基线方法，该方法在控制精度和扰动鲁棒性方面均有提升。演示和代码见：https://zhaozijie2022.github.io/LocoWM
tldr: LocoWM introduces a world-model-guided residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion, where a world model predicts future physical states to enable preactive corrective actions, improving tracking precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive baselines.
tldr_zh: LocoWM 提出了一种基于世界模型引导的残差自适应框架，用于高精度运动控制，通过预测未来物理状态来生成预动修正动作，相比于端到端和反应式基线，提高了跟踪精度和抗干扰鲁棒性。

title: Exploiting Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
summary: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have revolutionized robotic manipulation by seamlessly integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation in an end-to-end learning framework. However, since these models are designed to interact directly with the physical world and humans, their security is critical, and even small vulnerabilities can lead to catastrophic failures. In this work, we propose the Universal Adversarial Object, a sphere with optimized surface texture that significantly degrades task success rates when placed within the robot's field of view. Specifically, our approach introduces a multi-level attack framework that jointly disrupts trajectory planning, task execution, and action control. We validate our method in both simulated and real-world robotic settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the adversarial object reduces the average task success rates by 31.2%-39.9% for two representative VLA models (Pi0 and RDT), with success rates dropping to near zero in complex scenarios. Index Terms--Vision-Language-Action models, adversarial attack, robotic security, universal adversarial object
summary_zh:
近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过在端到端学习框架中无缝集成视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，彻底革新了机器人操控技术。然而，由于这些模型直接与物理世界及人类交互，其安全性至关重要，即使微小的漏洞也可能导致灾难性故障。在本研究中，我们提出了一种通用对抗物体——一种表面纹理经过优化的球体，当它被放置在机器人视野内时，能够显著降低任务成功率。具体而言，我们的方法引入了一个多层攻击框架，可同时干扰轨迹规划、任务执行和动作控制。我们在仿真和真实机器人环境中均验证了该方法的有效性。实验结果表明，该对抗物体使两种代表性VLA模型（Pi0和RDT）的平均任务成功率降低了31.2%至39.9%，在复杂场景中成功率甚至降至接近零。

关键词——视觉-语言-动作模型，对抗攻击，机器人安全，通用对抗物体
tldr: This paper introduces a Universal Adversarial Object (a sphere with optimized surface texture) that, when placed in a robot's field of view, significantly degrades the task success rates of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models like Pi0 and RDT in both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种通用对抗性物体（具有优化表面纹理的球体），当置于机器人视野中时，可显著降低 Pi0 和 RDT 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在仿真和真实机器人操作中的任务成功率。

title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
summary: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.
summary_zh: 世界模型规划器通常通过更远地展开、采样更多轨迹或优化更长时间来进行外部扩展，同时对每个想象转换分配相同的计算量。我们证明，使每个转换均匀地更深会浪费计算，并可能降低规划质量，因为有用的细化集中在少数决策关键事件上。我们引入了DeepJEPA，一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测世界模型，它将转换深度作为内部测试时扩展轴，并学习对每个候选和展开步骤何时值得再进行一次循环更新。在五个视觉控制设置中，DeepJEPA在平均每次转换仅需1.00至1.26次更新的情况下，改进或匹配了最强的固定深度规划器。其额外计算集中在接触起始和持续物体交互上，在这些情况下，潜在修正可以改变哪些候选进入规划器的精英集以及选择哪个动作。表示探针进一步表明，改进的规划并不需要均匀更好的物体状态可解码性。因此，DeepJEPA将世界模型扩展重新定义为分配内部计算以改变规划器决策的问题：在决策关键转换处更深入地思考，而不是使每个展开都均匀地更深或更长。
tldr: DeepJEPA introduces a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that adaptively allocates computation per transition, improving planning efficiency and performance in visual-control tasks.
tldr_zh: DeepJEPA 提出了一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测世界模型，通过自适应分配每个转换的计算量，提高了视觉控制任务中的规划效率和性能。

title: Occlusion-Aware, Quasi-Static, Stability-Oriented Trajectory Planning on Uneven Terrain
summary: Autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments requires reasoning about both vehicle--terrain interaction and environmental unknowns. We propose a model-based framework for generating quasi-static, stability-oriented reference trajectories for rigid, non-articulated four-wheeled vehicles on highly uneven terrain. Our work makes three primary contributions. First, we model blind spots caused by terrain occlusion as coverage-induced epistemic uncertainty in a fixed-feature Fourier terrain representation, quantified through a regularized inverse-Hessian estimate. Second, we propagate this uncertainty through the Nonlinear Least-Squares (NLS) pose/contact model using implicit differentiation and incorporate the resulting pose, contact-point, and per-wheel surface-normal uncertainty terms into trajectory optimization based on the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). Third, we introduce a Flow Matching model that warm-starts terrain fitting, and we evaluate its fitting-accuracy--latency trade-off while retaining model-based refinement. Across six synthetic terrains with 30 matched start--goal pairs per terrain, the complete framework produced an observed failure rate of 18.9%, compared with 46.1% and 41.7% for two representative baselines and 34.4% for an ablation that removed the propagated-uncertainty scoring. Hardware evaluations span six distinct outdoor environments, with two representative executions presented in the paper and four additional executions included in the supplementary video. The evaluation also reports the accuracy--latency trade-off for the Flow Matching warm start.
summary_zh: 在非结构化的越野环境中进行自主导航，需要同时考虑车辆与地形的相互作用以及环境中的未知因素。我们提出了一种基于模型的框架，用于在高度不平坦的地形上为非铰接式四轮刚体车辆生成准静态、面向稳定性的参考轨迹。我们的工作有三个主要贡献。首先，我们将由地形遮挡引起的盲区建模为固定特征傅里叶地形表示中的覆盖诱发的认知不确定性，并通过正则化的逆海森矩阵估计进行量化。其次，我们利用隐式微分将该不确定性传播到基于非线性最小二乘（NLS）的位姿/接触模型中，并将由此产生的位姿、接触点以及每个车轮的表面法向不确定性项纳入基于交叉熵方法（CEM）的轨迹优化中。第三，我们引入了一种流匹配模型，用于地形拟合的暖启动，并在保留基于模型的精细化的同时，评估其拟合精度与延迟之间的权衡。在六个合成的具有30个匹配起点-终点对的地形上进行的实验表明，完整框架的观测失败率为18.9%，而两个代表性基线的失败率分别为46.1%和41.7%，去除传播不确定性评分后的消融实验失败率为34.4%。硬件评估覆盖了六个不同的户外环境，其中两次代表性执行在论文中展示，另外四次执行包含在补充视频中。评估还报告了流匹配暖启动的精度-延迟权衡。
tldr: The paper presents an occlusion-aware, stability-oriented trajectory planning framework for off-road vehicles on uneven terrain, incorporating uncertainty propagation through a pose/contact model and a flow matching warm start to reduce failure rates versus baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对不平坦地形的遮挡感知、稳定性导向的轨迹规划框架，通过位姿/接触模型中的不确定性传播和流匹配热启动，相比基线降低了失败率。

title: Make Code as Policy Great Again: Frontier Agents Write, Call, and Evolve Robot Tools
summary: Frontier models can control robots, but reasoning through every reach, grasp, and retreat makes manipulation slow and token-intensive. We revisit code as policy with a different division of labor: models build executable tools, code handles multi-phase motions, and models decide what to do next. We introduce URAI (Universal Robot-Agent Interface), which couples a programming agent that constructs robot tools with an execution agent that uses them in a feedback loop. The programming agent writes reusable and task-specific tools from task intent and refines them through execution feedback and human guidance. The execution agent selects and parameterizes these tools from current observations; each call runs a complete motion locally before returning control to the agent. Unlike delegating subsequent decisions to a generated program, this design retains model-level decision-making between tool executions. Validated tool revisions persist across episodes without updating foundation-model weights, and a shared GUI and API make the same tools available to humans and agents. Across five RoboDojo tasks and four frozen execution agents, URAI raises aggregate success from 18.0% to 53.0% relative to direct fingertip control, with the largest gain on Swap Blocks; with the same tools, a program written in advance reaches only 24% against 56% for two agents deciding after each call. Three of the four agents also finish episodes 1.3-1.5 times faster with 1.5-1.7 times fewer execution-agent output tokens; DeepSeek-V4-Flash's cost barely changes. We further evaluate URAI on seven real-world AgileX dual-arm tasks, spanning object manipulation, cloth folding, and human-interactive tic-tac-toe. URAI connects the coding and decision-making capabilities of frontier agents, organizing robot control around reusable tools that agents can both invoke and revise.
summary_zh: 前沿模型能够控制机器人，但若对每一次伸手、抓取与撤回都进行推理，会使得操作过程缓慢且消耗大量令牌。我们重新审视“以代码作为策略”的思路，并采用不同的分工方式：模型负责构建可执行工具，代码处理多阶段动作，模型则决策下一步行动。我们提出URAI（通用机器人-代理接口），它将构建机器人工具的编程代理与在反馈循环中使用这些工具的执行代理相结合。编程代理根据任务意图编写可复用且任务专用的工具，并通过执行反馈和人工指导加以完善。执行代理则根据当前观测选择并参数化这些工具；每次调用都会在本地运行完整动作，然后将控制权交还给代理。与将后续决策委托给生成程序的做法不同，这一设计在工具执行之间保留了模型层面的决策能力。经过验证的工具修订可在各回合间持续保留，且无需更新基础模型权重；共享的图形用户界面（GUI）和应用程序接口（API）使人类与代理都能使用相同的工具。在五个RoboDojo任务和四个冻结执行代理的实验中，相较于直接指尖控制，URAI将总体成功率从18.0%提升至53.0%，其中在Swap Blocks任务上改进最大；使用相同工具时，预先编写的程序仅达到24%的成功率，而两个代理在每次调用后决策则达到56%。四个代理中有三个完成任务的速度提升了1.3至1.5倍，执行代理输出令牌减少了1.5至1.7倍；DeepSeek-V4-Flash的成本几乎不变。我们还进一步在七个真实世界的AgileX双臂任务上评估了URAI，涵盖物体操作、布料折叠以及人机交互的井字棋。URAI将前沿代理的编码能力与决策能力相连接，围绕可复用工具组织机器人控制，这些工具既可被代理调用，也可由代理修改。
tldr: URAI introduces a code-as-policy framework where a programming agent builds reusable robot tools and an execution agent decides when to call them, improving success rates and efficiency across simulated and real dual-arm manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: URAI 提出一种代码即策略框架，编程智能体构建可复用机器人工具，执行智能体决定何时调用，在仿真和真实双臂操作任务中提升了成功率和效率。

title: OccluDex: Hierarchical 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Learning for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation under Self-Occlusion
summary: Reliable dexterous manipulation requires continuous estimation of object geometry and hand-object contact throughout interaction. With egocentric sensing, however, the manipulating hand frequently occludes task-relevant object surfaces and contact regions, reducing the visual evidence available for state estimation and thereby making robust closed-loop control and generalization to unseen object geometries particularly challenging. To address this, we present OccluDex, a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning framework that integrates global geometric structure with local contact information for robust manipulation under dynamic self-occlusion during hand-object interaction. OccluDex adopts multi-scale masked autoencoding to progressively encode partial 3D geometry and fuses tactile contact tokens with high-level geometric features through cross-modal attention. The encoder is pretrained from synchronized human visuo-tactile demonstrations and transferred as a frozen perceptual backbone for downstream reinforcement learning. We evaluate OccluDex on a faucet rotation task, requiring one full clockwise handle revolution, and a tabletop object reorientation task, requiring a 180-degree tabletop object reorientation without toppling. In simulation experiments, OccluDex demonstrated 12.6% higher accuracy for unseen objects and 8.3% higher accuracy for previously seen objects than the strongest state-of-the-art baseline models. Physical experiments were further performed with a Shadow Hand to demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real generalization on unseen physical objects. This results could enable humanoid egocentric object manipulation for seen and unseen objects even when the manipulating robotic hand occludes vision.
summary_zh: 可靠灵巧操作需要对交互过程中物体几何形状以及手-物体接触状态进行持续估计。然而，在自我中心感知条件下，操作手 frequently 遮挡与任务相关的物体表面和接触区域，减少了状态估计可用的视觉证据，从而使鲁棒的闭环控制和对未见物体几何形状的泛化尤为困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出OccluDex，一种层级化三维视觉-触觉表征学习框架，该框架在动态自我遮挡的手-物体交互过程中，将全局几何结构与局部接触信息进行整合，以实现鲁棒操作。OccluDex采用多尺度掩码自编码技术逐步编码部分三维几何信息，并通过跨模态注意力机制将触觉接触令牌与高层几何特征相融合。该编码器通过同步的人体视觉-触觉演示进行预训练，随后作为冻结感知骨干迁移至下游强化学习任务。我们在水龙头旋转任务（需完成一整圈顺时针手柄转动）以及桌面物体重定向任务（需在桌面完成180度重定向且不倾倒）上对OccluDex进行评估。仿真实验结果表明，与最强的现有最先进基线模型相比，OccluDex对未见物体的准确率提升了12.6%，对已见物体的准确率提升了8.3%。此外，我们还使用Shadow Hand进行了物理实验，验证了在未见物理物体上零样本仿真到现实迁移的成功实现。该成果可使仿人机器人即使在被操作机械手遮挡视觉的情况下，仍能对已见及未见物体实现自我中心视角下的物体操作。
tldr: OccluDex introduces a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning framework that integrates multi-scale masked autoencoding with cross-modal attention to enable robust dexterous manipulation under self-occlusion, demonstrating improved generalization in simulation and successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Shadow Hand.
tldr_zh: OccluDex提出了一种分层3D视觉-触觉表示学习框架，通过多尺度掩码自编码和跨模态注意力整合几何与接触信息，在自遮挡下实现鲁棒的灵巧操作，并在仿真和Shadow Hand实物上验证了泛化能力。

title: Function beyond Form: Functional Correspondence for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
summary: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation remains challenging because robotic hands differ substantially in geometry, topology, and kinematics. Existing approaches often lack explicit correspondences between structurally different hand regions that play similar functional roles in a grasp, a concept we refer to as functional correspondence. Consequently, their models tend to learn hand-specific interaction patterns rather than transferable grasp knowledge, limiting generalization to unseen hands. To address this limitation, we introduce FunCo-Grasp, which establishes functional correspondences across heterogeneous hand embodiments. Specifically, Functional Part Alignment aligns each hand to a canonical functional schema by mapping physical links to shared functional parts according to their grasping roles, while Canonical Frame Alignment expresses these parts in canonical local frames. These two alignments provide a consistent representation for inter-part and hand-object interactions, allowing the model to learn transferable grasp knowledge across hands. Conditioned on the aligned hand representation and object geometry, a diffusion model generates the target spatial arrangement of the functional parts, which are then converted into an executable joint configuration. Adapting FunCo-Grasp to an unseen hand requires only its geometric and kinematic models and a one-time lightweight functional annotation, without target-hand grasp data, fine-tuning, or learned retargeting. In simulation on held-out objects from the filtered CMapDataset, we achieves average success rates of 92.40% on three seen hands and 74.02% on four unseen hands. In real-world experiments, the same model achieves an overall success rate of 76.00% on two unseen hands without additional training or fine-tuning. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of FunCo-Grasp in transferring grasp knowledge to unseen hands.
summary_zh: 跨实体灵巧抓取生成仍具挑战性，原因在于机器人在几何结构、拓扑结构及运动学方面存在显著差异。现有方法往往缺乏对不同结构手部区域之间明确对应关系的建模，而这些区域在抓取中扮演相似的功能角色，我们将这一概念称为功能对应。因此，其模型倾向于学习特定于手部的交互模式，而非可迁移的抓取知识，从而限制了对未见过手部的泛化能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出FunCo-Grasp方法，在不同形态的手部实体之间建立功能对应关系。具体而言，功能部件对齐通过依据抓取角色将物理连杆映射至共享功能部件，将每只手对齐到一个规范功能模式；同时，规范框架对齐将这些部件表达于规范局部坐标系中。这两种对齐方式为部件间交互及手-物体交互提供了一致的表示，使模型能够学习跨手部可迁移的抓取知识。以对齐后的手部表示和物体几何为条件，扩散模型生成功能部件的目标空间布局，进而转换为可执行的关节配置。将FunCo-Grasp适配到未见过的手部，仅需其几何模型与运动学模型，以及一次性轻量级功能标注，无需目标手部抓取数据、微调或习得式重定向。在过滤后的CMapDataset保留物体上的仿真实验中，模型在三只已见手部上实现了92.40%的平均成功率，在四只未见手部上实现了74.02%的平均成功率。在真实世界实验中，同一模型在两只未见手部上无需额外训练或微调即实现了76.00%的整体成功率。上述结果验证了FunCo-Grasp在向未见过手部迁移抓取知识方面的有效性。
tldr: FunCo-Grasp establishes functional correspondences across heterogeneous robotic hands via canonical functional part and frame alignment, enabling a diffusion model to generate transferable grasps for unseen hands without extra data or fine-tuning, demonstrated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: FunCo-Grasp 通过将不同机器手对齐到规范的功能部分和坐标系，建立了跨异构手部的功能对应关系，使扩散模型能够为零样本的未见手部生成可迁移的抓取，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
summary: Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method. Project website: https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/
summary_zh: 全身遥操作要求人形机器人在操作者所处地形不同的情况下，仍能复现其行为。这要求机器人感知局部地形，并相应调整自身的姿态和接触状态，而非逐帧复制操作者的运动。然而，目前缺乏将平地与不同地形上相同行为关联起来的成对运动数据，这限制了对地形自适应控制进行监督学习的可能性。为了实现跨不匹配地形的全身遥操作，我们提出了NEXUS，一种将人类运动指令与机载感知反馈相结合的感知全身控制框架。我们首先开发了一种可扩展的地形感知自适应算法，无需针对每个动作或每种地形进行调参，即可高效生成覆盖多种动作和地形的高质量运动配对数据。利用总计近1000小时的配对运动语料库，我们通过教师-学生学习训练了一个感知全身控制器，使其能够跨地形复现指令行为。实验表明，该方法能够高效、可扩展地生成高质量运动数据，并展示出NEXUS兼具广泛的行为覆盖、地形适应能力和跟踪精度，在评估基准上优于现有全身控制器。零样本的真实世界部署实现了在多种未见地形上的实时全身遥操作，进一步验证了本方法的泛化能力。项目网站：https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/
tldr: NEXUS introduces a perceptive whole-body teleoperation framework for humanoid robots that adapts human motion commands to local terrain via a scalable terrain-aware data generation pipeline and teacher-student learning, achieving zero-shot real-world deployment on diverse unseen terrains.
tldr_zh: NEXUS 提出了一种感知全身遥操作框架，通过可扩展的地形自适应数据生成和师生学习，使仿人机器人能够根据局部地形调整姿态与接触，并在多种未见地形上实现零样本真实世界部署。

title: Cue the Flow: Steering Flow-Matching Policies for Open-World Delivery Manipulation
summary: Open-world goods delivery requires mobile manipulators to follow free-form user instructions and manipulate potentially novel objects. Existing dual-system approaches use high-level grounding models to convert language into grounded visual prompts, but their low-level controllers can remain brittle under noisy perception, dynamic scenes, and contact-rich interactions. We instead use a pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action model as the low-level control interface, leveraging its reactivity and robustness to environmental changes while treating the grounding output as a spatial cue for policy steering. Our key insight is that the pretrained VLA already provides a strong manipulation prior, while the spatial cue supplies the missing target information needed to guide actions under novel language--object mappings. Concretely, we introduce a lightweight cue-conditioned adapter. The adapter is first trained with contrastive objectives to produce salient and spatially discriminative cue representations, and is then supervised to predict a diagonal affine transformation over the generated action chunk, aligning policy steering with the cued target. Across tabletop and mobile-base settings, our method improves instruction following and manipulation success on both in-domain and out-of-domain objects, achieving up to near $2\times$ improvement in average task success rate with negligible inference overhead.
summary_zh: 开放世界货物配送要求移动操作机器人遵循自由形式的用户指令并操作潜在的新颖物体。现有的双系统方法使用高层语义落地模型将语言转换为具象化的视觉提示，但其低层控制器在感知噪声、动态场景及富含接触的交互中仍可能表现脆弱。我们转而采用预训练的流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型作为低层控制接口，利用其对环境变化的响应能力与鲁棒性，同时将语义落地输出视为策略引导的空间提示。我们的核心洞见在于，预训练的VLA模型已具备强大的操作先验，而空间提示则提供了在新颖语言-物体映射关系下引导动作所需的缺失目标信息。具体而言，我们引入了一种轻量级的提示条件适配器。该适配器首先通过对比学习目标进行训练，以产生显著且具有空间判别性的提示表征，随后被监督学习预测生成动作块上的对角仿射变换，使策略引导与提示目标对齐。在桌面场景和移动底盘场景中，我们的方法在域内物体和域外物体上均提升了指令遵循与操作成功率，平均任务成功率最高提升近$2$倍，且推理开销可忽略不计。
tldr: This paper introduces a cue-conditioned adapter that steers a pretrained flow-matching VLA model using spatial grounding from language instructions, improving open-world delivery manipulation success on real mobile manipulators.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种线索条件适配器，利用语言指令的空间接地来引导预训练的流匹配VLA模型，提高了开放世界移动操作任务的成功率。

title: Sparse-WAM: Accelerating World Action Models via Action-Guided Sparse Imagination
summary: World-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video models to improve generalization in robot control by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. This capability comes at a substantial inference cost, as dense future-frame tokens are repeatedly processed during denoising. Prior methods address this by token pruning that prioritizes visual fidelity to reduce denoising costs in video diffusion models. However, these methods do not use action relevance to determine which future-frame tokens to retain during joint denoising in WAMs. In this paper, we propose Sparse-WAM, a training-free framework for action-guided sparse imagination that selectively processes future-frame tokens to accelerate WAM inference. We observe substantial overlap in the spatial distribution of attention from action tokens to future-frame tokens (action-to-future attention) between consecutive denoising steps, despite continued updates to the future representations. Motivated by this, we develop Action-Guided Token Selection to retain frame-specific action-relevant regions together with cross-frame context. However, a naive implementation can incur attention-scoring and token-packing overhead that offsets the computational savings from pruning. We therefore introduce Pilot, an efficient engine that reduces sparse inference overhead through lightweight scoring and cross-step reuse of token selections. On LIBERO with FastWAM-Joint and RoboLab-120 with Cosmos 3 Edge, Sparse-WAM achieves inference speedups of approximately $2.0\times$ and $1.8\times$, respectively, over dense eager inference on an NVIDIA RTX 4090, while largely preserving task performance.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）利用预训练的视频模型，通过联合预测未来视觉状态和动作来提升机器人控制中的泛化能力。然而，这种能力带来了巨大的推理成本，因为在去噪过程中需要反复处理密集的未来帧标记。现有方法通过优先考虑视觉保真度的标记剪枝来降低视频扩散模型中的去噪成本，但这些方法并未利用动作相关性来决定WAMs联合去噪过程中应保留哪些未来帧标记。本文提出Sparse-WAM，一种免训练的动作引导稀疏想象框架，通过选择性处理未来帧标记以加速WAM推理。我们观察到，在连续的去噪步骤中，尽管未来表示持续更新，动作标记到未来帧标记的注意力（动作到未来注意力）在空间分布上存在显著重叠。基于此观察，我们开发了动作引导标记选择，以保留特定于帧的动作相关区域以及跨帧上下文。然而，朴素实现可能引入注意力评分和标记打包的开销，从而抵消剪枝带来的计算节省。因此，我们引入Pilot，一种高效引擎，通过轻量级评分和跨步标记选择复用来减少稀疏推理开销。在LIBERO测试集上搭配FastWAM-Joint，以及在RoboLab-120测试集上搭配Cosmos 3 Edge，Sparse-WAM在NVIDIA RTX 4090上相比密集即时推理分别实现了约$2.0\times$和$1.8\times$的推理加速，同时基本保持了任务性能。
tldr: Sparse-WAM introduces a training-free, action-guided token selection method to accelerate world action model inference by pruning future-frame tokens during joint denoising, achieving ~2x and ~1.8x speedups on LIBERO and RoboLab-120 while preserving task performance.
tldr_zh: Sparse-WAM 提出了一种无需训练、动作引导的令牌选择方法，通过在联合去噪过程中剪枝未来帧令牌来加速世界动作模型推理，在 LIBERO 和 RoboLab-120 上分别实现了约 2 倍和 1.8 倍的加速，同时保持了任务性能。

title: SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable abilities to autonomously reason about and achieve goals in the digital world. However, bringing this success to the physical world remains challenging. On the one hand, direct generation methods (e.g., Code as Policies) often suffer from the LLMs' insufficient understanding of robots and physical environments. On the other hand, iterative trial-and-error tuning in the physical world (e.g., physical autoresearch) induces significant experimental cost and safety concerns. We introduce SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch, an autoresearch framework that tightly integrates simulated experimentation, enabling coding agents to efficiently acquire physical capabilities for controlling real robots. SimEX operates in two stages. First, the agent conducts open-ended probe-and-optimize iterations in simulation, developing a robot toolbox with robust and generalizable capabilities. Second, the agent adapts the toolbox and the simulator together through only a few physical trials: each trial corrects the simulator, and the corrected simulator is used to diagnose failures and screen candidate repairs. We evaluate SimEX extensively in sim-to-sim settings and on physical robots. On challenging real-world manipulation tasks including towel folding, barcode scanning, and plate manipulation, SimEX enables coding agents to efficiently acquire robot skills without any demonstration and with only 10 minutes of real-robot interaction. These results suggest that simulation can be a critical component in achieving physical intelligence, not only as a source of training data that must closely replicate the real world, but also as a roughly correct laboratory where a coding agent develops the knowledge and procedures needed to act on the robot. More details and robot videos at https://robo-simex.github.io/
summary_zh: 由大语言模型（LLMs）驱动的编码智能体已在数字世界中展现出自主推理并实现目标的卓越能力。然而，将这一成功推广至物理世界仍面临挑战。一方面，直接生成方法（如“代码即策略”）常常受限于大语言模型对机器人和物理环境理解的不足。另一方面，在物理世界中进行迭代试错调优（如物理自动研究）则带来显著的实验成本与安全隐患。我们提出SimEX：仿真集成式机器人自动研究框架，该框架紧密集成仿真实验，使编码智能体能够高效获取控制真实机器人的物理能力。SimEX分两个阶段运行。首先，智能体在仿真环境中进行开放式“探索—优化”迭代，构建具有鲁棒性和泛化能力的机器人工具库。其次，智能体仅通过少量物理试验即可协同适配工具库与仿真器：每次试验对仿真器进行校正，而校正后的仿真器则用于诊断失败并筛选候选修复方案。我们在仿真到仿真设置及物理机器人上对SimEX进行了广泛评估。在包括毛巾折叠、条码扫描和餐盘操作等具有挑战性的真实世界操作任务中，SimEX使编码智能体在无需任何示范、仅需10分钟真实机器人交互的情况下，高效获取机器人技能。这些结果表明，仿真是实现物理智能的关键组成部分，它不仅作为必须紧密复现真实世界的训练数据来源，更是一个大致正确的实验室，编码智能体可在其中发展执行机器人操作所需的知识与流程。更多详情及机器人视频请见 https://robo-simex.github.io/
tldr: SimEX is an autoresearch framework that uses simulation-integrated, open-ended probe-and-optimize iterations to enable LLM coding agents to acquire real-world robot manipulation skills with minimal physical trials, demonstrating effectiveness on tasks like towel folding and barcode scanning.
tldr_zh: SimEX是一个仿真集成的自动研究框架，通过开放式探索和优化迭代，使LLM编码代理能够以极少的真实世界试验获得真实机器人操作技能，在毛巾折叠和条形码扫描等任务中展示了有效性。

title: Refusals That Bend: Measuring and Predicting Task Malleability in Embodied VLM Planners
summary: Embodied vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for robots because they generalize across diverse environments. However, this requires their safety alignment to also hold in unseen environments. Existing red-teaming assumes an adversary who optimizes the prompt, the pixels, or text in the environment, and existing benchmarks ask whether a planner recognizes or mitigates a hazard in a fixed scene. Neither asks whether a refusal the planner has already given survives an ordinary change to the environment. We ask that question by placing a single everyday object into the environment, with no pixel, gradient, or prompt under adversarial control. On $846$ tasks that a constitution-guarded planner initially refuses, we find $20.2\%$ of tasks can be flipped to compliance by one or more objects, and the number of objects differs from one task to another. In addition, the object need not be chosen for the task, i.e., items drawn from a fixed list, with no knowledge of the environment or the instruction, bypass safety about as often as items proposed for the specific task. We qualitatively contrast the tasks bypassed most and least often and find that the distinction lies in how conspicuous the hazard is in the instruction and environment. Susceptibility to safety bypass is therefore a property of the task, which we call its \emph{malleability}, and we show that it can be predicted before the target is ever queried. A composite of signals read from a small open-source VLM identifies malleable tasks $2.4\times$ as often as picking at random. Everyday objects, whether placed by an adversary or introduced by ordinary rearrangement of the environment, are thus sufficient to overturn a refusal. Because susceptibility is determined by how a task is specified, we recommend assessing malleability per task prior to deployment.
summary_zh: 具身视觉语言模型（VLMs）正越来越多地被部署为机器人的高级规划器，因为它们在多样环境中具有良好的泛化能力。然而，这要求其安全对齐在未见环境中同样成立。现有的红队测试假设攻击者对提示词、像素或环境中的文本进行优化，而现有基准测试则考察规划器是否能在固定场景中识别或缓解危险。两者均未提出这样的问题：规划器已经给出的拒答能否在环境的普通变化下依然成立。我们通过向环境中放入一个日常物品来提出这一问题，且不涉及任何对抗性控制的像素、梯度或提示词。在宪法保护下的规划器最初拒绝的846个任务中，我们发现20.2%的任务可因一个或多个物品而被翻转为遵从，且所需物品数量因任务而异。此外，该物品无需针对任务特别选择，即从固定列表中抽取、对环境或指令一无所知的物品，其绕过安全的频率与针对特定任务提议的物品大致相当。我们定性对比了最常被绕过和最不常被绕过的任务，发现差异在于危险在指令和环境中的显著程度。因此，对安全绕过的敏感性是任务本身的一种属性，我们称之为任务的“可塑性”（malleability），并证明可以在目标被查询之前对其进行预测。从一个小型开源VLM中读取的复合信号识别可塑性任务的频率是随机选取的2.4倍。因此，无论是攻击者放置的还是环境普通重排引入的日常物品，都足以推翻拒答。由于敏感性由任务的指定方式决定，我们建议在部署前对每个任务进行可塑性评估。
tldr: This paper introduces the concept of 'malleability' in embodied VLM planners, showing that a single everyday object can flip a planner's safety refusal to compliance across 20.2% of tasks, and that this susceptibility can be predicted before deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了具身VLM规划器中的“可塑性”概念，表明一个日常物体可以在20.2%的任务中使规划器的安全拒绝转为合规，且这种易感性可以在部署前预测。

title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作的强化学习必须发现手指与物体的接触，并在此基础上精确控制物体；而服务于前一目标的动作噪声可能干扰后一目标。在诸如ViViDex这类由轨迹引导的设置中，强化学习从人类视频中细化手-物轨迹，我们的基线PPO在5M步后其末端动作噪声仍接近初始水平，这促使我们对探索尺度进行显式控制。DexPolicy将这一尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，在保持损失、架构、奖励和优化器设置不变的情况下，将探索从广泛退火至狭窄。我们研究了三种策略优化设置：PPO、无评论家的GRPO续训，以及流参数化的PPO变体（FPO）。在五个YCB物体和三个训练种子上，确定性目标成功率均值从49.4%提升至68.1%（FPO）、从14.1%提升至45.4%（GRPO）、从32.0%提升至35.7%（PPO）。在配备Inspire/RH56灵巧手的RealMan RM75机械臂上，对三个物体进行的360次试验将平均目标成功率从25.0%提升至85.0%（FPO）、从10.0%提升至63.3%（GRPO）、从8.3%提升至43.3%（PPO），每个物体-方法条件下各训练一个模型。PPO组件筛选表明，噪声控制优于所测试的优化器收缩策略；在三个测试物体上，所选的PPO调度相比具有相同端点的线性衰减获得了更高的平均目标成功率。训练回报、确定性目标成功率以及对执行噪声的容忍度三者并不一致；因此，应根据目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率，针对每个任务和策略优化设置来评判调度策略。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy。
tldr: DexPolicy introduces a scheduled exploration mechanism that anneals action noise from broad to narrow during RL training, significantly improving trajectory-guided dexterous manipulation success in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: DexPolicy提出了一种从宽到窄的探索调度机制，在强化学习训练中动态调整动作噪声，显著提升了仿真和真实机器人上的轨迹引导灵巧操作成功率。

title: EmbodiRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Data-Efficient Robot Adaptation
summary: Adapting robot manipulation policies to new tasks and environments remains highly data-intensive, while the data needed for further improvement depends on the policy's current capabilities and failure modes. We introduce EmbodiRSI, an agentic system for recursive self-improvement (RSI) in a real-to-sim-to-real setting, where task-specific simulations are constructed from target deployment scenarios and used as low-cost environments for iterative policy improvement before transfer back to the physical world. EmbodiRSI uses policy execution feedback to guide subsequent experience acquisition and policy updates. Two complementary mechanisms close this loop: Collaborative Error Correction generates agent-assisted corrective trajectories from policy-reached states, while Adaptive Data Collection directs expert demonstration generation toward the current policy's weaknesses. The task-specific simulation serves as a reusable workspace for policy warm-up, repeatable evaluation, failure diagnosis, and targeted data generation across successive RSI rounds. Across three tabletop environments and 14 subtasks, EmbodiRSI increases scene-balanced autonomous simulation success from 50.4% to 83.5% over two RSI updates. With 400 adaptive simulated trajectories and only ten real-world refinement trajectories per subtask, EmbodiRSI achieves 83.1% scene-balanced autonomous real-world success, compared with 75.0% for adaptation using 200 real-world demonstrations per subtask. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven recursive improvement in deployment-specific simulations can enable data-efficient adaptation of embodied policies to physical environments.
summary_zh: 让机器人操作策略适应新任务和新环境仍然高度依赖数据，而进一步提升所需的数据则取决于策略当前的能力与失败模式。我们提出了EmbodiRSI，一个在“真实-仿真-真实”框架下实现递归自我改进（RSI）的智能体系统。在该系统中，针对目标任务场景构建特定仿真环境，并将其作为低成本环境，在策略迁移回物理世界之前进行迭代改进。EmbodiRSI利用策略执行反馈来指导后续经验获取和策略更新。两个互补机制闭环运行：协作错误纠正机制从策略已到达的状态生成智能体辅助修正轨迹，而自适应数据收集机制则将专家示范生成引导至当前策略的弱点区域。任务特定仿真环境作为可复用工作空间，支持策略预热、可重复评估、失败诊断以及跨多轮递归改进的定向数据生成。在三个桌面环境和14个子任务中，EmbodiRSI经过两轮递归改进，将场景均衡的自主仿真成功率从50.4%提升至83.5%。在每子任务仅使用400条自适应仿真轨迹和十条真实世界精调轨迹的情况下，EmbodiRSI实现了83.1%的场景均衡真实世界自主成功率，而采用每子任务200条真实世界示范进行适配的方法仅为75.0%。这些结果表明，在部署特定仿真环境中进行反馈驱动的递归改进，能够实现具身策略对物理环境的数据高效适应。
tldr: EmbodiRSI introduces a real-to-sim-to-real agentic system that uses recursive self-improvement, including collaborative error correction and adaptive data collection, to achieve data-efficient adaptation of robot manipulation policies, improving real-world success from 75.0% to 83.1% with far fewer real-world demonstrations.
tldr_zh: EmbodiRSI 提出了一种真实到仿真再到真实的智能体系统，通过递归自我改进（包括协作错误修正和自适应数据收集），在少量真实演示下实现机器人操作策略的高效适应，将真实成功率从75.0%提升至83.1%。

title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled manipulation policies to perform increasingly diverse tasks and generalize across environments. However, reliable execution often depends on hidden task states that cannot be determined from current observations alone, making interaction history essential. We introduce $HIDE$, a benchmark for evaluating manipulation memory under partial observability. HIDE comprises 15 tasks covering repetition counting, historical-state recall, and execution-progress tracking, with randomized initial configurations and decision points where similar observations require different actions depending on prior events. We further propose $SEEK$, a framework combining three complementary memory mechanisms to retain historical evidence and track execution state. Evaluations reveal substantial limitations in existing policies on HIDE, while memory augmentation improves task success in both simulation and real-world experiments. Individual mechanisms benefit some tasks but can degrade others; their combination achieves the highest average success rate on HIDE among the evaluated configurations. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining internal representations of hidden task states and matching memory design to task-specific information requirements.
summary_zh: 近年来，机器人学习领域的进展使得操作策略能够执行日益多样化的任务，并在不同环境中实现泛化。然而，可靠的执行往往依赖于无法仅凭当前观测确定的任务隐藏状态，因此交互历史的记录至关重要。我们提出了$HIDE$，一个用于在部分可观测性条件下评估操作记忆能力的基准测试平台。HIDE包含15项任务，涵盖重复计数、历史状态回忆和执行进度追踪，并设有随机初始配置及决策点——在这些决策点上，相似观测要求依据先前事件采取不同动作。我们进一步提出$SEEK$框架，该框架结合三种互补的记忆机制以保留历史证据并追踪执行状态。评估结果显示，现有策略在HIDE上存在显著局限，而记忆增强在仿真和真实世界实验中均能提升任务成功率。各单一机制对部分任务有益，但可能对其他任务产生负面影响；而它们的组合配置在HIDE上取得了评估设置中的最高平均成功率。这些发现凸显了维护隐藏任务状态内部表征的重要性，以及将记忆设计匹配至任务特定信息需求的关键价值。
tldr: This paper introduces HIDE, a benchmark for evaluating manipulation memory under partial observability, and SEEK, a framework combining three memory mechanisms to improve task success on HIDE in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HIDE基准，用于评估部分可观测条件下的操作记忆，并提出了SEEK框架，结合三种互补记忆机制，在仿真和真实世界实验中提高了任务成功率。

title: Efficient Multi-Modal Planning with Reward-Guided Preference Optimization for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safe and efficient trajectory planning is essential in autonomous driving. However, existing end-to-end approaches often fall short in both computational efficiency and safety guarantees. Methods based on imitation learning suffer from causal confusion, while rule-based scoring approaches often incur heavy computational overhead and suffer from objective misalignment. Additionally, preference-based methods rely on strict pairwise annotations, limiting data utilization. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPlan, an efficient multi-modal trajectory planning method powered by reward-guided fine-tuning. We design a hybrid architecture that combines sparse anchors with an offset refinement module for efficient multi-modal trajectory prediction. Sparse anchors provide coarse trajectory candidates with low latency, which are subsequently refined by the offset module for higher prediction accuracy. To enhance safety without incurring additional inference costs, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm consisting of pretraining and reward-guided fine-tuning. During fine-tuning, we leverage rule-based reward signals and unpaired preference supervision to refine the pretrained policy toward safer trajectory selection. We evaluate EMPlan on the non-reactive NAVSIM benchmark, where it strikes a favorable balance between planning accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating superior performance under real-time constraints.
summary_zh: 摘要：安全高效的轨迹规划对于自动驾驶至关重要。然而，现有的端到端方法在计算效率和安全保障方面往往存在不足。基于模仿学习的方法易受因果混淆的影响，而基于规则评分的方法通常计算开销较大，且存在目标不一致的问题。此外，基于偏好的方法依赖于严格的成对标注，限制了数据的利用率。为克服上述局限，我们提出EMPlan，一种以奖励引导微调驱动的高效多模态轨迹规划方法。我们设计了一种混合架构，将稀疏锚点与偏移精化模块相结合，以实现高效的多模态轨迹预测。稀疏锚点以低延迟提供粗略的轨迹候选，随后由偏移模块对其进行精化，以提升预测精度。为在不增加推理成本的前提下增强安全性，我们采用了两阶段训练范式，包括预训练和奖励引导微调。在微调阶段，我们利用基于规则的奖励信号和非成对偏好监督，将预训练策略优化为更安全的轨迹选择。我们在非反应式NAVSIM基准上对EMPlan进行了评估，其在规划精度与效率之间取得了良好平衡，在实时约束下展现出优越性能。
tldr: EMPlan proposes a hybrid sparse-anchor-plus-offset architecture and a two-stage training paradigm with reward-guided preference optimization for efficient and safe multi-modal trajectory planning in autonomous driving, achieving favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on the NAVSIM benchmark.
tldr_zh: EMPlan 提出了一种结合稀疏锚点和偏移细化模块的混合架构，并采用基于奖励引导的偏好优化的两阶段训练范式，用于自动驾驶中的高效安全多模态轨迹规划，在 NAVSIM 基准上实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。

title: Plan-Conditioned Imitation for Robust Object Retrieval under Self-Occlusion in Dense Clutter
summary: Retrieving objects from dense clutter requires rearrangement during which the manipulator can occlude objects while moving them. Repeated arm withdrawals to restore visibility interrupt execution. We introduce TRACE, a plan-conditioned imitation framework for retrieval under self-occlusion. A single unoccluded observation initializes a digital twin, where a privileged teacher generates a fixed nominal rollout. A recurrent student combines local rollout context, partial object observations, and proprioception to select actions that can correct deviations from the prediction. Behavior cloning initializes the student; DAgger refines it with teacher labels on student-visited states. The rollout remains fixed throughout execution, so the deployed student needs neither online teacher queries nor additional simulator rollouts during pushing. On 511 simulation test scenes, TRACE achieves 90.7% success versus 43.4% for nominal replay and 96.7% for the privileged closed-loop teacher. At a matched 26,373-label budget, student-state supervision achieves 87.8% versus 66.7% for expert-only cloning, demonstrating gains beyond additional labels. On a UR5e, TRACE achieves 90.0% success versus 95.0% for the closed-loop teacher, while reducing total execution time from 192.7 s to 67.3 s. It avoids the teacher's 16.8 sensing-related arm retractions per trial during pushing, retaining a final withdrawal for graspability evaluation. Code and data will be released at: https://trace-retrieval.github.io.
summary_zh: 从密集杂乱环境中取回物体需要重新排列，在此过程中机械臂在移动物体时可能遮挡其他物体。反复收回机械臂以恢复视野会中断操作执行。我们提出TRACE，一种面向自遮挡条件下取回任务的基于计划条件的模仿学习框架。单次无遮挡观测初始化一个数字孪生环境，其中特权教师生成固定的标称轨迹展开。循环学生网络结合局部轨迹上下文、部分物体观测和本体感觉来选择能够纠正与预测偏差的动作。行为克隆初始化学生网络；DAgger算法利用教师对学生访问状态的标注进一步优化。轨迹展开在整个执行过程中保持不变，因此部署的学生网络在推动过程中既不需要在线教师查询，也不需要额外的仿真轨迹展开。在511个仿真测试场景中，TRACE实现了90.7%的成功率，而标称重放为43.4%，特权闭环教师为96.7%。在匹配的26，373条标注预算下，学生状态监督达到87.8%的成功率，而仅专家克隆为66.7%，证明了超越额外标注的收益。在UR5e机械臂上，TRACE实现了90.0%的成功率，而闭环教师为95.0%，同时将总执行时间从192.7秒缩短至67.3秒。它避免了教师在推动过程中每轮试验平均16.8次与传感相关的机械臂收回，仅保留最终一次收回用于可抓取性评估。代码和数据将在以下网址发布：https://trace-retrieval.github.io。
tldr: TRACE is a plan-conditioned imitation framework for robotic object retrieval from dense clutter, using a privileged teacher's fixed rollout to train a recurrent student that handles self-occlusion, improving success and efficiency on both simulation and a real UR5e robot.
tldr_zh: TRACE 是一种计划条件模仿框架，用于从密集杂乱环境中取回物体，利用特权教师的固定 rollout 训练循环学生网络以应对自遮挡，在仿真和真实 UR5e 机器人上均提高了成功率和效率。

title: Online Evolution Strategy for Flow-Matching VLA Policies via Self-Supervised Trajectory Distribution Optimization
