summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models based on generative frameworks, such as Flow Matching, have recently achieved impressive performance in robotic manipulation. Unlike deterministic policies, Flow Matching enables VLA models to learn conditional action trajectory distributions, where latent noise vectors induce different actions under the same task scenario. However, we observe that these distributions are often ill-formed, with successful and failed behaviors coexisting while considerable probability mass remains in unfavorable regions. To this end, we propose Online-ES, an online adaptation framework for Flow Matching VLAs based on Evolution Strategy (ES), which refines the learned action trajectory distribution through interaction feedback. Instead of pruning the latent noise space, our method performs evolutionary exploration directly in the action trajectory space, where diverse trajectories generated by Flow Matching provide candidate solutions for adaptation. By perturbing sampled trajectories and evaluating their execution outcomes, we derive a self-supervised MSE objective that transfers the evolution direction from trajectory space into model parameter space. Mathematically, we prove that the proposed objective provides an unbiased estimator of the optimal evolution direction. Moreover, we also incorporate failure experiences as negative feedback to regularize the evolution direction, steering the policy away from previously explored failure regions. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that Online-ES achieves policy improvement comparable to reinforcement fine-tuning, without learning a value model or computing advantages.
summary_zh: 基于生成框架（如流匹配）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近期在机器人操作任务中取得了显著性能提升。与确定性策略不同，流匹配使VLA模型能够学习条件动作轨迹分布，其中潜在噪声向量在同一任务场景下可诱导出不同动作。然而，我们观察到这些分布往往形态不佳，成功与失败的行为并存，且相当一部分概率质量落在不利区域。为此，我们提出Online-ES，一种基于进化策略（ES）的流匹配VLA在线适应框架，通过交互反馈来细化所学到的动作轨迹分布。我们的方法并非剪除潜在噪声空间，而是直接在动作轨迹空间中进行进化探索，由流匹配生成的多样化轨迹为适应过程提供候选解。通过对采样轨迹施加扰动并评估其执行结果，我们推导出一个自监督的均方误差（MSE）目标，将进化方向从轨迹空间传递至模型参数空间。从数学上，我们证明所提出的目标能够为最优进化方向提供无偏估计。此外，我们还引入失败经验作为负反馈来正则化进化方向，引导策略远离先前探索过的失败区域。在仿真和真实环境中的实验均表明，Online-ES在无需学习价值模型或计算优势函数的情况下，能够实现与强化学习微调相当的策略改进效果。
tldr: This paper introduces Online-ES, an online adaptation framework using Evolution Strategy to refine the action trajectory distributions of Flow-Matching VLA policies via self-supervised trajectory distribution optimization, achieving policy improvement comparable to reinforcement fine-tuning in simulation and real-world robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Online-ES，一种基于进化策略的在线自适应框架，通过自监督轨迹分布优化来改进Flow-Matching VLA策略的动作轨迹分布，在仿真和真实机器人操作中取得了与强化学习微调相当的性能提升。

title: PhaseSync-Exo: Human Clock Anchored Reference Adaptation for Dynamic Gait Tracking
summary: Human-aware exoskeleton walking requires reconstructing gait, tracking diverse motions under dynamic constraints, and preserving human timing. We present PhaseSync-Exo, which combines two-IMU CNN-Transformer reconstruction, factorized amplitude-cadence retargeting with curriculum-trained recurrent control, and a human-clock-anchored adapter (HCA). HCA combines human-clock attraction with robot-relative feedback to adjust reference rate while preserving forward progression and continuity. The reconstruction module achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 3.24 degrees on a held-out recording, and the frozen tracking policy completes 356 of 357 amplitude-frequency trials. Two complementary dynamic comparisons isolate HCA's timing benefit without retraining. Against robot-relative correction, HCA reduces human-clock phase MAE from 95.55 degrees to 10.99 degrees, limiting reference drift. When human and delivered phases initially differ, it reduces phase MAE from 72.02 degrees to 13.90 degrees versus fixed-clock continuation. Compared with immediate phase reset, HCA reduces transient reference-tracking hip RMSE by 22.7% without reference jumps. All 420 timing rollouts complete without falls. These simulation results support continuous phase acquisition and sustained alignment to an independent human clock.
summary_zh: 人类感知的外骨骼行走需要重建步态、在动态约束下跟踪多样化运动，并保持人类的时间节律。我们提出了PhaseSync-Exo，它结合了双IMU CNN-Transformer重建、因子化幅度-步频重定向与课程训练的循环控制，以及以人类时钟为锚点的适配器（HCA）。HCA将人类时钟吸引与机器人相对反馈相结合，以调整参考速率，同时保持前进推进和连续性。重建模块在保留测试记录上实现了3.24度的平均绝对误差（MAE），冻结的跟踪策略在357个幅度-频率试验中完成了356个。两项互补的动态对比在不重新训练的情况下隔离了HCA的时间节律优势。与机器人相对校正相比，HCA将人类时钟相位MAE从95.55度降至10.99度，限制了参考漂移。当人类相位与传递相位初始不一致时，与固定时钟延续相比，HCA将相位MAE从72.02度降至13.90度。与即时相位重置相比，HCA在不产生参考跳变的情况下，将瞬态参考跟踪髋关节RMSE降低了22.7%。所有420次时间节律展开均无摔倒完成。这些仿真结果支持连续相位获取以及对独立人类时钟的持续对齐。
tldr: PhaseSync-Exo introduces a human-clock-anchored adapter (HCA) that improves dynamic gait tracking for exoskeletons by maintaining human timing and reducing phase errors, demonstrated in simulation.
tldr_zh: PhaseSync-Exo 提出了一种以人类时钟为锚点的适配器（HCA），通过在仿真中减少相位误差并保持人类时序来改善外骨骼的动态步态跟踪。

title: CEER2: Directional and Tunable End-Effector and Root Compliance for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoids are increasingly capable of tracking complex whole-body motions, but physical interaction introduces a different challenge. When a robot makes contact with a person or the environment, it needs to respond to external forces while preserving the motion needed for the task. This response can vary across directions in the end-effectors and on the body. For example, an end effector may need to accommodate contact force in one direction while maintaining motion accuracy in another, while the robot body may resist an external force or move with it. We present a compliance framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines directional and tunable end-effector (EE) compliance with selectable root compliance for external force rejection or force following. A hierarchical reinforcement learning controller modulates a fixed whole-body tracking policy through high-level EE and root commands, while interaction forces are estimated from proprioceptive history. Our simulation and real-world experiments on a humanoid demonstrate directional stiffness control, online stiffness adjustment, distinct root compliance, compliant manipulation, and collaborative carrying.
summary_zh: 人形机器人日益能够追踪复杂的全身运动，但物理交互引入了另一项挑战。当机器人与人或环境发生接触时，它需要在应对外部力的同时，保持任务所需的运动。这种响应在末端执行器的不同方向及身体各部位之间可能存在差异。例如，末端执行器可能需要在某一方向上顺应接触力，同时在另一方向上保持运动精度，而机器人身体则可能抵抗外力或随外力运动。我们提出了一种适用于人形机器人 locomotion-manipulation 的柔顺框架，该框架将方向性且可调谐的末端执行器（EE）柔顺性与可选择的根部柔顺性相结合，以实现外力抑制或力跟随。一个分层强化学习控制器通过高层级的末端执行器和根部指令来调节固定的全身跟踪策略，同时交互力从本体感觉历史数据中估计得出。我们在人形机器人上进行的仿真和实际实验展示了方向性刚度控制、在线刚度调节、不同的根部柔顺性、柔顺操作以及协作搬运能力。
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning-based compliance framework for humanoid loco-manipulation, enabling directional and tunable end-effector compliance and selectable root compliance for external force rejection or following, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于分层强化学习的人形机器人移动操作柔顺控制框架，可实现末端执行器的方向可调柔顺性和根部的可选柔顺性，以抵抗或跟随外力，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. However, VLAs can take only a limited number of frames as visual input due to the high token cost of an image, which is problematic for memory-dependent tasks such as determining the arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. Existing solutions use latent vector memories accessed through cross-attention, which are neither interpretable nor portable. In this paper, we propose AD-Memo, a general-purpose VLA driving agent with language-based memory. The agent outputs memory as an extension of its Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to record surrounding objects critical to driving; this memory becomes part of the agent's future input. We curate memory-based datasets and train VLAs with a two-stage recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and \textit{Da Capo}, a novel semi-closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm which uses trajectory-level advantage for memory and step-level advantage for driving, leading to better credit assignment. Across scenarios such as all-way stops and general driving, AD-Memo improves driving quality, enables better question answering on driving scenes, and produces plug-and-play memory for other models.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型近来已成为自动驾驶领域的主流解决方案之一，因其能够利用视觉-语言预训练阶段获得的知识，实现准确且可解释的驾驶决策。然而，由于单张图像的高令牌成本，VLA模型只能接收有限数量的帧作为视觉输入，这在涉及记忆依赖的任务中存在问题，例如判断全向停车路口的到达顺序以及长时域驾驶场景理解。现有方案通过交叉注意力机制访问潜在向量记忆，但这种方式既缺乏可解释性，也不具备可移植性。本文提出AD-Memo，一种基于语言记忆的通用VLA驾驶智能体。该智能体将其记忆作为思维链（CoT）的扩展输出，用于记录对驾驶至关重要的周围物体；这些记忆随后成为智能体未来输入的一部分。我们构建了基于记忆的数据集，并采用两阶段训练方案对VLA进行训练：监督微调（SFT）以及\textit{Da Capo}——一种新颖的半闭环强化学习（RL）算法，该算法利用轨迹级优势函数处理记忆，利用步骤级优势函数处理驾驶行为，从而实现更优的信用分配。在全向停车路口和一般驾驶等场景中，AD-Memo提升了驾驶质量，增强了对驾驶场景的问答能力，并生成了可直接插拔使用的记忆模块，可供其他模型调用。
tldr: AD-Memo introduces a VLA driving agent with language-based memory, stored as natural-language Chain-of-Thought extensions, trained via SFT and a novel semi-closed-loop RL algorithm (Da Capo) to improve driving performance and interpretability in memory-demanding scenarios.
tldr_zh: AD-Memo提出了一种带语言记忆的VLA驾驶代理，将记忆作为思维链扩展输出并回灌，通过SFT和半闭环强化学习训练，提升复杂场景下的驾驶能力和可解释性。

title: Correcting WHERE, Preserving HOW: Compositional Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Referential Guidance
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable flexible action generation, their generalization across diverse environmental elements, including manipulated objects, destinations, and backgrounds, is limited by the lack of diversity in robotic training data. Trained end-to-end on such data, VLAs tend to exploit visual shortcuts, associating actions with task-irrelevant visual features rather than the intended task semantics. These shortcuts block recomposition of elements already seen by the policy, that is, compositional generalization. Existing approaches mitigate such entanglement through task-relevant perception or targeted data diversification, but offer no explicit mechanism for unseen recomposition and require backbone-specific modifications with retraining. We observe that under such recomposition, VLAs often fail at global grounding while retaining local manipulation skills that recover near the correct target in familiar configurations. Therefore, we propose Referential Guidance (ReGuide), a training-free wrapper that, given object poses from a grounding module, combines semantic and geometric rebinding to guide the end-effector into demonstration-supported configurations of the instructed referent, where the frozen policy can resume execution. Experiments in simulation across multiple VLA backbones as well as on a real robot show that ReGuide improves success rates under compositional shifts by up to 56.8 and 75.0 percentage points, respectively, while preserving standard-task performance.
summary_zh: 虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够实现灵活的动作生成，但其在多样化环境要素（包括操作对象、目标和背景）上的泛化能力受限于机器人训练数据多样性的不足。在此类数据上进行端到端训练，VLA模型倾向于利用视觉捷径，将动作与任务无关的视觉特征关联起来，而非预期的任务语义。这些捷径阻断了策略对已见要素的重新组合，即组合泛化。现有方法通过任务相关感知或针对性的数据多样化来缓解此类纠缠问题，但未能提供针对未见重组的显式机制，且需要针对特定骨干网络进行修改并重新训练。我们观察到，在此类重组情形下，VLA模型往往在全局定位上失败，同时保留了局部操作技能，能够在熟悉配置中接近正确目标时恢复执行。为此，我们提出参考引导（ReGuide），一种无需训练的包装模块，在给定来自定位模块的对象姿态后，结合语义与几何重绑定，将末端执行器引导至指令参照物的演示支持配置中，使冻结的策略能够恢复执行。在多个VLA骨干网络的仿真实验以及真实机器人上的实验表明，ReGuide在组合偏移下的成功率分别最高提升56.8和75.0个百分点，同时保持标准任务性能不变。
tldr: ReGuide is a training-free wrapper that improves compositional generalization in VLA models by using grounding-based object poses and semantic/geometric rebinding to guide end-effectors back to demonstration-supported configurations, boosting success rates under compositional shifts on simulated and real robots.
tldr_zh: ReGuide 是一种无需训练的外挂模块，通过基于物体位姿的语义和几何重绑定，引导末端执行器回到演示支持的状态，从而在仿真和真实机器人上提升 VLA 模型在组合泛化下的成功率。

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of a Driving VLA to Class 8 Trucks
summary: Class 8 trucks differ from passenger cars in geometry, dynamics, and maneuvering requirements. As a result, vision-language-action (VLA) models trained for passenger vehicles do not readily transfer to Class 8 trucks, particularly in unstructured scenarios such as accident scenes and construction zones. Rather than training a truck-driving VLA from scratch, we propose an adapt-then-steer strategy that adapts an off-the-shelf VLA to generate trajectories for Class-8 trucks in these challenging scenarios. In the adapt stage, we use NVIDIA's Alpamayo 1.5 as the base model, fine-tuning only its action-generation stack on a few hundred real-world construction and accident-related highway scenarios. In the steer stage, we introduce Flow Velocity Steering (FVS) to further refine the model's predictions while holding the adapted VLA fixed. FVS is a compact, flow-time-conditioned residual module that adds learned corrections to the action-space flow velocity used to update the action sequence at each generation step. In open-loop evaluation on a scenario-disjoint held-out set, targeted fine-tuning more than halves single-candidate average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) over the entire 6.4 s horizon compared to the base model. Using the same targeted demonstrations, FVS further reduces the fine-tuned model's full-horizon ADE and FDE by 13.9% and 16.5%, respectively. At matched data budgets, targeted supervision yields 19-26% lower full-horizon ADE than general truck-driving supervision, while the targeted model remains competitive with a model fine-tuned on approximately 65 times as many general truck-driving scenarios. These results support adapt-then-steer for data-efficient vehicle-domain transfer to Class 8 trucks. Our project website is available at https://truckvla.github.io.
summary_zh: 8级卡车在几何结构、动力学特性及操控要求上与乘用车存在显著差异。因此，为乘用车训练得到的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型无法直接迁移至8级卡车，尤其是在事故现场和施工区域等非结构化场景中。我们并未从零开始训练卡车驾驶VLA模型，而是提出了一种“先适配后转向”（adapt-then-steer）策略，将现成的VLA模型适配为可在这些挑战性场景中为8级卡车生成轨迹。在适配阶段，我们以NVIDIA的Alpamayo 1.5作为基础模型，仅在其动作生成模块上，利用数百个真实世界的高速公路施工与事故相关场景进行微调。在转向阶段，我们引入了流量速度转向（Flow Velocity Steering, FVS）模块，在保持已适配VLA模型固定的前提下进一步优化模型预测。FVS是一个紧凑的、以流时间为条件的残差模块，可在每个生成步骤中向用于更新动作序列的动作空间流量速度添加学习到的修正量。在场景不相交的留出集上进行开环评估时，与基础模型相比，定向微调在6.4秒完整预测时域内将单候选平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）降低了一半以上。在相同定向演示数据下，FVS进一步将微调模型的全时域ADE和FDE分别降低了13.9%和16.5%。在相同数据预算下，定向监督相比通用卡车驾驶监督可将全时域ADE降低19%至26%，同时定向模型仍能与在约65倍规模的通用卡车驾驶场景上微调得到的模型保持竞争力。这些结果验证了“先适配后转向”策略在面向8级卡车的低数据成本车辆域迁移中的有效性。我们的项目网站位于 https://truckvla.github.io。
tldr: This paper proposes an adapt-then-steer strategy to efficiently transfer a passenger-car driving VLA model to Class 8 trucks, using targeted fine-tuning on a few hundred real-world highway scenarios and a Flow Velocity Steering module to further reduce trajectory errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种“先适配后转向”的策略，通过针对性的微调和流速度转向模块，将乘用车驾驶VLA模型高效迁移到Class 8卡车上，显著降低了轨迹误差。

title: Systematically Exploring the Capabilities of GPT-6 Astra as Embodied Policies
summary: GPT-6 Astra exhibits a remarkable ability to generate numerical robot actions, extending its role beyond high-level planning. To assess Astra's capabilities as general-purpose embodied policies, we conduct comprehensive evaluations across six domains, examining direct control, cooperation with learned policies, and feedback-driven adaptation. In gripper manipulation, Astra can correct task targets and prepare contact conditions for subsequent policy execution; hybrid control with π0.5 achieves 48% success on the evaluated RoboDojo subset. In dexterous manipulation, hybrid control achieves 50% success in ten experience-guided DexJoCo trials, while direct in-hand control struggles to coordinate finger contacts. In mobile manipulation, hybrid control reaches 38.7% success on the evaluated RoboCasa365. In navigation, Astra leads our local comparisons, reaching 92% success on RxR instruction following and 82% on HM3D object search, although search incurs substantial detours. In locomotion, dense motion-reference generation remains unreliable: none of five sequential attempts on a single obstacle course reaches the goal, despite improvements in stability and forward progress. In humanoid loco-manipulation, Astra exceeds baseline methods on 13 of 30 HumanoidBench tasks with pretrained whole-body controllers. These findings reveal a gap between useful task decisions and reliable physical control. Inference latency further constrains practical control: across 50 RoboDojo instances per condition, policy-assisted and direct control consume 624.8 million and 1.132 billion tokens. A 30-second locomotion run requires 250 model calls averaging 39.86 seconds each, with physics paused during inference.
summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra展现出生成数值机器人动作的卓越能力，将其角色拓展至高层规划之外。为评估Astra作为通用具身策略的能力，我们在六个领域进行了全面评估，考察直接控制、与学习策略的协作以及反馈驱动的适应性。在夹爪操作中，Astra能够修正任务目标并为后续策略执行准备接触条件；与π0.5的混合控制在所评估的RoboDojo子集上实现了48%的成功率。在灵巧操作中，混合控制在十次经验引导的DexJoCo试验中达到50%的成功率，而直接手内控制则难以协调手指接触。在移动操作中，混合控制在所评估的RoboCasa365上达到38.7%的成功率。在导航方面，Astra在本地对比中领先，在RxR指令跟随中达到92%的成功率，在HM3D物体搜索中达到82%的成功率，尽管搜索过程中存在大量绕路。在运动控制方面，密集运动参考生成仍不可靠：在单一障碍赛道上连续五次尝试均未到达目标，尽管稳定性和前进进度有所改善。在人形机器人 locomotion-操作方面，Astra在30项HumanoidBench任务中的13项上使用预训练全身控制器超越了基线方法。这些发现揭示了任务决策的实用性与物理控制的可靠性之间的差距。推理延迟进一步制约了实际控制：每种条件下50个RoboDojo实例中，策略辅助控制和直接控制分别消耗6.248亿和11.32亿个令牌。一次30秒的运动运行需要250次模型调用，平均每次39.86秒，推理期间物理模拟暂停。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates GPT-6 Astra as a general-purpose embodied policy across six robot domains, showing that hybrid control with learned policies outperforms direct control but physical control and inference latency limit practical use.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了 GPT-6 Astra 作为通用具身策略在六个机器人领域的表现，发现与学习策略的混合控制优于直接控制，但物理控制和推理延迟限制了实际应用。

title: Diffusion-2BC: Hybrid Diffusion and Regression Training for Offline Behavior Cloning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Behavior cloning provides an offline route to autonomous-driving policy learning, but mean-squared-error regression is poorly matched to demonstrations in which one observation admits several valid actions. Diffusion policies can represent conditional multimodal action distributions, yet their closed-loop performance may be unstable when visual features and control are learned from limited data. This paper presents Diffusion-2BC, which combines a diffusion denoising objective with an auxiliary deterministic behavior-cloning loss over a shared visual encoder. The auxiliary branch is used only during training; inference remains diffusion-based. The proposed method is evaluated in the controlled Claw environment and in bird's-eye-view CARLA navigation, including route-conditioned driving, route-free navigation through multiple intersections, and cross-map evaluation from Town01 to Town02. In the Claw task, Diffusion-2BC reduced the mean mask-distance error by approximately 10% relative to a diffusion-based behavior-cloning baseline and by 85% relative to standard deterministic behavior cloning. In route-free CARLA, Diffusion-2BC traveled substantially farther before termination under the evaluation protocol than both baselines in Town01 and Town02. Additional qualitative rollouts revealed distinct route choices, showing the multimodal behavior of the proposed diffusion-based agent. The results indicate that an auxiliary regression signal can improve the closed-loop reliability of diffusion behavior cloning while preserving multimodal prediction in the controlled benchmark.
summary_zh: 行为克隆为自动驾驶策略学习提供了一条离线途径，但均方误差回归在面对同一观测对应多个有效动作的演示数据时表现不佳。扩散策略能够表示条件多模态动作分布，然而当视觉特征与控制从有限数据中学习时，其闭环性能可能不稳定。本文提出Diffusion-2BC方法，该方法将扩散去噪目标与共享视觉编码器上的辅助确定性行为克隆损失相结合。辅助分支仅在训练阶段使用；推理过程仍基于扩散模型。所提方法在受控Claw环境以及鸟瞰视角CARLA导航场景中进行了评估，包括路线条件驾驶、穿越多个交叉路口的无路线导航，以及从Town01到Town02的跨地图评估。在Claw任务中，Diffusion-2BC相较于基于扩散的行为克隆基线，平均掩码距离误差降低了约10%；相较于标准确定性行为克隆，误差降低了85%。在无路线CARLA任务中，根据评估协议，Diffusion-2BC在Town01和Town02中的终止前行驶距离均显著超过两种基线方法。额外的定性轨迹展示揭示了不同的路线选择，体现了所提出的基于扩散的智能体的多模态行为。实验结果表明，辅助回归信号能够在保持受控基准中多模态预测能力的同时，提升扩散行为克隆的闭环可靠性。
tldr: This paper introduces Diffusion-2BC, a hybrid training approach that combines diffusion denoising with an auxiliary deterministic behavior cloning loss over a shared visual encoder for autonomous driving, improving closed-loop reliability in CARLA while preserving multimodal prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Diffusion-2BC，将扩散去噪目标与共享视觉编码器上的辅助确定性行为克隆损失相结合，用于自动驾驶，在CARLA中提高了闭环可靠性并保持了多模态预测。

title: TrafficSignBench: Rule-Centric Closed-Loop Evaluation of Traffic-Sign Compliance in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving planners are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics such as driving score, destination rate, and collision rate, which do not explicitly measure compliance with traffic rules. As a result, planners can achieve high benchmark scores while still exhibiting unsafe or illegal behaviors, limiting their applicability to real-world deployment. To address this gap, we introduce TrafficSignBench, a large-scale, traffic sign-centric benchmark for systematic and interpretable evaluation of traffic-rule compliance in autonomous driving. Our framework combines real-map-based simulation for realistic road layouts with rule-targeted procedural scenario generation for scalable and balanced coverage of underrepresented rules. We implement traffic rules corresponding to 34 traffic signs, each equipped with an automatic rule checker for detecting violations during closed-loop execution. This design yields 29,000 diverse road scenes and 29 distinct testing scenario types, enabling controlled evaluation of rule-specific planner behavior. We construct 5,800 testing scenes and demonstrate that current autonomous driving planners can exhibit poor traffic-rule compliance despite strong performance on standard evaluation metrics. To address this limitation, we transform existing planners into rule-compliant trajectory experts via explicit traffic-sign constraints, enabling scalable generation of high-quality oracle trajectories for fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶规划器通常使用驾驶得分、目的地到达率和碰撞率等聚合指标进行评估，但这些指标并未明确衡量对交通规则的遵守情况。因此，规划器可能在基准测试中取得高分，却仍表现出不安全或不合法的驾驶行为，这限制了其在实际部署中的适用性。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了TrafficSignBench，一个大规模、以交通标志为中心的基准测试，用于对自动驾驶中的交通规则遵守情况进行系统化且可解释的评估。我们的框架将基于真实地图的仿真（用于构建 realistic 的道路布局）与面向规则的程序化场景生成相结合，以实现对代表性不足规则的规模化且均衡的覆盖。我们实现了与34种交通标志对应的交通规则，每种规则均配备自动违规检测器，用于在闭环执行过程中检测违规行为。该设计生成了29,000个多样化的道路场景和29种不同的测试场景类型，从而能够对特定规则下的规划器行为进行受控评估。我们构建了5,800个测试场景，并证明当前的自动驾驶规划器即使在标准评估指标上表现优异，也可能在交通规则遵守方面表现不佳。为解决这一局限，我们通过显式的交通标志约束，将现有规划器转化为符合规则的轨迹专家，从而能够规模化生成高质量的“神谕”轨迹用于微调。
tldr: TrafficSignBench is a large-scale, traffic-sign-centric benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of traffic-rule compliance in autonomous driving, featuring 34 traffic rules, 29,000 scenes, and automated rule checkers, and it demonstrates that current planners often violate rules despite strong standard metrics. The work also transforms planners into rule-compliant trajectory experts for generating oracle data.
tldr_zh: TrafficSignBench是一个以交通标志为中心的大规模闭环自动驾驶交通规则合规性基准，包含34种交通规则、29,000个场景和自动规则检查器，并表明现有规划器在标准指标上表现良好但常违反规则。该工作还将规划器转化为符合规则的轨迹专家，用于生成高质量oracle数据。

title: A Reachability-based Safety Certificate for Dynamical System Motion Policies
summary: Dynamical Systems (DS) are reactive motion policies representing vector fields trained with theoretical guarantees of stability and convergence. To ensure safety during deployment in unknown environments they must be locally reshaped, either through modulation or geometric control barrier function strategies. However, depending on the geometry of the obstacles and the complexity of the DS, these local strategies can lead the system to unavoidable collisions or spurious attractors. In this work, we certify safety with a value function drawn from the notion of backward reachability tube, which measures the worst-case safety along a rollout trajectory of the nominal DS. Usually, such a value function is intractable for a controlled system due to curse of dimensionality. We show that in the DS-based learning-from-demonstration setting, the absence of a control input collapses the reachability problem to a deterministic rollout, and the presence of certain stability conditions truncates the infinite horizon to a finite one, resulting in a well-defined value function. We further show that the value function we devised is the maximal forward-invariant subset of the obstaclefree region for the nominal DS flow. The application of this certificate function is validated across five DS constructions - analytical, Neural ODE, diffeomorphic latent space, LPV-DS, SE(3)and validate it on a Franka manipulator. Modulation and geometric CBFs also suffer from saddle point in cases of headon approach towards an unsafe zone. We show that CBF-on-V avoids this pitfall entirely.
summary_zh: 动力系统（DS）是一种反应式运动策略，表示经过训练并具有稳定性与收敛性理论保证的向量场。为确保在未知环境中部署时的安全性，必须通过调制或几何控制屏障函数策略对系统进行局部重塑。然而，根据障碍物的几何形状以及DS的复杂度，这些局部策略可能导致系统发生不可避免的碰撞或产生虚假吸引子。在本研究中，我们基于后向可达管的概念推导出一个值函数，该函数衡量标称DS沿滚动轨迹的最坏情况安全性，从而对安全性进行认证。通常，对于受控系统而言，由于维度灾难，此类值函数难以求解。我们证明，在基于DS的示教学习框架中，由于不存在控制输入，可达性问题退化为确定性滚动过程；同时，特定稳定性条件的存在可将无限时域截断为有限时域，从而得到定义良好的值函数。我们进一步证明，所设计的值函数是标称DS流在无障碍区域内最大的前向不变子集。该认证函数的应用在五种DS构建方式上得到验证——解析形式、神经常微分方程、微分同胚潜空间、LPV-DS、SE(3)——并在Franka机械臂上进行了实验验证。此外，调制方法和几何CBF在面对危险区域的正面逼近时也会出现鞍点问题。我们证明，基于势函数的安全屏障（CBF-on-V）能够完全避免这一缺陷。
tldr: This paper introduces a safety certificate for Dynamical System motion policies based on backward reachability tubes, ensuring collision-free execution in unknown environments and validated on a Franka manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于后向可达管的安全证书，用于动力系统运动策略，确保未知环境中的无碰撞执行，并在Franka机械臂上进行了验证。

title: PneuTac: Tactile Manipulation with Soft Pneumatic Robots via Unified MPM-Gaussian Splatting Simulation
summary: Soft robots and tactile sensors have demonstrated great potential in delicate manipulation tasks. Soft pneumatic robots enable safe contact through compliance, and vision-based tactile sensors offer high-resolution touch perception. However, learning tactile manipulation with compliant robots has been challenging, bottlenecked by the lack of efficient simulation. Existing simulators typically model them in isolation, and exhibit large calibration gaps that are difficult to overcome efficiently. We present PneuTac, a unified framework for tactile-feedback manipulation with soft pneumatic robots. We leverage the material point method (MPM) for modelling the dynamics of the soft robot and the deformable tactile membrane, and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) for rendering. Real-to-sim modelling is done with a simple vision-based method, to then train action and perception networks for efficient simulation with surrogate models. We use the framework to drive a tactile-guided pipeline to collect demonstrations in simulation. Through experiments on a custom-designed pneumatic soft finger with a tactile sensing tip, together with additional cross-device evaluations, we show that PneuTac is capable of accurately modelling soft robots with tactile sensors, and that policies trained with simulation-augmented demonstrations outperform baselines trained on the same real data on three real-world contact-rich compliant manipulation tasks, making it a practical framework for tactile manipulation on compliant hardware.
summary_zh: 软体机器人与触觉传感器在精细操作任务中展现出巨大潜力。软体气动机器人通过柔顺性实现安全接触，而基于视觉的触觉传感器则提供高分辨率触觉感知。然而，在柔顺机器人上学习触觉操作一直面临挑战，其瓶颈在于缺乏高效的仿真环境。现有仿真器通常分别对两者进行建模，且存在难以高效克服的显著标定误差。我们提出PneuTac，一个面向软体气动机器人触觉反馈操作的统一框架。我们利用物质点法（MPM）对软体机器人和可变形触觉膜的动力学进行建模，并采用三维高斯溅射（3DGS）进行渲染。实到仿建模通过简单的基于视觉的方法完成，随后训练动作和感知网络，以替代模型实现高效仿真。我们利用该框架驱动一条触觉引导的流程，在仿真环境中收集示范数据。通过在定制设计的带有触觉传感尖端的软体气动手指上的实验，以及额外的跨设备评估，我们证明PneuTac能够准确建模带有触觉传感器的软体机器人，并且采用仿真增强示范训练的策略在三个真实世界接触密集的柔顺操作任务上优于仅在相同真实数据上训练的基线方法，使其成为在柔顺硬件上进行触觉操作的实用框架。
tldr: PneuTac presents a unified MPM-Gaussian Splatting simulation framework for soft pneumatic robots with tactile sensing, enabling real-to-sim modeling and policy training that improves real-world tactile manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: PneuTac 提出了一个统一的 MPM-高斯泼溅仿真框架，用于软体气动机器人与触觉传感，实现了真实到仿真的建模与策略训练，并在真实世界的触觉操作任务上提升了性能。

title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
summary: Existing LLM-driven robot task planners rely on a taken-for-granted assumption of an ideal user whose instructions are clear, complete, and task-focused. However, when interacting with real-world users, especially those experiencing cognitive impairments, such as people living with dementia (PLWD), the planners often make mistakes and even pose physical safety risks. We proposed TALK-Dem (Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia), the first benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated verbal communication. TALK-Dem contains 4,800 instructions and covers five typical communication patterns, including Referential Imprecision, Object Substitution, Empty Speech, Topic Drift, and Intrusion, at three intensity levels. Experiments across six open-weight LLMs reveal a substantial robustness gap. Across communication patterns, open-weight models exhibited performance drops of up to 22.3 percentage points compared to ideal instructions. This revealed a critical gap and even danger for real-world applications, especially in assistive robotics, where locally deployable models are necessary due to privacy concerns and connectivity constraints. To mitigate this issue, we proposed the Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience (CARE) method, which retrieves relevant previously resolved tasks to provide task-specific interpretation and planning context. CARE generally outperformed standard prompting baselines across the six open-weight models, improving average task success by 18.1 percentage points over the vanilla prompt. These results highlighted the importance of both evaluating communication robustness and developing effective adaptation strategies for locally deployable assistive robots. The TALK-Dem dataset is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/.
summary_zh: 现有的大语言模型驱动的机器人任务规划器依赖于一个理所当然的假设，即理想用户的指令清晰、完整且以任务为中心。然而，在与现实用户（尤其是存在认知障碍的用户，如痴呆症患者）互动时，这些规划器常常出错，甚至带来身体安全风险。我们提出了TALK-Dem（Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia，痴呆症中的言语属性与语言知识），这是首个用于评估大语言模型驱动机器人在痴呆症相关言语沟通下进行任务规划能力的基准。TALK-Dem包含4，800条指令，覆盖五种典型沟通模式，包括指称不精确、客体替代、空泛言语、话题漂移和侵入性言语，并设置三个强度等级。在六个开放权重大语言模型上的实验揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距。在各沟通模式下，开放权重模型相较于理想指令的性能下降最高达22.3个百分点。这揭示了现实应用中的关键缺陷甚至危险，尤其是在辅助机器人领域——由于隐私顾虑和连接限制，局部可部署模型在此类场景中必不可少。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了基于经验的上下文感知检索（CARE）方法，该方法通过检索先前已解决的类似任务来提供任务特定的解释和规划上下文。CARE在六个开放权重模型上的总体表现优于标准提示基线，相较于原始提示将平均任务成功率提高了18.1个百分点。这些结果凸显了评估沟通鲁棒性以及为局部可部署辅助机器人制定有效适应策略的重要性。TALK-Dem数据集公开可用，网址为https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/。
tldr: TALK-Dem benchmarks LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated communication patterns, revealing robustness gaps in open-weight models and introducing a retrieval-based mitigation method (CARE) that improves success rates.
tldr_zh: TALK-Dem 在痴呆相关沟通模式下对 LLM 驱动的机器人任务规划进行基准测试，揭示了开源模型的鲁棒性差距，并引入了一种基于检索的缓解方法 (CARE) 以提高成功率。

title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
summary: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.
summary_zh: 随着交互式三维世界越来越多地被用于研究智能行为，开发高效流程以识别这些模拟环境中的异常现象（如漂浮物体、可穿越墙体或与周边场景不符的物体）变得愈发重要。多模态人工智能系统，包括视觉-语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-行动模型（VLA），已展现出自动化完成该任务的潜力。然而，三维世界审计具有复杂性，要求两种不同能力的紧密耦合：一是行动能力，即系统性地高效导航三维世界并搜索异常；二是视觉推理能力，即理解环境并从多模态观测中识别异常。多模态智能体能否有效耦合这两种能力，在利用视觉推理识别潜在异常的同时采取行动加以验证，这一问题在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文提出了WorldAuditBench，一个面向三维世界审计的基准测试集，包含基于虚幻引擎5和Three.js构建的13个环境中的213个异常任务，涵盖五类异常家族。我们在固定探索预算下，采用两种审计范式评估了五个前沿模型：先基于VLA进行探索，再由VLM进行异常识别；以及端到端的VLM智能体，其中视觉推理直接引导行动选择。在所评估的模型和两种范式中，成功率介于6.6%至42.3%之间，显著低于人类表现（83.4%）。通过世界审计这一任务，WorldAuditBench为研究多模态智能体如何在交互式三维环境中耦合行动与视觉推理提供了测试平台，同时揭示了其在探索过程中收集和解读证据方面的当前局限性。
tldr: Introduces WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for auditing interactive 3D worlds that evaluates multimodal agents' ability to couple action and visual reasoning, showing they lag significantly behind human performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了 WorldAuditBench，一个用于审计交互式 3D 世界的基准，评估多模态代理将行动与视觉推理结合的能力，结果显示其性能远低于人类。

title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）将视觉动态预测与动作生成相结合，但并未显式支持跨操作任务的动作经验复用。此外，现有WAMs难以捕捉能够指导目标动作预测的潜在跨任务语义关系，因为冗余背景元素干扰了关键视觉信息的提取。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的动作经验字典（AED），将历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入，以支持技能复用并建模跨任务关系。具体而言，我们首先聚合历史动作以与视觉观察对齐，并通过预训练的动作分词器从AED中检索动作嵌入。随后，我们通过交叉注意力对汇集后的嵌入进行视觉条件化处理，并将其前置到带噪声的动作标记前，从而为预测提供交互上下文和动作意图。为建模与动作相关的运动并降低对无关背景线索的依赖，我们引入了一种运动感知的转移损失，用于监督随机时间间隔内的视觉特征变化预测。在仿真基准测试以及真实世界跨具身设置中的实验验证了我们AED方法的有效性。匿名项目网站可访问\href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}。
tldr: This paper introduces an Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical action trajectories into shared action embeddings, enabling skill reuse and cross-task relationship modeling in World Action Models for manipulation tasks, with experiments in simulation and real-world cross-embodiment settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种动作经验字典（AED），将历史动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入，支持世界动作模型中的技能复用和跨任务关系建模，并在仿真和真实世界跨实体设置中验证了有效性。

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 具身智能体必须确定在何处行动，预判由此产生的场景变化，并解读观察到的结果以指导后续行动。这要求将4D交互理解——即解释过去行动如何改变场景——与空间锚定的规划——即确定如何及在何处朝向目标行动并预判由此产生的场景变化——相连接。我们提出ChronoGraph，一种功能性4D场景图，将可操作部件上的行动与语义及几何状态变化关联起来。通过以相同形式表示观察到的和预期的状态转换，它为理解与规划提供了共享基础。我们通过一个自动数据引擎构建ChronoGraphBench，将人类交互视频和模拟机器人轨迹转换为带图标注的问题，用于在两项任务上训练和评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）。利用这些标注，我们通过两阶段适配预训练VLM来训练ChronoGraphVLM。图作为思维链的监督微调教会模型在作答前重建观察到的转换并预测未来的转换，形成图轨迹。随后的联合4D图强化学习直接对图属性和答案正确性进行奖励。跨模型规模的实验表明，相较于对应的预训练基线，性能有所提升，并能零样本迁移至VLM4D。真实世界演示进一步表明，基于图的规划和可操作性接地能够通过现有机器人技能支持移动操作，无需额外微调。
tldr: ChronoGraph introduces a functional 4D scene graph linking actions to semantic/geometric state changes, with a benchmark and a VLM trained to understand and plan grounded interactions, demonstrating real-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: ChronoGraph 提出了功能化 4D 场景图，将动作与语义/几何状态变化关联，并构建基准和训练 VLM 进行交互理解与规划，在真实机器人上验证了迁移能力。

title: AVERT-VLN: Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Deploying vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents in unseen environments remains challenging because unfamiliar layouts and visual conditions can cause execution to go off track. Rather than relying on continuous human supervision, a practical strategy is to selectively request corrective guidance, recover the ongoing task, and reuse corrective interactions to improve subsequent navigation. We propose Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation (AVERT-VLN), a closed-loop framework that uses a plug-in vision-language Monitor for online human-assisted recovery and offline preference learning. The Monitor operates separately from navigation decision generation and assesses instruction-execution consistency from the instruction, visual history, and current observation. To train the Monitor for deviation recognition, we construct LOSTNAV DATASET with 20K counterfactual risk trajectories and rule-based deviation labels. The Monitor is first fine-tuned on 40K normal trajectories to assess instruction progress and then jointly fine-tuned on normal and risk trajectories to recognize semantic deviations. At runtime, Asynchronous Sidecar Monitoring evaluates execution alongside the navigation model. When the controller accepts a LOST verdict, it suspends autonomous execution and requests human guidance for recovery. For offline policy improvement, Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning converts deviation-associated failures into decision-level preference pairs under shared decision contexts, restricting supervision to the decisions targeted for correction. Under human-assisted evaluation, the full AVERT-VLN system achieves success rates of 76.2% and 66.3% on the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. The same monitoring and human-assisted recovery interface also improves success rates across the three evaluated navigation architectures.
summary_zh: 在未知环境中部署视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体仍具挑战性，因为不熟悉的布局和视觉条件可能导致执行偏离轨道。与其依赖持续的人工监督，一种实用的策略是选择性地请求纠正性指导、恢复进行中的任务，并复用纠正性交互以改进后续导航。我们提出了面向视觉-语言导航的弃权感知视觉错误恢复与训练方法（AVERT-VLN），这是一个闭环框架，利用即插即用的视觉-语言监控器实现在线人工辅助恢复和离线偏好学习。该监控器独立于导航决策生成模块运行，从指令、视觉历史记录和当前观测中评估指令-执行一致性。为训练该监控器进行偏离识别，我们构建了包含20K条反事实风险轨迹和基于规则的偏离标签的LOSTNAV数据集。监控器首先在40K条正常轨迹上进行微调以评估指令进展，随后在正常轨迹和风险轨迹上联合微调以识别语义偏离。在运行时，异步伴随监控与导航模型并行评估执行过程。当控制器接受“迷失”判定时，系统暂停自主执行并请求人工指导以恢复任务。在离线策略改进方面，轨迹锚定偏好学习将偏离相关的失败转化为共享决策上下文下的决策级偏好对，将监督限定在需要纠正的目标决策上。在人工辅助评估下，完整的AVERT-VLN系统在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen划分上分别达到76.2%和66.3%的成功率。相同的监控和人工辅助恢复接口也提升了三种评估导航架构的成功率。
tldr: AVERT-VLN introduces a closed-loop framework with a plug-in vision-language Monitor for selective human-assisted recovery and offline preference learning, improving VLN success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE.
tldr_zh: AVERT-VLN 提出了一种封闭循环框架，通过可插拔的视觉语言监视器进行选择性人工辅助恢复和离线偏好学习，提高了 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 上的 VLN 成功率。

title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
summary: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.
summary_zh: 持久空间记忆使具身智能体能够在多次访问中导航至熟悉环境。然而，目标可能在未被观察时发生移动，包括在导航过程中，这导致智能体到达时记忆中的位置可能已不可靠。尽管记忆检索和状态预测方面取得了进展，但在有限可见性下考虑隐藏世界的持续演化并修正信念仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了演化世界导航问题，智能体从间歇性观察中推断目标位置，预测其在检查时刻的状态，并利用视觉证据修正信念。我们提出EvolvingNav，通过结构化的持久-重定位模型，从带有时间戳的3D物体历史构建时间索引信念。该信念区分目标在最后观察位置的持久性与重定位到其他位置的可能性，并在已知候选集之外保留概率质量。事件驱动的滤波器随时间推移传播当前信念，预测候选检查时刻的目标占用情况，并融合新的RGB-D证据。负面观察根据经过校准且以可见性为条件的检测概率降低位置假设的权重，而证据追踪则防止重复使用相同的观察。冻结的零样本视觉-语言控制器利用更新后的信念选择动作并重新规划。我们进一步引入EvoWorld-Bench，这是一个基于人类活动轨迹的基准，包含54个场景和803，680个任务，在导航前和导航过程中具有受控变化。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，EvolvingNav相较于评估的基线方法在导航成功率和搜索效率上均有所提升。配对实验表明，在可学习的时间模式下增益最为明显，而消融实验则证明了保留不确定性和引入可见性感知证据的价值。
tldr: This paper introduces EvolvingNav, a navigation approach that maintains a time-indexed predictive belief over target locations in evolving environments, using a frozen vision-language controller, and demonstrates improved success and efficiency in simulation and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 EvolvingNav，一种在演化环境中通过维护时索引预测信念来导航的方法，利用冻结的视觉语言控制器，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中展示了更高的导航成功率和搜索效率。

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
summary: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型旨在预测物理世界的演变，然而它们常常生成在视觉上看似合理却违背基本物理原理的视频。现有方法通常假设自然语言不足以表达可靠生成所需的物理知识，因此引入额外的视觉、潜在、数值或基于规划的信号。我们重新审视这一假设，并提出Physis-Lang，一个自进化框架，将物理语言视为一种在数据整理、模型训练和视频生成中共享且可优化的表示。Physis-Lang通过描述相关实体、原因、相互作用、支配原理、时间演变及其影响的语言来表示物理过程。为改进这一表示，我们构建了PhysCapBench，将物理过程分解为原子断言，并使用召回率和精确率评估描述文本。一个智能体循环迭代地分析断言级错误，并优化用于生成物理描述文本的指令。Physis-Lang进一步将模型缺陷转化为文本描述，并利用语言引导的检索来识别覆盖缺失物理过程、视觉多样化的视频。在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准测试上，以Wan和Cosmos为骨干网络的实验表明，物理合理性均得到持续提升。值得注意的是，从开源Cosmos3-Nano骨干出发，我们经Physis-Lang增强的模型超越了领先的专有Veo 3.1模型。
tldr: Physis-Lang introduces a self-evolving framework that uses physical language as a shared, optimizable representation to improve the physical plausibility of video world models, outperforming proprietary models on physical video benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Physis-Lang 提出了一种自进化框架，将物理语言作为共享且可优化的表示，以提高视频世界模型的物理合理性，在物理视频基准上超越了专有模型。

title: World-as-Graph: Relational World Modeling Through Latent Space Graphs
summary: World models aim to learn representations of real-world environments and predict their future evolution. Recent object-centric world models have made expressive progress by representing visual scenes as sets of object-level latent states, but object-object relations are often captured only implicitly, which limits explicit relational and temporal structure modeling and object-centric dynamic memory modeling. To address such challenges, we propose World-As-Graph (WAG), a graph-based object-centric world model that introduces relational inductive bias into JEPA-style predictive representation learning. The proposed WAG contains two main modules: (1) Relation-aware structure induction, which constructs time-varying latent graphs from object-centric slots and designs relation-aware object masking policies to guide relational object representation learning in latent space; (2) Object-centric memory transition, which maintains and updates object-level dynamic states by combining relational information from neighboring objects with historical memory, enabling effective autoregressive future prediction. Extensive experiments on both visual reasoning and robotic manipulation tasks could demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed WAG.
summary_zh: 世界模型旨在学习真实环境的表征并预测其未来演变。近年来，以对象为中心的世界模型通过将视觉场景表示为对象级潜在状态的集合，取得了显著进展，但对象间的关系通常仅被隐式捕获，这限制了显式的关系与时序结构建模以及以对象为中心的动态记忆建模。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了基于图的对象中心世界模型——World-As-Graph（WAG），该模型将关系归纳偏置引入JEPA风格的预测性表征学习中。所提出的WAG包含两个主要模块：（1）关系感知结构归纳模块，该模块从对象中心槽中构建时变潜在图，并设计关系感知的对象掩蔽策略，以引导潜在空间中关系对象表征的学习；（2）对象中心记忆转换模块，该模块通过结合来自邻接对象的关系信息与历史记忆，维护并更新对象级动态状态，从而实现有效的自回归未来预测。在视觉推理和机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，我们提出的WAG具有优越的性能。
tldr: This paper proposes World-As-Graph (WAG), a graph-based object-centric world model that introduces relational inductive bias into JEPA-style predictive representation learning for future prediction and robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出World-As-Graph（WAG），一种基于图的对象中心世界模型，将关系归纳偏置引入JEPA风格的预测表示学习，用于未来预测和机器人操作。

title: Learning to Explain While Planning: Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion planners exhibit strong capabilities in generating multimodal trajectories. However, existing methods primarily rely on expert demonstrations to fit trajectory distributions, learning statistical correlations among scenes, behaviors, and trajectories without explicitly modeling driving rules. In long-tail scenarios where expert data are scarce, the lack of behaviors to imitate may lead to trajectories that violate safety or compliance requirements. Moreover, their generation process lacks rule-level explanations, making it difficult to determine which rules drive trajectory adjustments, when they take effect, and how strongly they act, thereby limiting failure diagnosis, safety validation, and targeted improvement. To address these limitations, we propose the Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planner (RADP), which incorporates differentiable driving rules into the diffusion objective during training, turning rule knowledge into intrinsic behavioral principles beyond finite demonstrations. We further introduce Rule-Pressure Attribution (RPA), which constructs supervision signals from gradients of rule losses with respect to predicted trajectories and employs a lightweight attribution head to estimate the optimization pressure exerted by each rule online. To assess the closed-loop behavioral relevance of these attributions, we propose a temporal risk-alignment protocol that evaluates whether current rule pressures reflect corresponding risks during subsequent closed-loop execution. Experiments on nuPlan show that RADP improves closed-loop planning in challenging safety-critical scenarios, while RPA exhibits consistent temporal alignment with subsequent rule-specific risks, validating both intrinsic rule learning and rule-level interpretability.
summary_zh: 扩散规划器在生成多模态轨迹方面展现出强大的能力。然而，现有方法主要依赖专家示范来拟合轨迹分布，学习场景、行为与轨迹之间的统计相关性，并未显式建模驾驶规则。在专家数据稀缺的长尾场景中，缺乏可模仿的行为可能导致生成的轨迹违反安全或合规要求。此外，其生成过程缺乏规则层面的解释，难以确定哪些规则驱动了轨迹调整、这些规则何时生效以及作用强度如何，从而限制了故障诊断、安全验证和针对性改进。为解决上述局限，我们提出了规则对齐扩散规划器（RADP），将可微驾驶规则纳入训练过程中的扩散目标，使规则知识转化为超越有限示范的内在行为准则。我们进一步引入规则压力归因（RPA），通过规则损失对预测轨迹的梯度构建监督信号，并采用轻量级归因头在线估计每条规则施加的优化压力。为评估这些归因在闭环场景中的行为相关性，我们提出了一种时间风险对齐协议，用于评估当前规则压力是否反映了后续闭环执行中对应的风险。在nuPlan上的实验表明，RADP在具有挑战性的安全关键场景中提升了闭环规划性能，而RPA与后续规则特定风险表现出一致的时间对齐，验证了内在规则学习与规则层面可解释性的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces the Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planner (RADP), which integrates differentiable driving rules into diffusion training for autonomous driving and proposes Rule-Pressure Attribution (RPA) for online rule-level explanations, demonstrating improved closed-loop planning in safety-critical scenarios on nuPlan.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了规则对齐扩散规划器（RADP），将可微驾驶规则融入扩散训练，并提出了规则压力归因（RPA）实现在线规则级解释，在nuPlan上展示了安全关键场景下闭环规划性能的提升。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
summary: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.
summary_zh: 移动机器人与车辆通常搭载同步多相机装置，然而许多流式3D基础模型是为单目输入设计的，导致如何高效利用装置几何结构成为一个挑战。我们提出StreamRig，一个冻结并流式的框架，在冻结的多视角3D基础模型上为标定装置构建因果流式里程计。冻结的前端利用装置标定联合感知同步视角。一个Rig-Resampler压缩其特征，CausalBridge采用带键值缓存的因果注意力，轻量级头回归装置位姿。周期性重新锚定协议支持长序列上的稳定位姿估计。仅这些模块被训练，总计7460万参数，仅以相对位姿作为监督信号。我们的两阶段训练策略将组重定位预训练与因果装置训练相结合，将冻结前端的几何先验及预训练模块的对齐能力迁移至流式里程计。我们在NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360和自采集的人形机器人数据集ZJH上进行评估，其中训练仅使用仿真数据，实际环境评估为零样本。在所有四个数据集上，StreamRig相比所评估的非神谕单目流式及装置感知离线模型均实现了更低的平移和旋转漂移，同时保持低推理成本。消融实验和受控相机数量实验确定了这些增益的来源。我们进一步考察了更长的训练窗口如何影响更长时间跨度上的推理。代码已发布于https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig。
tldr: StreamRig presents a freeze-and-stream framework that leverages a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model with a trainable Rig-Resampler and CausalBridge to produce causal streaming odometry for calibrated multi-camera rigs, demonstrating low-drift zero-shot real-world performance.
tldr_zh: StreamRig 提出了一种冻结-流式框架，利用冻结的多视角 3D 基础模型与可训练的 Rig-Resampler 和 CausalBridge，为标定的多相机系统生成因果流式里程计，在真实世界零样本评估中展现出低漂移性能。

title: Rethinking Legibility in Social Robot Hallway Navigation: Impact of Intent Representation and Human Distraction
summary: We focus on legible robot motion generation in social navigation settings. Legibility in human-robot interaction (HRI) is often described as the property of robot motion that enables an observer to confidently infer the robot's intent. While mature frameworks exist for generating legible motion in front of static observers, social robot navigation presents a new challenge: the robot must clearly convey its intent while ensuring human safety in dynamic pedestrian environments where human attention is often divided. With the goal of enabling robots to generate legible motion in dynamic and constrained spaces, we investigate how the choice of representation and the level of human attention shape navigation performance and human impressions. Focusing on the ubiquitous and demanding scenario of hallway navigation, we conduct two controlled user studies involving alternative legibility formulations implemented within a shared model predictive control framework. Study 1 (N = 45) investigates the role of intent representation, showing that passing-side legibility, particularly when adaptively updated, leads to smoother human motion and is perceived as more competent and less mentally and physically demanding than destination-based and non-legible baselines. Study 2 (N = 45) examines the effect of pedestrian attention, demonstrating that legible motion allows for smooth human motion even under distraction, even if this is not consistently reflected in subjective ratings. Together, these findings suggest that effective legible motion in social robot navigation benefits from interaction-level intent representations that support coordination, with some effects persisting even when human attention is divided. Code is available at https://github.com/fluentrobotics/Legible_MPPI.
summary_zh: 我们聚焦于社交导航场景中机器人运动轨迹的可读性生成问题。在人机交互中，可读性通常被描述为机器人运动的一种特性，使观察者能够有把握地推断出机器人的意图。尽管在静态观察者面前生成可读运动已有成熟框架，但社交机器人导航提出了新的挑战：在行人动态变化且注意力常被分散的环境中，机器人既要清晰传达自身意图，又要确保人类安全。为了实现机器人在动态且受限空间中生成可读运动的目标，我们研究了表征方式的选择以及人类注意力水平如何影响导航性能与人际印象。以普遍且要求高的走廊导航场景为切入点，我们开展了两项受控用户研究，在共享模型预测控制框架内分别实现了不同的可读性表达方案。研究一（N=45）考察了意图表征的作用，结果表明，过侧可读性——尤其在自适应更新情况下——相较于基于目的地和无可读性的基线方案，能带来更平滑的人类运动轨迹，并在主观评价中被认为更具胜任力，且心智与体力负担更低。研究二（N=45）探讨了行人注意力的影响，结果显示，即使在注意力分散的情况下，可读性运动仍能实现平滑的人类运动，尽管这一优势在主观评分中并未始终保持一致。综合来看，这些发现表明，在社交机器人导航中，有效可读运动的生成受益于支持协调的交互层面意图表征，且部分效果在人类注意力分散时依然存在。代码已开源，见 https://github.com/fluentrobotics/Legible_MPPI。
tldr: The paper investigates legible robot motion generation in social hallway navigation, comparing intent representations and the effect of human distraction through two user studies, showing that passing-side legibility improves coordination and perceived competence even under divided attention.
tldr_zh: 本文研究社交走廊导航中机器人的可读运动生成，通过两项用户研究比较意图表示和人类注意力分散的影响，表明过侧可读性即使在注意力分散时也能改善协调性和感知能力。

title: TACTIC: Temporal and Context-Aware LLM Tactical Planning for Roadside LiDAR Attacks
summary: Physical LiDAR attacks are often evaluated using fixed primitives and manually selected parameters, despite their strong dependence on surrounding traffic. We present TACTIC, a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to coordinate state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks. Under a gray-box threat model, TACTIC relies only on an attacker-operated roadside perception stack, without accessing the victim LiDAR's native point clouds or internal processing. Local perception provides metric vehicle states, while the MLLM combines these measurements with roadside imagery to infer relational traffic context and construct a semantic scene graph. Based on this representation, TACTIC selects and configures two complementary primitives: \emph{push-away}, which shifts the perceived range of a lead vehicle, and \emph{phantom-obstacle braking}, which triggers emergency braking through obstacle injection. Measured traffic states and empirically calibrated constraints ground the generated tactics in physically feasible operating regions. To accommodate MLLM latency, TACTIC overlaps reasoning and execution asynchronously while high-rate local perception detects scene changes and triggers replanning. Across 280 randomized CARLA trials, the full policy achieves a 100% collision rate, compared with 35% for a fixed rule, 60% for random selection, and 75% for a restricted LLM using mode selection with default parameters. Joint physical-and-image input achieves 100% success, versus 65% with physical measurements alone and 75% with imagery alone, while asynchronous $Δ$ refresh reduces scene-mutation response from 7.4 s to 2.0 s. These results show that scene-dependent tactical planning can expose context-sensitive LiDAR failure modes that fixed attack policies may miss.
summary_zh: 物理LiDAR攻击的有效性往往高度依赖于周围交通环境，然而现有评估通常采用固定攻击原语并人工设定参数。我们提出TACTIC——一种场景感知攻击框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）协调状态自适应的路侧LiDAR攻击。在灰盒威胁模型下，TACTIC仅依赖攻击者操控的路侧感知栈，无需访问受害者LiDAR的原始点云或内部处理流程。局部感知模块提供车辆状态的度量信息，而MLLM将这些测量数据与路侧图像相结合，推断交通上下文关系并构建语义场景图。基于该场景表示，TACTIC选择并配置两种互补的攻击原语：\emph{推离}（\emph{push-away}），用于偏移前车被感知到的距离；以及\emph{幻影障碍制动}（\emph{phantom-obstacle braking}），通过注入虚拟障碍物触发紧急制动。实测交通状态与经验校准约束共同确保所生成攻击策略处于物理可行的作用范围内。为适应MLLM的推理延迟，TACTIC将推理与执行异步重叠进行，同时依靠高速局部感知实时检测场景变化并触发重新规划。在280次随机化CARLA仿真实验中，完整策略实现了100%的碰撞率，而固定规则、随机选择以及使用默认参数的受限LLM模式选择策略的碰撞率分别为35%、60%和75%。联合物理与图像输入时成功率可达100%，而仅使用物理测量或仅使用图像时成功率分别为65%和75%；异步$Δ$刷新机制将场景突变响应时间从7.4秒缩短至2.0秒。上述结果表明，依赖场景的战术规划能够揭示固定攻击策略可能遗漏的上下文敏感型LiDAR失效模式。
tldr: TACTIC uses a multimodal LLM for scene-aware tactical planning of LiDAR attacks in autonomous driving, achieving a 100% collision rate in CARLA simulations by adapting attack primitives to traffic context.
tldr_zh: TACTIC 利用多模态大语言模型实现场景感知的激光雷达攻击战术规划，在 CARLA 仿真中通过适应交通环境实现 100% 的碰撞率。

title: Magnetic based In-situ Self 3D Pose Estimation for a Modular Soft Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot via IMU-Fusion
summary: Continuum robots are well suited for gentle manipulation because of their inherent compliance and ability to adapt to complex environments. However, their continuously deformable structure makes accurate configuration estimation challenging, particularly when external vision systems are unavailable or obstructed. In this work, we present an embedded pose sensing framework that combines inertial measurement units (IMUs) and active magnetic fields to estimate the robot configuration without relying on external cameras. The angular measurements from the IMU and magnetic-field references are fused to improve local orientation estimation and reduce accumulated orientation error during operation. This pose sensing scheme achieves an update rate of 16.7~Hz, allowing real-time feedback. The proposed system is experimentally validated through closed-loop control, where the estimated robot configuration is used to maintain the end-effector at a desired position while interacting with an object. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed magnetic--inertial sensing for real-time pose estimation and closed-loop control of continuum robots.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人因其固有的柔顺性和适应复杂环境的能力，非常适合轻柔操作任务。然而，其连续可变形结构使得精确位形估计具有挑战性，尤其是在外部视觉系统不可用或受阻的情况下。本文提出了一种嵌入式姿态感知框架，该框架结合惯性测量单元（IMUs）与主动磁场，无需依赖外部相机即可估计机器人位形。通过融合IMU的角度测量与磁场参考信息，可改善局部朝向估计，并减小运行过程中累积的朝向误差。该姿态感知方案实现了16.7 Hz的更新速率，能够支持实时反馈。所提系统通过闭环控制实验进行了验证，在实验中，估计得到的机器人位形被用于维持末端执行器在与物体交互时的期望位置。这些结果展示了分布式磁-惯性传感在连续体机器人实时姿态估计与闭环控制中的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents an embedded pose sensing framework for soft continuum robots, fusing IMU and magnetic field data for real-time 3D pose estimation without external cameras, validated through closed-loop control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于软连续体机器人的嵌入式位姿感知框架，通过融合IMU和磁场数据实现无外部相机的实时3D位姿估计，并通过闭环控制验证。

title: RL-Guided PAC-NMPC for Probabilistically-Safe Perception-Based Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary: In this paper, we present an approach for combining stochastic nonlinear model predictive control (SNMPC) and reinforcement learning (RL) to enable probabilistically-safe perception-based navigation in unknown environments. Our method first uses RL to train probabilistic actor-critic and sensor prediction models. We then leverage these probabilistic models in a sampling-based SNMPC framework known as Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-NMPC, which uses hard constraints to enforce finite-time statistical guarantees on the probability of collision and value function improvement. By ensuring that our finite-horizon SNMPC policies decrease the value function in expectation, we can approach the long-horizon performance of the RL approach while satisfying probabilistic safety constraints. Through simulation experiments, we show that our approach can improve the safety of perception-based RL navigation policies and scale to high dimensional systems with large sensor input spaces and complex nonlinear dynamics. We also demonstrate our approach through hardware experiments, showing improved performance for vision-based navigation with an agile fixed-wing aerial vehicle in unknown environments.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种结合随机非线性模型预测控制（SNMPC）与强化学习（RL）的方法，以实现在未知环境中基于感知的概率安全导航。我们的方法首先利用强化学习训练概率演员-评论家模型及传感器预测模型。随后，我们将这些概率模型应用于一种基于采样的SNMPC框架，即“近似正确”（PAC）-NMPC，该框架通过硬约束确保有限时间内碰撞概率与价值函数改进的统计保证。通过确保我们的有限时域SNMPC策略在期望意义上降低价值函数，我们能够在满足概率安全约束的同时，接近强化学习方法的长时域性能。通过仿真实验，我们展示了该方法能够提升基于感知的强化学习导航策略的安全性，并能扩展到具有高维传感器输入空间和复杂非线性动力学的高维系统。我们还通过硬件实验验证了该方法，展示了在未知环境中使用敏捷固定翼飞行器进行视觉导航时性能的提升。
tldr: This paper combines reinforcement learning with stochastic nonlinear model predictive control (PAC-NMPC) to achieve probabilistically-safe, perception-based navigation in unknown environments, demonstrated on an agile fixed-wing aerial vehicle.
tldr_zh: 本文结合强化学习与随机非线性模型预测控制（PAC-NMPC），在未知环境中实现基于感知的概率安全导航，并在敏捷固定翼飞行器上进行了验证。

title: Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models
summary: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.
summary_zh: 基于学习的世界模型进行规划，将在线轨迹优化与学习得到的价值函数和策略函数相结合，以应对高维控制问题。由于规划器决定了用于学习的经验，而学习得到的评论家与行动者又反过来对候选规划进行评分和提议，规划与学习由此形成了一个闭环反馈系统。TD-MPC便是这一设计的典型代表。近期引入的策略约束变体通过使学习得到的策略与规划器行为对齐，强化了该闭环中的一部分环节。我们提出了PL-MPC（规划-学习MPC），该方法进一步修改了评论家的监督信号以及规划器的终端价值估计。混合多步TD目标使评论家的更新在自举之前接触到更多已实现的奖励；基于分歧感知的终端估计减少了MPPI规划过程中不确定评论家价值的影响；而基于回报加权的行动者蒸馏则强调从高回报回合中提取规划器实际执行的动作。除上述改动外，世界模型架构与MPPI优化器保持不变。在HumanoidBench基准测试中，性能提升最为显著的任务是\texttt{balance-hard}，其总平均回报（TAR）从$98\pm18$提升至$387\pm255$；以及\texttt{hurdle}任务，从$199\pm13$提升至$466\pm200$。在更广泛的基准测试中，性能表现仍取决于具体任务，而PL-MPC在DMControl上保持了竞争力。受控消融实验揭示了两个任务中不同组件间的交互差异。我们进一步展示了在7自由度KUKA IIWA14机械臂上进行扳手螺母对中任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移能力，在训练目标尺寸及两种未见尺寸上均获得了高于TD-M(PC)^2的实测成功率。代码与数据将发布在：https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io。
tldr: This paper introduces PL-MPC, which enhances the TD-MPC framework by modifying critic supervision, planner terminal-value estimation, and actor distillation to improve performance on high-dimensional humanoid control and succeed in sim-to-real transfer on a 7-DoF robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 PL-MPC，通过修改评论家监督、规划器终端值估计和演员蒸馏来增强 TD-MPC 框架，从而在高维人形控制上提升性能，并在七自由度机器人上成功实现仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations
summary: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.
summary_zh: 空中抓取与提升任务需要在部分目标观测条件下，跨越接近、抓取和提升阶段实现全身协调。训练过程中，早期的接近失败可能限制对后续任务阶段的接触，而可见性的变化则给执行阶段的对准和闭合时机带来复杂性。我们提出了一种循环教师-学生框架，在仿真中学习单一策略，无需显式任务阶段输入即可联合控制飞行、机械臂运动和夹爪闭合。特权教师通过强化学习结合关键状态课程进行训练，该课程在将抓取和提升状态与正常接近轨迹衔接之前，先使其暴露于这些状态。其行为被提炼至一个循环视觉学生模型中，该模型以双视角点云和本体感觉替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史以实现闭环控制。专门的闭合目标函数通过模型定义的持续就绪序列监督闭合时机。训练和主要评估使用一个模拟的抓取-载荷模型，该模型具备条件触发的锁闭机制、虚拟连接以及基于力矩的载荷加载，用于短距离提升。在该模型下完成的8，996次仿真回合中，冻结的学生模型在标称、物理/控制随机化以及额外相机随机化条件下，分别实现了99.97%、97.14%和95.84%的全任务成功率。标称条件下，各随机种子第90百分位对准误差的锁存计数加权平均值为8.12毫米。
tldr: This paper introduces a recurrent teacher-student framework for whole-body aerial grasping and lifting, training a single policy in simulation that learns to coordinate flight, arm motion, and gripper closure from partial visual observations, and demonstrates high success rates in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全身空中抓取和提升的循环师生框架，在仿真中训练单个策略，学习从部分视觉观测中协调飞行、手臂运动和夹爪闭合，并在仿真中展示了高成功率。

title: Making Waves: A Membrane-Coupled Delta Array for Manipulating Objects Below the Actuator Spacing
summary: Distributed manipulator systems manipulate objects through the coordinated motion of many actuators. However, an object must be supported by several actuators at once, so the centre-to-centre actuator spacing imposes a hard lower bound on manipulable object size. We remove this bound by coupling the end-effectors of an 8 x 8 array of three degrees-of-freedom delta robots with a stretchable fabric, turning 64 discrete contacts into a continuous surface capable of manipulating objects smaller than the actuator spacing. Viewing the array as a displacement field over that surface, we investigate local quasi-static and cyclic fields as manipulation primitives. These primitives can be applied globally across the array or locally confined around each tracked object to independently manipulate several objects in parallel. We then train a policy acting on low-order discrete cosine transform coefficients: at equal action dimension, commanding a nineteen-delta neighbourhood halves the placement error of commanding the whole array. The policy transfers to hardware without adaptation at 76% success. The platform manipulates objects from 15mm-90mm, a six-fold range spanning both sides of the actuator spacing, 43.3mm, on a single surface.
summary_zh: 分布式机械臂系统通过多个执行器的协同运动来操控物体。然而，由于物体必须同时由多个执行器支撑，执行器中心间距对可操控物体的尺寸设定了严格的下限。为了消除这一限制，我们将一个8×8阵列的三自由度Delta机器人末端执行器与可拉伸织物耦合，将64个离散接触点转变为连续表面，从而能够操控小于执行器间距的物体。将这一阵列视为该表面上的位移场，我们研究了局部准静态场和循环场作为操控基元。这些基元可全局应用于整个阵列，也可局部限制在每个被追踪物体周围，以实现多个物体的并行独立操控。随后，我们训练了一个基于低阶离散余弦变换系数的策略：在相同动作维度下，指令十九个Delta邻域相比指令整个阵列可将放置误差减半。该策略无需适配即可迁移至硬件，成功率达76%。该平台可在单一表面上操控尺寸为15毫米至90毫米的物体，覆盖范围达六倍，跨越执行器间距（43.3毫米）的两侧。
tldr: This paper introduces a membrane-coupled 8x8 delta robot array that forms a continuous deformable surface, eliminating the actuator-spacing limit on object size and enabling parallel manipulation of small objects via learned DCT-based policies that transfer to hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种膜耦合的8x8并联机器人阵列，通过连续可变形表面突破执行器间距对可操作物体尺寸的限制，并利用基于DCT系数的学习策略实现多物体并行操作，且可直接迁移至硬件。

title: Prediction is Better than Detection: Traffic Congestion Control using Drones
summary: A central question in deploying teams of mobile robots for persistent monitoring is how task performance scales with fleet size, and whether this scaling holds once sensing drives downstream action rather than mere observation. We study this question for a team of drones performing traffic-jam detection and prediction in a simulated road network, whose reports drive an adaptive traffic-signal controller in closed loop. We build a multi-agent simulation, with vehicles following Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular-automaton dynamics and drones patrolling junctions via a round-robin policy, and sweep fleet size, traffic level, and network size to evaluate detection rate, detection delay, and prediction rate. We show how performance plateaus for fleet size approximating the number of junctions being monitored, and offer a general fleet-provisioning rule for persistent-monitoring deployments. More significantly, adapting the signal on a predicted jam, rather than a detected one, roughly doubles the resulting reduction in jam duration, showing that the value of onboard prediction in a sensing-to-action pipeline can exceed the value of adding more robots. Prediction accuracy, not sensing coverage, is now the binding constraint on further improvement, pointing to onboard inference, not fleet size, as the more promising direction for future work.
summary_zh: 在部署移动机器人团队进行持续监测时，一个核心问题是任务性能如何随机队规模扩展，以及当感知驱动下游行动而非仅仅进行观察时，这种扩展关系是否仍然成立。我们针对一组在模拟路网中执行交通拥堵检测与预测的无人机团队研究该问题，其报告在闭环中驱动自适应交通信号控制器。我们构建了一个多智能体仿真，其中车辆遵循Nagel-Schreckenberg元胞自动机动力学，无人机采用轮询策略巡逻交叉口，并扫描机队规模、交通水平和路网规模，以评估检测率、检测延迟和预测率。我们展示了当机队规模接近被监测交叉口数量时性能趋于平稳的现象，并为持续监测部署提出了一条通用的机队配置规则。更重要的是，基于预测的拥堵而非检测到的拥堵来调整信号，可使拥堵持续时间减少幅度大约翻倍，这表明在感知到行动的处理链中，机载预测的价值可能超过增加机器人数量的价值。预测精度而非感知覆盖，现已成为进一步改进的约束瓶颈，这指向机载推断而非机队规模，是未来工作更有前景的方向。
tldr: This paper studies drone-based traffic congestion detection and prediction in a simulated network, showing that prediction-driven traffic signal control reduces jam duration twice as much as detection-driven control and outperforms adding more drones.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于无人机的交通拥堵检测与预测在模拟路网中的应用，结果表明基于预测的交通信号控制将拥堵持续时间减少约两倍，优于基于检测的控制和增加无人机数量。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in everyday environments, ensuring their safety has become a central challenge. Existing methods often encode safety requirements as opaque mathematical/logical formulations or dense cost functions. While effective in specific tasks, they remain difficult to interpret, tightly coupled to individual tasks, and offer limited insight into why a robot action is considered safe or unsafe. To address this limitation, we propose ``Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control'' (NEUPRO), which leverages a differentiable reasoner that can learn reusable safety representations from human-specified safety knowledge. NEUPRO allows practitioners to express task-related safety requirements as transparent symbolic rules, while enabling gradients to propagate through these rules to a feature extractor that maps raw observations to safety-relevant concepts. As a result, the learned feature extractor is (softly) grounded in human-understandable semantics, supports transparent constraint evaluation, and is transferable across tasks. By coupling interpretability with differentiability, NEUPRO moves beyond opaque cost design toward reusable safety reasoning. To evaluate NEUPRO's capability, we collect and release REASON, the first real robot benchmark dataset for interpretable robot safety specification. Experiments on REASON show that NEUPRO learns safety-critical features that generalize across tasks, mitigate the interpretability limitations of conventional black-box cost formulations, and provide explicit explanations of safety violation.
summary_zh: 随着机器人在日常环境中的部署日益增多，确保其安全性已成为一项核心挑战。现有方法通常将安全要求编码为晦涩的数学/逻辑公式或密集的代价函数。尽管这些方法在特定任务中表现有效，但它们难以解释、与个别任务紧密耦合，并且对机器人行为为何被视为安全或不安全所提供的洞察有限。为应对这一局限，我们提出了“面向语义安全机器人控制的神经符号谓词学习”（NEUPRO），该方法利用一个可微推理器，能够从人类指定的安全知识中学习可复用的安全表征。NEUPRO允许实践者将任务相关的安全要求表达为透明的符号规则，同时使梯度能够通过这些规则传播至将原始观测映射为安全相关概念的特征提取器。由此，学习到的特征提取器（软性地）扎根于人类可理解的语义，支持透明的约束评估，并可跨任务迁移。通过将可解释性与可微性相结合，NEUPRO超越了不透明的代价设计，迈向可复用的安全推理。为评估NEUPRO的能力，我们收集并发布了REASON——首个面向可解释机器人安全规范的真实机器人基准数据集。在REASON上的实验表明，NEUPRO学习到的安全关键特征能够跨任务泛化，缓解了传统黑箱代价公式的可解释性局限，并为安全违规提供明确的解释。
tldr: NEUPRO introduces a neuro-symbolic framework that learns reusable safety features from symbolic rules for interpretable robot safety, validated on a new real-robot benchmark dataset REASON.
tldr_zh: NEUPRO提出了一种神经符号框架，从符号规则中学习可复用的安全特征，实现可解释的机器人安全，并在新发布的真实机器人基准数据集REASON上进行了验证。

title: ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
summary: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.
summary_zh: 生成人形机器人的全身协同语音动作，需要协调语音韵律、语言内容及机器人特有的动作模式。为此，我们提出了ECHO-G，一个联合基于语音音频和带时间戳文本的框架。其语音接地扩散变换器（SGDiT）将帧级声学特征与词级语言上下文相结合，保留它们各自不同的粒度。通过修正流匹配训练，该模型直接在机器人空间中建模一对多的语句-动作关系。为支持训练与评估，我们构建了源自BEAT2的音频-文本-机器人数据集，以及一个涵盖协同语音特征、机器人动作质量和运行时效率的基准。对比评估表明，直接机器人空间生成优于所评估的人体动作生成与重定向流程，而模态消融实验则凸显了音频-文本联合条件化的优势。我们进一步在实体人形机器人上展示了部署应用。一项补充的视频评分研究也倾向于联合条件化方案。数据集及训练、推理和评估代码均可通过我们的项目页面获取。
tldr: ECHO-G is a framework for generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots, jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts, with a new robot-space dataset and physical robot deployment.
tldr_zh: ECHO-G 是一个为类人机器人生成全身伴随语音动作的框架，联合基于语音音频和定时文本条件，并包含新的机器人空间数据集和实体机器人部署。

title: Sparse Planner: A Hybrid Planner for Efficient Sampling via a Conditional Variational Autoencoder
summary:
Trajectory planning is a core component of autonomous driving systems, where real-time performance and solution quality directly affect safety and reliability. Sample-Based Motion Planning (SBMP) is widely adopted for its ability to approximate near-optimal solutions through parameter space sampling. However, achieving high-quality trajectories typically requires dense sampling, leading to substantial computational overhead and significant runtime variability in complex traffic scenarios.
  To address this limitation, we propose a Sparse Planner (SP) that improves sampling efficiency by learning the conditional relationship between scene context and effective trajectory parameters using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). By modeling the structure of high-quality sampling distributions, SP directly generates cost-effective samples in the parameter space, significantly reducing the required sampling density while preserving solution quality.
  Experimental results show that SP achieves lower trajectory cost than the state-of-the-art FISS+ planner while using only one-eighth of the sampling density. In addition, SP demonstrates improved distance-keeping capability in obstacle-rich scenarios and maintains reduced and more stable runtime characteristics, indicating enhanced computational efficiency and predictable runtime behavior.
summary_zh:
轨迹规划是自动驾驶系统的核心组成部分，其实时性能与解的质量直接影响行车安全与可靠性。基于采样的运动规划方法（SBMP）因能够通过在参数空间中进行采样来逼近近似最优解而被广泛采用。然而，要获得高质量轨迹通常需要密集采样，这导致计算开销显著增加，并在复杂交通场景中产生较大的运行时间波动。
