summary_zh: 在搜索目标物体的过程中，人们会综合考虑可能的目标位置与已探索区域来选择下一步行动。当前的视野能够触发与地点关联的记忆，使目标相关性和先前的探索经历在同一空间背景下得到整合。然而，在许多零样本目标导航（ZSON）方法中，视觉语言模型（VLM）从第一视角图像中推断有前景的搜索区域，而探索历史则被单独表示（例如以文本或地图形式）。这种分离要么需要额外的融合步骤，要么将记忆与路径选择之间的对应关系交由VLM隐式推断。与此不同，我们直接将探索记忆呈现在视觉路径选择上。我们提出了MarvisNav，一个ZSON框架，它维护一个拓扑图，并将候选节点及其探索状态以携带记忆的视觉路径选择形式投影到第一视角图像中。这些状态捕捉了超越简单二值访问的局部探索进度。通过将探索状态直接绑定到每个视觉候选上，MarvisNav使VLM能够联合评估目标相关性和探索状态，无需单独的后期融合或重排序阶段。在无需策略训练的情况下，MarvisNav在HM3D上达到了最先进性能（SR为81.2%，SPL为42.5%），在MP3D上保持了竞争力，同时其VLM调用次数远低于代表性基于VLM的方法（例如仅占WMNav的7.5%）。在多样场景中进行的真实机器人实验进一步验证了其实用部署能力。超越MarvisNav本身，我们的研究表明记忆表征方式会影响VLM的决策和ZSON的性能，凸显有效利用记忆不仅取决于其可用性，还取决于其表征方式。代码和项目页面将在\url{https://wangjincheng1998.github.io/MarvisNav/}提供。
tldr: MarvisNav is a zero-shot object navigation framework that projects topological graph nodes and their exploration states onto egocentric views as memory-bearing visual route choices, enabling a VLM to jointly evaluate target relevance and exploration state without separate fusion, achieving SOTA on HM3D and real-robot deployment.
tldr_zh: MarvisNav 是一种零样本目标导航框架，将拓扑图节点及其探索状态投影到以自我为中心的视图上，作为带有记忆的视觉路线选择，使 VLM 能够联合评估目标相关性和探索状态，而无需单独融合，在 HM3D 和真实机器人部署上达到 SOTA。

title: Odyssey: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for Long-Horizon Real-World Driving with Explicit Navigation Routes
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end driving requires continuous rollouts that reveal how earlier decisions affect subsequent driving. However, existing benchmarks evaluate only short segments and fail to capture later consequences. Ambiguous directional commands also obscure the intended navigation objective. We introduce Odyssey, a closed-loop benchmark for long-horizon driving comprising 100 scenarios, each reconstructed from a 100-second nuPlan driving log to preserve the context of navigation maneuvers and traffic interactions. To provide a consistent navigation objective, Odyssey replaces directional commands with explicit standard-definition (SD) map routes that specify which roads to follow, while sensor-based planning determines local driving actions. Throughout these rollouts, diffusion-based refinement of 3DGS-rendered images reduces rendering artifacts along the ego trajectory. To assess how effectively planners follow these routes and prepare for upcoming maneuvers, we introduce SD Route Compliance and Pre-Lane Change Score. These assessments are complemented by RouteDS, which extends the Driving Score with penalties for SD-route deviations and failed lane preparation. We adapt state-of-the-art planners, including vision-language-action (VLA) models, and evaluate their navigation performance using these metrics. Odyssey highlights open questions in route representation and integration for E2E driving. Benchmark code and adapted baselines will be released publicly.
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶的闭环评估需要连续 rollout，以揭示早期决策如何影响后续驾驶行为。然而，现有基准仅评估短片段，无法捕捉后续后果。此外，模糊的方向指令也掩盖了预期的导航目标。我们提出 Odyssey，一个面向长时域驾驶的闭环基准，包含 100 个场景，每个场景均从 100 秒的 nuPlan 驾驶日志重建，以保留导航操作和交通交互的上下文。为了提供一致的导航目标，Odyssey 用显式的标准定义（SD）地图路线替代方向指令，明确指定应行驶的道路，而基于传感器的规划则负责确定局部驾驶动作。在整个 rollout 过程中，基于扩散的 3DGS 渲染图像细化减少了自车轨迹沿线的渲染伪影。为了评估规划器遵循路线及为后续操作做准备的效果，我们引入了 SD 路线符合度（SD Route Compliance）和变道前评分（Pre-Lane Change Score）。这些评估辅以 RouteDS，该指标在 Driving Score 基础上增加了对 SD 路线偏离和变道准备失败的惩罚。我们适配了包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在内的最先进规划器，并使用这些指标评估其导航性能。Odyssey 凸显了端到端驾驶中路线表示与集成方面的开放性研究问题。基准代码及适配的基线模型将公开发布。
tldr: Odyssey introduces a closed-loop benchmark for long-horizon driving with explicit SD map routes, replacing directional commands, and includes new metrics to evaluate route compliance and lane preparation, testing state-of-the-art planners including VLA models.
tldr_zh: Odyssey 提出了一个用于长时程驾驶的闭环基准，使用显式 SD 地图路线替代方向指令，并引入新指标评估路线遵循和变道准备，测试包括 VLA 模型在内的先进规划器。

title: I-BFM: Reward-Conditioned Robust Humanoid Interaction via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) have recently shown that a single humanoid policy can support diverse whole-body control, but extending such generality to physical interaction remains challenging. We introduce I-BFM, to our knowledge the first BFM for humanoid-object interaction. Rather than relying on task-specific policies or reference tracking, I-BFM learns a shared representation of the coupled dynamics among the humanoid, objects, and their contacts using forward-backward representations and unsupervised reinforcement learning. Given a downstream task reward, the same policy can be directly conditioned on a latent command to execute closed-loop interaction without task-specific policy optimization. To improve interaction control over different time scales, we further train the policy with both short-horizon interaction targets and longer-horizon goal targets. A single I-BFM policy performs carrying, pushing, and kicking, while also supporting goal reaching, motion tracking, stylistic control, and long-horizon task chaining. More importantly, it remains effective after large deviations from nominal execution: on Carry, I-BFM achieves 94.3% nominal success and retains 89.3% success after robot falls, compared with 1.3% for a planning-based baseline. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 further demonstrate diverse loco-manipulation behaviors, rapid recovery from interaction failures and external disturbances, and task chaining without task-specific retraining.
summary_zh: 行为基础模型（BFMs）近期已证明，单一的人形策略能够支持多样化的全身控制，但将这种通用性扩展到物理交互仍具挑战性。我们提出了I-BFM，据我们所知，这是首个面向人形-物体交互的BFM。I-BFM不依赖任务特定策略或参考轨迹跟踪，而是通过前向-后向表示和无监督强化学习，学习人形、物体及其接触之间耦合动力学的共享表征。给定下游任务奖励后，同一策略可直接以潜在命令为条件执行闭环交互，无需任务特定的策略优化。为改善不同时间尺度上的交互控制，我们进一步使用短时域交互目标和长时域目标目标对策略进行训练。单一I-BFM策略即可执行搬运、推和踢等操作，同时支持目标到达、运动跟踪、风格控制及长时域任务链。更重要的是，在偏离名义执行状态较大的情况下，该策略依然有效：在搬运任务中，I-BFM的名义成功率达94.3%，机器人跌倒后仍保持89.3%的成功率，而基于规划的方法仅为1.3%。在Unitree G1上的真实世界实验进一步展示了多样化的移动操作行为、交互失败和外部扰动后的快速恢复能力，以及无需任务特定重训练即可实现任务链执行。
tldr: I-BFM is the first behavioral foundation model for humanoid-object interaction, using unsupervised reinforcement learning to learn a shared representation that enables a single policy to perform diverse physical interactions and recover from failures without task-specific retraining.
tldr_zh: I-BFM 是首个用于人形机器人-物体交互的行为基础模型，通过无监督强化学习学习共享表示，使单个策略能够在不需要特定任务重训练的情况下执行多种物理交互并快速从失败中恢复。

title: How (and How Not) to Use Data Augmentation in VLA Post-Training
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models currently demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of real-world robotics tasks. However, they often still lack the generalization ability to handle large visual out-of-distribution shifts. Post-training of VLAs with reinforcement learning (RL) has been shown to benefit robustness, but significant room for improvement remains. In this work, we systematically study the effect of image augmentation on VLA post-training. We find that it is crucial to augment only the critic module during RL updates, while leaving the actor's input clean during both rollouts and updates. For $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 this raises out-of-distribution success on LIBERO-Plus by $7.8$ and $10.0$ points respectively, while augmenting the actor collapses training entirely. We investigate a range of augmentation types and strengths, and provide practical recommendations for improving generalization in VLA post-training.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型目前在各类真实世界机器人任务中展现出强劲的性能。然而，它们在应对大幅视觉分布外偏移时，往往仍缺乏足够的泛化能力。已有研究表明，利用强化学习（RL）对VLA进行后训练有助于提升鲁棒性，但仍有较大的改进空间。在本研究中，我们系统性地探讨了图像增强对VLA后训练的影响。我们发现，在RL更新过程中，仅对评论者模块进行增强至关重要，而在轨迹采样和参数更新阶段，均需保持行动者输入的原始状态。对于$π_{0.5}$和GR00T N1.5模型，该方法在LIBERO-Plus上的分布外成功率分别提升了$7.8$和$10.0$个百分点，而对行动者进行增强则会使训练完全崩溃。我们考察了多种增强类型及其强度，并为提升VLA后训练中的泛化能力提供了实用建议。
tldr: This paper systematically studies image augmentation in VLA post-training, finding that augmenting only the critic while keeping the actor's input clean significantly improves out-of-distribution robustness in real-robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究了VLA后训练中的图像增强策略，发现仅对critic进行增强而保持actor输入不变，可显著提升真实机器人操作任务中的分布外鲁棒性。

title: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models serve as unified policies for robotic manipulation, yet their expensive inference forces robots to pause between policy calls, resulting in stop-and-go execution that interrupts smooth motion and prolongs task completion. Extending the action chunk reduces policy calls and hence these pauses, but predicting farther into the future makes long-chunk execution unreliable. To understand where this unreliability arises, we analyze action errors within long chunks and find that they concentrate around transitions between manipulation subskills, growing sharply with chunk length. This suggests the importance of transition timing, i.e., when to switch subskills within a chunk. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RACE (Reliable Action-Chunk Extension), a framework that predicts the transition timing from an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on it. By learning and conditioning on transition timing, RACE reduces errors at subskill transitions and enables reliable execution of longer action chunks. Across simulation benchmarks, RACE outperforms fine-tuning at the same chunk length; with 2x longer chunks, it surpasses recent state-of-the-art and efficient VLAs in success rate, and with 4x longer chunks, it remains competitive. On a real robot, RACE uses 4x longer chunks, which reduces the idle time caused by stop-and-go execution by about 5x, while achieving a higher success rate than fine-tuning with the same chunk length. Code and a real-robot demo are available at https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为机器人操作中的统一策略，然而其昂贵的推理开销迫使机器人在策略调用之间暂停，导致“走走停停”式的执行方式，这不仅打断了动作的连贯性，也延长了任务完成时间。延长动作块长度可以减少策略调用次数，从而减少这些暂停，但向更远的未来预测会使长块执行变得不可靠。为了理解这种不可靠性的来源，我们分析了长动作块内的动作误差，发现这些误差集中出现在操作子技能之间的转换处，并随块长度的增加而急剧增大。这表明转换时机的关键性，即在一段动作块内部何时切换子技能。基于这一观察，我们提出了RACE（可靠动作块扩展）框架，该框架通过一次辅助的单步去噪过程预测转换时机，并据此对动作生成进行条件约束。通过学习并依赖转换时机，RACE在子技能转换处显著降低了误差，从而实现更长动作块的可靠执行。在仿真基准测试中，RACE在相同块长度下优于微调方法；在块长度延长至2倍时，其成功率超越近期最先进的高效VLA模型；而在块长度延长至4倍时，仍保持竞争力。在真实机器人上，RACE使用4倍长的动作块，将因“走走停停”式执行导致的空闲时间减少了约5倍，同时相较于同长度的微调方法实现了更高的成功率。代码和真实机器人演示可在 https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA 获取。
tldr: RACE extends action chunks in VLA models by predicting subskill transition timing via auxiliary denoising, reducing transition errors and enabling efficient, reliable long-horizon robotic manipulation with significantly fewer policy calls.
tldr_zh: RACE通过辅助去噪预测子技能转换时机来扩展VLA模型的动作块，减少转换误差，从而以更少的策略调用实现可靠高效的长期机器人操作。

title: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
summary: World--action models (WAMs) promise a unified model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination. However, existing joint video--action models often use computationally heavy, fixed-horizon backbones ill-suited to streaming inference and stable long-horizon open-loop rollouts. We introduce FLEX-WAM, a Flexible and Efficient Block-Causal World--Action Model for unified simulation and policy inference. FLEX-WAM supports variable-length contexts and non-causal prediction horizons, as well as infinite autoregressive generation frame by frame or block by block. Its block-causal, KV-cacheable architecture combines axial attention and blockwise diffusion forcing to enable efficient real-time rollout and deployment-time latency--throughput tradeoffs without retraining. Joint training can nevertheless produce plausible futures that weakly respond to commanded actions. We address this failure mode by balancing state and action flow-matching gradient contributions across the state--action diffusion-noise grid and regulating world-model sampling using Forward-Dynamics (FD) elasticity, an efficient training-time proxy for action responsiveness. Across simulated and real-world datasets, FLEX-WAM achieves superior multi-step prediction quality and latency while producing stable joint state--action rollouts for thousands of steps. As a joint action proposer and simulator within MCTS, it solves long-horizon PushT and all five OGBench Puzzle-4x4 tasks entirely in imagination. On a bimanual OpenArm-based robot, a single checkpoint jointly serves as a play policy and expected-outcome predictor, enabling real-time identification and collection of model--reality mismatches for future self-improvement.
summary_zh: 世界—动作模型（WAMs）有望实现一种统一模型，既能预测以动作条件化的未来状态，又能生成可行动作，并支持在想象中进行规划。然而，现有的联合视频—动作模型通常采用计算量较大且固定视野长度的骨干网络，难以适用于流式推理和稳定的长视野开环推演。我们提出了FLEX-WAM，一种灵活高效的分块因果世界—动作模型，用于统一的模拟与策略推理。FLEX-WAM支持可变长度的上下文和非因果预测视野，并支持逐帧或逐块进行的无限自回归生成。其分块因果、可缓存键值（KV-cacheable）的架构结合了轴向注意力与分块扩散强制机制，能够在无需重新训练的情况下实现高效的实时推演，并在部署时提供延迟—吞吐量的灵活折中。然而，联合训练可能产生对未来状态的合理预测，但对所施加的动作响应较弱。为解决这一失效模式，我们在状态—动作扩散噪声网格上平衡状态与动作的流匹配梯度贡献，并利用前向动力学（FD）弹性——一种高效的训练时动作响应性代理指标——来调节世界模型的采样过程。在仿真和真实世界数据集上，FLEX-WAM在多步预测质量和延迟方面均表现优异，同时能够稳定地生成数千步的联合状态—动作推演。作为MCTS中的联合动作提议器与模拟器，它能够完全在想象中解决长视野PushT任务以及全部五个OGBench Puzzle-4x4任务。在一台基于OpenArm的双臂机器人上，单个检查点同时作为行为策略和预期结果预测器，能够实时识别并收集模型与现实的偏差，为未来的自我改进提供支持。
tldr: FLEX-WAM introduces a flexible block-causal world-action model enabling efficient long-horizon imagination and planning, demonstrated on simulated tasks and a real bimanual robot.
tldr_zh: FLEX-WAM 提出了一种灵活的块因果世界-动作模型，支持高效的长时程想象与规划，并在仿真任务和真实双臂机器人上得到验证。

title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
summary: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.
summary_zh: 捕获到的人-物交互为类人机器人的移动操作提供了丰富的监督信号，但这些数据稀疏、异构，且无法直接被机器人执行。我们提出了InterMimicGen，一种自我进化的运动模仿框架，其中机器人运动数据与跟踪策略相互促进、共同提升。首先，我们整合了基于动作捕捉的人-物交互数据集，并将其重定向为类人机器人参考动作，同时保留全身协调性和灵巧的手-物关系，从而生成一个大规模、多样化的类人机器人全身灵巧移动操作参考集合。其次，我们训练了一个基于物理的通用跟踪器，在仿真环境中让具备灵巧双手的类人机器人执行这些参考动作，其覆盖的规模和多样性超越了以往面向移动操作的类人机器人跟踪系统。第三，我们构建了一个数据飞轮：每一轮迭代都会对交互发生的位置以及身体执行交互的方式做出微小但保持任务语义不变的改动，在此基础上对跟踪器进行微调，仅保留那些仿真执行能够完成任务目标的变体，并将其作为下一轮迭代的输入。随着迭代次数增加，这些微小改动逐渐累积，在稀疏的原始演示周围形成更广泛的覆盖范围，同时保持任务语义和运动质量。实验表明，该方法实现了跨机器人形态的接触保持重定向、单一通用策略的广泛跟踪、随着增强轮次持续增长的可执行运动，以及向真实机器人的迁移。InterMimicGen提供了一条从异构人类演示到类人机器人学习持续扩展运动资源的统一路径。
tldr: InterMimicGen introduces a self-evolving motion imitation framework that retargets motion-captured human-object interactions into humanoid robot references, trains a generalist physics-based tracker for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation, and iteratively expands executable motion data through a data flywheel, with transfer to real robots.
tldr_zh: InterMimicGen提出了一种自我进化的运动模仿框架，将动作捕捉的人-物交互数据重定向为人形机器人参考，训练用于灵巧全身移动操纵的通用物理跟踪器，并通过数据飞轮迭代扩展可执行的运动数据，并迁移到真实机器人。

title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
summary: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
summary_zh: 编排冻结视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的LLM智能体通过文本记忆在多个回合中提升表现，但文本记忆记录的是智能体做了什么，而非任务如何完成。演示视频虽能呈现过程，却难以融入智能体的上下文。完整视频会拖慢每一轮交互，固定关键帧则丢失了决定抓取是否成功的接触细节，且智能体的需求会随任务阶段变化——规划时需要任务的整体结构，执行时需要各接触点附近的帧。我们提出递归视频上下文学习（RV-ICL），一种无需训练的方法，将演示转化为智能体可导航的层次结构，而非其被动接收的提示。该层次结构由演示的子事件（如抓取和释放）构建，层级由粗到细，从整个任务的关键帧延伸到阶段、时刻和短片段，并通过只读工具暴露给智能体。智能体在规划前先读取粗粒度层级，执行过程中每当某一步需要更多细节时，便重新进入该层次结构，仅加载当前子目标对应的片段。每个任务仅需一个演示即可。基于RPent构建的RV-ICL在LIBERO-PRO上将成功率从92.6%提升至96.5%，在LIBERO-Plus上从86.7%提升至95.8%。
tldr: This paper introduces Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that organizes a demonstration video into a hierarchical structure of sub-events, allowing an LLM agent to query coarse-to-fine video clips to improve the execution of frozen VLA policies, achieving higher success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出递归视频上下文学习（RV-ICL），一种无需训练的方法，将演示视频组织成子事件的层次结构，使LLM智能体能够按需查询从粗到细的视频片段，从而提升冻结的VLA策略的执行效果，在LIBERO基准上取得更高成功率。

title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
summary: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.86% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 1.45% and 1.00% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.60% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过学习预测环境如何演化，为通用机器人控制奠定了重要基础。然而，世界动作模型依赖摄像头输入，而对这些输入的操纵可能破坏跨任务和动作策略所使用的视觉表征。现有针对这些模型的攻击往往针对受害者的动作或预测的未来状态进行优化，因此需要访问目标模型的输出。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对世界动作模型的攻击方法——TAPDreamer，该方法仅利用一个公共编码器构造固定的局部扰动，该扰动可跨任务和动作架构迁移，且无需查询目标策略。我们的关键洞见在于：补丁引起的注意力权重与值向量之间的交互变化，会将几乎相同的表征偏移传播到远超补丁覆盖范围之外，且该偏移在不同任务的观测中保持稳定。基于这一洞见，TAPDreamer利用来自单一源任务的六帧图像，最大化干净编码器表征与加补丁编码器表征之间的全局L1距离。在闭环评估中，每个基准仅使用一个冻结补丁，覆盖输入约6.5%的区域，即可将FastWAM在40个LIBERO任务中的成功率从97.7%降至0.0%，在50个RoboTwin任务中从90.86%降至0.0%；而随机放置的匹配补丁仍分别保持81.5%和79.2%的成功率。同样的补丁在两种DreamWAM配置上将成功率分别降至1.45%和1.00%，在Motus上降至10.60%。这些结果表明，仅保护下游动作生成是不够的：世界动作模型的防御措施还必须确保共享视觉编码器免受持续性局部扰动的攻击。
tldr: TAPDreamer constructs a transferable adversarial patch using only a public encoder, which, when placed on camera input, collapses the success rate of world action models across multiple benchmarks and architectures without requiring target-policy queries, highlighting the vulnerability of shared visual encoders.
tldr_zh: TAPDreamer仅使用公共编码器构造可转移的对抗性补丁，将其放置在相机输入上即可在无需查询目标策略的情况下，使多个基准和架构上的世界行动模型成功率降为零，凸显了共享视觉编码器的脆弱性。

title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
summary: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.
summary_zh: 长期规划与潜在世界模型需要跨时间尺度和抽象层次进行推理。现有的任务无关JEPA世界模型在单一时间尺度上预测和规划，或在共享潜在空间中采用多种时间视野。我们提出H-JEPA，一种端到端的训练层次化动作条件JEPA的配方，其中每一层在自己学到的潜在空间中预测更远的未来。规划采用自上而下的方式进行：顶层优化朝向目标的进展，每一层的预测成为其下层规划器的子目标。当数据中的因素以分离的时间尺度演化时，较高层会丢弃快速、不可预测的细节，保留较慢的与任务相关的状态。在四个模拟导航和操作环境中，层次化规划优于平面JEPA；在Visual AntMaze中，三层层次结构将成功率从18%提升至73%，同时使用更少的规划计算。消融实验表明，这些增益归因于时间分解和更高层目标表示。在逆动力学监督下，该方法扩展到来自DROID的多样化真实机器人视频，在较低规划计算下，层次结构提高了离线规划的保真度。
tldr: H-JEPA introduces an end-to-end method for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPA world models, where each level predicts at its own timescale and latent space, enabling top-down hierarchical planning. It improves long-horizon planning success in simulated navigation/manipulation tasks and extends to real-world robot videos.
tldr_zh: H-JEPA 提出了一种端到端训练层次化 JEPA 世界模型的方法，每个层级在各自的潜在空间和时间尺度上进行预测，并支持自顶向下的层级规划。在模拟导航和操作任务中显著提升了长时程规划成功率，并扩展到了真实机器人视频数据。

title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
summary: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.
summary_zh: 模拟环境中的机器人学习依赖于模拟器提供的物体对象。许多任务需要具备独立部件、能够实现所需运动的关节，以及在接触条件下保持有效的物理属性的物体。现有方法针对每张图像重新恢复这一结构：生成模型预测的部件和关节大多无法在模拟中稳定放置或运动，而通用智能体对每张照片都需要进行长时间的模型调用。AffordCraft 通过检索而非生成的方式，从单张RGB图像和任务指令构建此类资产：它定位目标物体及其待操作部件，从铰接资产库中选取匹配条目，并在保持部件与关节完整的前提下将其适配到图像中。无需任何框选或掩码标记物体，AffordCraft 即可为来自31个类别的2000张照片中的1703张生成物理有效的资产。五种生成方法在同一批照片上的通过率最高仅为45%，且在中位数情况下，每生成一个有效资产所需GPU时间是我们的10至78倍。在50张杂乱场景图像中，自动检测后的237个已标注物体中有162个通过了相同的物理测试。将资产库从141个条目扩展至11372个无需修改方法本身，类别覆盖率从46%提升至100%，具有请求标签的选择比例从18%提升至51%。我们还利用构建出的资产生成操作任务，涵盖单一物体及组合场景；基于脚本化演示训练的策略能够在训练中未见过的初始状态下完成这两类任务。
tldr: AffordCraft constructs physically valid articulated simulation assets from a single image and task instruction by retrieving and fitting from a library of articulated assets, enabling robot manipulation task creation.
tldr_zh: AffordCraft 通过从铰接资产库中检索并拟合，从单张图像和任务指令构建物理有效的仿真资产，从而支持机器人操作任务的创建。

title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link}.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）融合来自视频生成骨干网络的视觉表征，以引导动作预测。近期的高效WAMs采用混合Transformer（MoT）架构，并仅计算一次视频表征供动作专家复用。然而，专家内部迭代（即多步动作去噪）与专家间等待（即视频与动作专家的串行执行）仍制约推理效率。为此，我们提出RealtimeWAM，一种具备单步动作生成与异步推理的极高效WAM变体，以解决上述两大瓶颈。为减少专家内部迭代，我们提出教师锚定一致性蒸馏（TACD），以应对局部-全局误差缺口：仅降低局部一致性误差无法保证最终动作的准确性。TACD通过冻结教师的逐步展开终点提供显式监督，补充局部一致性约束，从而实现精确的单步动作生成。此外，我们提出跨专家波前流水线（CEWP），以消除不必要的专家级等待。该机制通过块级共享视频KV缓存实现两专家的重叠执行，仅在对应动作注意力消费该缓存前即刻同步。跨多个基准（如LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin）及模型变体（如Fast-WAM和Faster-WAM）的大量实验表明，RealtimeWAM具有显著优越性。值得注意的是，RealtimeWAM在保持近乎无损性能（即各基准性能下降小于1%）的同时，实现了显著的端到端加速（如H100上约25倍加速）。我们的代码与检查点可通过此链接获取。
tldr: RealtimeWAM accelerates World Action Models by proposing one-step action generation via Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation and asynchronous cross-expert execution via Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining, achieving ~25x speedup with minimal performance loss on robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RealtimeWAM通过教师锚定一致性蒸馏实现单步动作生成，并通过跨专家波前流水线实现异步推理，在机器人操作基准上实现约25倍加速且性能几乎无损。

title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
summary: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}
summary_zh: 动作条件下的机器人世界模型必须精确响应机器人轨迹，同时保留逼真的视觉动态，然而从异构机器人视频中同时学习这两者仍具挑战性。仿真能够提供结构化的运动监督，但外观差异阻碍了直接迁移，且不准确的仿真预测可能误导真实视频的生成。我们提出SimForcing，一种仿真引导框架，将仿真既用作可迁移运动知识的来源，又用作预测的可控参考。首先，我们通过潜在运动蒸馏从仿真教师模型中迁移运动知识，对齐潜在空间中的时序变化以内化运动先验，同时缓解外观差异的影响。其次，我们引入带有条件丢弃的多块仿真条件化机制，以利用预测的仿真轨迹，同时不过度依赖其准确性。我们的仿真条件化无分类器引导方案通过平衡基于内化运动知识的预测与额外由仿真潜在变量引导的预测，将这两种思想统一起来。联合训练的学生模型同时生成仿真条件和真实域视频，推理时无需额外世界模型。在Bridge上，SimForging在无外部具身预训练的情况下，与对比方法相比取得了最优的PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS和FVD指标。在InternData-A1上的评估进一步支持其跨机器人数据集的适用性。此外，使用我们训练的世界模型初始化视觉-语言-动作模型可提升LIBERO任务成功率，表明其在下游策略学习中的实用价值。\url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}
tldr: SimForcing is a simulation-guided framework that distills motion priors from a simulation teacher into real-domain robot world models via latent-motion distillation and multi-block simulation conditioning, improving video prediction and downstream policy learning.
tldr_zh: SimForcing 是一个仿真引导框架，通过潜在运动蒸馏和多块仿真条件将仿真中的运动先验迁移到真实域机器人世界模型，提升视频预测及下游策略学习。

title: DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
summary: Human demonstrations offer rich examples of precise dexterous manipulation and a promising source of robot training data. However, high-fidelity reproduction of demonstrated motions and hand-object interactions across robot embodiments remains challenging under physical constraints. We present DexForge, a differentiable physics-grounded framework for converting human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories. We reconstruct spherical-Gaussian object models and hand-object motion from visual observations, then build a differentiable simulator combining efficient Gaussian collision detection with existing differentiable dynamics. Based on this simulator, DexForge combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting: robot-adapted stable contacts guide kinematic reference construction and subsequent gradient-based control refinement for precise physical motion reproduction. Experiments on 130 DexYCB and HOT3D demonstrations across seven dexterous hands show success-rate gains of approximately 35-53 percentage points over the baseline, with object position and orientation tracking errors on successful trajectories reduced by approximately 34-67% and 71-78%, respectively. Further experiments demonstrate open-loop transfer to MuJoCo and real-robot execution. Our project page is available at https://wmz1226.github.io/DexForge/
summary_zh: 人类示范为精细灵巧操作提供了丰富的实例，是机器人训练数据的重要来源。然而，在物理约束下，如何跨机器人本体高保真地复现示范动作及手物交互仍具挑战。我们提出DexForge，一个基于可微物理的框架，用于将人类视频示范转化为高保真机器人轨迹。我们从视觉观测中重建球面高斯物体模型及手物运动，并构建一个结合高效高斯碰撞检测与现有可微动力学的可微仿真器。在此基础上，DexForge将接触感知的运动学重定向与力感知的动力学重定向相结合：适配机器人的稳定接触引导运动学参考构建，并进一步用于基于梯度的控制优化，以实现精确的物理运动复现。我们在涵盖七种灵巧手的130段DexYCB和HOT3D示范上的实验表明，相比基线，成功率提升约35至53个百分点，成功轨迹上的物体位置和姿态跟踪误差分别降低约34-67%和71-78%。进一步实验验证了至MuJoCo的开环迁移及实体机器人执行。我们的项目页面见 https://wmz1226.github.io/DexForge/
tldr: DexForge converts human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories for dexterous hands using a differentiable physics-grounded framework that combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting, achieving significant success-rate and tracking-error improvements on DexYCB and HOT3D benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DexForge 利用可微物理框架将人类视频演示转化为高保真机器人轨迹，结合接触感知运动重定位与力感知动力学重定位，在 DexYCB 和 HOT3D 基准上显著提升了成功率并降低了跟踪误差。

title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.
summary_zh: 将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适应部署时的分布偏移，对于可靠的机器人操作至关重要，但传统的一阶自适应方法可能超出面向推理的部署平台的内存预算。零阶（ZO）优化提供了一种仅需前向传播、内存消耗与推理阶段相当的替代方案，但精确的梯度估计需要大量扰动查询，这使得朴素零阶方法在大型VLA模型上速度过慢，难以实际应用。我们提出VLA-ZO，一种利用VLA计算结构实现快速零阶自适应的框架。通过将自适应限制在动作侧，VLA-ZO保持昂贵的视觉-语言前缀部分冻结，并在扰动查询和优化器步骤之间复用其条件状态，同时通过调度感知的预取机制隐藏状态传输开销。在LIBERO相机视角偏移任务上，与基线零阶方法相比，VLA-ZO在$q=16$时将端到端自适应时间缩短了25.59倍，在$q=64$时缩短了32.54倍，同时将平均任务成功率从无自适应时的48.27%分别提升至58.17%和63.58%。这些结果表明，加快零阶方法的速度可使更大的查询预算变得切实可行，为在部署平台上实现资源高效的VLA自适应提供了一条有前景的路径。
tldr: VLA-ZO introduces a framework for fast zeroth-order adaptation of Vision-Language-Action models by freezing the vision-language prefix and reusing its conditioning states, significantly reducing adaptation time and improving task success under distribution shifts.
tldr_zh: VLA-ZO提出了一种针对视觉-语言-行动模型的快速零阶自适应框架，通过冻结视觉-语言前缀并复用其条件状态，大幅缩短自适应时间并提高分布偏移下的任务成功率。

title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
summary: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.
summary_zh: 指令跟随是语言条件化机器人策略的核心：当同一场景允许多种有效动作时，语言应决定执行何种操作。然而，仅凭成功执行并不能确定策略是遵循了指令，还是从场景中推断出了任务。我们通过保持场景不变的指令干预来研究这一歧义，使用有效的目标替换、任意名词和不相关句子进行测试。我们在仿真和真实世界实验中评估了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略和世界动作模型（WAM）。我们的分析围绕三个问题展开：（a）任务成功是否意味着指令跟随？当指令要求不同的可见物体时，所有被评估的策略主要倾向于接近并拾取与场景相关的错误原始目标。（b）这种失败是否由语言不敏感所致？指令扰动会影响任务表现。逐层动作透镜显示中间动作预测对这些扰动有响应。线性探针能够准确恢复被指示的目标，表明修改后的指令虽被编码，却很少决定目标选择。（c）为什么编码后的语言未能控制动作？注意力分析表明指令标记对动作生成的贡献较弱。目标标记的注意力可能仍集中在原始物体上，揭示了目标编码与视觉基础之间的错配。UMAP和共享非负矩阵分解显示，目标信息在越来越以场景身份组织的表征中仍然可访问。我们的发现暴露了名义成功掩盖下的基础错位，并提供了一个诊断框架。它们进一步确立了具体的进展标准：策略应可靠地遵循用户意图的有效变化，即使这些变化与场景偏好的行为相冲突。
tldr: This paper investigates whether vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models truly follow language instructions or instead rely on scene-favored behavior, revealing a 'grounding gap' where instructions are encoded but do not control action selection.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界动作模型是否真正遵循语言指令，还是依赖场景偏好的行为，揭示了一个“接地差距”，即指令被编码但不控制动作选择。

title: Arm-wise Compositional Generalization in Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Generalization in multi-arm collaboration can be studied as composing familiar atomic skills in new ways across arms. However, existing evaluations offer limited insight into which training and architectural choices support this ability under different coordination requirements. We introduce \textbf{ACG-Bench}, a benchmark for \emph{Arm-wise Compositional Generalization} that provides a common testbed for studying skill recomposition in dual-arm policies. It contains 23 task--condition pairs across 8 task families, with 6 in-domain conditions and 17 unseen compositions covering reordering, synchronization, their combination, and cross-task composition. All methods receive the same per-arm atomic prompts, and success requires achieving the task goal while satisfying physical milestones and specified order or timing constraints. Using $π_{0.5}$ as a common vision-language-action backbone, we compare representative data-augmentation and architectural strategies with shared source data and a common evaluation protocol. Our architectural study examines arm-token grouping, skill-specific LoRA adapters (SkillLoRA), and arm-wise attention (AWA), highlighting the complementarity of skill-conditioned parameters and attention structure. Combining these choices yields \textbf{AE-VLA}, which achieves 21.53\% generalization success in simulation, compared with 2.94\% for Single $π_{0.5}$, 3.06\% for MA-VLA, and 5.53\% for two independently controlled $π_{0.5}$ policies. On physical SO101 robots, AE-VLA reaches 39.00\% mean success across five unseen conditions, compared with 10.00\% for the strongest baseline. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing dual-arm policies that generalize beyond fixed training routines.
summary_zh: 多臂协作中的泛化可以理解为以新的方式跨机械臂组合熟悉的原子技能来加以研究。然而，现有评估在支持不同协调要求下训练与架构选择的能力方面提供的洞察有限。我们提出\textbf{ACG-Bench}，一个用于\emph{臂间组合泛化}的基准，为研究双臂策略中的技能重组提供了通用测试平台。它包含8个任务族中的23个任务–条件对，涵盖6个域内条件和17个未见过的组合，涉及重排序、同步、二者的结合以及跨任务组合。所有方法均接收相同的每臂原子提示，成功要求达到任务目标，同时满足物理里程碑以及指定的顺序或时间约束。以$π_{0.5}$作为共同的视觉—语言—动作骨干，我们在共享源数据和统一评估协议下，比较了代表性的数据增强和架构策略。我们的架构研究考察了臂令牌分组、技能专用LoRA适配器（SkillLoRA）以及臂间注意力（AWA），强调了技能条件参数与注意力结构之间的互补性。将这些选择组合起来得到\textbf{AE-VLA}，在仿真中实现了21.53\%的泛化成功率，而单一$π_{0.5}$为2.94\%，MA-VLA为3.06\%，两个独立控制的$π_{0.5}$策略为5.53\%。在实际SO101机器人上，AE-VLA在五个未见条件下达到了39.00\%的平均成功率，而最强基线为10.00\%。这些发现为设计超越固定训练例程的双臂策略提供了实证指导。
tldr: This paper introduces ACG-Bench, a benchmark for arm-wise compositional generalization in dual-arm VLA policies, and proposes AE-VLA, which combines skill-specific LoRA adapters and arm-wise attention to significantly improve generalization in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了双臂VLA策略中手臂级组合泛化的基准ACG-Bench，并提出了AE-VLA，通过结合技能特定LoRA适配器和手臂级注意力，在仿真和真实机器人上显著提高了泛化性能。

title: Controllable and Photorealistic Pedestrian Risky Motion Generation for End-to-End Driving Safety Evaluation
summary: Evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving under rare, safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian interactions requires photorealistic, sensor-level scenarios. However, trajectory-based scenario generators cannot synthesize raw visual observations, whereas video-based approaches lack controllability. To bridge this gap, we present ControlPed, a novel framework that combines trajectory-level conflict synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to generate photorealistic, motion-controllable safety-critical scenarios. Built upon HazardPed, a dataset derived from 10,352 traffic videos comprising 422 conflict trajectories, HD maps, and 857 annotated 3D human motions, ControlPed first generates conflict trajectories, lifts them into 3D human motion sequences via text-conditioned motion diffusion, and finally renders multi-view sensor observations using animatable 3DGS avatars. Safety evaluation in 88 rendered photorealistic scenarios reveals that seven leading end-to-end driving models suffer a severe performance drop, with their mean HDScore plunging from 88.8 to 47.4, exposing major failure modes under dangerous pedestrian behaviors. The dataset and testing benchmarks will be released to facilitate safety assessment of vehicle-pedestrian interactions.
summary_zh: 评估端到端自动驾驶在罕见且安全关键的车辆-行人交互场景中的性能，需要照片级逼真且具备传感器级细节的测试环境。然而，基于轨迹的场景生成器无法合成原始视觉观测数据，而基于视频的方法则缺乏可控性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了ControlPed，一个新颖的框架，将轨迹级冲突合成与三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）相结合，以生成照片级逼真、运动可控的安全关键场景。ControlPed基于HazardPed数据集构建，该数据集源自10，352个交通视频，包含422条冲突轨迹、高清地图以及857个带标注的三维人体运动。ControlPed首先生成冲突轨迹，通过文本条件运动扩散将其提升为三维人体运动序列，最后使用可动画化的3DGS虚拟化身渲染多视角传感器观测数据。在88个渲染出的照片级逼真场景中进行的安全评估显示，七种领先的端到端驾驶模型性能严重下降，其平均HDScore从88.8骤降至47.4，暴露了在危险行人行为下的主要失败模式。该数据集及测试基准将公开发布，以促进车辆-行人交互安全评估。
tldr: ControlPed generates photorealistic, motion-controllable safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian scenarios for evaluating end-to-end driving models by combining trajectory-level conflict synthesis, text-conditioned motion diffusion, and 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering.
tldr_zh: ControlPed结合轨迹级冲突合成、文本条件动作扩散和3D高斯溅射渲染，为评估端到端驾驶模型生成逼真、运动可控的人车危险场景。

title: Radar2Plan: Benchmarking 4D Radar for End-to-End Open-Loop Ego-Trajectory Planning
summary: Adverse weather and poor illumination remain major challenges for robust ego-trajectory planning in mobile autonomy. 4D radar offers reliable sensing under adverse conditions and direct radial-velocity measurements. However, sensing robustness does not necessarily translate into robust downstream planning, while existing 4D radar benchmarks focus primarily on perception rather than trajectory planning. We present Radar2Plan, a modular benchmark for open-loop ego-trajectory planning using real-world 4D radar data. Radar2Plan connects sensor encoders, scene representations, and planning heads through common interfaces, enabling controlled comparisons between different sensor and planner configurations. Using DSERT-RoLL and MAN TruckScenes, we evaluated seven combinations of camera, 4D radar, and LiDAR in four representative planning baselines and 12 weather and illumination conditions under a unified protocol. To our knowledge, Radar2Plan is the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating real-world 4D radars for autonomous driving planning. Experiments show that 4D radar alone supports competitive ego-trajectory planning and robust performance under adverse conditions. Sensor-configuration comparisons further demonstrate its complementary value to other modalities, while revealing dependencies on sensor combination and planning architecture. The modular design also supports additional datasets, sensing modalities, and planners, providing a flexible foundation for future research on radar-based autonomous driving planning.
summary_zh:
摘要：
恶劣天气和光照不足仍然是移动自主系统中鲁棒自我轨迹规划的主要挑战。4D雷达在恶劣条件下能够提供可靠的感知以及直接的径向速度测量。然而，传感鲁棒性并不一定能转化为下游规划的鲁棒性，且现有的4D雷达基准主要聚焦于感知而非轨迹规划。我们提出Radar2Plan，一个基于真实世界4D雷达数据的开环自我轨迹规划的模块化基准。Radar2Plan通过通用接口连接传感器编码器、场景表示和规划头，实现了不同传感器与规划器配置之间的受控比较。利用DSERT-RoLL和MAN TruckScenes数据集，我们在统一协议下，在四种代表性规划基线和12种天气及光照条件下评估了相机、4D雷达和激光雷达的七种组合。据我们所知，Radar2Plan是首个专门评估真实世界4D雷达用于自动驾驶规划的基准。实验表明，单独的4D雷达即可支持具有竞争力的自我轨迹规划，并在恶劣条件下保持鲁棒性能。传感器配置比较进一步展示了其与其他模态的互补价值，同时揭示了其对传感器组合和规划架构的依赖性。该模块化设计还支持额外的数据集、感知模态和规划器，为未来基于雷达的自动驾驶规划研究提供了灵活的基础。
tldr: Radar2Plan presents the first benchmark for end-to-end open-loop ego-trajectory planning using real-world 4D radar data, evaluating multiple sensor combinations and planning baselines across diverse conditions, and demonstrating competitive and robust radar-based planning.
tldr_zh: Radar2Plan 提出了首个基于真实 4D 雷达数据的端到端开环自车轨迹规划基准，评估了多种传感器组合和规划基线在不同条件下的表现，展示了基于雷达规划的竞争力和鲁棒性。

title: Conditional Trajectory Peaks: Single-Pass Multimodal Policies over Action Chunks
summary: Multimodal imitation learning requires diverse executable futures under the same observation and consistent behavior across replanning cycles. We present Conditional Trajectory Peaks (CTP), a single-pass policy framework that jointly predicts complete action-chunk candidates, probability masses, and trajectory scales. Distribution-Aware Peak Specialization (DAPS) specializes trajectory peaks using trajectory-level posterior responsibilities and mass- and scale-modulated overlap constraints. Evidence-Gated Trajectory Belief Transport (ETBT) maintains cross-chunk consistency through geometric correspondence between exchangeable candidate sets, while allowing current policy evidence to override historical constraints. CTP achieves a coverage score of 91.40% on Push-T; success rates of 100.0%, 79.72%, and 84.44% on D3IL Avoiding, Aligning, and Sorting-2, respectively. On LIBERO, CTP achieves an average success rate of 97.25%. In real-world dual-arm experiments, CTP preserves both placement modes in a two-plate task, succeeding in all 50 trials. On bottle uprighting and pen placement into a holder, it maintains success rates comparable to $π_{0.5}$ while reducing policy inference latency from 218.24 ms to 75.80 ms. These results demonstrate that single-pass trajectory modeling can combine multimodal behavior, closed-loop consistency, and efficient inference.
summary_zh: 多模态模仿学习要求在同一观察条件下生成多样化的可执行未来轨迹，并在重新规划周期中保持行为一致性。我们提出条件轨迹峰值（CTP）方法，这是一种单遍策略框架，能够联合预测完整的动作块候选、概率质量及轨迹尺度。分布感知峰值特化（DAPS）利用轨迹级别的后验责任以及质量与尺度调制的重叠约束，对轨迹峰值进行特化。证据门控轨迹信念传输（ETBT）通过可交换候选集合之间的几何对应关系维持跨块一致性，同时允许当前策略证据覆盖历史约束。CTP在Push-T任务上达到91.40%的覆盖率得分；在D3IL的Avoiding、Aligning和Sorting-2任务上分别取得100.0%、79.72%和84.44%的成功率。在LIBERO基准上，CTP的平均成功率达到97.25%。在真实世界双臂实验中，CTP在双盘任务中保留了两种放置模式，50次试验全部成功。在瓶体竖直放置和笔放入支架任务中，CTP保持了与$π_{0.5}$相当的成功率，同时将策略推理延迟从218.24毫秒降至75.80毫秒。这些结果表明，单遍轨迹建模能够兼顾多模态行为、闭环一致性和高效推理。
tldr: This paper introduces Conditional Trajectory Peaks (CTP), a single-pass policy framework for multimodal imitation learning that predicts action-chunk candidates, probabilities, and scales, achieving high success rates and low inference latency across simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出条件轨迹峰值（CTP），一种单遍策略框架，用于多模态模仿学习，可预测动作候选、概率和尺度，在仿真和真实机器人操作中实现高成功率与低推理延迟。

title: Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise for Consistent Asynchronous Replanning in Generative Robot Policies
summary: Continuous asynchronous replanning is essential for real-time generative robot policies, but independent stochastic initialization can cause mode switching and inconsistent continuation across action chunks. We propose Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise (EAPN), which introduces structured stochasticity at both inter-chunk and intra-chunk levels. Across replanning steps, EAPN propagates a shared noise trajectory and aligns it with the actual execution displacement, establishing execution-aligned inter-chunk correlation. Within each action chunk, it models temporal correlation along action time. The aligned stochastic history is further combined with committed action context to condition subsequent generation, allowing new chunks to continue from execution-consistent generative states rather than restart from independent noise. We evaluate EAPN on D3IL, Kinetix, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation tasks. EAPN improves multimodal behavior consistency on D3IL and achieves an average success rate of 88.59% on Kinetix. On LIBERO, it remains robust and maintains strong task performance even under long inference delays. Real-robot experiments further achieve 90.0% success on Object Storage and 96.7% on bimanual Cloth Folding, demonstrating reliable continuous execution under asynchronous replanning.
summary_zh: 连续异步重规划对于实时生成式机器人策略至关重要，但独立的随机初始化可能导致模式切换以及动作片段之间不一致的延续。我们提出了执行对齐渐进噪声（EAPN），该方法在片段间和片段内两个层面引入结构化随机性。在重规划的每一步之间，EAPN传播共享噪声轨迹，并将其与实际执行位移对齐，从而建立执行对齐的片段间相关性。在每个动作片段内部，该方法对沿动作时间的时间相关性进行建模。对齐后的随机历史进一步与已承诺的动作上下文相结合，以条件化后续生成过程，使新片段能够从与执行一致的生成状态继续推进，而非从独立噪声重新开始。我们在D3IL、Kinetix、LIBERO以及真实世界操作任务上对EAPN进行了评估。EAPN在D3IL上改善了多模态行为一致性，并在Kinetix上取得了88.59%的平均成功率。在LIBERO上，即使在长时间推理延迟下，该方法仍保持稳健，并维持较强的任务表现。真实机器人实验进一步在物体存储任务中实现了90.0%的成功率，在双臂布料折叠任务中实现了96.7%的成功率，证明了在异步重规划下连续执行的可靠性。
tldr: EAPN introduces execution-aligned progressive noise for consistent asynchronous replanning in generative robot policies, improving multimodal behavior consistency and task success across simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EAPN 通过执行对齐的渐进噪声，在生成式机器人策略中实现一致的异步重规划，提升多模态行为一致性和真实世界操作成功率。

title: Adaptive Mean Flow for Responsive Closed-Loop Robot Control
summary: Diffusion- and flow-based robot policies have recently become widespread in robotic Imitation Learning (IL) due to their high performance and ability to model continuous and multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising procedure used by these models introduces significant prediction latency, hindering high-frequency closed-loop robot control and leading to jittery, unstable motion when frequent updates to the robot's action predictions are used. Therefore, it is common practice to train models to predict chunks of actions that can be executed sequentially without feedback, even when this reduces responsiveness and may mean the most recent state information is not used. In this article, we present Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF), a flow-based IL method that enables smooth and responsive, fully closed-loop robot control. AMF uses Mean Flow, which is an accelerated form of Flow Matching (FM), to minimize prediction latency. To ensure smoothness and consistency across predictions, AMF uses a corrupted version of the trajectory from the previous step when predicting new robot actions, with the signal-to-noise ratio increasing over the time parameter of the trajectory. This discourages large changes in the prediction from one step to the next, while allowing freedom to adapt the predictions for future steps. We evaluate AMF across a wide range of simulated and real robot tasks and demonstrate significantly improved performance compared with baselines. Code: https://github.com/akselva/Adaptive-mean-flow-RoboticIL.
summary_zh: 扩散与流基机器人策略近年来因高性能及对连续多模态分布的建模能力，在机器人模仿学习（IL）领域得到广泛应用。然而，这类模型所采用的迭代去噪过程引入了显著的预测延迟，阻碍了高频闭环机器人控制，并导致在频繁更新机器人动作预测时产生抖动和不稳定的运动。因此，常见做法是训练模型预测可顺序执行而无须反馈的动作块，即便这会降低响应性，并可能意味着最新的状态信息未被使用。本文提出自适应平均流（AMF），一种基于流的模仿学习方法，可实现平滑、响应迅速且完全闭环的机器人控制。AMF利用平均流——一种加速的流匹配（FM）形式——来最小化预测延迟。为确保预测的平滑性与一致性，AMF在预测新机器人动作时使用前一步骤轨迹的损坏版本，其信噪比随轨迹时间参数的增加而增大。这既抑制了每一步预测间的大幅波动，又保留了调整未来步骤预测的自由度。我们在广泛的仿真与真实机器人任务中评估AMF，并展示了相较于基线方法的显著性能提升。代码地址：https://github.com/akselva/Adaptive-mean-flow-RoboticIL。
tldr: This paper proposes Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF), a flow-based imitation learning method that reduces prediction latency by using an accelerated flow matching procedure and stabilizes closed-loop robot control by conditioning predictions on corrupted previous trajectories. It demonstrates improved performance over baselines on simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出自适应均值流（AMF），一种基于流的模仿学习方法，通过加速流匹配和利用受污染的先前轨迹进行条件生成，降低预测延迟并稳定闭环机器人控制，在仿真和真实机器人任务上优于基线。

title: Do VLAs Understand and Adapt to the Objects They Handle, or Simply Replay Learned Behaviors?
summary: This paper asks whether VLA generalization is grounded in a global understanding of objects' physical properties that enables policies to adapt their motion to unseen setups, or if policies simply replay the motions they've learnt that happen to succeed in new setups. The former reflects genuine generalization; the latter reflects incidental robustness. We first examine awareness of physical properties in seven VLAs by applying linear probing and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to their activations. We find that physical properties, including mass, fragility, deformability, friction and size are less decodable than non-physical properties such as semantic category, material, sound and price in nearly every modality stream. Compared with their base VLMs, robot pre-training weakens the linear encoding of physical properties in the language stream. Neither pre-training nor downstream fine-tuning strengthens the alignment between physical-property differences and activation distances. We then ask whether the weak physical information present in these activations shapes the actions a VLA generates. In a controlled LIBERO case study, we increase the mass of an in-domain object and signal the change through language or vision. Most VLAs use similar lifting behaviour for the heavier and original-mass objects, leading to task success declines. The few exceptions change their behaviour in response to lexical or visual cues rather than to mass itself. These results suggest that VLAs encode physical properties weakly and do not reliably use them to adapt their motion.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型的泛化能力是否基于对物体物理属性的全局理解，从而使其策略能够适应未见过的场景，还是仅仅重放已习得的动作并恰好在新场景中成功。前者反映真正的泛化，后者则体现偶然的稳健性。我们首先通过线性探针和表征相似性分析（RSA）对七个VLA模型的激活进行检测，考察其对物理属性的感知能力。结果发现，在几乎所有的模态流中，质量、易碎性、可变形性、摩擦力和尺寸等物理属性的可解码性均低于语义类别、材质、声音和价格等非物理属性。与其基础VLM相比，机器人预训练削弱了语言流中物理属性的线性编码。无论是预训练还是下游微调，均未增强物理属性差异与激活距离之间的一致性。随后，我们探究这些激活中存在的微弱物理信息是否会影响VLA生成的动作。在受控的LIBERO案例研究中，我们增加了领域内物体的质量，并通过语言或视觉方式传达这一变化。大多数VLA对较重物体与原始质量物体表现出相似的提升行为，导致任务成功率下降。少数例外模型根据词汇或视觉线索改变行为，而非基于质量本身。这些结果表明，VLA对物理属性的编码较弱，且不能可靠地利用这些属性来调整其动作。
tldr: This paper investigates whether VLA models generalize by understanding objects' physical properties or by replaying learned behaviors, finding that physical properties are weakly encoded and rarely used to adapt motion.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨VLA模型是通过理解物体的物理属性来泛化，还是仅仅重放已学行为；发现物理属性编码较弱且很少用于调整动作。

title: Mulligan: Performance-Guided Data Collection for Efficient On-Robot Learning
summary: Learning from human demonstrations is a reliable way to teach robots new tasks, but the gains from each additional demonstration shrink as the policy improves. Continued improvement can instead come from supervised deployment, where an operator places the objects and intervenes when the policy fails. We ask how to maximize improvement from a fixed budget of supervised episodes on high-precision manipulation tasks with wide ranges of object placements. We observe that failures can concentrate in a small subset of initial states, so uniform collection spends much of the operator's time on states the policy already handles. Mulligan makes the initial-state distribution a decision, starting each round's episodes at observed failures and untried states. To further improve data efficiency, we augment interactive imitation learning with a value function trained on all data, including failures that imitation discards. Across three real-world tasks evaluated on 2,550 held-out, blinded episodes and two simulated tasks, Mulligan outperforms uniform initial-state sampling at matched collection budgets, and combined with value-based action selection, HiL-IDQL+Mulligan, improves final real-task success by 10-34 percentage points. With operator interventions, the human-robot team completes 98% of collection episodes, remaining productive while the policy learns. Videos, code, and data are available at https://mulligan.page/.
summary_zh: 从人类演示中学习是教会机器人新任务的一种可靠方式，但随着策略的改进，每增加一次演示所带来的收益会逐渐减少。持续的改进可以转而来自监督式部署，即操作员放置物体并在策略失败时进行干预。我们研究的问题是：在具有广泛物体放置范围的高精度操作任务中，如何在固定的监督回合预算下最大化改进效果。我们观察到，失败可能集中在初始状态的一小部分子集中，因此均匀采集会将操作员的大量时间花费在策略已能处理的狀態上。Mulligan将初始状态分布视为一种决策，每轮从观察到的失败和未尝试的状态开始收集回合。为了进一步提高数据效率，我们将交互式模仿学习与基于所有数据（包括模仿学习所丢弃的失败数据）训练的价值函数相结合。在三个真实世界任务（在2,550个保留的、盲测回合上评估）和两个模拟任务中，Mulligan在匹配采集预算下优于均匀初始状态采样，并且结合基于价值的动作选择后，HiL-IDQL+Mulligan在最终真实任务成功率上提升了10到34个百分点。在操作员干预下，人机团队完成了98%的采集回合，在策略学习期间保持高效运作。视频、代码和数据可在 https://mulligan.page/ 获取。
tldr: Mulligan improves on-robot learning from a fixed budget of supervised episodes by biasing initial states toward observed failures and untried states, and by adding a value function trained on all data including failures; it outperforms uniform collection on real and simulated manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Mulligan通过在固定监督预算下将初始状态偏向已观察到的失败和未尝试的状态，并利用包括失败在内的所有数据训练价值函数，提高了机器人学习效率；在真实和模拟操作任务上优于均匀采集方法。

title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
summary: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.
summary_zh: 基准测试将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略暴露于少量规范指令之下，而全面的部署测试是不可能实现的。我们引入了物体锚定注意力监控（OGAM），将系统性测试与运行时保障相连接：测试揭示了成功执行与失败执行之间的注意力分歧，而OGAM利用这一信号在超出有限测试集的情况下阻止失败发生。我们通过动作模板与物体的两两组合生成场景锚定指令，并分别测试保留语义的改述版本。在基准测试之外的87个案例中，全部暴露了OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和$π_{0.5}$中的问题行为：这些模型均未完成24条可行指令中的任何一条，而不可行或危险的请求同样触发了行为替代。在每次动作查询时，我们通过物体掩码投影梯度加权视觉注意力，并按指令角色对其进行分组，以跨任务和策略进行比较。动态时间规整将该过程与成功参考轨迹对齐，尽管存在速度差异；基于成功片段的一致性校准设定了持续偏差的早停阈值，标称误停目标为$α=0.05$。在四种策略中，OGAM在20秒的时间预算内，以5-12秒的中位时间阻止了87-100%的失败片段，观测到的误停率为3-5%，且无需使用失败标注训练。因此，有限测试所识别的注意力模式能够在失败完全展开之前支持在线干预。
tldr: OGAM connects systematic testing to runtime assurance for VLA policies by identifying attention divergence between successful and failed executions, then uses object-grounded attention monitoring with conformal calibration to early-stop failures in real time across multiple VLA models.
tldr_zh: OGAM 将系统测试与运行时保障联系起来，通过识别成功与失败执行之间的注意力差异，并利用基于对象的注意力监控和共形校准，在多个 VLA 模型上实时提前阻止失败。

title: Transporting Unsecured Stacked Payloads with a Quadrupedal Robot via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: Transporting unsecured payloads with legged robots over uneven terrain requires balancing locomotion performance and payload stability, since aggressive motion can destabilize the payload even when the robot remains stable. We study quadrupedal transportation of unsecured stacked boxes on an edgeless torso-mounted board without dedicated payload sensors or active carrier mechanisms. To address this trade-off, we propose Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation (PAMORT). PAMORT trains a multi-objective base policy conditioned on a preference vector that weights locomotion and payload-stability reward groups, then trains a weight adjuster on the frozen policy to adapt this preference online from proprioception. In simulation, PAMORT achieves comparable or better overall transportation success than a corresponding single-objective baseline across different payload configurations, including an unseen three-box stack, despite training only with two boxes. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate zero-shot transfer to slopes and steps at or beyond the training difficulty, with mean success rates of 0.850 for PAMORT and 0.675 for the baseline across eight tasks. These results demonstrate robust unsecured-payload transportation with online adaptation of the locomotion--payload trade-off from proprioceptive information.
summary_zh: 运输无固定载荷的腿式机器人穿越崎岖地形时，需要在运动性能与载荷稳定性之间取得平衡，因为即使机器人自身保持稳定，过于剧烈的运动也可能导致载荷失稳。我们研究了在无专用载荷传感器或主动承载机构的情况下，四足机器人通过躯干上方无边缘平板运输无固定堆叠箱体的问题。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了载荷自适应多目标强化学习运输方法（PAMORT）。PAMORT训练一个以偏好向量为条件的多目标基础策略，该向量加权运动与载荷稳定性两组奖励，随后在冻结策略上训练一个权重调节器，通过本体感觉在线调整该偏好。在仿真中，尽管仅使用两个箱体进行训练，PAMORT在不同载荷配置（包括未见过的三箱堆叠）下，其整体运输成功率均达到或优于对应的单目标基线。在Unitree Go2上的现实实验中，零样本迁移至训练难度相当或更高的斜坡与台阶场景，八项任务中PAMORT的平均成功率为0.850，基线为0.675。这些结果表明，利用本体感觉信息在线调整运动-载荷权衡，能够实现稳健的无固定载荷运输。
tldr: This paper introduces PAMORT, a multi-objective reinforcement learning approach for quadrupedal robots to transport unsecured stacked payloads, balancing locomotion and payload stability via a preference vector adapted online from proprioception. It demonstrates zero-shot transfer from simulation to a real Unitree Go2 on slopes and steps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PAMORT，一种多目标强化学习方法，使四足机器人能够在不固定堆叠载荷的情况下运输，通过从本体感觉在线调整偏好向量来平衡运动与负载稳定性，并在真实Unitree Go2上实现了零样本迁移。

title: What the Guard Misses, the Robot Executes: Implied Harm in VLA Instructions
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) act on instructions without being able to refuse, so screening harmful requests falls to monitors. We test whether these monitors catch ordinary robot tasks requested for harmful reasons, holding the task fixed while varying only how explicitly the intent is stated. $π_{0.5}$ completes the task at every level of explicitness, as often as for harmless controls. Text guards flag nearly every blunt request but few implied ones: up to 95% of implied-harm runs end with the task done and no flag raised, and up to 90% even after recalibrating on robot instructions. Monitoring the model's activations does not close this gap. Linear probes separate harmful from harmless instructions almost perfectly in the base language and vision-language models, but this separation weakens after robot training in two model families, most for implied harm.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）能够执行指令，却无法拒绝指令，因此对有害请求的筛查责任落在了监控系统上。我们测试这些监控系统能否识别因有害目的而提出的普通机器人任务——在保持任务不变的情况下，仅改变意图陈述的明确程度。无论意图表述多么含蓄，π₀.₅ 都能完成该任务，其完成率与无害对照任务持平。文本守卫能拦截几乎所有直白的请求，却对隐含性请求几乎毫无察觉：多达95%的隐含有害任务运行以任务完成且无警报告终，即便在针对机器人指令重新校准后，这一比例仍高达90%。监控模型内部激活状态也无法弥补这一差距。线性探针在基础语言模型和视觉-语言模型上几乎能完美区分有害与无害指令，但在两个模型系列中，这一区分能力在机器人训练后有所减弱，其中对隐含有害指令的区分下降最为明显。
tldr: This paper evaluates whether safety monitors catch harmful robot instructions when the physical task is benign but the intent is harmful, finding that implied harm largely bypasses guards and activation-based monitors while remaining detectable in base models before robot training.
tldr_zh: 本文评估安全监视器能否捕捉意图有害但任务本身无害的机器人指令，发现隐含危害大多能绕过文本与激活监视器，而在机器人训练前的基座模型中仍可被线性探针区分。

title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
summary: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.
summary_zh: 训练后量化已被证明在标准评估条件下能保持VLA性能，但其是否能保持全精度模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们系统性地研究了后量化VLA策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。实验结果表明，尽管量化策略在分布内性能上保持相当水平，但其可能对环境中的细微变化变得脆弱。我们进一步观察到，动作偏差集中在少量回滚状态中，而教师指导根据偏差程度产生相反效果：在高偏差状态下，它能提升泛化能力；在低偏差状态下，反而可能降低泛化能力。这些发现表明，有效的后量化恢复需要对脆弱状态进行选择性干预，而非对学生模型进行全局蒸馏。为此，我们提出了策略诱导脆弱性导向微调（PIVOT-Q），这是一种面向脆弱性感知的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架，利用冻结的全精度策略作为教师，对量化学生策略回滚过程中遇到的脆弱状态进行选择性修正。PIVOT-Q通过短时间窗口内的折扣累积偏差识别脆弱状态，采用相位平衡的稀疏监督，并使用行为锚点防止不必要的改变。在七种LIBERO-Plus环境变化下的实验表明，该方法在多种VLA主干网络和量化方法上均能实现一致的恢复效果。值得注意的是，PIVOT-Q在所有设置下均持续优于全状态蒸馏，且仅使用其状态级蒸馏预算的7.4%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q获取。
tldr: This paper investigates the robustness and generalization of post-training quantized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models under environmental disturbances, revealing that quantized policies become fragile at specific 'vulnerable' states. It introduces PIVOT-Q, a vulnerability-aware on-policy distillation framework that selectively corrects these states using the full-precision teacher, achieving superior generalization recovery with only 7.4% of the distillation budget compared to full-state distillation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了后训练量化VLA模型在环境扰动下的鲁棒性和泛化性，发现量化策略在特定'脆弱'状态下变得脆弱。提出了PIVOT-Q，一种基于漏洞感知的在线蒸馏框架，仅使用全精度教师选择性纠正这些状态，以7.4%的蒸馏预算实现了优于全状态蒸馏的泛化恢复。

title: FreeSpeed: Training-Free Speed Control for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Online control of execution speed is essential for deploying robot policies in real-world scenarios, as robots may need to speed up under time constraints or slow down to facilitate human interaction and improve safety. However, imitation-learned policies inherit the execution speed of their demonstrations, and test-time speed modification can introduce unrecoverable out-of-distribution observations, reducing task success. We observe that the directional inconsistency of action chunks reflects task-phase criticality, indicating how aggressively action step lengths can be modified while preserving task success. Based on this observation, we introduce FreeSpeed, a training-free module that post-processes action chunks from pretrained policies. FreeSpeed resamples each predicted chunk at the requested rate, then uses directional inconsistency between adjacent actions as the primary signal for rescaling. This signal adaptively determines how closely the execution speed can approach the requested speed, allowing flexible speed adjustment within the evaluated limits without compromising task success. Across three policy families and 50 simulated tasks, FreeSpeed supports online speed changes, with realized execution rates spanning 0.22x to 2.53x among settings that preserve per-task success. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, FreeSpeed achieves an average success rate of 94.0%, matching the frozen policy's 93.8%, while realizing execution rates from 0.38x to 1.97x.
summary_zh: 在线控制执行速度对于在现实场景中部署机器人策略至关重要，因为机器人可能需要在时间限制下加速，或减速以促进人机交互并提升安全性。然而，模仿学习策略继承了其示范数据的执行速度，测试时的速度修改可能引入无法恢复的分布外观测，从而降低任务成功率。我们观察到，动作块的方向不一致性反映了任务阶段的紧要程度，指示了在保持任务成功的前提下，动作步长可被修改的激进程度。基于这一观察，我们提出了FreeSpeed，一种无需训练的模块，用于对预训练策略生成的动作块进行后处理。FreeSpeed以请求速率对每个预测的动作块进行重采样，然后利用相邻动作之间的方向不一致性作为重新缩放的主要信号。该信号自适应地决定执行速度能够多接近请求速度，使得在评估限度内灵活调整速度而不牺牲任务成功率。在三个策略家族和50个模拟任务中，FreeSpeed支持在线速度变化，在保持各任务成功率的设置中，实现的实际执行速率范围为0.22倍至2.53倍。在四个真实世界操作任务中，FreeSpeed实现了94.0%的平均成功率，与冻结策略的93.8%相匹配，同时实现的实际执行速率范围为0.38倍至1.97倍。
tldr: FreeSpeed is a training-free module that adjusts the execution speed of pretrained robot policies by resampling action chunks and using directional inconsistency to rescale step lengths, achieving flexible speed control across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks without compromising success.
tldr_zh: FreeSpeed是一种无需训练模块，通过重采样动作块并利用方向不一致性来重新缩放步长，从而调整预训练机器人策略的执行速度，在模拟和真实操作任务中实现灵活调速而不影响成功率。

title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.
summary_zh: 全身跟踪已成为操作员驱动机器人的人形机器人的接口，然而其消耗的参考轨迹是在平坦地面上且未携带任何负载的情况下记录的，因此跟踪器既不知道机器人必须与物体交换的力，也不知道其必须站立的地形。现有控制器仅解决了这一差距的一个方面：具备力控制能力的策略命令末端执行器施加特定力，但未规定全身姿态；而地形自适应跟踪器则将负载视为需要抑制的干扰，而非需要指令的力旋量。我们提出了BRACE，一种全身跟踪器，能够在斜坡地形上跟随平面参考轨迹的同时，从多种姿态施加并补偿指令手部力。BRACE并未让跟踪器自行吸收负载和坡度的影响，而是将两者纳入其跟随的参考轨迹中：地形贴合将立足点和根部抬升至局部表面，力旋量变换则解算出手部位移，该位移与引起的质心和压力中心偏移共同产生力，并以教师特定的手臂出力极限为约束。独立的施力与补偿教师通过DAgger算法被蒸馏为一个仅依赖本体感觉的流匹配学生模型，无需高度图或实测力旋量，因此遥操作员（即使在远程位置）可以提供平面轨迹，机器人则自行在机载解决坡度和负载问题。我们在Unitree-G1上进行了大量实验，以证明BRACE在仿真和真实机器人实验中施加力、补偿力以及应对多样地形的能力。
tldr: BRACE is a whole-body tracking controller for humanoid robots that adapts flat-ground, no-load reference motions to sloped terrain and commanded hand forces by transforming the reference motion, and distills force-exertion and compensation behaviors into a proprioception-only policy via DAgger.
tldr_zh: BRACE 是一种人形机器人全身跟踪控制器，通过变换参考运动，将平地、无负载的参考动作适应到斜坡地形和指令手部力，并通过 DAgger 将施力和补偿行为蒸馏为仅基于本体感觉的策略。

title: Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture
summary: Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface. Project website: https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/
summary_zh: 大多数现有的人形机器人移动操控控制器依赖于人体运动数据来学习全身协调与姿态，从而使策略依赖外部数据源提供这些信息。我们提出OCLO（在线姿态顺应性移动操控），一种无需人体运动数据、仅通过两个末端执行器目标即可指令控制的人形机器人移动操控系统。由于这些目标无法唯一确定全身姿态，OCLO利用解析可达性先验在线生成骨盆高度和躯干姿态，并通过基于策略的回环采样与任务无关代价进一步优化。OCLO还通过学习全身顺应性，依据弹簧-阻尼模型根据实测力位移末端执行器参考，促使腿部、腰部和骨盆在外部载荷下顺应屈服。在仿真中，使用可达性先验使命令参考获取的成功率达到77.8%，远优于无先验时的37.8%。此外，优化过程在所有评估任务中均降低了末端执行器方向误差。相同的姿态模块在五项任务中的四项上提升了预训练的SONIC控制器性能。未经顺应性训练的策略在面对扰动时倾向于失去平衡，而非牺牲跟踪精度。在Unitree G1上，OCLO在导致其消融变体失败的末端执行器扰动下保持平衡，并执行了七项移动操控任务，包括蹲姿行走和从低矮表面拾取箱子。项目网站：https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/
tldr: OCLO presents a dataset-free humanoid loco-manipulation controller that uses online posture generation and compliance training to achieve diverse tasks on a Unitree G1, improving success rates and balance under disturbances.
tldr_zh: OCLO 提出了一种无需人类运动数据的人形机器人全身操控控制器，通过在线姿态生成和柔顺训练，在 Unitree G1 上实现了多样任务，并在扰动下保持平衡。

title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.
summary_zh: 密集的可供性监督是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中一种有吸引力的辅助信号，然而，简单地对可供性预测头进行联合训练可能会严重损害指令跟随能力。我们在LIBERO基准上对如何将这种预测头接入现代VLA进行了受控研究。我们的方案通过停止梯度读取主干网络，并通过学习得到的桥接模块将中间层预测头特征重新注入动作专家网络。停止梯度是一个前提条件：若允许可供性梯度传播至主干网络，策略性能将降至无预测头基线之下（85.5%对93.1%）。在保护主干网络的前提下，针对注入拓扑结构（拼接对残差）和桥接初始化方式（零初始化对随机初始化）进行了同等预算的2×2消融实验，结果表明初始化方式是主导因素。最优布线方案采用主动初始化的残差桥接，达到了96.2%的性能，与构造复杂得多的三专家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）相当，而额外参数不足1%。两项探针实验解释了其内在机制：将真实可供性作为输入会损害性能；推理时置零实验表明，惰性桥接仅充当训练时的正则化器，而主动桥接则成为承载性能的关键组件。
tldr: This paper studies how to wire affordance heads into VLA policies, finding that a stop-gradient and actively-initialized residual bridge matches a more elaborate three-expert model on LIBERO with minimal parameter overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文研究如何将affordance头接入VLA策略，发现使用停止梯度和主动初始化的残差桥接可在LIBERO上以极少参数开销媲美更复杂的三专家模型。

title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
summary: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.
