summary_zh: 我们提出FoldBack，一种面向长时程衣物折叠任务的自校正掩码生成策略。现有的长轨迹策略可能在抓取遗漏或滑落之后仍然继续执行，即使衣物尚未达到预期构型。我们将FoldBack的恢复机制构建在三个推理时决策之上：何时进行细化与验证，如何回退，以及在何处并如何重试。FoldBack将细化操作与抓取验证对齐到拾放事件上，在保留成功抓取的同时，将机器人恢复到可重试的预抓取构型，并有选择性地重新生成失败片段及选定的未来动作，同时避开先前失败的抓取位置。据我们所知，FoldBack是首个将上述决策统一起来的可编辑全轨迹策略，使得失败交互能够在执行继续之前被检测、撤销并修复，而无需恢复示范或对基础策略进行重新训练。在来自六个类别的33件真实衣物上，FoldBack实现了75.2%的最终折叠成功率和0.837的最终掩码IoU，而最强先前基线的对应指标分别为45.7%和0.689。
tldr: FoldBack introduces a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding that detects, undoes, and repairs failed interactions at inference time without retraining, achieving significant improvements over prior baselines on real garments.
tldr_zh: FoldBack提出了一种自校正掩码生成策略，用于长时程衣物折叠任务，无需重新训练即可在推理时检测、撤销和修复失败操作，在真实衣物上显著优于先前基线。

title: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
summary: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.
summary_zh: 基于流策略为连续机器人控制提供了一种表达力强的框架，但其迭代式常微分方程积分带来了显著的推理成本。简单地减少积分预算会严重降低控制性能，因为在完整步长执行下优化的策略，并未被明确约束为在粗粒度数值积分下依然保持可靠。我们将这种不匹配称为少步离散化间隙。为解决这一问题，我们引入了RFPO，一种面向可靠少步执行的流策略优化框架。奖励感知的在线Reflow在策略学习过程中修正由学生模型诱导的传输路径，使所得策略对粗粒度积分更具鲁棒性。一个冻结的高斯PPO控制器在完整和中间积分预算下提供补充的动作空间监督，而部署的策略仍为通过单步欧拉法执行的学生流模型。在Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot、Unitree H1和Unitree G1上，RFPO在单步执行下持续保持完整的控制性能，在零初始化和随机初始化两种情况下，单步回报与相应的64步值的偏差保持在2.4%以内。在Unitree Go2上，单步执行保留了64步奖励的98.5%，同时将机载平均推理延迟从4.39毫秒降至0.08毫秒，实现了54.9倍的加速。真实机器人实验进一步验证了稳定的单步运动。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO。
tldr: RFPO introduces a reward-aware online Reflow and frozen Gaussian PPO supervision to make flow-based robot policies robust to one-step Euler execution, preserving full-step control performance across multiple legged robots and a real Unitree Go2.
tldr_zh: RFPO通过奖励感知的在线Reflow和固定的高斯PPO监督，使基于流的机器人策略对单步Euler执行稳健，在多种腿式机器人和真实宇树Go2上保持了全步控制性能。

title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
summary: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.
summary_zh: 摘要：流策略可捕获丰富多样的动作分布，而通过离线强化学习对其进行微调以超越示范性能，已引起越来越多的关注。然而，针对学习到的价值函数对流策略进行微调并非易事，因为该策略会通过多个流步骤生成其动作。伴随匹配提供了一种原则性的方法，通过将最终动作的价值信息传播回每个流步骤来更新流模型本身，但该方法需要在每一步计算策略的向量-雅可比乘积，其成本随流步骤数和策略规模的增长而增加。我们观察到，预训练流策略的批量平均速度雅可比矩阵集中在其对角线上。基于这一发现，我们推导出一种闭式标量伴随项，将最终动作处的价值梯度按流时间缩放，从而消除了逐步骤的向量-雅可比乘积。我们进一步发现，在标量伴随项下，对策略生成动作处的评论家价值进行控制尤为重要。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种带标量伴随匹配的Q学习方法（SQAM），该方法将标量伴随项与这些动作处的价值惩罚相结合。SQAM的增益集中在最具挑战性的四个OGBench领域中，其在每个领域的成功率超过该领域最强基线18至35个百分点。为测试SQAM是否可扩展至大规模预训练策略，我们还在真实双臂机器人上对视觉-语言-动作策略进行了微调。在所有三个任务上，SQAM均优于监督微调方法。
tldr: This paper proposes SQAM, a method for fine-tuning flow-based policies with off-policy RL using a closed-form scalar adjoint and a value penalty, demonstrating improvements on OGBench benchmarks and a real bimanual robot with a VLA policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SQAM方法，利用闭式标量伴随和值惩罚对基于流的策略进行离策略RL微调，在OGBench基准和真实双臂机器人VLA策略上取得了改进。

title: AirGroundVLN: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Goal-oriented Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to locate and reach targets described in natural language without prescribed routes. Air--ground collaboration is valuable for tasks requiring both wide-area search and fine-grained localization. However, systematic study of goal-oriented air--ground collaborative VLN remains limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse benchmarks and two core challenges: 1) substantial differences between aerial and ground views, together with useful observations becoming unavailable as navigation proceeds, make it difficult to maintain spatially consistent context across platforms and over time; and 2) asymmetric spatial observability makes ground perception locally detailed but spatially limited and aerial perception broad but locally coarse, limiting the reliability of single-platform planning. To address these limitations, we introduce AirGroundVLN, a benchmark containing 10,281 navigation episodes and 955 target instances across 19 Unreal Engine environments, with seen/unseen splits and an aerial-visibility protocol for systematic evaluation. Alongside the benchmark, we propose AG-CoNAV, a trainable reference framework comprising two key components: Spatiotemporally Anchored Collaborative Memory (SACM) and Aerial-Guided Regional-to-Local Planning (AGRLP). SACM maintains and retrieves spatially consistent historical context across aerial and ground observations. Meanwhile, AGRLP combines regional aerial guidance with fine-grained ground navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AG-CoNAV and establish AirGroundVLN as a comprehensive benchmark for future exploration.
summary_zh: 面向目标的视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在没有预设路线的情况下，根据自然语言描述定位并到达目标位置。对于需要广域搜索与细粒度定位相结合的任务，空—地协同具有重要价值。然而，受限于缺乏大规模、多样化的基准数据集，以及两大核心挑战，面向目标的空—地协同VLN系统研究仍十分有限：1）空中视角与地面视角之间存在显著差异，且随着导航推进，部分有效观测信息会逐渐不可用，这使得跨平台、跨时间维持空间一致的上下文变得困难；2）空间可观测性的不对称性导致地面感知局部精细但空间范围有限，空中感知覆盖广泛但局部粗糙，从而限制了单一平台规划的可靠性。为应对上述问题，我们提出了AirGroundVLN基准数据集，包含19个虚幻引擎环境中的10,281个导航片段和955个目标实例，并提供了已见/未见场景划分以及空中可见性协议，以支持系统化评估。在基准数据集之外，我们还提出了AG-CoNAV，一个可训练参考框架，包含两个关键组件：时空锚定协同记忆（SACM）和空中引导的区域到局部规划（AGRLP）。SACM负责在空—地观测之间维护并检索空间一致的历史上下文，而AGRLP则将区域级空中引导与细粒度地面导航相结合。大量实验验证了AG-CoNAV的有效性，并确立了AirGroundVLN作为未来探索的综合基准。
tldr: This paper introduces AirGroundVLN, a large-scale benchmark for goal-oriented air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation, along with a reference framework AG-CoNAV that addresses cross-platform spatial consistency and asymmetric observability through collaborative memory and aerial-guided planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AirGroundVLN，一个大规模空地协同视觉语言导航基准，并提出了AG-CoNAV参考框架，通过协同记忆与空中引导规划解决跨平台空间一致性与非对称观测问题。

title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.
summary_zh: 近期在多模态基础模型方面的进展，使其能够成为处理多种操作任务的通用物理智能体。然而，在陌生环境中成功运作可能要求智能体在观察中缺失任务相关信息时，通过交互主动寻求该信息：它可能需要确定相关物体的位置、检查未被观察到的属性，或发现不熟悉工具的效果。因此，我们引入了RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向的具身探索的基准测试，其中智能体必须通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息，利用所得证据调整后续行动，并自主决定何时完成任务的承诺。RoboQuest包含十项移动操作任务，围绕三种不确定性形式：搜索、基于操作的检查以及交互测试。我们通过一个共同的视觉运动接口评估了五个前沿多模态智能体，以及一个在我们发布的完整演示数据集上微调的\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略。表现最佳的智能体仅在23%的轮次中成功，而微调策略几乎从未成功。对构成这些任务的执行技能的孤立测试（提供隐藏信息）显示，智能体能够执行大部分所需动作，我们的失败分析将少数失败归因于执行环节。进一步的分析发现，智能体常常过早停止探索，因为它们在观察到完成任务的必要证据之前就做出了决策。我们还发现，智能体很少防止或修复其探索过程中造成的干扰。此外，通过试错进行学习对大多数模型而言仍然困难重重。
tldr: RoboQuest is a benchmark for embodied exploration where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction in mobile manipulation tasks, revealing that frontier multimodal agents and fine-tuned policies struggle, with failures mainly due to premature stopping and insufficient exploration.
tldr_zh: RoboQuest 是一个具身探索基准，要求智能体通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息，评估显示前沿多模态智能体和微调策略表现不佳，失败主要源于过早停止探索。

title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
summary: Tactile feedback provides embodied agents with physical information beyond visual observations, enabling more reliable interaction with the real world. However, despite the rapid progress of vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) policies, there remains a lack of unified benchmarks for evaluating tactile-enabled robot manipulation across simulation and the real world. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViTac, a visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark for evaluating robot policies across simulation and the real world. OpenViTac organizes contact-rich manipulation into four tactile-relevant capability dimensions and provides paired simulation-real-world settings for consistent evaluation of VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies. Building upon this benchmark, we investigate how different tactile representations and integration strategies affect the performance of pretrained VLA models. Correspondingly, we introduce OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that combines the best-performing representation and integration strategy. Furthermore, we leverage the paired benchmark setting to study sim-real co-training and analyze factors affecting cross-domain policy learning. Together, OpenViTac provides a unified platform for evaluating and advancing visuo-tactile robot manipulation.
summary_zh: 触觉反馈为具身智能体提供了超越视觉观测的物理信息，使其能够更可靠地与真实世界进行交互。然而，尽管视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略取得了快速发展，目前仍缺乏统一的基准来评估跨仿真和真实世界的触觉增强机器人操作。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OpenViTac——一个用于在仿真和真实世界中评估机器人策略的视觉-触觉操作基准。OpenViTac将接触密集操作归纳为四个与触觉相关的能力维度，并提供仿真-真实世界配对设置，以一致地评估VLA、WAM和VTLA策略。基于该基准，我们研究了不同触觉表示和集成策略如何影响预训练VLA模型的性能。相应地，我们提出了OpenVTLA，一个结合了最优表示和集成策略的触觉增强框架。此外，我们利用配对基准设置研究仿真-真实协同训练，并分析影响跨域策略学习的因素。OpenViTac共同为评估和推进视觉-触觉机器人操作提供了一个统一平台。
tldr: OpenViTac introduces a unified sim-and-real benchmark for visuo-tactile manipulation, organizing contact-rich tasks into four capability dimensions to evaluate VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies, and proposes OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that improves pretrained VLA models with the best tactile representation and integration strategy.
tldr_zh: OpenViTac 提出了一个统一的仿真与真实世界视觉-触觉操作基准，将接触丰富的任务组织为四个能力维度，用于评估 VLA、WAM 和 VTLA 策略，并提出了 OpenVTLA，一种通过最佳触觉表示和集成策略增强预训练 VLA 模型的触觉增强框架。

title: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
summary: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.
summary_zh: 虽然能效是腿式机器人运动控制的关键目标，但在不同速度范围和地形条件下，实现低能耗同时保持稳健性能仍然是一项核心挑战。这一问题对于端到端强化学习策略尤为突出，因为步态生成、运动执行和能量优化紧密耦合，导致对奖励设计高度敏感。在本研究中，我们提出了一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架，将用于稳定且稳健的关节级运动执行的高频策略，与显式最小化运输成本（CoT）的低频步态适应相分离。基于Isaac的三阶段训练流程实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移，提升了跟踪精度、鲁棒性和能效。学习到的分层结构展现出随速度自动调整的步态适应能力，从低速时的踱步步态过渡到高速时的小跑步态。我们在仿真中将所提方法与具有代表性的单策略及分层运动基线进行对比验证，结果表明在广泛指令速度范围内运输成本显著降低，同时在地面平坦、崎岖不平及倾斜地形上均保持稳健运动。此外，我们通过在实体Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上的零样本部署，进一步验证了该方法的实际可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for quadrupedal locomotion that separates high-frequency joint control from low-frequency gait adaptation to minimize energy consumption, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree AlienGo robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人运动的分层强化学习框架，将高频关节控制与低频步态适应分离以最小化能量消耗，并在 Unitree AlienGo 机器人上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
summary: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.
summary_zh: 人类几乎可以凭借指尖触觉反馈，以近乎完美的成功率抓取日常物品，然而大量机器人抓取文献却侧重于基于视觉的平行夹爪抓取选择。在本研究中，我们系统地探讨了高分辨率、动态触觉感知如何促进灵巧机器人手的抓取稳定性预测及模型引导抓取。为此，我们使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指机器人手，在200个物体上收集了10,000次抓取试验的数据集，并在每次抓取过程中记录外部视觉、本体感觉及触觉流数据。基于该数据集，我们训练了端到端的时序多模态模型，以从抓取前观测中预测提升后的稳定性，并比较了不同感知模态与编码骨干网络。实验结果及受控输入消融研究表明，融合触觉信息，尤其是高分辨率动态触觉信息，能够提升抓取稳定性预测。最后，我们将所学习的预测器作为在线稳定性门控部署于真实机器人上，相较于无触觉门控，视觉-触觉模型引导的重新抓取将执行提升的成功率提高了10.5个百分点。这些结果展示了丰富的指尖感知及捕捉触觉动态的具表达力时序模型，如何在不依赖显式接触或力建模的情况下支持多指手的习得性抓取，为从触觉经验迈向稳定灵巧操作提供了一条可扩展的数据驱动路径。该数据集公开获取于 https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/。
tldr: This paper investigates how high-resolution dynamic tactile sensing improves grasp stability prediction for dexterous robotic hands, introducing a 10,000-trial visuo-tactile dataset and a temporal multimodal model that boosts real-robot regrasping success by 10.5 percentage points.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了高分辨率动态触觉感知如何提高灵巧手抓取稳定性预测，并引入了包含10,000次抓取试验的视觉-触觉数据集和时序多模态模型，在真实机器人重抓取中提升了10.5个百分点的成功率。

title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型旨在跨环境和任务描述进行泛化，这引出了一个关键问题：其动作生成究竟是否真正依赖于语言指令，还是在很大程度上依赖视觉线索和表面相关性。对于现实世界的部署而言，对视觉和语言观测空间中的变化保持鲁棒性至关重要，然而VLA模型缺乏显式的接地模块，而是依赖其视觉-语言模型骨干网络固有的语言接地能力。为此，我们针对两个最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型——π₀.5和GR00T N1.7，开展了一项受控的机制可解释性研究，通过将激活修补（activation patching）和归因修补（attribution patching）应用于动作生成模块的残差流，考察其语言接地能力。我们按照五种策略系统性地破坏LIBERO基准测试中样本的任务指令：同义词替换、语义缩放、方向性破坏、随机物体替换以及空字符串。实验发现，两个模型对抽象改写和引用不存在物体的操作相对不敏感，但对空任务描述，尤其是方向性语言，反应强烈。在动作生成过程中，这种敏感性在两个模型中集中在不同的位点：GR00T N1.7主要集中于早期的周期性交叉注意力层，而π₀.5则分布在最早层和选定的较后层。对于GR00T N1.7，方向性扰动产生了某些最大的因果效应，同时内部表征几何结构相对保持不变，而这种分离现象在π₀.5中并未明显观察到。最后，归因修补的可靠性依赖于具体模型：它与GR00T N1.7的激活修补结果高度吻合，但π₀.5则不吻合。
tldr: This paper investigates the language grounding capabilities of two VLA models (π0.5 and GR00T N1.7) using mechanistic interpretability methods, finding that both are insensitive to abstract rephrasing but sensitive to directional language, with varying causal loci and attribution reliability.
tldr_zh: 本文通过机械可解释性方法研究了两个VLA模型（π0.5和GR00T N1.7）的语言接地能力，发现两者对抽象改写不敏感，但对方向性语言敏感，且因果定位和归因可靠性因模型而异。

title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成相结合，但其高推理延迟限制了机器人的实时控制能力。近期研究通过省去测试阶段的显式未来视频生成来加速推理，如FastWAM，该方法需要专门定制的架构设计。更通用的缓存策略利用特征冗余，但仅靠冗余无法捕捉闭环控制中不断变化的计算需求。为解决这些挑战，我们提出RealtimeWAM，一种通用的、无需训练的框架，将并行执行与自适应计算相协调，在多种WAM架构上实现低延迟推理。我们利用层间依赖关系将观测处理与预测重叠进行。然而，并行分支仍会竞争GPU资源，限制并行执行的收益。因此，我们通过选择性复用在整个流程中自适应调整计算量，在视觉稳定区域缓存观测特征，复用Transformer残差，同时为小幅预测调整保留额外的细化计算。我们在FastWAM和OpenWAM上，基于RoboTwin、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus数据集对RealtimeWAM进行评估。在RTX 4090上，测得的平均推理延迟分别为24.09毫秒和63.09毫秒，对应平均加速比为8.90倍和10.67倍。平均成功率分别为82.75%和87.41%，与原生推理相差仅0.02和0.53个百分点。在五项真实世界任务中，与原生推理相比，RealtimeWAM在FastWAM和OpenWAM上的平均成功率分别提升了17.2和37.2个百分点。
tldr: RealtimeWAM is a training-free framework that reduces inference latency in World Action Models by overlapping observation processing and prediction through layerwise dependencies and adaptive computation via selective feature reuse, achieving significant speedups on FastWAM and OpenWAM while maintaining or improving task success rates in simulation and real-world robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: RealtimeWAM 是一个无需训练的框架，通过层间依赖重叠观测处理与预测，并利用选择性特征重用的自适应计算来降低世界动作模型的推理延迟，在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上实现了显著加速，同时在仿真和真实机器人操作中保持或提高了任务成功率。

title: Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/
summary_zh: 离线强化学习使得从固定数据集中进行奖励驱动的策略改进成为可能，且无需在线探索，这使其在安全关键领域尤为具有吸引力。然而，一个核心挑战在于分布偏移：策略优化可能倾向于选择在离线数据中支持度较弱的动作，从而导致价值估计不可靠。现有方法主要在该策略自身的动作空间内控制这种偏移。在诸如自动驾驶等交互式环境中，这种做法可能并不充分：候选自车轨迹在边际行为分布下可能具有良好的支持度，但在与日志数据中记录的环境智能体行为联合考量时，其联合支持度却可能较低。我们将这种交互支持度的退化称为\emph{交互分布偏移}（IDS），并引入\emph{交互约束驾驶策略}（ICDP）——一种显式控制交互级分布偏移的离线强化学习框架。从自车与环境智能体未来轨迹的联合数据分布出发，我们证明联合支持度的退化可精确分解为自车支持度分量和残差交互支持度分量。我们通过对比密度比估计恢复后者，从而在策略优化过程中无需显式联合密度建模、环境智能体预测，也无需在反应式模拟器或学习的世界模型中进行 rollout，即可隔离交互兼容性。在nuPlan、Interplan上的闭环评估以及真实卡车实验中，ICDP抑制了高价值但缺乏交互支持的轨迹选择，并在交互关键驾驶场景中提升了性能。项目网页：https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/
tldr: This paper proposes ICDP, an offline reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving that explicitly constrains interaction-level distribution shift by decomposing joint-support degradation into ego-support and interaction-support components, using contrastive density-ratio estimation. It demonstrates improved performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios in closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan, and real-world truck experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ICDP，一种用于自动驾驶的离线强化学习框架，通过对比密度比估计将联合支持退化分解为自我支持分量和交互支持分量，显式约束交互级分布偏移，并在nuPlan、Interplan和真实卡车实验中展示了在交互关键驾驶场景中的性能提升。

title: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过用密集的未来预测增强稀疏的动作监督来改进机器人策略。然而，可预测的未来很大程度上由外观和场景持续性主导，而非依赖于动作的动态变化。我们观察到，近期几种WAM设计，包括光流、以运动为中心的表征和潜在动作，可以从一个共同视角来理解，即当世界监督中包含更高比例的动作相关变化时，其效率会更高。基于这一见解，我们引入了动作切向量场（Action Tangent Fields），通过动作如何引发未来动态变化的局部泰勒展开来重新构建世界监督。我们在残差变分自编码器（Residual-VAE）空间中表示未来动态，其中未来潜在表示可从当前潜在表示及其残差中恢复，并使用强动作条件世界模型（ACWM）来探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的局部对应关系。这种局部一阶结构被蒸馏到WAM中，引导其去噪监督朝向与动作更紧密耦合的动态，而非仅可从外观预测的内容。在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin和RoboTwin2.0-Plus上，我们的方法持续提升了对光照、背景、相机、布局及其他环境扰动的鲁棒性。尽管未使用大规模具身预训练，在多种分布偏移下，它仍比预训练策略实现了更强的鲁棒性。我们进一步将多步VideoDiT去噪蒸馏为单步，以实现高效推理。我们的结果表明，有效的WAM监督应保持信息丰富，同时将其预测能力集中在动作改变未来的方向上。
tldr: The paper introduces Action Tangent Fields, a method to distill action-conditioned world model supervision into World Action Models by focusing on action-relevant dynamics, improving robustness to environmental perturbations without large-scale pretraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了动作切向场，通过将动作条件世界模型的监督蒸馏到世界动作模型中，聚焦于与动作相关的动态，从而在没有大规模预训练的情况下提高对环境扰动的鲁棒性。

title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过大规模预训练获得了广泛的操作能力，但通过语言引导这些能力需要在指令与物理交互之间实现细粒度的对齐。现有的机器人演示通常仅提供粗略的任务描述，省略了动作的执行方式，包括哪个夹爪执行操作、接触哪个物体，以及如何抓取和移动该物体。我们提出YUBI-STAG，一个时空标注与对齐（Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding）框架，能够自动为操作演示丰富交互相关的语义，从而将预训练的VLA模型与细粒度的操作语言对齐。该框架结合接触物体分割与视觉-语言模型，对物体身份、属性和状态、各夹爪动作、双手协调以及空间定位的交互进行标注。为解决YUBI-STAG对局部序列和多阶段VLM推理的依赖，我们将其蒸馏为YUBI-VLM。YUBI-VLM能够直接从原始未分割的视频中，以少量推理调用恢复动作结构和标注，并仅依靠腕部视角即可运行。我们在YUBI-STAG-Bench上对两个框架进行了时间、语义和空间定位任务的评估。YUBI-VLM在减少推理调用和缩短运行时间的同时，保留了YUBI-STAG的大部分标注准确性，并能泛化到未见过的操作场景。最后，基于这些标注对VLA策略进行后训练，使其与细粒度语言和接触感知结构对齐。双手操作的实验表明，策略性能和指令跟随能力均有提升，包括对物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置以及原始标签中不存在的空间关系的控制。
tldr: YUBI-STAG automatically enriches robot manipulation demonstrations with fine-grained contact and semantic annotations using segmentation and VLMs, and distills this into YUBI-VLM for efficient annotation; post-training VLA policies on these annotations improves instruction following and bimanual control.
tldr_zh: YUBI-STAG 利用分割和视觉语言模型自动为机器人操作演示添加细粒度的接触和语义注释，并将其蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM 以高效注释；在这些注释上对 VLA 策略进行后训练可提高指令跟随和双臂控制能力。

title: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
summary: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.
summary_zh: 将机器人作为复杂自适应系统部署在未知和动态环境中，需要从刚性指令库向基于意图的自主性转变，因为自然语言是唯一能够表达超出有限指令集范围的复杂目标的中介。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）为自然语言目标描述提供了途径，但其集成引发了重大挑战：不精确意图与可执行动作之间的形式化差距、由不可预测环境引发的分类差距，以及维持时间状态和进度意识的挑战。本研究提出了一种架构框架，通过利用生成式人工智能实现机器人控制。该系统采用双AI设计：一个LLM将高层意图转换为受限的正式机器人库中的可执行程序代码，并通过可验证语法加以约束；同时，一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过蒸馏过程提供语义基础。为确保鲁棒性，该框架引入了基于几何和语义阈值的环境驱动重规划触发器，并辅以持续运行时监控和自适应规划循环。在多个前沿模型上进行的基准测试表明，我们的框架架构证明了将生成式人工智能置于反应性、受限循环中，能够在动态和未知环境中实现复杂意图的稳健履行。
tldr: This paper presents a dual-AI framework combining an LLM for code generation and a VLM for semantic grounding, enabling robots to execute high-level natural language intentions in dynamic environments through constrained, reactive code generation and replanning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双AI框架，结合LLM进行代码生成和VLM进行语义基础，通过受限、反应式代码生成和重新规划，使机器人能够在动态环境中执行高级自然语言意图。

title: Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.
summary_zh: 目标条件下的可变形线性物体动态操作通常将目标定义为绳端需要到达的位置。然而，许多任务取决于绳端到达的方式。因此，我们研究了单次挥动绳索击打任务，其目标同时指定绳端的三维位置和到达方向，覆盖整个工作空间并适用于不同绳索。这一任务具有挑战性，因为绳索动力学难以建模、不存在示范数据、不同挥动方式到达同一目标的可靠性各异，且仿真到现实的差距超出了绳索本身的范围。为应对这些挑战，我们对最先进的DLO仿真器DeformX进行了扩展，加入了GPU加速、稳定的Cosserat杆求解器和横流气动模型，形成了DeformX2.0，其速度提升了超过$20{,}000$倍。随后，我们提出了TRACE（基于轨迹根的自适应交叉熵方法），该方法通过从存储的挥动轨迹中选择绳端路径最接近新目标的挥动作为热启动，生成击打数据。其代价函数对绳索弯曲和绳端突变运动进行惩罚，以偏向可重复的挥动方式。基于这些数据训练的条件流匹配策略在仿真中达到了92.1%的准确率。最后，我们提出了RECAP（残差校准策略），该策略通过若干次校准挥动拟合仿真器的绳索和装置参数，并利用在仿真中训练的校正策略调整动作。在真实机器人上，针对三种绳索，RECAP将位置目标在5cm误差内的成功率从72%提升至87%，对同时指定到达方向的目标，在10cm和10°误差内的成功率从50%提升至79%。
tldr: This paper introduces TRACE and RECAP for direction-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects, using an accelerated simulator (DeformX2.0) and a flow-matching policy to achieve high accuracy in simulation and improved success on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TRACE和RECAP，用于可变形线性物体的方向条件动态操作，利用加速模拟器(DeformX2.0)和流匹配策略，在仿真中达到高精度，并在真实机器人上提高了成功率。

title: Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss
summary: Imitation learning policies that integrate multiple sensory modalities are prone to overreliance on a dominant modality, such as vision, during training, which can disrupt policy execution when that modality is lost at inference time. In this paper, we introduce Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), in which the dependence on each modality is estimated using attention and the most dominant modality is selectively dropped. This is combined with entropy regularization over the dependence distribution. Through real-robot evaluation using a bimanual manipulator, we show that under vision loss the success rate of the baseline policy drops substantially, whereas TMD sustains task execution. In contrast, a conventional dropout that selects the dropped modality at random, without the entropy regularization, fails on many tasks even without vision loss.
summary_zh: 模仿学习策略在整合多种感官模态时，容易在训练过程中过度依赖某一种主导模态（如视觉），当推理时该模态丢失，策略执行便会受到干扰。本文提出了一种目标模态丢弃（TMD）方法，通过注意力机制估计各模态的依赖程度，并选择性地丢弃最主导的模态。同时，结合对依赖分布的熵正则化处理。通过使用双臂操作机器人的真实机器人评估，我们表明，在视觉丢失的情况下，基线策略的成功率大幅下降，而TMD能够维持任务执行。相比之下，未采用熵正则化且随机选择丢弃模态的常规丢弃方法，即使在视觉未丢失的情况下，也在多项任务中失败。
tldr: This paper introduces Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), a method that estimates modality dependence via attention and selectively drops the dominant modality during training, combined with entropy regularization, to make imitation learning policies robust to vision loss; real-robot bimanual manipulation experiments show TMD maintains task execution under vision loss while conventional random dropout fails.
tldr_zh: 本文提出目标模态丢弃（TMD）方法，通过注意力估计模态依赖并选择性丢弃主导模态，结合熵正则化，使模仿学习策略在视觉丢失时保持鲁棒；在双臂真实机器人操作实验中，TMD在视觉丢失下维持任务执行，而传统随机丢弃则失败。

title: Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization
summary: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.
summary_zh: 可泛化的接触丰富的操作任务要求机器人在保持预期任务行为的同时，将其物理实现方式适应变化的接触条件。然而，相互作用力会随着表面几何形状、朝向和摩擦力的微小变化而产生显著差异，这使得直接在原始力测量上训练的策略难以推广到演示条件之外。我们提出了FACE，一种接触因式分解的模仿学习框架，将预期任务行为与环境相关的接触因子分离开来。我们的表示方法在归一化的、接触相对坐标中表达相互作用力，同时，一个学习的接触法线估计器和一个在线摩擦力估计器推断局部接触法线和有效摩擦力尺度。这些估计器共同使得在执行过程中，力观测能够被编码，策略输出能够被解码为物理运动和力指令。通过这种方式，FACE在保持预期任务行为的同时，适应当前的接触条件，且无需更新策略参数。我们在真实机器人上，针对表面属性和几何形状的未见变化进行了接触丰富的操作任务评估，通过与适用于我们设置的先前方法变体进行受控比较，展示了在接触条件变化下的鲁棒泛化能力。视频和其他材料可在项目页面找到：https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face。
tldr: FACE introduces a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates task intent from environment-dependent contact conditions, using learned contact-normal and friction estimators to adapt force observations and policy outputs for robust real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen surface variations.
tldr_zh: FACE 提出一种接触因子化的模仿学习框架，将任务意图与环境依赖的接触条件分离，通过学习的接触法线和摩擦估计器调整力观测和策略输出，使真实机器人接触丰富操作在未知表面变化下稳健泛化。

title: Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）为自动驾驶提供了强大的开放世界感知与推理能力，但其高昂的计算成本和推理延迟使得持续依赖云端使用不切实际。这促使了“快—慢”协作模式的出现，即高效的车载模块负责实时感知与控制，而云端模型仅在需要时提供高层推理。关键挑战在于决定何时云端推理应影响时延敏感型驾驶决策。现有方法通常依赖感知不确定性、启发式触发条件或资源驱动策略，而未评估消解不确定性是否能够改善规划结果。为此，我们提出\textbf{SIGMA}，一种面向任务导向型快—慢协作的仿真闭环框架。SIGMA将规划器嵌入不确定性评估中，考察在语义与几何不确定性下，各种合理场景实现如何影响可行轨迹及规划成本，并据此估计消解不确定性所带来的规划成本预期降幅。我们进一步引入期望规划增益（EPG），一种面向决策层的度量指标，用于在截止时间和资源约束下指导云端调用、云端引导集成及请求优先级排序。在CARLA中的实验表明，SIGMA在静态与动态障碍物场景中减少了不必要的云端交互，同时提升了规划效率与导航成功率。与固定周期协作相比，SIGMA在动态场景中减少了50\%的不必要云端交互，导航成功率提升超过6\%，完成时间最多缩短26.2\%。
tldr: SIGMA is a simulation-in-the-loop framework that uses expected planning gain (EPG) to decide when to invoke cloud VLM reasoning in autonomous driving, reducing unnecessary cloud interactions and improving planning efficiency in CARLA.
tldr_zh: SIGMA 是一个闭环仿真框架，利用预期规划增益（EPG）决定何时调用云端VLM推理，从而在CARLA中减少不必要的云端交互并提升规划效率。

title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
summary: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.
summary_zh: 潜在动作通过从视觉转换中推断出的类动作编码来监督机器人策略，其有效性取决于两个问题：编码从一次转换中保留了哪些信息，以及当它在不同的初始状态下被复用时是否仍具有相同的含义。第一个问题涉及时间上的张力：端点差异忽略了动作展开的过程，而完整序列则引入了无关的变异。第二个问题在重建过程中未被解决，因为重建只观察到潜在变量与其来源状态的组合。我们认为这两个问题可以在同一框架内得到解答。TERRA（时间效应表示与关系对齐）通过紧凑的时间效应来描述一次转换，即净特征变化与低阶窗口内动态分量的组合，并从此效应中学习连续潜在变量。同一效应空间随后作为复用的参考：效应锚定传输（EAT）在其他初始状态下解码潜在变量，并将由此产生的效应锚定到其来源处观察到的效应上，从而使潜在变量由其跨情境的行为塑造，而不仅仅由其来源的转换决定。在冻结线性读取器的情况下，TERRA 在动作预测上比 UniVLA 和 LAPA 风格的基线更为准确，在视觉干扰下退化更慢，并且当接收者情境距离更远时，能保持传输后的转换忠实于供体动作；同一预算的对照实验表明，这些提升主要来自 EAT。在匹配的预训练规模下，完整系统在 LIBERO 上达到 93.4% 的平均成功率，而 UniVLA 为 91.8%。
tldr: TERRA introduces a novel latent action learning method using temporal effect representations and relational alignment to improve action prediction and transportability across robot manipulation tasks, achieving higher success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: TERRA 提出了一种利用时间效应表示和关系对齐的潜在动作学习方法，提高了机器人操作任务中的动作预测和可迁移性，在 LIBERO 基准上取得了更高的成功率。

title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用预训练视觉-语言模型的丰富表征，在机器人操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，其在实际环境中的部署仍受到反复出现的不可靠行为所限制。本研究聚焦于状态幻觉（state hallucination）这一反复出现的失效模式，即VLA在未实际达成机器人-物体目标状态时，仍持续执行动作仿佛该状态已实现。分析发现，状态幻觉与模型对任务相关视觉区域的注意力减弱同步发生，且通过稀疏自编码器的机制性解释表明，与幻觉相关的稀疏特征在这些失效发生时被激活。基于上述分析，我们提出SOUL（Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning）方法，该方法选择性地消除与状态幻觉行为相关的策略知识，其中从幻觉失效和成功行为中识别出的稀疏特征分别作为明确的遗忘目标和保留目标。在模拟及真实环境中的多种VLA架构上进行的实验表明，所提方法能显著减少幻觉性失效并提升任务成功率，同时不会明显削弱已有的操作能力。上述结果表明，可解释的特征分析为选择性修正机器人策略中的不良知识提供了切实可行的基础。
tldr: This paper investigates state hallucination in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, where policies act as if an unrealized state was achieved, and proposes SOUL, a sparse feature unlearning method that selectively removes hallucination-associated behaviors while preserving successful manipulation capabilities, validated across simulated and real-world environments.
tldr_zh: 本文研究VLA模型中的状态幻觉问题，并提出SOUL方法，通过稀疏特征选择性地遗忘幻觉相关行为，同时保留成功的操作能力，在仿真和真实环境中验证了其有效性。

title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
summary: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.
summary_zh: 人形机器人全身运动过程中的精确末端执行器跟踪，因浮动基座振荡、重力、动力学耦合及行走诱发扰动而极具挑战性。我们提出 ResGAC，一种用于精确末端执行器位姿跟踪的全身人形控制器，它将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习相结合。GAC 提供结构化的 $\SE$ 任务空间反馈，并生成标称的手臂关节位置目标，而残差强化学习则补偿未建模动力学，并在共享的关节位置动作空间中协调运动与平衡。左不变几何公式使同一 GAC 法则可适用于不同操作参考坐标系，从而能够使用地面附着的航向坐标系，该坐标系在保留平面运动的同时，从操作参考中去除骨盆的侧倾、俯仰和升降，进而减少运动过程中参考系所诱发的末端执行器运动。ResGAC 在实际 Unitree G1 人形机器人上得到验证。在四项站立末端执行器跟踪基准测试中，ResGAC 始终优于代表性基线方法（包括 SONIC），实现了更低的平移和旋转误差。真实世界实验进一步表明，使用所提出的地面附着航向坐标系，能够减少骨盆运动向期望末端执行器位姿的传播。在站立插孔任务中，ResGAC 的成功率达到 $90\%$，而 SONIC 仅为 $50\%$；同时在下肢运动期间实现了精确的世界坐标系 $\SE$ 末端执行器位姿跟踪。实验视频包含在补充材料中，也可在项目网站上获取：https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/。
tldr: ResGAC combines geometric admittance control with residual reinforcement learning to achieve precise SE(3) end-effector tracking in whole-body humanoid control, validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid with superior performance over baselines.
tldr_zh: ResGAC 将几何导纳控制与残差强化学习相结合，在人形全身控制中实现精确的SE(3)末端执行器跟踪，并在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证优于基线。

title: TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks
summary: Backdoored vision-language-action (VLA) policies can preserve benign task performance while producing malicious actions when a trigger appears. Detecting such activation is difficult because malicious behavior can comprise individually plausible actions, while unfamiliar tasks introduce legitimate changes in observations and behavior. We introduce TMT, a runtime backdoor detector based on Token Manifold and latent Transition modeling. Trained on benign rollouts, its two branches assess input-token structure and prediction errors in adjacent-layer latent dynamics. A suspicious rollout identified by the token manifold branch, once confirmed through latent deviations, guides transition selection for subsequent monitoring. We further explore policy purification through self-distillation: a frozen copy of the backdoored policy provides benign-input actions to supervise a student on paired benign and triggered observations, without requiring a separate clean reference policy. For evaluation, we adapt traditional backdoor detectors and repurpose anomaly and failure detection methods as VLA backdoor detectors. In a post-hoc comparison with ten baselines, TMT achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection performance on unseen tasks across three VLA backdoor attacks. Our project page is available at https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/.
summary_zh: 带后门的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在保持良性任务性能的同时，一旦触发条件出现便会生成恶意动作。检测此类激活十分困难，因为恶意行为可能由单个看似合理的动作组成，而不熟悉的任务则会在观测和行为中引入合理的变化。我们提出了TMT，一种基于Token流形和潜在转移建模的运行时后门检测器。该检测器在良性轨迹上训练，其两个分支分别评估输入令牌结构以及相邻层潜在动态中的预测误差。由令牌流形分支识别出的可疑轨迹，在通过潜在偏差确认后，将指导后续监控的转移选择。我们进一步探索了通过自蒸馏实现策略净化的方法：将带后门策略的冻结副本作为良性输入动作的监督信号，指导学生在成对的良性和触发观测上进行学习，而无需单独的干净参考策略。在评估方面，我们改编了传统的后门检测器，并将异常检测和故障检测方法重新用于VLA后门检测。在与十个基线的后验比较中，TMT在三种VLA后门攻击下的未见任务上达到了最先进的后门检测性能。我们的项目页面可在https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/访问。
tldr: TMT proposes a runtime backdoor detection method for Vision-Language-Action policies, leveraging token manifold and latent transition modeling to detect malicious triggers on unseen tasks, and introduces a self-distillation-based policy purification approach without needing a clean reference policy.
tldr_zh: TMT提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作策略的运行时后门检测方法，利用令牌流形和潜在转移建模在未见过的任务上检测恶意触发器，并引入了一种无需干净参考策略的基于自蒸馏的策略净化方法。

title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
summary: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.
summary_zh: 近年来，利用人类视频数据集进行机器人策略训练的方法日益普及。然而，现有的大多数手部跟踪器仅从裁剪后的帧中回归姿态，对手部运动和物体交互的先验信息利用有限，导致估计结果不准确且在物理上不一致。此外，缺乏物理线索（如接触力和作用力）限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的应用。为此，我们提出了RLHND，一种基于视频基础模型的手部跟踪模型，能够从单目第一人称视角视频中联合估计手部姿态和真实的触觉信息。RLHND通过干净潜变量条件化，将预训练的Cosmos 3视频扩散骨干网络转化为确定性的片段级特征提取器，将其在手部运动和手-物交互方面的先验知识引入跟踪过程。在姿态估计方面，RLHND（i）预测具有解剖学合理关节角度的姿态，并（ii）支持以形状参数为可选条件，以保持同一视频内甚至同一操作者录制的不同视频中手部形状的一致性。在触觉估计方面，一个独立的触觉专家流在姿态流冻结的状态下进行训练，预测手部表面的密集接触和作用力分布。我们进一步采用基于LBS的特征扩展方法，实现逐顶点的特征提取，而无需昂贵的逐顶点注意力计算。RLHND在多个基准数据集的姿态估计任务中达到了最先进的性能，同时在接触力和作用力估计中也取得了最先进的成果。此外，我们通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验展示了RLHND在机器人学习中的实用性。代码将在https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/ 公开提供。
tldr: RLHND adapts the Cosmos video diffusion model into a physically grounded hand tracker that jointly estimates anatomically plausible hand pose and dense contact/force from human egocentric videos, and demonstrates its utility for robot policy learning via retargeting and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: RLHND将Cosmos视频扩散模型改造为具有物理接地的手部追踪器，从人类第一人称视频中联合估计解剖学合理的手部姿态和密集接触力，并通过重定向和真实机器人实验展示了其在机器人策略学习中的实用性。

title: RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation
summary: Robotic manipulation videos are increasingly used as visual plans for embodied agents, but optimizing purely for visual plausibility often fails to capture the fragile physical manifold of real-world interactions. Even minor physics-violating errors at the interaction boundary, such as interpenetration or premature object motion, can completely invalidate the inferred timing and pose needed for downstream execution. Because standard supervised fine-tuning lacks the direct pressure to penalize these localized failures, we introduce AgiBot-PhysPref. This rigorously curated 10,000-sample preference dataset isolates condition-matched physics violations, turning the generator's own failure distribution into a foundational signal for physical consistency. Building upon this, we propose RobotAPO, an adversarial physics preference optimization framework operating in the continuous flow-matching denoising space. To prevent the policy from merely memorizing static curated failures, RobotAPO employs a lightweight adversarial counterfactual proposer that learns a condition-dependent, physical-failure-biased direction in denoising space. This encourages the model to explore and better respect the physical interaction boundary, all while maintaining a pure prompt-and-reference inference interface without requiring external structural conditioning. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that explicitly correcting these localized physics violations improves downstream robot execution from generated videos. On held-out AgiBot conditions, RobotAPO outperforms the strongest controlled internal baseline in physical consistency by 6.8% hard score and 10.0% soft score. Crucially, in real-robot replay, it translates these physical-consistency gains into a 37.4% relative improvement in task success over the strongest controlled internal baseline.
summary_zh: 机器人操作视频越来越广泛地被用作具身智能体的视觉规划，但仅仅优化视觉合理性往往难以捕捉真实世界交互中脆弱的物理流形。即使在交互边界处出现细微的违反物理规律的错误，例如相互穿透或物体过早运动，也可能完全破坏下游执行所需的时序和姿态推断。由于标准的监督微调缺乏直接压力来惩罚这些局部失败，我们引入了AgiBot-PhysPref。这个经过严格筛选的包含10，000个样本的偏好数据集，聚焦于条件匹配的物理违规，将生成器自身的失败分布转化为物理一致性的基础信号。在此基础上，我们提出了RobotAPO，一种在连续流匹配去噪空间中运行的对抗性物理偏好优化框架。为了防止策略仅仅记住静态筛选的失败案例，RobotAPO采用了一个轻量级的对抗性反事实提议器，该提议器在去噪空间中学习一个条件依赖、偏向物理失败的方向。这促使模型探索并更好地尊重物理交互边界，同时保持纯提示-参考的推理接口，无需外部结构条件。综合评估表明，明确修正这些局部物理违规能够提升从生成视频到下游机器人执行的性能。在保留的AgiBot条件下，RobotAPO在物理一致性方面相比最强受控内部基线，硬分数提升6.8%，软分数提升10.0%。关键在于，在真实机器人回放中，这些物理一致性的提升转化为任务成功率相比最强受控内部基线相对提升37.4%。
tldr: RobotAPO introduces an adversarial physics preference optimization framework for robotic manipulation video generation, using a curated preference dataset to correct physics violations and improve downstream robot execution success.
tldr_zh: RobotAPO 提出了一种对抗性物理偏好优化框架，用于机器人操作视频生成，通过精心策划的偏好数据集纠正物理违规，并提高下游机器人执行成功率。

title: TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are effective at understanding what task to perform, but provide limited control over how it should be executed, such as moving quickly or slowly. We introduce TempoBridge, a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to modulate actions according to tempo cues in the instruction at each task phase, without additional tempo-conditioned robot demonstrations or tempo-specific base-policy fine-tuning. TempoBridge extracts tempo cues from contextual VLM representations, aligns them with task progress through a causal phase router, and modulates nominal motion commands during execution. Across LIBERO tasks, TempoBridge improves Tempo Success Rate from 52.6% to 89.7% under canonical tempo instructions while retaining high task success. It also preserves near-baseline performance when no tempo cue is present and generalizes to unseen tempo expressions without additional training. Experiments on a physical robot further demonstrate language-conditioned tempo modulation in real-world manipulation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能有效理解需要执行何种任务，但在如何执行方面所提供的控制却十分有限，例如动作的快慢。我们提出了TempoBridge，这是一种轻量级框架，利用冻结的VLA表示，根据指令中每个任务阶段的节奏提示来调节动作，无需额外的节奏条件机器人演示或针对特定节奏的基础策略微调。TempoBridge从上下文视觉语言模型表示中提取节奏提示，通过因果阶段路由器将其与任务进度对齐，并在执行过程中调制标称运动指令。在LIBERO任务集合中，TempoBridge在标准节奏指令下将节奏成功率从52.6%提升至89.7%，同时保持了较高的任务成功率。在没有节奏提示时，TempoBridge的性能仍接近基线水平，并且无需额外训练即可泛化至未见过的节奏表达。在实体机器人上的实验进一步验证了语言条件节奏调制在真实世界操作中的可行性。
tldr: TempoBridge is a lightweight framework that modulates VLA policy actions according to language-specified tempo cues at each task phase, improving tempo success rate on LIBERO benchmarks and demonstrating real-world robot manipulation without requiring tempo-conditioned demonstrations or fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: TempoBridge是一个轻量级框架，根据语言指定的节奏提示在每个任务阶段调制VLA策略的动作，在LIBERO基准上提高了节奏成功率，并在无需节奏条件演示或微调的情况下展示了真实世界机器人操作。

title: Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) utilize future visual prediction as an intermediate reasoning process to guide action generation. However, existing WAMs typically structure visual imagination according to predefined temporal intervals, without explicitly accounting for the different roles of task-critical interactions and connecting transitions. We argue that effective visual foresight should align directly with task-relevant interactions and their corresponding reasoning demands. To this end, we introduce an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework that organizes visual-action prediction around interaction events. Through event-aligned visual-action supervision, WAM learns to generate event-aligned visual context in each imagined rollout, placing greater emphasis on critical state changes that inform action generation. This shapes the visual reasoning granularity according to the underlying interaction dynamics, with detailed reasoning around task-critical events and coarser progression through connecting transitions. Furthermore, we introduce an execution validity head that identifies the valid portion of each predicted action sequence, avoiding redundant actions during chunked inference. Experiments demonstrate a 10.26 percentage point improvement in DOMINO success rate over baseline and competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0. It also transfers from DOMINO Level 1 to Levels 2 and 3 without target-level adaptation.
summary_zh: 世界-行动模型（WAMs）利用未来视觉预测作为中间推理过程来引导行动生成。然而，现有的WAMs通常根据预定义的时间间隔构建视觉想象，未明确考虑任务关键交互与衔接转换的不同作用。我们认为，有效的视觉前瞻应直接与任务相关的交互及其对应的推理需求对齐。为此，我们提出了一种事件对齐的视觉行动推理框架，围绕交互事件组织视觉-行动预测。通过事件对齐的视觉-行动监督，WAM学习在每个想象推演中生成事件对齐的视觉情境，更加注重影响行动生成的关键状态变化。这根据底层交互动态塑造了视觉推理的粒度，即在任务关键事件周围进行细致推理，在衔接转换中采用较粗略的推进。此外，我们引入了一个执行有效性头，用于识别每个预测行动序列中的有效部分，避免在分块推理过程中产生冗余行动。实验表明，在DOMINO成功率上相较于基线提升了10.26个百分点，并在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了具有竞争力的表现。该方法还能从DOMINO第1级迁移至第2级和第3级，无需目标级别的适配。
tldr: The paper proposes an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework for World Action Models, organizing visual prediction around task-critical events to improve action generation, and introduces an execution validity head to filter redundant actions, achieving significant success rate improvements on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种事件对齐的视觉动作推理框架，用于世界动作模型，通过围绕任务关键事件组织视觉预测来改善动作生成，并引入执行有效性头来过滤冗余动作，在操作基准上取得了显著的成功率提升。

title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
summary: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.
summary_zh: 当扩散策略首次被提出时，研究者期望其能够恢复多模态动作分布。然而，我们发现这一期望并不总是成立——即使我们保证了数据集模态的平衡以及批内精确的对称性，扩散策略仍常常坍缩到单一模态。我们的分析表明，独立的动作-噪声配对通过增加扩散路径之间的混合与交叉，导致这一问题，进而可能产生平均化的去噪响应，并抑制模态特有的行为。这一问题在机器人规划中尤为严重，因为动作空间密集且维度较低，显著加剧了此类混合与交叉。为缓解该问题，我们提出了不混溶扩散策略（Immiscible Diffusion Policy），这是一种无需标签的训练时附加机制，通过动作-噪声分配保留相对清晰的噪声到动作的映射路径，而无需修改策略架构或推理流程。在涵盖状态、RGB和点云观测的五项仿真任务及两项真实世界人形操控任务中，我们的方法显著提升了策略对动作模态的保持能力，同时维持了强劲的任务表现。在三个双模态任务中，该方法将非主导模态的比例提升了6.0倍至14.6倍，并在两个四模态任务中恢复了原始策略回放中完全缺失的示范模态。这些结果表明，不混溶扩散策略为一般机器人学习任务中保持动作多模态提供了一种简单而稳健的方法。
tldr: The paper identifies modality collapse in diffusion policies for robot action generation and proposes a label-free training-time noise-assignment method to preserve multimodal action distributions, validated on simulated and real-world humanoid manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文发现扩散策略在机器人动作生成中存在模态坍缩问题，并提出一种无需标签的训练时噪声分配方法以保持动作多模态性，在仿真和真实人形操作任务中验证了效果。

title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
summary: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/
summary_zh: 生成式世界模型能够对操作场景如何朝着任务目标演化提供丰富的预测，然而这些未来状态并不直接暴露控制所需的紧凑任务变量。当训练仅监督未来预测时，终端目标的准确性并非显式学习目标，即使在几何恢复可用的情况下也是如此。我们提出实体级目标读取（Entity-Level Goal Readout），这是一种学习得到的预测到执行接口，使可执行的终端目标成为3D轨迹世界模型的显式输出。该方法将以对象为中心的位姿预测与基于观测深度进行 grounding 的平移相结合，在SE(3)中生成紧凑目标。共享的位姿原生执行器（Pose-Native Executor）利用该固定目标并结合在线对象位姿反馈进行闭环控制，而无需重新运行世界模型。在五项操作任务中，该流程实现了79.69%的平均成功率。目标诊断直接度量终端目标精度，而受控平移扰动则刻画了在目标误差下执行性能的退化情况。在Franka机械臂上的零样本部署中，标称StackCube任务达到73.33%的成功率，加入干扰物时为66.67%，PickPlate任务在策略训练中未见的目标上达到75.00%。这些结果支持将预测到执行接口视为世界模型规划中一个显式学习的组成部分，而非控制流程中偶然的后处理环节。项目页面：https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/
tldr: This paper introduces Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned interface that converts 3D trace world model predictions into executable SE(3) goals for closed-loop robot manipulation, achieving high success rates on simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了实体级目标读取方法，一种将3D轨迹世界模型预测转换为可执行的SE(3)目标的接口，用于闭环机器人操作，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得了高成功率。

title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.
summary_zh: 仿真技术能够大规模、低成本地生成机器人数据，但基于仿真训练的策略往往因仿真到现实的视觉差异而难以迁移至真实世界。现有方法通常依赖中间表示，这可能会丢失丰富的语义信息，或在部署时需要额外的感知模块。我们通过RoboRender框架解决这一视觉仿真到现实差距问题，该框架将仿真轨迹转换为逼真的RGB视频，用于策略学习。RoboRender训练一个面向机器人的视频生成模型，该模型以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人RGB掩码视频为条件输入，在保留仿真器几何结构、机器人运动及动作标签的同时，合成逼真的纹理、背景和干扰物。生成的RGB视频与仿真器提供的状态和动作配对，用于训练策略，实现零样本真实世界部署。在机器人视频测试集上，我们的视频模型在生成质量上优于基于深度条件的视频生成基线。在抓取放置、铰接物体操作和移动操作任务的真实世界实验中，基于RoboRender生成数据训练的策略实现了71%的平均成功率，分别比原始仿真渲染和传统视觉域随机化方法高出约7.1倍和3.6倍。我们进一步表明，每条仿真轨迹生成更多视频可提升策略性能，使开启任务的成功率提高65个百分点。这些结果表明，生成式视频渲染有效缩小了零样本策略迁移中的视觉仿真到现实差距。项目网站：https://robo-render.github.io/。
tldr: RoboRender uses a robot-oriented video generation model to convert simulated trajectories with depth and mask conditions into photorealistic RGB videos, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real policy transfer for manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboRender 利用面向机器人的视频生成模型，将带有深度和掩码条件的仿真轨迹转换为逼真的 RGB 视频，从而实现操作任务的零样本仿真到真实策略迁移。

title: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled legged robots to perform a range of skills in single-task settings. However, applications such as farm robotics or space exploration require diverse skills such as locomotion, digging, or close-range surveying. Training an end-to-end policy to address this problem remains difficult due to challenges such as sample inefficiency and gradient conflict between tasks in multi-task learning. We propose a three-stage method that trains a single policy to perform distinct tasks such as walking, digging, and hopping, and compose them into novel behaviors such as crawling. First, multiple teacher policies are trained using RL on narrowly defined tasks. Then, two additional stages train a student policy with a multi-teacher distillation setup that uses a combined RL and Imitation Learning (IL) objective under an adversarial task selection process that focuses training on the worst-performing task. With this method, we train a student policy that performs 22 tasks using 8 teachers. Evaluations show our method preserves motion quality and tracks commands more accurately than PPO and distill-then-finetune baselines, and in some cases generalizes to new tasks without explicit training. Finally, we demonstrate real-world robustness by deploying the resulting policy on a Unitree B1 quadruped. Video: https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）使得腿式机器人能够在单一任务环境中执行一系列技能。然而，诸如农业机器人或太空探索等应用场景则需要多样化的技能，例如移动、挖掘或近距离勘测。训练一个端到端策略来解决这一问题仍面临诸多困难，原因包括样本效率低下以及多任务学习中各任务之间的梯度冲突。我们提出了一种三阶段方法，用于训练单一策略以执行行走、挖掘和跳跃等不同任务，并将其组合成诸如爬行等新颖行为。首先，使用强化学习在定义明确的任务上训练多个教师策略。随后，通过两个额外阶段，在对抗性任务选择过程下，利用结合强化学习与模仿学习（IL）目标的多人教师蒸馏框架来训练学生策略，该过程聚焦于表现最差的任务进行训练。采用此方法，我们使用8个教师策略训练了一个能够执行22项任务的学生策略。评估结果表明，与PPO及先蒸馏后微调的基线方法相比，我们的方法保留了动作质量并更准确地跟踪命令，在某些情况下甚至无需显式训练即可泛化到新任务。最后，我们通过在宇树B1四足机器人上部署所得策略，展示了其在现实世界中的鲁棒性。视频链接：https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA
tldr: This paper introduces a three-stage training method combining reinforcement learning and imitation learning with adversarial task selection to train a single quadruped robot policy capable of 22 diverse skills, demonstrating real-world deployment on a Unitree B1.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习与模仿学习并采用对抗性任务选择的三阶段训练方法，训练出一个能够执行22种不同技能的四足机器人单一策略，并在Unitree B1上进行了真实世界部署。

title: CAP: Codebook-Aligned Prediction for Tokenized Robot Policies
summary: Action tokenization converts continuous robot actions into discrete symbols that can be modeled autoregressively. However, existing tokenizer-based policies typically ignore the tokenizer's learned latent code structure: after tokenization, the policy treats tokens as unrelated class indices and learns a new classifier from scratch. We show that this discarded structure is valuable. We introduce Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), a method that directly reuses the tokenizer's code vectors as policy class prototypes while leaving the tokenizer and policy backbone otherwise unchanged. Across four quantizer families, three simulation benchmarks, and two real-robot tasks, CAP consistently improves task success over standard token classification heads while holding the tokenizer (and therefore its reconstruction quality) fixed. Our analysis further shows that these gains are not explained by higher token accuracy or changes in the policy head alone. Instead, reusing the tokenizer codebook provides the policy with valuable information about the tokenizer's learned latent structure across tokens, making token prediction errors more benign in action space and improving the representations learned by the policy backbone. These results suggest that action tokenizers learn useful action-aware latent structure beyond discrete targets that should be preserved when training downstream policies.
summary_zh: 动作分词将连续的机器人动作转换为离散符号，从而可以通过自回归方式进行建模。然而，现有的基于分词器的策略通常忽略分词器学习到的潜在码本结构：分词后，策略将词元视为无关的类别索引，并从零开始训练新的分类器。我们表明，这种被丢弃的结构具有重要价值。我们提出了码本对齐预测（CAP）方法，该方法直接复用分词器的码本向量作为策略类别原型，同时保持分词器和策略主干网络不变。在四种量化器家族、三个模拟基准测试以及两个真实机器人任务中，CAP consistently 相较于标准词元分类头提升了任务成功率，同时保持分词器（及其重建质量）固定不变。我们的进一步分析表明，这些提升并不能仅由更高的词元准确率或策略头的变化来解释。相反，复用分词器的码本为策略提供了关于分词器在词元间学习到的潜在结构的有价值信息，从而使词元预测误差在动作空间中更具良性，并改善了策略主干网络学习到的表示。这些结果表明，动作分词器学习到了超越离散目标的有用的动作感知潜在结构，这些结构在训练下游策略时应予以保留。
tldr: This paper proposes Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), which reuses action tokenizer code vectors as policy class prototypes, improving robot policy performance across benchmarks and real robots without changing the tokenizer or reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出码本对齐预测（CAP），将动作分词器的码向量直接用作策略类原型，在不改变分词器或重构质量的情况下，提高了机器人策略在多个基准和真实机器人上的成功率。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
summary: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.
summary_zh: 自回归动作令牌策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型，需要动作分词器将离散令牌序列转换为连续空间中的精确控制动作。许多动作分词器通过重构目标来学习令牌与动作之间的映射。然而，正如我们通过广泛分析所示，足够精确的动作重构仅是使下游机器人策略成功的因素之一。同样关键的是，策略能够针对新的观测预测正确的令牌，并且未见过的策略令牌预测仍能解码为合理的动作。这些性质源于分词器的训练过程，仅靠重构目标并不能直接激励这些特性。在本工作中，我们引入了可预测且鲁棒的动作分词（ProAct），这是一种分词器训练方法，策略性地增强重构过程，旨在提升下游可预测性和鲁棒性。ProAct与策略无关，仅使用动作数据集进行训练。在Robomimic、LIBERO和RoboTwin基准测试以及多种分词器架构中，ProAct将部署成功率平均提高了11.3个百分点。这些改进同样适用于视觉-语言-动作策略和真实世界机器人操作，分别平均提升了21.8和36.7个百分点。这些结果表明，有效的动作分词应设计为一种策略接口，平衡保真度、可预测性和鲁棒性，而非仅仅作为重构问题来处理。
tldr: This paper introduces ProAct, a tokenizer training method that augments reconstruction with predictability and robustness objectives, improving downstream robot policy success across multiple benchmarks and real-world manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 ProAct，一种在重建目标基础上增强可预测性和鲁棒性的 tokenizer 训练方法，在多个基准和真实机器人操作中提升了策略成功率。
