summary: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.
summary_zh: 学习目标达成策略的困难通常被归因于“视野诅咒”，其表现为时间差备份中的偏差累积以及噪声优势估计。在本研究中，我们识别出目标条件策略学习中存在另一种信息层面的视野诅咒，即增加目标重标注视野会显著降低策略的泛化能力和性能。通过一系列使用预言式规划器的受控实验，我们将训练期间采样的目标视野与测试时策略需要达成的目标视野进行解耦。即使在仅评估一系列邻近子目标的情况下，目标条件行为克隆策略也会遭受严重的、依赖于训练视野的性能退化，而这种退化可通过强化学习目标得到缓解。我们将这一现象解释为动作与事后重标注目标之间条件互信息随视野增加而减少，并在经验上发现，基于较长视野目标训练的BC和RL策略，其灵敏度从目标信息向状态信息转移，这一变化可通过策略输入雅可比矩阵进行度量。基于这一观察，我们发现将短视野策略的输入雅可比矩阵蒸馏至长视野策略中可带来显著的性能提升，尤其在组合操作任务中表现突出。综合来看，我们的研究结果强调了目标重标注视野是从离线数据学习通用型策略时的重要考量因素。
tldr: This paper identifies an informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where longer relabeling horizons degrade policy generalization due to reduced mutual information between actions and goals, and proposes Jacobian distillation from short-horizon to long-horizon policies to mitigate this.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了目标条件策略学习中的信息性地平线诅咒：较长的重标记地平线通过降低动作与目标之间的互信息而损害策略泛化，并提出将短地平线策略的雅可比矩阵蒸馏到长地平线策略中以缓解此问题。

title: Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing
summary: Robot throwing has emerged as a promising technique for improving efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation, by enlarging the workspace and speeding up the process. To significantly increase the throwing system's throughput, we develop strategies for throwing multiple objects in one swipe. Such multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) leverages the large degrees of freedom of anthropomorphic hands. The key is to quickly generate fast and feasible throwing motions, which involves a complex trade-off between short trajectory duration and short planning time. We solve this problem in two stages. Offline, we build a model of the feasible set by combining object's inverted flying dynamics and the robot's kinematics and dynamics. Online, we generate feasible throws through fast solution matching and filtering of object's valid detach state and robot's feasible state that can compose sequences of throws in less than 5 ms. We validate the framework on a 7-DoF manipulator equipped with a multi-fingered hand. In simulation, coordinated two-object throwing reduces execution time by up to 46% compared to independent single-object planning, and this improvement is maintained when scaling to three objects. Real-world experiments with two objects confirm a 29% reduction; the remaining gap to the theoretical 50% is attributed to inter-throw transition overhead. When target positions are randomly changed mid-execution, the system re-plans and successfully reaches the new targets within 100 ms latency without stopping the robot. These results establish the first unified planning framework for MOMT throwing -- demonstrating scalability to multiple objects in simulation and real-world feasibility on two-object tasks -- advancing the frontier of high-throughput robotic manipulation. A video summarizing the method and the hardware experiments is available at https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video
summary_zh: 机器人投掷作为一种提升物流与仓储自动化效率的新兴技术，通过扩大工作空间和加快流程来发挥作用。为显著提高投掷系统的吞吐量，我们开发了一次投掷中抛掷多个物体的策略。这种多物体多目标投掷（MOMT）利用了拟人手的自由度优势。关键在于快速生成快速且可行的投掷运动，这涉及短轨迹持续时间与短规划时间之间的复杂权衡。我们分两个阶段解决这一问题。离线阶段，我们结合物体的倒飞动力学与机器人的运动学和动力学，构建可行集合模型。在线阶段，我们通过快速解匹配与滤波，在不到5毫秒内生成可行投掷，筛选出物体的有效脱离状态和机器人的可行状态，从而组合成连续投掷序列。我们在配备多指手的七自由度机械臂上验证了该框架。仿真中，与独立单物体规划相比，协调双物体投掷将执行时间缩短了高达46%，且在三物体扩展时仍保持这一改进。真实世界双物体实验确认了29%的缩减；与理论50%的差距归因于投掷间的过渡开销。当执行过程中目标位置随机变化时，系统能在不停机的情况下于100毫秒延迟内重新规划并成功到达新目标。这些成果建立了首个面向MOMT投掷的统一规划框架——在仿真中展示了多物体的可扩展性，并在双物体任务中验证了实际可行性——推动了高吞吐量机器人操作的前沿。总结方法与硬件实验的视频可在 https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video 观看。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage planning framework for multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) using a 7-DoF manipulator with a multi-fingered hand, achieving coordinated throws in under 5 ms and reducing execution time by up to 46% in simulation and 29% in real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多目标多目标投掷（MOMT）的两阶段规划框架，使用7自由度机械臂和多指手，在5毫秒内实现协调投掷，仿真中执行时间减少高达46%，实际实验中减少29%。

title: StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images
summary: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.
summary_zh: 从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的人手抓取动作具有挑战性，因为抓取的物理建模本身就十分困难，且该问题不仅需要估计受视觉约束的手部姿态，还需要确定能够稳定抓取的控制目标。现有方法要么仅建模视觉手部几何而不考虑物理因素，要么依赖不够合理的物理建模，这限制了所得抓取结果的物理有效性。本文提出StableGrasp，一种基于可微分仿真的优化框架，明确地将视觉手部姿态与决定抓取力的控制目标相分离。该方法通过在可微分仿真器中最小化抓取的动能，联合优化手部几何与控制目标，同时对正则化手部几何以保持视觉一致性和几何合理性。在严格的物理仿真下，重建的抓取动作显著更加稳定，同时与输入图像保持视觉一致并具备几何合理性。实验表明，我们的方法比替代性手部控制策略产生远更稳定的抓取，能够将纯视觉抓取重建管线的输出转化为物理稳定的抓取，从而使其受益。
tldr: StableGrasp uses differentiable simulation to jointly optimize hand geometry and control targets from a single RGB image, producing physically stable human hand grasps while maintaining visual consistency.
tldr_zh: StableGrasp 利用可微分仿真，从单张 RGB 图像联合优化手部几何和控制目标，在保持视觉一致性的同时生成物理上稳定的人手抓取。

title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
summary: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人拆卸需要部件级别的表示，以区分真实组件几何与扫描及重建伪影。在硬盘驱动器（HDD）的点云中，结构化鬼影伪影在局部可能类似于有效部件，但整体几何上却存在不一致，从而使错误测量获得看似合理的语义标签。这构成了一个工程信息问题：仅凭语义预测置信度无法确定底层几何是否可靠。我们提出\textbf{GUARD}，一种几何不确定性感知框架，通过对学习到的几何表示的可信度进行建模，在单次前向传播中同时实现点过滤和分割。GUARD将多尺度几何变压器与多带宽随机傅里叶特征高斯过程相结合，以估计逐点几何不确定性，并辅以预测熵来抑制不可靠测量，同时保留信息丰富的结构。在2,745个真实HDD点云上的评估表明，GUARD将PointNet++分割的平均交并比从0.7739提升至0.8318。在ShapeNetPart和ScanNet上的进一步实验考察了其在损坏类型、点云领域和分割骨干网络上的鲁棒性。在手动标注的ScanNet样本上，几何不确定性实现了0.7931的损坏点检测F1分数，而预测熵仅为0.2212。结果证明了区分几何可靠性与语义置信度的价值，并揭示了伪影抑制与信息丰富结构保留之间的权衡。GUARD为不完美3D测量的解释提供了一种可靠性感知的方法，用于部件识别及后续的机器人操作。项目网站：https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/。
tldr: GUARD proposes a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that jointly performs point filtering and part-level segmentation on HDD point clouds, modeling per-point geometric reliability to suppress artifacts while improving segmentation accuracy for robotic disassembly.
tldr_zh: GUARD 提出了一种几何不确定性感知框架，在硬盘点云上联合进行点滤波和部件级分割，通过建模逐点几何可靠性来抑制伪影并提升分割精度，以支持机器人拆解。

title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.
summary_zh: 人类视频为类人机器人学习提供了丰富的运动目标，然而视觉上合理的参考轨迹在基于物理的执行过程中仍可能产生持续失败。这些失败揭示了训练监督需要调整之处。我们提出了MimicX，一种策略在环框架，利用执行反馈来优化视频驱动的类人运动跟踪。从重建并重定向的运动出发，MimicX定位困难转换及受影响的躯体区域，然后联合调整跟踪目标与重置课程以支持策略延续。重复的滚动验证在跟踪守护约束下选择执行优先的改进项。在四个核心视频任务中，MimicX相较于固定参考基线持续提升了跟踪精度与稳健执行时域。任务平均结果显示，躯体跟踪误差降低25.7%，执行时域提升255.6%。额外的视频、运动参考及碰撞场景研究在核心任务之外评估了该方法，而MimicX-HLoop通过异构执行加速反馈循环。总体而言，MimicX将策略失败转化为可操作的监督信号，用于决策改进内容以及保留哪些改进成果。
tldr: MimicX uses policy execution feedback to iteratively refine supervision for video-driven humanoid motion tracking, improving tracking accuracy and execution robustness.
tldr_zh: MimicX利用策略执行反馈迭代优化视频驱动的人形运动跟踪的监督信号，提升跟踪精度和执行鲁棒性。

title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.
summary_zh: 航空视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体通常基于细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的指令进行训练，而用户实际提出的是简短、意图驱动的指令；在冻结的OpenFly导航器上，这一“指令鸿沟”使得成功率（SR）从$31.03\%$降至$11.33\%$。为扩展翻译器的训练规模，我们利用语言模型，以人工撰写的风格示例为提示，将原始指令转换为配对的、以意图为中心的弱指令，这些弱指令实现了$15.27\%$的成功率。我们引入了\textbf{轨迹接地指令翻译器（TGIT）}——一种前端模块，在保持导航器冻结的同时，通过从导航器的轨迹结果中学习，将弱输入翻译为智能体可执行的指令。由此训练的弱指令翻译器将弱输入的成功率提升至$37.93\%$，并可零样本迁移至真实人工指令（$11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$）；此外，它还提升了保留数据集OpenFly上的表现（$4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$），并在CityNav和AirVLN上实现了恢复性改进。
tldr: This paper introduces TGIT, a trajectory-grounded instruction translator that converts short, intent-driven user commands into agent-executable instructions for frozen aerial VLN agents, significantly improving success rates and transferring zero-shot to real human instructions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TGIT，一种轨迹引导的指令翻译器，将用户的简短意图指令转换为冻结的空中VLN智能体可执行的指令，显著提高了成功率并零样本迁移到真实人类指令。

title: SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models
summary: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object search involves a closed loop of perception, decision-making, and action under partial observability. Urban environments pose several challenges: large search areas and narrow egocentric views limit coverage, dense 3D geometry constrains safe motion, and open-world instructions require identifying a specific target among distractors. Many existing methods mitigate partial observability through explicit maps or memory representations, yet remain largely reactive, reasoning over past observations without explicitly predicting future states. World models enable prospective reasoning through imagined rollouts. However, image-generating world models can incur high inference latency, while spatially grounded planning remains challenging for latent world models. We propose SearchWorld, a recurrent state-space world model that connects explicit spatial memory with value-guided imagination. The model maintains BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer to guide search. A cognition-action network uses this learned spatial value prior to improve the policy through imagined rollouts, without training a separate scalar critic. Training progresses from world-model learning to expert imitation and imagination-based exploration refinement. On UAV-ON, SearchWorld improves the success rate to 23.8% (19.5% for the strongest published agent) and raises oracle success to 35.5%, while remaining robust on unseen scenes (19.9% success rate). By grounding imagination in explicit spatial representations, SearchWorld enables UAV agents to plan prospectively rather than react.
summary_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）目标搜索涉及在部分可观测条件下感知、决策与行动之间的闭环过程。城市环境带来多重挑战：大范围搜索区域与狭窄的第一人称视野限制了覆盖能力，密集的三维几何结构约束了安全运动，而开放世界指令要求在干扰物中识别特定目标。现有方法多通过显式地图或记忆表征缓解部分可观测性问题，但本质上仍属反应式推理，仅基于历史观测进行判断，未显式预测未来状态。世界模型通过想象推演实现前瞻性推理。然而，图像生成类世界模型推理延迟较高，而潜在空间世界模型在空间接地规划方面仍面临困难。本文提出SearchWorld，一种循环状态空间世界模型，将显式空间记忆与价值引导的想象相结合。该模型维护鸟瞰图（BEV）探索与障碍物记忆，并解码任务感知的空间价值层以引导搜索。认知-行动网络利用学习到的空间价值先验，通过想象推演改进策略，无需训练独立的标量评论网络。训练流程依次涵盖世界模型学习、专家模仿及基于想象的探索精化。在UAV-ON基准上，SearchWorld将成功率提升至23.8%（此前最强已发表智能体为19.5%），并将oracle成功率提高至35.5%，同时在未见场景中保持稳健表现（成功率为19.9%）。通过将想象锚定于显式空间表征，SearchWorld使无人机智能体能够进行前瞻性规划，而非被动反应。
tldr: SearchWorld introduces a recurrent state-space world model with explicit spatial memory and value-guided imagination for UAV object search in urban environments, improving success rates and robustness over prior methods.
tldr_zh: SearchWorld 提出了一种带有显式空间记忆和价值引导想象力的循环状态空间世界模型，用于城市环境中的无人机目标搜索，提高了成功率和鲁棒性。

title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
summary: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.
summary_zh: 摘要：人工智能智能体的快速发展使智能体安全性受到越来越多的关注，相关评估工作主要集中于数字环境。随着智能体进入物理世界，具身安全性变得愈发重要：其失效可能导致人身伤害和高昂的硬件损失。除选择安全动作外，具身智能体还必须在实时约束条件下运行：物理世界不会在智能体推理期间暂停。当推理过程中行人移动、车辆接近时，某一在观测时刻看似安全的动作可能在执行前就已变得不安全。因此，实时具身安全同时取决于决策质量和决策延迟。我们提出了RT-SAFE，一个用于在实时约束下评估具身智能体安全性的模拟城市场景基准。RT-SAFE将导航任务与移动行人、环境危险和交通规则相结合，并允许世界在推理和动作执行过程中持续演化。在八种视觉语言模型（VLM）中，智能体实现了较高的任务完成率，但几乎无法在安全条件下完成任务：在最困难的设置下，仅有0.7%的场景在无安全事件的情况下完成。更引人注目的是，在匹配的静态与实时评估中，任务完成率分别达到91.3%和94.1%，而实时执行使碰撞次数增加了12.3倍。这些结果表明，标准任务成功可能掩盖大量安全失效，且决策延迟本身可能成为物理风险来源。最后，我们展示RT-SAFE能够支持离线强化学习训练，在显著降低碰撞率的同时保持较高的任务完成率。
tldr: RT-Safe introduces a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied agent safety under real-time constraints, showing that decision latency significantly increases collisions and that offline RL can reduce them.
tldr_zh: RT-Safe 提出了一个在实时约束下评估具身代理安全性的模拟城市基准，表明决策延迟显著增加碰撞，而离线RL可以减少碰撞。

title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Wasserstein-Based Evidential Uncertainty for Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.
summary_zh: 语义分割网络在固定的类别集合上运行，因此在部署期间出现分布外（OOD）对象时会失效，这是自动驾驶等安全关键应用中的一个关键限制。可靠识别OOD对象需要校准良好的认知不确定性，然而常见的基于Softmax的置信度得分仍然过于自信，而贝叶斯替代方法如蒙特卡洛Dropout或深度集成则需要成本高昂的重复前向传播。证据深度学习（EDL）通过将类别概率建模为从单次确定性前向传播中学习到的Dirichlet分布，提供了一种高效的替代方案。现有的EDL公式依赖于欧几里得目标函数，将预测推向单纯形的顶点，从而鼓励过度自信，而非为陌生输入保留不确定性。我们转而采用基于Wasserstein的目标函数，该函数尊重概率单纯形的几何结构，并在统一的证据框架内研究Wasserstein阶数对分割精度和OOD检测的影响。我们在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准测试上，对卷积架构（DeepLabV3+）和基于Transformer的架构（SegFormer）评估该框架，测试集包括LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21和Fishyscapes。结果表明，最优的Wasserstein阶数依赖于架构：二阶目标在卷积骨干网络上占优，三阶目标在Transformer骨干网络上占优，并且我们的框架在大多数指标上超越了可比基线，且仅需单次确定性前向传播。
tldr: This paper investigates Wasserstein-based evidential deep learning for out-of-distribution (OOD) segmentation, specifically targeting safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios. It shows that higher-order Wasserstein objectives improve OOD detection on convolutional and transformer architectures using a single deterministic forward pass, outperforming comparable baselines on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于Wasserstein距离的神经确定性深度学习在语义分割中的分布外（OOD）检测问题，特别针对自动驾驶等安全关键场景。结果表明，在卷积和Transformer架构上，高阶Wasserstein目标函数通过单次确定性前向传播提升了OOD检测性能，在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准上超越了可比基线。

title: Controllable Crowd Generation through World-Model Planning
summary: Crowd simulation plays a central role in robot navigation, autonomous driving, and urban planning. For these applications, realistic simulation requires crowds to adapt their behavior to environmental changes and user objectives. However, existing methods that rely on predefined control settings have limited flexibility in accommodating new user-specified objectives. To address this limitation, we propose Ctrl-CWM, a multi-agent Controllable Crowd World Model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control. Our key idea is to adapt the world-model principle of planning using imagined futures to crowd simulation. To this end, Ctrl-CWM consists of an encoder that learns a representation of human motion dynamics, an actor that proposes pedestrian displacements, a critic that evaluates imagined crowd trajectories, and a planner that selects actions. We first learn human motion dynamics through trajectory prediction on real-world pedestrian videos and then freeze the encoder to preserve them. Using this representation, the actor generates imagined crowd trajectories through repeated state updates, and the planner combines the critic's scores with user costs to select actions. Repeated planning advances the simulated crowd, while additional user costs introduce new control objectives without retraining. We extensively evaluate crowd generation under varied agent arrival conditions and run-time control across avoidance and attraction scenarios. Ctrl-CWM outperforms the state-of-the-art method on most crowd realism and collision metrics, and adapts crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives introduced during simulation. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM
summary_zh: 群体仿真在机器人导航、自动驾驶和城市规划中扮演着核心角色。对于这些应用而言，逼真的仿真要求群体能够适应环境变化和用户目标。然而，现有依赖预定义控制设置的方法在适应新的用户指定目标方面灵活性有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Ctrl-CWM，一种集成了群体生成与运行时控制的多智能体可控群体世界模型。我们的核心思想是将“利用想象未来进行规划”这一世界模型原理应用于群体仿真。为此，Ctrl-CWM由以下部分组成：一个学习人体运动动力学表征的编码器，一个提议行人位移的演员网络，一个评估想象群体轨迹的评论家网络，以及一个选择动作的规划器。我们首先通过在真实世界行人视频上的轨迹预测来学习人体运动动力学，然后冻结编码器以保留这些知识。利用该表征，演员网络通过重复的状态更新生成想象的群体轨迹，规划器则结合评论家网络的评分与用户成本来选择动作。重复的规划推进了模拟群体的演化，而额外加入的用户成本则在不重新训练的情况下引入了新的控制目标。我们在不同的智能体到达条件下对群体生成进行了广泛评估，并在避障和吸引场景中测试了运行时控制。Ctrl-CWM在大多数群体真实感和碰撞指标上优于现有最先进方法，并能根据仿真过程中引入的用户指定目标自适应地调整群体行为。项目页面可在https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM查看。
tldr: This paper proposes Ctrl-CWM, a controllable crowd world model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control, using world-model planning to adapt crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives for applications like robot navigation and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Ctrl-CWM，一种可控人群世界模型，通过世界模型规划集成人群生成与运行时控制，以适应机器人导航和自动驾驶等应用中的用户指定目标。

title: SPW-Nav: A Streaming Panoramic World Model for Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Language-guided panoramic video generation benefits various downstream applications, such as interactive 3D scene exploration, virtual reality experiences, and embodied agent training. Existing panoramic generators follow predefined trajectories, and interactive world models act through low-level actions in perspective views. We propose SPW-Nav, a streaming panoramic world model that understands movement instructions and streams one minute of 2K 360-degree video in real time from a single panorama. SPW-Nav interprets each instruction in the previously generated panorama as camera motion. Spherical rotation decoupling applies rotation exactly on the sphere, pose-aligned conditioning keeps translation inputs bounded over long streams, and a multi-term memory with a few-step generator continues the scene as instructions change. We also build SPW-NavSet, panoramic videos with camera trajectories and verified instructions. Driven by language, SPW-Nav outperforms prior panoramic generators in camera-following accuracy and video quality, and supports on-the-fly instruction switching.
summary_zh: 语言引导的全景视频生成技术可为多种下游应用提供支持，包括交互式三维场景探索、虚拟现实体验以及具身智能体训练等。现有的全景生成器通常沿预定义轨迹生成内容，而交互式世界模型则通过第一人称视角中的低级动作进行控制。为此，我们提出SPW-Nav，一种流式全景世界模型，能够理解移动指令，并基于单张全景图实时生成一分钟时长的2K 360度视频。SPW-Nav在每个先前生成的全景图中解释指令，将其转换为相机运动。球面旋转解耦技术确保旋转精确在球面上执行，位姿对齐条件约束保证在长序列流中平移输入保持有界，而多项记忆配合少步生成器则能在指令变化时持续生成场景。我们还构建了SPW-NavSet数据集，包含具备相机轨迹和已验证指令的全景视频。经语言驱动，SPW-Nav在相机跟随精度和视频质量方面均优于先前的全景生成器，并支持实时指令切换。
tldr: SPW-Nav proposes a streaming panoramic world model that generates 360-degree videos following language instructions, with applications in embodied agent training and interactive scene exploration.
tldr_zh: SPW-Nav 提出了一种流式全景世界模型，根据语言指令生成360度视频，可用于具身智能体训练和交互式场景探索。

title: Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients
summary: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/
summary_zh: 基于令牌的世界模型支持细粒度的潜在规划，但反复处理大规模空间令牌网格使得动作搜索代价高昂。我们提出COSTGRAD，一种无需训练、以目标为条件的选择器，依据每个输入令牌对应的规划代价梯度范数对空间令牌进行排序。通过从下游控制目标中推导重要性，COSTGRAD聚焦于对规划至关重要的令牌，而非仅对预测重要的令牌。在$50\%$稀疏度下的AdaLN条件预测器上，COSTGRAD在四个连续控制基准中的三个上达到或超过全令牌规划的性能，同时实测每个环境规划步骤获得$2.6\times$的墙钟加速。将令牌稀疏性与缩减的CEM搜索相结合，总加速比提升至约$5\times$，同时仍超过全令牌基线。我们还识别出一种依赖架构的失效模式：在匹配的AdaLN与拼接（concat）对比中，拼接保持相当的全令牌性能，但纯COSTGRAD相对于随机选择失去优势。这一差异与动作通路漂移相关：在AdaLN上，梯度选择式移除产生的漂移小于随机移除，而在拼接上则相反。这些结果凸显了选择器与架构的兼容性作为稀疏世界模型规划的一个设计维度。项目页面与演示：https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/
tldr: This paper introduces COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens for sparse planning in visual world models by gradient norms of the planning cost, achieving significant speedups while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出COSTGRAD，一种无需训练的、目标条件下的选择器，通过规划成本的梯度范数对视觉世界模型中的空间令牌进行排序，实现稀疏规划，在保持性能的同时获得显著加速。

title: Context-aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Models for Vehicular Trajectory Prediction
summary: Reliable and interpretable trajectory prediction is critical for cooperative and autonomous driving in complex and uncertain environments. This paper introduces a Context-Aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Model (CAA-GMM) for multimodal, uncertainty-aware motion forecasting. The proposed approach models future motion as a probabilistic mixture conditioned on both scene context and agent dynamics, capturing diverse behavioral modes with interpretable Gaussian components. A lightweight attention mechanism adaptively encodes inter-agent interactions and contextual salience, enabling efficient fusion of rasterized environment cues and motion history in dense traffic scenes. Comprehensive evaluations on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that CAA-GMM achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared with state-of-the-art raster-based baselines, while maintaining low computational complexity. Ablation analyses confirm the importance of the attention module for robust contextual reasoning and predictive precision. Furthermore, evaluations under imperfect communication and perception conditions highlight the framework's resilience to uncertainty, establishing CAA-GMM as an efficient and scalable solution for cooperative trajectory prediction in intelligent transportation systems.
summary_zh: 可靠且可解释的轨迹预测对于复杂和不确定环境中的协同与自动驾驶至关重要。本文提出了一种基于上下文感知注意力的高斯混合模型（CAA-GMM），用于多模态、不确定性感知的运动预测。所提出的方法将未来运动建模为以场景上下文和智能体动态为条件的概率混合，通过可解释的高斯分量捕捉多样化的行为模式。一种轻量级注意力机制自适应地编码智能体间交互和上下文显著性，使得在密集交通场景中能够高效融合栅格化环境线索和运动历史。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上的综合评估表明，与最先进的基于栅格的方法相比，CAA-GMM在精度上达到了相当或更优的水平，同时保持了较低的计算复杂度。消融分析证实了注意力模块对鲁棒上下文推理和预测精度的重要性。此外，在不完美通信和感知条件下的评估突显了该框架对不确定性的鲁棒性，使CAA-GMM成为智能交通系统中协同轨迹预测的一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces CAA-GMM, a context-aware attention-based Gaussian mixture model for multimodal vehicular trajectory prediction that efficiently fuses rasterized environment cues and motion history. It demonstrates competitive accuracy and robustness to imperfect conditions on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets, targeting autonomous driving applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于上下文注意力机制的高斯混合模型(CAA-GMM)，用于多模态车辆轨迹预测，该模型高效融合栅格化环境线索与运动历史，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上展示了竞争性的精度以及对不完善条件下的鲁棒性，面向自动驾驶应用。

title: Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control
summary: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. We use this progress signal as a temporal critic for direct goal-conditioned policy learning. Model-assisted targets provide an additional training-time refinement under behavior-support and dynamics-agreement constraints. Across ten visual control tasks, DTRC achieves strong goal-conditioned control performance relative to planning and direct-policy baselines. Held-out diagnostics on the four LeWM tasks show consistent short-range temporal calibration, task-dependent long-range and directional structure, and positive transition-level progress. Temporal supervision improves the same flow-policy parameterization across all four LeWM tasks, while the resulting policy acts directly without iterative trajectory search at test time.
summary_zh: 预测性世界模型为控制任务提供了紧凑的视觉表征。控制任务需要一种与时间可达性对齐的潜在几何结构，而非仅依赖预测相似性。我们提出了一种面向控制的定向时间表征方法（DTRC），该方法在冻结的LeWorldModel（LeWM）特征之上，从离线视觉轨迹中学习这种几何结构。DTRC在所学控制表征上构建了一个定向时间拟度量。短时程时间偏移用于校准距离尺度。引导式目标则将时间可达性扩展到更长的时间跨度。动作条件一致性使表征与局部转移动力学对齐。由此得到的距离估计了时间达到代价，而其跨转移的变化则定义了相对目标的定向时间进展。我们使用该进展信号作为时间评论员，直接用于目标条件策略学习。在行为支持与动力学一致性约束下，模型辅助目标提供了额外的训练阶段细化。在十个视觉控制任务中，DTRC相对于规划方法和直接策略基线，实现了强目标条件控制性能。在四个LeWM任务上的保留诊断显示出一致的短时程时间校准、任务相关的长时程与方向性结构，以及正转移级进展。时间监督在所有四个LeWM任务上提升了相同流策略参数化的性能，而所得策略在测试阶段无需迭代轨迹搜索即可直接执行。
tldr: This paper introduces DTRC, a method that learns directed temporal representations from offline visual trajectories for goal-conditioned control, using a temporal quasimetric and action-conditioned consistency to improve policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 DTRC 方法，从离线视觉轨迹中学习有向时间表征用于目标条件控制，通过时间拟度量与动作条件一致性提升策略学习。

title: CARE: Certifying Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: While vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly, running them at every control step remains expensive. Prior work accelerates VLA inference using techniques like action chunking and visual-token pruning, typically evaluating based on latency and average task success. However, acceleration may discard information and break tasks the original policy would solve, a risk hidden by average metrics. Measuring these failures is challenging because action deviations compound over closed-loop trajectories, meaning task failure is only observable across full episodes. We therefore define an acceleration-induced failure via paired rollouts from identical initial conditions, tracking when the reference succeeds but the accelerated policy fails. To manage this, we introduce CARE, an approach for certified accelerator selection. CARE uses paired rollouts on a calibration set to provide finite-sample guarantees that acceleration-induced failure risk stays below a user-specified budget. It deploys the fastest certified candidate, falling back to the reference if none qualify. By relying only on terminal outcomes and measured compute, CARE applies unchanged across diverse acceleration mechanisms, while sequential testing and failure-triggered reference rollouts keep certification affordable. On four LIBERO suites with OpenVLA-OFT, CARE certifies $9.0$--$10.8\times$ speedups while guaranteeing (at $95\%$ confidence) that at least $85.8\%$ of reference-solved episodes are preserved. Under tight budgets, selectors without guarantees exceed the budget in up to $75\%$ of trials, whereas CARE stays within budget and its sequential form uses $78.9\%$ fewer rollouts than exhaustive evaluation. CARE further generalizes to flow-step reduction for $π_{0.5}$, and to Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B agents in Crafter.
summary_zh: 虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型取得了快速发展，但在每个控制步运行它们仍然代价高昂。先前的工作通过动作分块和视觉令牌剪枝等技术加速VLA推理，通常基于延迟和平均任务成功率进行评估。然而，加速可能会丢弃信息并破坏原始策略本可解决的任务，这一风险被平均指标所掩盖。衡量这些失败具有挑战性，因为动作偏差在闭环轨迹中会不断累积，意味着任务失败只能在完整回合中观察到。因此，我们通过从相同初始条件出发的配对轨迹来定义加速诱导的失败，追踪参考策略成功但加速策略失败的情况。为管理这一问题，我们引入CARE，一种认证加速器选择方法。CARE在校准集上使用配对轨迹，提供有限样本保证，使加速诱导的失败风险保持在用户指定的预算以下。它部署最快的认证候选方案，若无候选合格则回退到参考策略。由于仅依赖终端结果和测量的计算量，CARE可不变地适用于各种加速机制，同时序贯测试和失败触发的参考轨迹使认证成本保持可控。在四个LIBERO套件上配合OpenVLA-OFT，CARE认证了$9.0$--$10.8\times$的加速，同时保证（在$95\%$置信度下）至少保留$85.8\%$的参考策略可解回合。在严格预算下，无保证的选择器在高达$75\%$的试验中超出预算，而CARE保持在预算内，其序贯形式相比穷举评估减少了$78.9\%$的轨迹数量。CARE进一步推广到$π_{0.5}$的流步数减少，以及Crafter中Qwen3.5-9B和Llama-3.1-8B智能体的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces CARE, a certification method that provides finite-sample statistical guarantees on the acceleration-induced failure risk of VLA inference, by using paired rollouts to select the fastest safe accelerator while preserving most reference-solved episodes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CARE，一种通过配对轨迹提供加速诱导失败风险有限样本统计保证的认证方法，用于在保证保留大部分参考成功回合的前提下选择最快的安全加速器。

title: ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying
summary: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.
summary_zh: 具身智能体和辅助智能体不仅要识别物体，还需推断在特定环境布局及居住者习惯下物体应放置的位置。该问题的研究进展一直受限，部分原因在于缺乏专门的基准测试或数据集来定义和评估该任务。现有的RGB-D扫描数据集重建了静态房间，但未包含人类活动；而人-物交互数据集虽捕捉了动作，却缺少可导航的完整重建场景，也没有物体自然归属地的真值概念。我们提出了“情境化物体放置”作为一项基准任务：即在观察到的物体携带过程中预测物体的目的地。为支持该任务，我们推出了“具身相机观察下的人类物体携带行为”（Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying, ECHO）数据集——这是一个大规模合成数据集，将室内场景的密集RGB-D扫描与具身智能体携带日常物品至情境适当地点的记录相结合。ECHO是首个同时包含重建场景、人类活动、自然语言和情境化放置标注的公开数据集，涵盖115个HM3D场景中159个楼层的3,805个人工标注片段，涉及198种不同物体。每个楼层均配有完整的RGB-D扫描、人工标注的房间标签及表面清单；每个片段则提供同步的RGB-D相遇片段、六自由度相机/人体/物体轨迹、起始与目标表面、动作描述文本，以及一条人工撰写的情境说明——用一句话描述居住者的日常习惯，在不直接指明目的地的情况下暗示其所在。我们通过输入遮蔽探针和端到端基线方法评估了情境化物体放置任务。结果表明，单一输入模态均不足以完成任务，凸显了联合推理场景结构、人类活动与情境知识的必要性。
tldr: ECHO is a large-scale synthetic dataset and benchmark for contextual object placement, pairing dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with embodied human object-carrying episodes and contextual annotations, demonstrating the need for joint reasoning over scene, activity, and context.
tldr_zh: ECHO是一个大规模合成数据集和基准，用于情境化物体放置任务，将室内场景的密集RGB-D扫描与人类携带物体的具身行为片段及情境注释配对，展示了需要联合推理场景、行为和情境。

title: NeRFifyMesh: Optimizing Neural Radiance Fields from Textured Meshes for Robotics Scene Building
summary: In robotics, scene representation plays a pivotal role in understanding and interacting with the environment. The advent of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and its variants, as a novel representation, has opened a new frontier of research. In applications such as semantic mapping and simulation, roboticists aim to build scenes using multiple NeRF models, each representing an object. While extensive datasets of 3D mesh models already exist, there is an urgent need to develop tools to convert these assets to NeRF models for rapid algorithm development and testing. This paper presents a new pipeline for converting existing mesh models to NeRF representations by artificially generating a ground truth point-based radiance field through sampling mesh geometry and texture. This approach alleviates the need for camera-based sampling or rendering multi-view images of the original mesh to train the NeRF model. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that our method yields comparable rendering quality to the baselines. Additionally, the application of this representation is shown by constructing unified NeRF scenes and performing collision simulations with extracted geometry.
summary_zh: 在机器人学中，场景表示对于理解环境并与之交互起着至关重要的作用。神经辐射场（NeRF）及其变体的出现，作为一种新颖的表示方法，开辟了研究的新前沿。在语义映射和模拟等应用中，机器人专家旨在利用多个NeRF模型构建场景，每个模型代表一个物体。尽管已经存在大量3D网格模型数据集，但迫切需要开发工具将这些资源转换为NeRF模型，以支持快速算法开发与测试。本文提出了一种新流程，通过采样网格几何和纹理，人为生成基于点的真实辐射场，从而将现有网格模型转换为NeRF表示。该方法无需基于相机的采样，也无需渲染原始网格的多视角图像来训练NeRF模型。广泛的基准测试表明，我们的方法在渲染质量上与基线方法相当。此外，本文还通过构建统一的NeRF场景并利用提取的几何进行碰撞模拟，展示了该表示的应用价值。
tldr: This paper introduces a pipeline that converts textured mesh models into NeRF representations by generating a point-based radiance field directly from mesh geometry and texture, avoiding multi-view rendering. It demonstrates comparable rendering quality and applications in unified scene construction and collision simulation for robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种将纹理网格模型转换为 NeRF 表示的流程，通过直接从网格几何和纹理生成基于点的辐射场，避免了多视图渲染。实验表明其渲染质量与基线相当，并可应用于统一场景构建和碰撞模拟。

title: Semantic-Aware Predictive Mapping for Exploration and Navigation
summary: Predictive mapping can support robotic exploration and navigation by estimating unseen geometric layouts from partial occupancy observations. However, occupancy-only representations may fail to distinguish semantically different structures with similar geometry. This is particularly relevant for indoor doors, which may appear as occupied cells like walls but indicate possible connected rooms or corridors beyond the observed region. This work investigates whether semantic door cues improve predictive geometric occupancy mapping around such ambiguous regions. We modify a subset of the CogniPlan dataset by inserting door-induced ambiguities into partial occupancy maps while keeping the ground-truth layouts unchanged. We compare a geometry-only control model with a semantic-cued model trained on the same modified dataset, where the semantic-cued model receives an additional door channel. Evaluation uses L1 error, F1 score, and Intersection over Union (IoU) over both the full map and a 10-pixel door-region mask. Full-map performance remains broadly similar between models, but localized door-region results show a clear qualitative improvement: L1 decreases from 0.004342 to 0.000025, while F1 and IoU improve from 0.031311 and 0.015905 to 1.000000 and 1.000000, respectively. These results suggest that semantic cues can improve predictive occupancy completion in regions where geometric observations alone are ambiguous.
summary_zh: 预测性地图构建能够通过部分占用观测估计未见几何布局，从而支持机器人探索与导航。然而，仅基于占用信息的表示可能无法区分几何相似但语义不同的结构。这一问题在室内门场景中尤为突出，因为门在占用栅格中可能表现为与墙壁相同的占用单元，却暗示着观测区域之外可能存在相连的房间或走廊。本研究探讨了语义门线索是否能够改善此类模糊区域周围的预测性几何占用地图生成。我们在CogniPlan数据集的一个子集上进行了修改，在部分占用地图中引入由门导致的模糊性，同时保持真实布局不变。我们将仅基于几何信息的控制模型与在同一修改数据集上训练的语义线索模型进行比较，后者额外接收一个门通道。评估采用L1误差、F1分数以及交并比（IoU），分别在全图和10像素宽的门区域掩码上进行。全图性能在两模型之间总体相似，但局部门区域结果显示出明显的定性改善：L1误差从0.004342降至0.000025，F1分数和IoU分别从0.031311和0.015905提升至1.000000和1.000000。这些结果表明，在仅凭几何观测难以判断的区域，语义线索能够有效改善预测性占用补全效果。
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic-aware predictive mapping approach that incorporates door cues into occupancy map completion, improving geometric prediction in ambiguous regions and potentially aiding robotic exploration and navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种语义感知的预测建图方法，将门线索融入占据栅格图补全，改善了模糊区域的几何预测，有望辅助机器人探索与导航。

title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
summary: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.
summary_zh: 我们推出MultiFly，这是一个面向RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达模态语义感知的真实世界低空无人机数据集。MultiFly包含来自四个郊区场景的17，272个同步样本，为15个语义类别提供了逐帧标注，并附带标定数据和GNSS-RTK/IMU测量值。为避免模态专属标注的高成本和不一致性，我们仅从115张人工标注的RGB图像出发，通过共享几何表示将标签传播至全部四种模态。该方法为额外17，157张RGB图像、17，272张热成像图像、8.4亿个LiDAR点和340万个雷达点生成了语义标签。迁移标注与保留人工标注的平均一致率达到89.93%，全部六组模态对间的平均语义一致性达到90.94%。我们还为四种模态建立了语义分割基准，揭示了密集LiDAR与稀疏雷达数据下不同的架构行为。总体而言，MultiFly为多模态空中感知提供了可扩展的基础，并且据我们所知，是首个将RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达的一致性逐帧语义标注相结合的真实世界低空空中公开基准数据集。数据获取：https://github.com/markus-42/multifly。
tldr: MultiFly introduces a real-world low-altitude UAV dataset with synchronized RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar data and 15-class semantic annotations, significantly reducing annotation cost by propagating labels from only 115 manually labeled RGB images across modalities using shared geometric representations. The dataset includes benchmarks for all modalities, achieving high cross-modal semantic consistency.
tldr_zh: MultiFly 提出了一个真实世界低空无人机数据集，包含同步的 RGB、热成像、LiDAR 和雷达数据以及 15 类语义标注，通过共享几何表示将仅 115 张人工标注的 RGB 图像标签传播到所有模态，大幅降低了标注成本，并为所有模态建立了基准，实现了高跨模态语义一致性。

title: Making Task Abstractions Executable: Control-Aware Layout Repair for a Fixed Controller
summary: A task abstraction can specify the intended events while its spatial layout prevents a fixed agent and controller from completing them. Starting from a supplied structured task record, we compile whole-task tracking, clearance, and actuation requirements into auditable affine layout constraints. We repair only declared continuous coordinates, preserving event order, timing, topology, and the controller. A most-violated-row update admits conditional finite-certification and net-displacement bounds; a same-compiler quadratic projection separates the representation from the optimizer. On three researcher-authored task abstractions, both backends certify all three layouts and complete all 300 fresh paired rollouts per backend. A risk-target sweep also exposes fixed event tests that the chosen certificate cannot satisfy through layout edits alone.
summary_zh: 任务抽象可以指定预期事件，而其空间布局可能会妨碍固定的智能体与控制器完成这些事件。从提供的结构化任务记录出发，我们将整体任务跟踪、清除及驱动要求编译为可审计的仿射布局约束。我们仅修复已声明的连续坐标，同时保持事件顺序、时序、拓扑结构及控制器不变。最违反行更新方法支持条件有限验证与净位移界限；同编译器二次投影将表示与优化器分离。在三个研究人员撰写的任务抽象上，两种后端均验证了所有三种布局，并分别完成了每个后端300次全新的配对轨迹展开。风险目标扫描还揭示了所选证书无法仅通过布局编辑满足的固定事件测试。
tldr: This paper introduces a control-aware layout repair method that compiles task abstractions into affine constraints and repairs spatial layouts to make them executable by a fixed robot controller, demonstrating certification and successful rollouts on three task abstractions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种控制感知的布局修复方法，将任务抽象编译为仿射约束并修复空间布局，使其能被固定机器人控制器执行，并在三个任务抽象上验证了可认证性和成功的 rollout。

title: Design of a Fully Actuated 4-DOF Robotic Finger With Joint-Specific Hybrid Remote Actuation
summary: This paper presents a fully actuated 4-DOF robotic finger using a joint-specific hybrid remote-actuation architecture. The metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint is driven by two coordinated rigid-link transmission sets, whereas the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints are independently actuated by closed-loop wire transmissions incorporating circular rolling-contact joints (RCJs). A larger transmission radius is used at the PIP joint than at the DIP joint. The RCJ wire geometry maintains the total wire-loop length during joint rotation, and the DIP wire routing is designed so that PIP motion does not affect its differential actuation for a fixed MCP configuration. The distal wire transmission, MCP linkage, and fingertip kinematics are analytically modeled. In experiments, the transmission behavior was quantitatively evaluated from the ball-screw displacements measured using ArUco-marker tracking. MCP actuation produced measurable displacements of the PIP and DIP transmission units, whereas isolated PIP and DIP actuation with the MCP fixed supported the intended mechanical decoupling between the distal transmissions. The mean peak fingertip forces under isolated MCP, PIP, and DIP actuation were 21.28 N, 9.22 N, and 5.75 N, respectively. The resulting finger postures were also examined using objects of different geometries and sizes.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种采用关节特定混合远程驱动架构的全驱动四自由度机器人手指。掌指关节由两组协调的刚性连杆传动装置驱动，而近端指间关节和远端指间关节则通过包含圆形滚动接触关节的闭环丝传动装置独立驱动。近端指间关节采用的传动半径大于远端指间关节。滚动接触关节的丝几何结构在关节旋转过程中保持丝环总长度不变，且远端指间关节的丝线路径经过设计，使得在掌指关节构型固定时，近端指间关节的运动不会影响其差动驱动。对远端丝传动、掌指连杆机构及指尖运动学进行了解析建模。实验中，通过ArUco标记跟踪测量滚珠丝杠位移，对传动行为进行了定量评估。掌指关节驱动引起了近端指间关节和远端指间关节传动单元的可测位移，而掌指关节固定时单独的近端指间关节和远端指间关节驱动则验证了远端传动之间预期的机械解耦特性。在掌指关节、近端指间关节和远端指间关节单独驱动下，平均指尖峰值力分别为21.28 N、9.22 N和5.75 N。此外，还使用不同几何形状和尺寸的物体对所得手指姿态进行了检验。
tldr: This paper designs and evaluates a fully actuated 4-DOF robotic finger with a hybrid remote actuation system combining rigid-link and wire-driven transmissions, demonstrating measurable decoupling and fingertip forces.
tldr_zh: 本文设计并评估了一种采用刚性连杆与线驱动混合远程传动、全驱动的四自由度机器人手指，验证了传动解耦与指尖力性能。

title: Decoding Neural Population Dynamics through Robotic Analog
summary: Animal evidence shows that precise voluntary movements arise from rotational neural population dynamics in motor cortex, but their physical effects remain unknown. We developed a robotic analog of biological motor systems with artificial muscles, multimodal sensors, and a neural network controller trained via reinforcement learning. The robotic analog exhibited accurate movements, robustness to damage, and neural population dynamics akin to animals. This task-driven, embodied model illuminates the causal link between neural population dynamics and motor outcomes. We discovered that neural rotations generate oscillatory maneuvers orthogonal to the reaching direction, optimizing trajectory adjustments, which is confirmed by primate neural data. The model also revealed counterintuitive neural energy principles under sensor and motor redundancies, and striking Eureka moments during motor learning, bridging biological and artificial systems. These findings provide new perspectives on how neural dynamics contribute to accurate and flexible movement, inspiring future intelligent robots with animal-like mobility.
summary_zh: 动物方面的证据表明，精准的自主动作源于运动皮层中的旋转神经群体动态，但这些动态对物理世界的影响仍不明确。我们开发了一种生物运动系统的机器人类比模型，配备人工肌肉、多模态传感器以及通过强化学习训练的神经网络控制器。该机器人模型表现出精准的运动能力、对损伤的鲁棒性以及与动物相似的神经群体动态。这种任务驱动、具身化的模型揭示了神经群体动态与运动结果之间的因果联系。我们发现，神经旋转产生与伸展方向正交的振荡性动作，从而优化轨迹调整，这一发现得到了灵长类动物神经数据的证实。该模型还揭示了在传感器和运动冗余条件下的反直觉神经能量原则，以及运动学习过程中令人惊叹的“尤里卡”时刻，从而将生物系统与人工系统紧密联系起来。这些发现为理解神经动态如何促成精准灵活的运动提供了新视角，并启发了具备类动物机动性能的未来智能机器人。
tldr: This paper develops a robotic analog of biological motor systems with a neural network controller to study the causal link between neural population dynamics and motor outcomes, revealing that neural rotations generate oscillatory maneuvers and providing insights into motor learning and energy principles.
tldr_zh: 本文通过构建具有神经网络控制器的机器人模拟系统，研究神经群体动力学与运动结果之间的因果关系，发现神经旋转产生振荡机动，并为运动学习和能量原则提供见解。

title: Borrowed Eyes: Markerless Nano-UAV Flight with an Active Quadruped Observer
summary: Nano unmanned aerial vehicles (nano-UAVs) can navigate confined spaces that larger robots cannot, but their payload capacity severely limits the sensors and compute available for self-localization in global navigation satellite system (GNSS)-denied environments. We present a vision-based system that localizes a nano-UAV from a quadruped robot with an arm-mounted camera. The quadruped tracks the drone, estimates its position in its own coordinate system using segmentation masks and depth, and transmits that position over a real-time radio link. To ensure continuous tracking, we developed a perception-aware nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) that dynamically adjusts the quadruped's body and arm to maximize the drone's visibility, treating observation reliability as a primary control objective. Relying solely on this external estimate, the nano-UAV executed predefined trajectories from takeoff to landing with a median 3D localization error of 59 mm. The system demonstrates robustness against short visual occlusions by smoothly transitioning to onboard inertial flight when line-of-sight is temporarily lost. Ultimately, this framework allows a quadruped to offload the localization burden of a nano-UAV, enabling inspection of complex spaces that neither robot could navigate alone.
summary_zh: 纳米无人机（nano-UAV）能够在大型机器人无法进入的受限空间中导航，但其有效载荷能力严重限制了在全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）拒止环境中用于自主定位的传感器和计算资源。我们提出了一种基于视觉的系统，该系统利用四足机器人上搭载的臂装摄像头对纳米无人机进行定位。四足机器人跟踪无人机，通过分割掩码和深度信息在其自身坐标系中估计无人机位置，并通过实时无线电链路传输该位置。为确保连续跟踪，我们开发了一种感知感知的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），该控制器动态调整四足机器人的身体和机械臂以最大化无人机的可见性，将观测可靠性作为主要控制目标。仅依赖此外部估计，纳米无人机从起飞到着陆执行了预定义轨迹，三维定位误差中位数为59毫米。该系统通过在视线暂时丢失时平滑切换至机载惯性飞行，展现了对短暂视觉遮挡的鲁棒性。最终，该框架使四足机器人能够分担纳米无人机的定位负担，从而实现对两者单独均无法导航的复杂空间的检查。
tldr: This paper presents a vision-based system where a quadruped robot with an arm-mounted camera localizes and tracks a nano-UAV, offloading its localization burden in GNSS-denied environments. The system uses a perception-aware NMPC to maintain visibility and transmits position estimates to the UAV, achieving low-error autonomous flight.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉系统，由带臂载相机的四足机器人定位并跟踪纳米无人机，在无GNSS环境中减轻其定位负担。通过感知感知NMPC保持可见性，并传输位置估计，实现低误差自主飞行。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Generation of Human Assembly Plans
summary: Turning a CAD design into an assembly plan is still largely done by hand, requiring engineers to reason about geometric feasibility, tool access, stability, and the ergonomics of human assembly. In this work, we encode long-established design for assembly (DfA) principles into a contained, end-to-end approach for generating assembly plans. Our approach takes only a mesh assembly and produces either a step-by-step assembly manual or a structured failure report, requiring no joint metadata, fastener annotations, or additional information. Four major components of a manufacturing plan are addressed autonomously: an assembly tool list, the assembly sequence and subassemblies, an assembly manual, and design feedback for improving assemblability. For determining the sequence plan, we systematically disassemble the object in a physics simulator and apply a cost function that encodes DfA principles. Manual generation, tool labelling, and assembly feedback rely primarily on multimodal large language models. Compared with a baseline that always removes the outermost part first from Tian et al., DfA-aware sequence planning reduces simulated assembly time, measured with a robot-arm assembly-time proxy, by 35% on 136 assemblies of 5 to 30 parts. The correct tool is selected for 88.6% of assembly steps. A vision-language model judge compares the generated manuals against ablated variants, identifying which page elements carry the information a reader needs. The presented approach and open-source code are available for use by engineers or AI agents looking to rapidly accelerate the creation of manufacturing plans for a given product design.
summary_zh: 将CAD设计转化为装配方案在很大程度上仍依赖人工完成，工程师需要推理几何可行性、工具可达性、稳定性以及人工装配的人机工程学。在这项工作中，我们将成熟的面向装配设计原则编码为一种自包含的端到端方法，用于生成装配方案。我们的方法仅需输入一个网格装配体，即可生成逐步装配手册或结构化失败报告，无需关节元数据、紧固件标注或其他附加信息。制造方案中的四个主要组成部分被自主处理：装配工具清单、装配顺序与子装配体、装配手册，以及用于改善可装配性的设计反馈。为确定顺序方案，我们在物理模拟器中系统性地拆解对象，并应用一个编码DfA原则的成本函数。手册生成、工具标注和装配反馈主要依赖多模态大语言模型。与Tian等人提出的始终优先移除最外层部件的基线方法相比，基于DfA的顺序规划在136个由5至30个零件组成的装配体上，通过机械臂装配时间代理测量，将模拟装配时间平均减少了35%。在88.6%的装配步骤中，工具选择正确。一个视觉语言模型评审员将生成的手册与消融变体进行比较，识别出哪些页面元素承载了读者所需的信息。所提出的方法和开源代码可供工程师或AI代理使用，以加速为给定产品设计创建制造方案的过程。
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end system that automatically generates human assembly plans from CAD meshes by combining physics-based disassembly planning with multimodal LLMs for manual generation, tool labeling, and design feedback.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种端到端系统，从CAD网格自动生成人工装配计划，结合基于物理的拆卸规划与多模态大语言模型用于手册生成、工具标注和设计反馈。

title: AeroEval: Staged Program and Execution Validation for AI-Generated Drone Missions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate drone programs from natural-language mission descriptions, but syntactically valid programs may still violate user intent, environmental constraints, and mission-level behavior. This problem is pronounced in cyber-physical applications, where correctness depends on the interaction among generated code, mobile sensing, environmental geometry, event-driven analytics, and physical execution. Existing drone code-generation systems primarily use prompt guardrails or simulator outcomes and provide limited failure localization. We present AeroEval, an agent-assisted middleware for staged validation of AI-generated drone missions. AeroEval combines deterministic program analysis with context-grounded LLM agents. It first validates program syntax, platform API usage, and mission intent, and then evaluates the realized behavior using execution trajectories, mission requirements, and environmental context. Each stage returns structured failure information for iterative regeneration. In our evaluation using 20 navigation tasks and five analytical mission types over AirSim and Gazebo simulators, AeroEval improves navigation success from 55% to 95%. In a stagewise ablation study, our Code and Trajectory Validators by themselves achieve mean run-level success rates of 44% and 56%, respectively, while the full AeroEval pipeline achieves 88%; the stages detect complementary failures in program structure, API usage, mission intent, obstacle avoidance, altitude, coverage, and event-driven transitions and the guided regeneration corrects for them. Across the main analytics missions, AeroEval increases aggregate run-level success from 34% for one-shot AeroGen to 88% within the regeneration budget. These results demonstrate the benefit of combining program-level and execution-grounded agentic validation for AI-generated drone applications in the evaluated environment.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够根据自然语言任务描述生成无人机程序，但语法上有效的程序仍可能违反用户意图、环境约束及任务层面的行为规范。这一问题在信息物理系统中尤为突出，因为其正确性取决于生成代码、移动感知、环境几何、事件驱动分析以及物理执行之间的交互。现有的无人机代码生成系统主要依赖提示护栏或模拟器反馈，且故障定位能力有限。我们提出了AeroEval，一种用于AI生成无人机任务分阶段验证的智能体辅助中间件。AeroEval将确定性程序分析与基于上下文的LLM智能体相结合，首先验证程序语法、平台API使用及任务意图，随后利用执行轨迹、任务需求和环境上下文评估实际行为。每个阶段均返回结构化故障信息，以支持迭代式重新生成。在基于AirSim和Gazebo模拟器的20个导航任务及五种分析型任务类型的评估中，AeroEval将导航成功率从55%提升至95%。在分阶段消融实验中，仅使用代码验证器和轨迹验证器时，平均运行级成功率分别为44%和56%，而完整的AeroEval流水线达到88%；各阶段能够检测出程序结构、API使用、任务意图、避障、飞行高度、覆盖范围及事件驱动转换中的互补性故障，并借助引导式重新生成加以纠正。在主要分析型任务中，AeroEval在重新生成预算内将整体运行级成功率从单次AeroGen的34%提升至88%。上述结果表明，在评估环境中，将程序级验证与基于执行的有据可依的智能体验证相结合，对AI生成的无人机应用具有显著的促进作用。
tldr: AeroEval is an agent-assisted middleware that validates AI-generated drone programs through staged program analysis and execution validation, improving navigation success from 55% to 95% in simulated environments.
tldr_zh: AeroEval 是一个代理辅助中间件，通过分阶段的程序分析和执行验证来验证 AI 生成的无人机程序，在模拟环境中将导航成功率从 55% 提高到 95%。

title: MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中进行自主导航，需要计算满足非完整运动约束的时空轨迹。当移动障碍物的轨迹可预测或已知时，一种有效的方法是结合由预计算可行运动基元构建的状态格栅与安全间隔路径规划——一种具有强理论保证的基于搜索的算法。尽管该方法能够生成可行路径，但实现平滑导航所需的丰富基元集会带来较大的分支因子，在与时间相关的障碍物间隔耦合时，计算成本会显著增加。为此，我们提出了MeshSIPP，一种高效的规划器，通过利用许多基元扫过相同区域这一特性，将它们整体进行验证，从而消除计算瓶颈。MeshSIPP将基元作为空间束进行传播，通过轻量级的包围间隔检查进行筛选，并将精确出发时间的昂贵搜索延迟到基元到达其终端状态之后。此外，一种时间感知的剪枝规则在搜索早期即丢弃冗余的时空分支。我们证明了该搜索算法具有完备性和最优性。在超过6,000个基准实例及实时ROS 2仿真中的大量实验表明，MeshSIPP相较于最先进的时空规划器实现了最高3倍的加速比。
tldr: MeshSIPP accelerates lattice-based spatiotemporal path planning by grouping motion primitives into bundles, using early pruning and deferred exact checks, achieving up to 3x speedup in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: MeshSIPP 通过将运动原语分组为束、早期剪枝和延迟精确检查，加速基于格子的时空路径规划，在动态环境中实现高达 3 倍的加速。

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
summary: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.
summary_zh: 现实应用要求6D姿态估计具备准确性、速度快且能扩展到未见物体的能力。本文提出了WAPR，一种零样本宽角度姿态细化模型，能够对旋转偏差高达90度的候选姿态进行细化。对于每个检测到的物体实例，仅需12个候选姿态，WAPR即可在每帧1秒内完成快速推理，并实现每秒最多25个检测物体实例的姿态估计吞吐量。为支持旋转对称物体的宽角度训练，WAPR利用旋转对称先验，在损失计算之前对对称等价姿态目标进行规范化处理。我们进一步构建了SA6D，一个带有此类先验的大规模6D训练数据集。SA6D为944个GSO扫描获取了KASAL辅助的旋转对称先验，并通过几何与纹理增强将其扩展为约5万个增强物体实例和约200万张渲染的RGB-D图像。此外，角度平衡损失通过降低无信息大误差案例的影响，稳定了不同角度范围的学习过程。在七个BOP核心数据集上的实验表明，WAPR在快速和非受限推理设置下，均达到了未见物体6D姿态定位与检测的最新性能水平。项目页面：https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR。
tldr: WAPR introduces a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model for unseen 6D object pose estimation, using rotational symmetry priors and a large synthetic dataset to achieve state-of-the-art performance on BOP benchmarks.
tldr_zh: WAPR提出了一种用于未知物体6D姿态估计的零样本广角精化模型，利用旋转对称先验和大规模合成数据集，在BOP基准上取得了最先进性能。

title: ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
summary: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.
summary_zh: 随着机器人在多样化的任务中日益辅助人类，它们需要对其周围环境具备几何与语义的双重理解。此外，机器人常常在陌生环境中运行，并在事先不了解相关概念的情况下承担新任务。这促使了支持开放词汇场景理解与人机交互的语言标注三维地图的发展。我们提出了ActiveLang，一种自主系统，用于主动的开放词汇三维建图，并辅以语义不确定性引导的探索。ActiveLang在紧凑的双高斯表示上执行在线语言特征自适应，以适度的内存开销联合重建场景几何、外观及开放词汇语义。其规划器高效地选择信息丰富的视点，从而以更少的观测和较低的计算成本实现有效建图。在Replica和ScanNet++上的实验表明，在二维和三维开放词汇分割方面，相较于在线及离线基线均有显著提升，凸显了主动探索场景能够更高效地构建语言标注的三维地图。
tldr: ActiveLang introduces an autonomous active mapping system that uses semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration to build open-vocabulary 3D maps efficiently, integrating online language-feature adaptation in a dual-Gaussian representation, and demonstrates improved segmentation and mapping on Replica and ScanNet++.
tldr_zh: ActiveLang 提出了一种基于语义不确定性引导探索的自主主动建图系统，通过在线语言特征适应和紧凑双高斯表示高效构建开放词汇3D地图，在Replica和ScanNet++上展示了更好的分割和建图效果。

title: COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance
summary: Robots are increasingly expected to provide personalized services in everyday environments. To do so, they must ground natural-language commands such as "Where is my backpack?" or "Find my bottle" and execute them by reasoning about object instances, people, locations, and ownership. This is challenging because ownership is rarely labeled explicitly and must be inferred from long-term, behavioral evidence of human-object interactions. To address this, we present COOL, a novel robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from everyday observations and maintaining a long-term spatial memory of its environment. To keep its memory current, COOL uses an agent-based curiosity-driven data collection strategy that guides the robot toward the most promising locations to gain information and refresh stale observations. Offline experiments, ablation studies, and real-world evaluations show that COOL can infer ownership relations from real-world interactions and use this knowledge for ownership-conditioned navigation and task execution.
summary_zh: 机器人日益被期望在日常环境中提供个性化服务。为此，它们必须理解诸如“我的背包在哪里？”或“找到我的瓶子”等自然语言指令，并通过推理对象实例、人物、地点和所有权来执行这些指令。这一任务颇具挑战性，因为所有权关系很少被明确标注，必须从长期的行为证据中推断人与物体之间的互动。为解决这一问题，我们提出了COOL，一种新颖的机器人框架，能够从日常观察中自主学习物体所有权，并维护其环境的长期空间记忆。为了保持记忆的时效性，COOL采用了一种基于智能体的、由好奇心驱动的数据收集策略，引导机器人前往最有价值的位置获取信息并刷新过时的观察数据。离线实验、消融研究以及真实世界评估表明，COOL能够从真实互动中推断所有权关系，并利用这些知识进行基于所有权的导航和任务执行。
tldr: COOL presents a robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from long-term observations and using curiosity-driven exploration to maintain a spatial memory, enabling personalized navigation and task execution.
tldr_zh: COOL 提出了一种机器人框架，能够从长期观察中自主学习物体所有权，并通过好奇心驱动的探索维护空间记忆，从而实现个性化的导航和任务执行。

title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
summary: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.
summary_zh: 用于衡量动作条件世界模型质量的基准测试仍在不断演变，正从基于视觉相似性的指标转向动作语义和物理基础指标。然而，对于领域无关和任务无关的动作条件世界模型训练，现有基准提供的信号十分有限。通过在《反恐精英》游戏数据上训练和评估扩散世界模型，我们确认了定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS和JEDi等指标并不对应。我们将此称为“虚拟到现实差距”。我们认为，在缺乏可靠基准的情况下，整理原始游戏数据并测量多种诊断属性，能够在训练开始前提供更稳健的信号，从而弥合这一差距。我们提出了若干数据整理策略，并介绍了一个面向物理AI数据整理的通用工具包，名为Kuration SDK，本文随附开源该SDK。该SDK在揭示虚拟到现实差距的根本原因方面发挥了关键作用，具体案例为：尽管两个世界模型在相同游戏地图、动作和状态分布上训练，其LPIPS和FVD得分非常相似，但在实际游戏表现上却差异显著。因此，Kuration SDK有潜力揭示特定数据集中虚拟到现实差距的根本原因，并加速样本高效训练数据集的开发。
tldr: The paper introduces Kuration SDK, a data curation toolkit for action-conditioned world models, which addresses the Virtual2Real gap by showing that raw gameplay data diagnostics are more reliable than standard visual metrics; it also uncovered why two world models with similar metrics behaved differently in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本论文介绍了Kuration SDK，一个用于动作条件世界模型的数据整理工具包，通过展示原始游戏数据诊断比标准视觉度量更可靠，解决了虚拟到现实差距的问题；并揭示了两个具有相似指标的世界模型在模拟中表现不同的原因。

title: geodex: A Library for Motion Planning on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Planning motions that respect the intrinsic geometry of a robot's configuration space, including its curvature and a configuration-dependent notion of cost, yields shorter, lower-energy, and more natural trajectories than planning under the ambient flat metric. Existing libraries for optimization on manifolds provide rich geometric primitives but do not plan around obstacles. While general-purpose motion planning libraries support many state spaces and custom distance functions, they do not yet treat a configuration-dependent Riemannian metric as the geometry that drives distance, interpolation, and geodesics. We present geodex, an open-source C++20 library with Python bindings. The library exposes the manifold, its Riemannian metric, the retraction, and the sampler as independent, interchangeable components through a single sampling-based motion planning interface. The same planner runs unchanged on canonical spaces $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathbb{T}^n$, $\mathbb{S}^n$, matrix Lie groups such as $SO(2)$, $SE(2)$, $SO(3)$, and $SE(3)$, products of these spaces, and articulated-robot configuration spaces, each equipped with a user-defined Riemannian metric. We make geodex publicly available with documentation, tests, and a reproducible benchmark suite.
summary_zh: 规划尊重机器人构型空间内在几何特性（包括曲率和与构型相关的代价概念）的运动，相比在环境平坦度量下进行的规划，能够产生更短、更低能耗且更自然的轨迹。现有的流形优化库提供了丰富的几何原语，但无法处理障碍物周围的规划问题。通用运动规划库虽然支持多种状态空间和自定义距离函数，但尚未将依赖于构型的黎曼度量作为驱动距离、插值和测地线的几何基础。我们提出了geodex，一个带有Python绑定的开源C++20库。该库通过统一的基于采样的运动规划接口，将流形、其黎曼度量、收缩映射和采样器作为独立且可互换的组件暴露出来。同一规划器无需修改即可在典型空间$\mathbb{R}^n$、$\mathbb{T}^n$、$\mathbb{S}^n$、矩阵李群（如$SO(2)$、$SE(2)$、$SO(3)$和$SE(3)$）、这些空间的积空间以及铰接机器人构型空间上运行，每种空间均配备用户自定义的黎曼度量。我们公开发布了geodex，并附带文档、测试以及可复现的基准测试套件。
tldr: geodex is an open-source C++20 library for sampling-based motion planning on Riemannian manifolds, enabling planners to respect configuration-space curvature and metrics across a variety of spaces including robot configuration spaces.
tldr_zh: geodex 是一个开源的 C++20 库，用于黎曼流形上的基于采样的运动规划，使规划器能够尊重配置空间的曲率和度量，适用于多种空间，包括机器人配置空间。

title: A Unified Kinematic Representation Enables Reusable Biological Joint Moment Estimation
summary: Objective: Data-driven models that estimate physiological states, particularly biological joint moments, are widely used in exoskeleton control. However, these estimators are often coupled to device-specific sensor configurations, limiting controller transfer and the use of open-source biomechanics datasets. Methods: We proposed joint kinematics as an intermediate representation that decouples hardware-specific sensing from downstream biological joint moment estimation. A joint-moment estimator using joint angles and angular velocities was trained exclusively on open-source biomechanics data and evaluated using kinematics from a hip exoskeleton, knee exoskeleton, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor suite during level-ground, ramp-ascent, and ramp-descent walking. Results: The estimator achieved an root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.17 Nm/kg and coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.79 using hip exoskeleton kinematics, 0.19 Nm/kg and 0.62 using knee exoskeleton kinematics, and 0.15 Nm/kg and 0.85 using kinematics derived from IMUs across bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Conclusion: Joint kinematics enabled an estimator trained only on open-source data to operate across distinct wearable platforms. Significance: This framework may reduce target-device data collection and support transferable biological joint moment estimation for exoskeleton control and wearable biomechanics.
summary_zh: 目的：估算生理状态（特别是生物关节力矩）的数据驱动模型被广泛用于外骨骼控制中。然而，这些估算器通常与特定设备的传感器配置相耦合，限制了控制器的迁移以及开源生物力学数据集的使用。方法：我们提出将关节运动学作为中间表示，将硬件特定的感知与下游生物关节力矩估算解耦。一个使用关节角度和角速度的关节力矩估算器仅在开源生物力学数据上训练，并利用髋部外骨骼、膝部外骨骼和惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器套件在平地行走、斜坡上行走和斜坡下行走中的运动学数据进行评估。结果：该估算器在使用髋部外骨骼运动学数据时，均方根误差（RMSE）为0.17 Nm/kg，决定系数（R²）为0.79；使用膝部外骨骼运动学数据时，RMSE为0.19 Nm/kg，R²为0.62；使用基于IMU推导的双侧髋、膝、踝关节运动学数据时，RMSE为0.15 Nm/kg，R²为0.85。结论：关节运动学使得仅基于开源数据训练的估算器能够在不同的可穿戴平台上运行。意义：该框架可能减少目标设备的数据采集，并支持可迁移的生物关节力矩估算，用于外骨骼控制和可穿戴生物力学应用。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified kinematic representation (joint angles and angular velocities) to decouple hardware-specific sensing from biological joint moment estimation, enabling a model trained on open-source biomechanics data to work across hip/knee exoskeletons and IMU suites.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种统一的运动学表示（关节角度和角速度），将硬件特定传感与生物关节力矩估计解耦，使得仅用开源生物力学数据训练的模型可跨髋/膝外骨骼及IMU套件使用。

title: Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage
summary: Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection. We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.
summary_zh: 深空任务中的乘组无法依赖实时地面支持来处理紧急的非正常事件。初始警报可能无法充分确定原因，而具有判别性的证据可能存在于乘组观测中，或位于对乘组检查而言不安全、成本过高或无法到达的地点。我们提出了一种基于证据驱动的架构，用于人-智能体-机器人团队在地球独立异常分诊中的协作。智能体AI被视为有状态协调器，运行于有界、可检查的服务之上，而非完全自主的飞行器控制器。分诊状态管理器维护假设、证据来源、不确定性、运行背景和工具状态；面向乘组的具身智能体负责引导观测并解释评估变化；移动机器人则获取有针对性的局部证据。类型化接口将对话与编排从监控、机器人指令、背景检索和安全关键控制中分离。两个场景说明了该架构：一个基于国际空间站实际氨泄漏误报的载人深空任务，其中疑似污染限制了乘组进入；另一个是载人月球基地的电源接口异常场景，其中机器人检查区分了局部连接器故障与遥测中模糊的其他原因。我们的主要贡献是一种权限有界的闭环证据架构，并在一个硬件在环集成原型中进行了验证，该原型使用Reachy Mini和Innate MARS移动机器人实现。
tldr: This paper presents an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage, featuring a stateful AI coordinator, a crew-facing embodied agent, and a mobile robot for targeted evidence collection, validated in a hardware-in-the-loop prototype.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向地外自主异常分诊的人-智能体-机器人团队协作的循证驱动架构，包含有状态AI协调器、面向乘员的具身智能体以及用于定向证据采集的移动机器人，并在硬件在环原型中进行了验证。

title: Hall Effect-Based Tactile Force Detection Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery has revolutionized surgical practice. However, as the surgeons are mechanically separated from the surgical tools, loss of tactile feedback occurs. We present a compact force sensor with three, millimeter scale sensing elements (taxels) that can be affixed to the grasping face of a robotic surgical tool. The sensor features a miniaturized design using Hall effect sensors and magnets embedded in a deformable elastomer contact layer. Sensor calibration is achieved with a 6 degree of freedom (DoF) parallel robot. Each taxel can detect applied normal and shear forces with average RMSE of 2.133 kPa. The calibrated sensor was validated on phantom and ex vivo porcine tissue, demonstrating tactile sensing during retraction as well as slip. This work introduces a small-scale Hall effect based tactile sensor, enabling sensing for force-sensitive robotic surgical applications.
tldr: This paper presents a compact Hall effect-based tactile force sensor for robotic minimally invasive surgery, enabling normal and shear force detection on surgical tools, validated on phantom and ex vivo tissue.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于机器人微创手术的紧凑型霍尔效应触觉力传感器，能够在手术工具上检测法向力和剪切力，并在模型组织和离体猪组织上进行了验证。

title: NAViLoss: An Underwater Navigation-Aware Dual-Residual Objective for Physics-Consistent Learning
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) commonly rely on inertial navigation systems (INS) aided by Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for reliable underwater navigation. Accurate DVL velocity estimation is therefore essential for successful operation. Recent learning-based methods have demonstrated improved DVL velocity estimation, particularly under degraded measurement conditions. However, their training objectives typically rely on conventional regression losses that are highly sensitive to large residuals and corrupted observations. Additionally, they do not explicitly account for the physical consistency and measurement uncertainty associated with the underlying sensing process.
